Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MARR框架，通过将多模态适应能力分配到三个层面（策略路由、模态私有残差执行、图像域残差校正），实现PET、CT、MRI的统一医学图像恢复，无需退化标签或独立模态专属模型，在基准上超越13种方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全一体医学图像恢复中，PET、CT和MRI在退化统计、解剖对比度和输出空间偏差上差异显著，完全共享的网络会纠缠模态特异性残差误差，而完全分离的模态专属网络又牺牲了统一部署的实际优势。因此需要找到有限的适配能力应该被放置在何处的问题。

Method: 提出MARR紧凑恢复框架，将多模态适应约束到三个方面：(1) 退化感知策略路由（policy routing）：策略分支从输入统计、潜在内容和模态身份形成路由提示，仅用作控制信号；(2) 模态私有残差执行（modality-private residual execution）：通过提示门控的模态私有适配器在中级解码器阶段执行轻量残差细化；(3) 图像域残差校正（output calibration）：零初始化的模态专属输出头校准最终图像域残差，不扰动初始共享预测。

Result: 在PET/CT/MRI一体化恢复基准上超越13种同协议重训练的方法，PET、CT、MRI分别达到PSNR 37.34 dB、33.85 dB、32.09 dB，取得最佳模态平均PSNR 34.43 dB。

Conclusion: MARR通过将多模态适应定位在策略选择、特征执行和输出校准三个精细层面，在无需退化标签或独立专属模型的前提下有效解耦了模态特异性信息，兼顾了恢复性能与统一部署的实用性。

Abstract: All-in-one medical image restoration seeks to recover heterogeneous clinical images with a single model, but PET, CT, and MRI differ substantially in degradation statistics, anatomical contrast, and output-space bias. A fully shared network can entangle modality-specific residual errors, whereas separate modality-specific networks sacrifice the practical advantages of unified deployment. We therefore recast all-in-one restoration as a question of where limited adaptation should be placed: policy selection, feature execution, or output calibration. We propose MARR, a compact restoration framework that constrains multi-modality adaptation into degradation-aware policy routing, modality-private residual execution, and image-domain residual correction without requiring degradation labels or separate modality-specific models. The policy branch forms a routing prompt from input statistics, latent content, and modality identity, and uses it only as a control signal. Prompt-gated modality-private adapters then perform lightweight residual refinement at intermediate decoder stages, while zero-initialized modality-specific output heads calibrate the final image-domain residual without perturbing the initial shared prediction. On an all-in-one PET, CT, and MRI restoration benchmark, MARR outperforms thirteen methods re-trained under the same protocol, achieving PSNR values of 37.34 dB, 33.85 dB, and 32.09 dB on PET, CT, and MRI, respectively, and the best modality-average PSNR of 34.43 dB. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/CHB-learner/MARR.

</details>


### [108] [When Does a Laugh Begin? Structured Annotator Disagreement in Temporal Laughter Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06646)
*Eyal Hanania,Daniel Arkushin,Naveh Ayal,Jonathan Benvenisti,Amos Bercovich,Elie Zemmour,Sahar Froim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示了时间笑声定位任务中标注者分歧的结构性特征，并提出了一种基于一致性校准的分歧校准评估方法。通过在SMILE-Temporal基准上重新标注（每视频3-5名标注者），发现分歧在笑声结束偏移处比起始处大1.73倍，微小笑声比完整大笑更易产生分歧（77% vs 20%），且可从事件属性预测（AUC=0.831）。传统单标注评估会导致系统评分波动0.246 F1，正确排序系统的概率仅69.7%。提出的方法利用一致性校准的容忍带对完整标注分布评分（偏移容忍带0.727s，起始0.5s），显著提升评估可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前时间笑声定位任务使用单一参考标注进行评估，但标注者对笑声边界和小声轻笑常存在分歧。如果这种分歧是结构性的而非随机噪声，那么单标注评估将产生系统性偏差，导致系统评分和排序不可靠。因此需要理解分歧的结构特征并设计更稳健的评估方法。

Method: 1) 在SMILE-Temporal基准（672个视频、1,683个事件）上重新标注，每视频3-5名标注者，计算标注者间一致性（alpha=0.757）；2) 分析分歧的结构模式（起始vs偏移、轻笑vs大笑、事件属性预测性）；3) 对比单标注评估与多标注评估对系统排名的影响；4) 提出分歧校准的评估方法，使用一致性校准的容忍带对预测与完整标注者分布进行评分。

Result: 分歧具有系统性结构：偏移处分歧比起始处大1.73倍；轻笑分歧率77%远高于大笑的20%；事件属性可预测分歧（AUC=0.831）。单标注评估随选择不同导致0.246 F1的系统评分波动，正确排序系统仅69.7%的时间（对比全标注者的80%）。提出的分歧校准评估使用非对称容忍带（偏移0.727s vs 起始0.5s）。

Conclusion: 标注者分歧在笑声定位中是结构化的而非随机噪声，应采用多标注者评估来获得更可靠的系统排名。提出的分歧校准评估方法利用一致性校准的容忍带，能更公平地评价预测质量，并公开了标注数据和代码以促进可复现研究。

Abstract: Annotators routinely disagree on laughter boundaries and subtle chuckles, yet temporal laughter localization typically evaluates against a single reference annotation. We show that this disagreement is structured rather than random noise. Re-annotating the SMILE-Temporal benchmark (672 videos, 1,683 events) with 3-5 annotators per video (alpha = 0.757), we find systematic patterns: disagreement is 1.73 times larger at offsets than onsets, far more common for chuckles than full laughs (77% vs. 20%), and predictable from event attributes (AUC = 0.831). Evaluating against a single annotator breaks down under this structure: system scores shift by 0.246 F1 depending on the chosen ground truth, correctly ranking systems only 69.7% of the time (vs. 80% against all annotators). We propose a disagreement-calibrated evaluation that scores predictions against the full annotator distribution using conformally calibrated tolerance bands (wider at offsets, 0.727s, than onsets, 0.5s). The per-annotator annotations and analysis code are available at https://github.com/WSCSports/SMILE-Disagreement .

</details>


### [109] [VidaForge: Open Research Infrastructure for Video Pretraining Data Recipes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06652)
*Yan Ma,Jiadi Su,Zhulin Hu,Ethan Chern,Linhao Zhang,Tiantian Mi,Pengfei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VIDAFORGE，一个开放的视频数据配方研究基础设施，将视频数据制作流程抽象为五阶段可执行工作流，并基于此对比不同覆盖率和质量的数据配方对Wan 2.1和V-JEPA 2.1早期预训练的影响，同时发布包含314万场景级片段、总计6475小时及细粒度标注的VIDAFORGE-3M数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频基础模型越来越依赖大规模预训练数据，但端到端数据管道通常封闭、难以检查和复用。研究者若想探究视频数据配方如何影响模型预训练，往往需要先构建大量基础设施才能验证一个聚焦的假设，缺乏开放、标准化的研究基础设施。

Method: 将视频数据配方表示为从原始视频到训练数据集的可执行五阶段工作流；工作流中的决策可以灵活变化以构造替代数据集，同时保留每个样本的产生过程。基于此框架，在Wan 2.1和V-JEPA 2.1的早期从零预训练中对比不同覆盖率和质量的数据配方。

Result: 在两种学习目标下，更广覆盖率的数据配方在下游基准测试中取得最高分数，而基于损失的评估则偏好不同的配方。同时发布了VIDAFORGE-3M数据集，包含314万个场景级片段，总计6475小时，带有细粒度标注和策展信号。

Conclusion: VIDAFORGE证明了其能够将数据配方选择与下游模型性能建立联系，为视频数据配方的可复现、可检测研究提供了开放基础设施，有助于推动视频基础模型数据工程的透明化和科学化。

Abstract: Video foundation models increasingly rely on large-scale pretraining data, yet the end-to-end data pipelines behind them remain largely closed and difficult to inspect or reuse. Researchers seeking to understand how video data recipes affect model pretraining often need to build substantial infrastructure before testing even a focused hypothesis. We present VIDAFORGE, an open research infrastructure that represents a video data recipe as an executable five-stage workflow from raw videos to training datasets. A decision in this workflow can be varied to construct alternative datasets while preserving how every sample was produced. To demon strate this research workflow, we compare data recipes with different coverage and quality in early from-scratch pretraining of Wan 2.1 and V-JEPA 2.1. Across both learning objectives, the broader-coverage recipe achieves the highest downstream benchmark scores, while loss-based evaluation favors different recipes. This study demonstrates how VidaForge connects data-recipe choices to downstream model performance. We further release VIDAFORGE-3M, containing 3.14 million scene level clips totaling 6,475 hours, with fine-grained annotations and curation signals for video data-recipe research.

</details>


### [110] [FSAN: Flow State Attention Network for Aerodynamic Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06660)
*Wenxuan Jin,Jianguo Yao,Haibing Guan,Xijun Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出流状态注意力网络（FSAN），一种用于空气动力学预测的深度学习代理模型。FSAN将几何点云与流动条件分开编码，并通过可学习的软分配将几何划分为多个流动状态，实现几何与流动信息的状态级细粒度交互，在Emmi-Wing和DrivAerNet++两个基准上分别比最强基线降低20%和10%以上的REL-L2误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CFD仿真计算昂贵且依赖专家经验，限制了其在迭代设计和实时分析中的应用。现有深度学习代理模型存在两大局限：(i) 在窄流动条件范围的数据集上评估，复杂流动条件下的性能未得到验证；(ii) 将全局流动条件作为单一向量均匀注入所有表面点，忽略了不同几何区域经历的局部流动现象差异，降低了复杂流动条件下的预测精度。

Method: FSAN（Flow State Attention Network）包含三个关键步骤：首先分别编码点云和流动条件；然后通过可学习的软分配机制将几何划分为多个流动状态；最后利用流动特征更新这些状态表征，并通过状态变化影响点云特征，实现几何与流动信息之间细粒度、状态特定的交互。

Result: 在两个公认的空气动力学基准上验证了FSAN的有效性：在Emmi-Wing上，相比最强基线Transolver，REL-L2误差降低超过20%；在DrivAerNet++上，相比最强基线AdaField，误差降低10%。但值得注意的是其计算成本更高。结果确立了FSAN作为在多样流动条件和几何体的公共基准上有前景的神经替代模型。

Conclusion: FSAN通过状态级的几何-流动交互机制，有效解决了现有深度学习代理在复杂流动条件下精度不足的问题，在公共基准上取得了领先性能，为高效空气动力学预测提供了一种有前景的解决方案，尽管以更高的计算成本为代价。

Abstract: Accurate aerodynamic prediction is critical for designing fuel-efficient and safe transportation systems such as aircraft and automobiles, yet traditional computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations remain computationally expensive and expertise-intensive, severely limiting their use in iterative design and real-time analysis. Existing deep learning surrogates suffer from two major limitations: (i) they are evaluated on datasets with narrow flow-condition ranges, leaving their performance under complex flow conditions undemonstrated; (ii) they treat global flow conditions as a single vector injected uniformly across all surface points, ignoring that different geometric regions experience distinct local flow phenomena, which degrades prediction accuracy under complex flow conditions. To address these limitations, we propose the Flow State Attention Network (FSAN). FSAN separately encodes point cloud and flow conditions, then partitions the geometry into multiple flow states via learnable soft assignments, and uses flow features to update these state representations, which in turn influence point cloud features through state changes. This enables fine-grained, state-specific interaction between geometry and flow information. Extensive experiments on two well-recognized aerodynamic benchmarks demonstrate that FSAN achieves the highest accuracy among the methods compared in this work at a higher computational cost. On Emmi-Wing, FSAN reduces the Relative L2 (REL-L2) error by over 20\% compared to the strongest baseline (Transolver), and on DrivAerNet++, it achieves a 10\% reduction compared to the strongest baseline (AdaField). These results establish FSAN as a promising neural surrogate on public benchmarks with diverse flow conditions and geometries.

</details>


### [111] [TransNormal-2: Geometry-Grounded Rectified Flow with Edge-Aware Decoding for Precise Normal Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06665)
*Mingwei Li,Yi Yang,Hehe Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TransNormal-2是一个基于FLUX.2的整流流（rectified-flow）框架，用于单目几何估计（法线预测），核心解决VAE解码器导致的像素空间精度退化问题。通过引入像素空间的几何感知损失（含逆向渲染自一致性、von Mises-Fisher角度损失、小波边缘正则）和轻量级几何精修模块（GRM），在通用场景基准上匹配或超越MoGe-2，且仅需其1.4%的任务特定法线标注量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型用于单目几何估计时，像素空间精度受限于一个此前被低估的误差源——VAE重构退化。VAE编码-解码的8倍空间压缩会严重退化物体边界处的表面法线，即使对真值法线进行编解码也会引入1.3-8.5°的平均角度误差（MAE），且边缘MAE高达全局MAE的2.8倍。这一问题严重制约了扩散模型法线估计的精度上限。

Method: 提出TransNormal-2框架，从VAE解码器的两侧同时解决退化问题：（1）训练侧——在潜空间MSE损失之外，补充像素空间的几何感知损失，包括逆向渲染自一致性（模拟漫反射成像线索）、von Mises-Fisher角损失（约束球面法线几何结构）、小波边缘感知正则（强化边界精度）；（2）推理侧——引入轻量级几何精修模块（GRM），利用RGB引导的残差修正来降低边界局部的解码误差，且不重写粗略预测的整体结构。整个框架采用单步确定性推理的整流流范式。

Result: 在通用场景基准上，TransNormal-2在全部八项评估指标上匹配或超越MoGe-2，而仅使用其1.4%的任务特定法线标注。在透明物体这一最具挑战的场景中提升最为显著：ClearGrasp上MAE降低4.2°，ClearPose上MAE降低3.1°，均超过此前最强基线。

Conclusion: TransNormal-2证明了扩散模型单目几何估计的精度瓶颈可归因于VAE解码退化，且通过在训练损失和推理修正两个层面进行针对性设计，能以极低的标注成本显著提升法线估计精度，尤其在透明物体等边界误差集中场景中表现突出。

Abstract: Diffusion-based models enable monocular geometry estimation, yet their pixel-space precision is limited by a shared, under-studied error source: VAE reconstruction degradation. The 8x spatial compression in the VAE encoder-decoder degrades surface normals at object boundaries; even encoding and decoding ground-truth normals introduces 1.3--8.5° of mean angular error (MAE), with edge MAE reaching 2.8x the global MAE. We present TransNormal-2, a FLUX.2-based rectified-flow framework with single-step deterministic inference that addresses this degradation on both sides of the VAE decoder: in how latent predictions are supervised during training, and in how decoded normals are corrected at inference. First, geometry-aware pixel-space losses, including inverse rendering self-consistency, von~Mises-Fisher angular loss, and wavelet edge-aware regularization, complement latent MSE by enforcing spherical normal geometry and diffuse image-formation cues after VAE decoding. Second, a lightweight Geometric Refinement Module (GRM) applies an RGB-guided residual correction to reduce boundary-localized decoding errors without freely rewriting the coarse prediction. On general-scene benchmarks, TransNormal-2 matches or exceeds MoGe-2 on all eight reported metrics while using only 1.4% as many task-specific normal annotations. The gains are clearest for transparent objects, reducing MAE by 4.2° on ClearGrasp and 3.1° on ClearPose over the strongest prior baselines. Code will be released at https://longxiang-ai.github.io/TransNormal-2.

</details>


### [112] [Attention-Enhanced Deep Features with Heterogeneous Ensemble Learning for Glaucoma Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06699)
*Abdullah Al Shafi,Nishat Sadaf Lira,Abrar Hasan,Kazi Saeed Alam,Swapnil Kundu Argha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种混合青光眼检测框架，结合了注意力增强的深度特征提取（InceptionV3+CBAM）与异构集成学习（SLE和DLE策略），并采用SMOTE+Tomek Links处理类别不平衡问题。实验表明该方法优于手工特征和纯深度特征方法，Grad-CAM可视化也证实了模型关注临床相关区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 青光眼早期诊断至关重要，但现有深度学习检测方法存在三个主要问题：忽略特征细化、受类别不平衡影响、依赖单一分类器导致预测鲁棒性不足。

Method: 采用InceptionV3提取深度特征，结合卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）细化可判别性视网膜特征；使用多种机器学习模型配合单层集成（SLE）和双层集成（DLE）策略进行分类；利用SMOTE+Tomek Links（SMOTE+TL）缓解类别不平衡；并对手工特征、深度特征和注意力增强深度特征进行系统比较。

Result: 在两个公开视网膜眼底数据集上的实验表明：深度特征方法一致优于手工特征方法，提出的注意力增强框架取得了最佳整体性能；Grad-CAM可视化确认模型聚焦于临床相关的视网膜区域。

Conclusion: 注意力增强的深度特征结合异质集成学习能够有效提升青光眼自动检测的准确性和鲁棒性，同时Grad-CAM提供了可解释性证据，验证了模型预测过程的临床合理性。

Abstract: Glaucoma is a progressive optic neuropathy characterized by irreversible damage to the optic nerve, making timely diagnosis critical to prevent permanent vision loss. Although deep learning has demonstrated promising performance in automated glaucoma detection, existing approaches often overlook feature refinement, suffer from class imbalance, and rely on individual classifiers that limit prediction robustness. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hybrid glaucoma detection framework that integrates attention-enhanced deep feature extraction with heterogeneous ensemble learning. Specifically, deep representations are extracted using InceptionV3 and subsequently refined by incorporating the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) to enhance discriminative retinal features. To improve classification robustness, the extracted features are classified using multiple machine learning models together with Single-Level Ensemble (SLE) and Double-Level Ensemble (DLE) strategies, while SMOTE combined with Tomek Links (SMOTE+TL) is employed to alleviate class imbalance. Furthermore, a systematic comparison of handcrafted, deep, and attention-enhanced deep feature representations is conducted. Experimental evaluation on two public retinal fundus datasets demonstrates that deep feature-based methods consistently outperform handcrafted feature-based methods, while the proposed attention-enhanced framework achieves the best overall performance. Furthermore, Grad-CAM visualizations confirm that the proposed model focuses on clinically relevant retinal regions, providing interpretable evidence on the model's prediction process.

</details>


### [113] [Counterfactual Tests for Measuring Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness in Visual Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06704)
*Bayar Menzat,Maximilian Süss,Ruizhi Wang,Benno Steinegger,Thomas Lukasiewicz,Oana-Maria Camburu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出两种用于视觉输入的反事实测试方法(vCT和vCCT)，用于评估视觉语言模型(VLM)中思维链(CoT)的忠实性。实验发现CoT并不总是可靠地追踪影响模型预测的视觉证据，而Predict-then-Explain解释与扰动导致的概率变化对齐程度更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 思维链推理虽然看起来合理，但可能无法忠实反映模型的真实决策过程。已有衡量文本输入CoT忠实性的方法难以直接应用于视觉输入，需要针对视觉输入进行适配。

Method: 将反事实测试(CT)和相关性反事实测试(CCT)适配到视觉输入，提出vCT和vCCT方法。通过物体移除的图像编辑构造反事实图像对，并引入重建控制以排除编辑管线本身的干扰。构建Counter-SNLI-VE和Counter-A-OKVQA数据集。

Result: 在8个开源VLM和2个数据集上的基准测试显示：CoT未可靠追踪影响模型预测的视觉证据，可能忽略导致大幅预测变化的对象移除，却提及影响甚微的对象。Predict-then-Explain解释与概率变化的对齐强于应答前CoT，而二值vCT分数常接近饱和。

Conclusion: CoT在视觉输入上的忠实性存疑，Predict-then-Explain范式可能更具忠实性优势，需要开发更细致的评测方法以超越饱和的二值测试。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) may often look plausible, yet it may not faithfully reflect the model's decision-making process. While methods for measuring the faithfulness of CoTs for textual inputs have been increasingly introduced, using these methods for visual inputs is not straightforward. In this work, we adapt the family of counterfactual methods for measuring CoT faithfulness, namely the Counterfactual Test (CT) and Correlational Counterfactual Test (CCT), to visual inputs, and call them vCT and vCCT, respectively. Using vCT and vCCT, we benchmark eight recent open-source Vision Language Models (VLMs) on two datasets. Our analysis shows that CoTs do not reliably track visual evidence that influences model predictions: they may omit the removed object even when its removal causes a large prediction shift, yet mention it when the shift is small. We further find that Predict-then-Explain explanations align more strongly with perturbation-induced probability shifts than pre-answer CoTs, while binary vCT scores are often nearly saturated. We also include a reconstruction control, in which images pass through the same editing pipeline without object removal, and find that the main object-removal intervention induces larger shifts than reconstruction alone. We construct and release Counter-SNLI-VE and Counter-A-OKVQA, two datasets of image pairs that differ by a single object.

</details>


### [114] [RoLA: Rotary-Positioned Low-Rank Linear Attention for Efficient Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06712)
*Zekun Zhang,Yixiang Cai,Yuxi Liu,Tengxu Sun,Tianle Liu,Zhoutong Wu,Haoyu Li,Baole Ai,Ang Wang,Jiamang Wang,Lin Qu,Kun Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RoLA，一种面向视频Diffusion Transformers的旋转位置低秩线性注意力分支。通过将RoPE放置在非线性低秩特征映射之外，并复用预训练旋转调度中的截断子集，RoLA在保持真正的跨token全局聚合的同时实现线性复杂度，且在90%稀疏度下保持生成质量，在Wan2.1-14B上实现2.63倍端到端推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频DiT的稠密时空自注意力随序列长度二次方增长，成为主要推理瓶颈。稀疏低秩混合架构虽可缓解，但在3D RoPE下，全局分支面临结构兼容性问题：RoPE在非线性特征映射前应用时，旋转与非线性不满足交换律，难以在保留相对旋转几何的同时维持查询无关的线性摘要。现有方法用坐标条件替代或可学习绝对位置模块绕开问题，但这些折衷从绝对坐标近似相对衰减并引入额外位置参数。

Method: RoLA的核心设计：1) 将RoPE应用于非线性低秩特征映射之外（outside），解决旋转和非线性操作的交换性问题；2) 复用预训练旋转调度中与低秩瓶颈匹配的截断子集作为可复用的线性摘要，无需额外位置参数；3) 保留固定稀疏度的稀疏分支，构成完整的稀疏-低秩模块；4) 实现具有设计上相对位置行为且线性时间的低秩全局分支。

Result: 在开源视频DiT上的实验表明：在90%稀疏度下生成质量保持竞争力，在NVIDIA H100 GPU上对Wan2.1-14B（720p，81帧）实现2.63倍端到端推理加速。

Conclusion: RoLA通过将RoPE外置于非线性映射并重用预训练旋转调度的截断子集，成功解决了视频DiT中全局低秩分支与3D RoPE的兼容性问题，实现了线性时间且无需额外参数的全局注意力，同时通过稀疏-低秩混合架构在不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著加速推理。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve strong video generation quality, but their dense spatiotemporal self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length and quickly becomes the dominant inference bottleneck. Sparse low-rank hybrids alleviate this cost by combining a local sparse branch with a global compressed branch. In video DiTs equipped with 3D Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE), the global branch faces a structural compatibility issue: when RoPE is applied before a nonlinear feature map, the rotation and nonlinearity generally do not commute, making it difficult to keep a query-independent linear summary while preserving relative rotary geometry. Existing work often sidesteps this issue by replacing genuine cross-token global aggregation with coordinate-conditioned surrogates or learnable absolute positional modules. These compromises can be effective, but they approximate relative decay from absolute coordinates and introduce extra positional parameters. We propose \textbf{RoLA}, a rotary-positioned low-rank linear-attention branch that keeps genuine cross-token aggregation while remaining compatible with a reusable linear summary. The design applies RoPE \emph{outside} the nonlinear low-rank feature map and reuses a truncated subset of the pre-trained rotary schedule matched to the low-rank bottleneck.
  This yields a linear-time low-rank global branch with relative positional behavior by design and no additional positional parameters; the full sparse--low-rank module still includes the fixed-sparsity sparse branch. Experiments on open-source video DiTs show that the resulting method remains competitive in generation quality at 90\% sparsity while achieving 2.63$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup on Wan2.1-14B (720p, 81 frames, measured on an NVIDIA H100 GPU).

</details>


### [115] [Companion-style QA Assistance in Ego-Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06721)
*Hangyu Qin,Junbin Xiao,Shenglang Zhang,Angela Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出BuddyVQA基准测试，用于评估第一人称日常流媒体视频中的陪伴式问答任务，并设计了MyBuddy助手，通过多模态思维链推理来解决自我指示表达式和交互式连环问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VideoQA基准大多忽视了日常第一人称QA辅助中常见的两个关键特征：自我指示表达式（ego-deictic expressions）和交互式连环问题（interactively chained questions），这些需要模型在长视频流环境中解析视觉代词并推断用户的情境意图。

Method: 提出MyBuddy陪伴式问答助手，核心是多模态思维链推理机制，基于历史QA与视觉内容推断最终答案；同时设计了问题过滤器和多级记忆机制，以促进流式QA设置下高效的QA与视觉信息检索。

Result: 实验表明MyBuddy显著提升了基础模型在BuddyVQA上的性能，且这些提升可泛化到其他流式视频和通用视频QA基准上，证明了方法的适用性和有效性。

Conclusion: BuddyVQA填补了第一人称陪伴式QA基准的空白，MyBuddy展示了通过思维链推理与记忆机制相结合能够有效应对流式视频中的复杂QA挑战。

Abstract: AI companions are envisioned as always-on assistants that support users in daily life. With this regard, we introduce BuddyVQA, a benchmark for companion-style question answering (QA) on egocentric streaming video. BuddyVQA contains 21.6K questions linked to 6K highlight moments across 1,012 long, egocentric videos. It features two key characteristics that are common in daily first-person QA assistance but are largely overlooked in existing VideoQA benchmarks: ego-deictic expressions and interactively chained questions (e.g., "Where is it?", "How to get there?"). These require models to infer a user's in-situation intent by resolving visual pronouns in the context of egocentric visual and QA contents, with both grounded in a long-form streaming setting. To tackle the challenges, we propose MyBuddy, a companion-style QA assistant that highlights a multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning mechanism to infer the final answer based on the historical QA and visual content. An additional question filter and multi-level memory are designed to facilitate efficient QA and visual information retrieval under streaming QA settings. Experiments show that MyBuddy significantly enhances the performance of foundation models on BuddyVQA. Moreover, these gains generalize to other streaming and common video QA benchmarks, demonstrating the applicability and effectiveness of our approach. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/QHUni/BuddyVQA

</details>


### [116] [ADELE - Adaptive Delaunay Grids for High-Fidelity Mesh-Native Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06723)
*Johannes Weidenfeller,Shaofei Wang,Philipp Fürnstahl,Siyu Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应的网格优化框架，结合可优化的Delaunay四面体网格与多分辨率哈希网格，用于直接从网格表示进行三维重建，避免了传统NeRF/3DGS的后处理网格提取问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网格重建方法存在两大问题：1）主流方法先学习中间表示（NeRF/3DGS）再后处理提取网格，导致表面过度平滑或三角面片数量过多、质量差；2）现有的网格原生优化方法受限于固定分辨率离散化和不稳定的优化行为。

Method: 提出一个自适应网格优化框架，包含两部分核心：1）可优化的Delaunay三角化四面体网格，通过点剪枝与插入实现细化；2）多分辨率哈希网格用于提供SDF/外观值预测的潜特征。先用体渲染引导粗几何初始化，再用基于网格的渲染恢复精细细节。并提出可微的、基于光栅化的深度偏移渲染公式以减少几何伪影。

Result: 在多种以物体为中心的基准测试中，该方法显著优于现有网格优化方法，并与最先进的NeRF/3DGS方法性能相当。

Conclusion: 从头到尾直接在网格表示上进行优化，同时利用自适应离散化和混合渲染策略，能够在保持网格质量的同时达到与NeRF/3DGS方法竞争的性能，为高质量网格重建提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Meshes remain the most practical representation for geometry reasoning and integration into graphics pipelines, yet existing reconstruction methods struggle to produce high-quality meshes. Most state-of-the-art approaches initially learn an intermediate representation (NeRF/3DGS) and treat mesh extraction as a post-processing step, which often leads to oversmoothed surfaces or poor quality meshes with excessive triangle counts.Existing mesh-native optimization methods alleviate some of these issues but suffer from fixed-resolution discretizations and unstable optimization behavior. In this paper, we introduce an adaptive mesh-based optimization framework and a practical mesh rendering technique to address these challenges. Our representation combines an optimizable Delaunay-triangulated tetrahedral grid with a multi-resolution hash grid. The former is refined through point pruning and insertion, while the latter provides latent features for SDF/appearance value predictions. We use volumetric rendering to bootstrap a coarse geometry while leveraging mesh-based rendering for recovering fine-grained details. Additionally, we propose a differentiable, rasterization-based depth-offset rendering formulation, reducing geometric artifacts and improving reconstruction quality. Our method significantly outperforms existing mesh optimization approaches across a variety of object-centric benchmarks while being competitive with state-of-the-art NeRF/3DGS methods.

</details>


### [117] [Back to the Feature: Zero-Shot 6DoF Pose Estimation via Dense Local Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06726)
*Ali Rafiaei,Michael Greenspan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: B2TFPose是一种无需训练的零样本6DoF姿态估计方法，仅使用单个冻结的DINOv3视觉Transformer作为预训练组件，通过重新审视经典局部特征匹配范式并借助大规模自监督基础模型的能力，在BOP Benchmark七个核心数据集上达到了训练自由RGB方法的最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的6DoF姿态估计方法通常需要针对特定对象进行训练或微调，难以处理未见过的对象（unseen objects），并且面临合成到真实（synthetic-to-real）域差距的挑战。作者希望探索是否可以利用大规模自监督基础模型的泛化能力，在不进行任何训练的情况下实现零样本姿态估计。

Method: 提出三个关键贡献：1) 测地线非极大值抑制（geodesic NMS）策略，用于检索视角多样的模板集，实现由粗到细的对应匹配；2) 渲染引导的重新对应（RRC），在估计姿态处合成对象特定视图并重新建立稠密2D-3D对应关系，无需额外学习参数即可锐化初始估计；3) 多掩膜假设选择策略，联合评分竞争的图像分割候选以解决分割歧义问题。

Result: 在BOP Benchmark的七个核心数据集上，B2TFPose在无细化的情况下达到40.7的平均召回率（mean AR），在细化后达到56.4，在训练自由的RGB方法中建立了最先进性能，且超越了一些已训练方法如GigaPose和GenFlow，推理速度具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了大规模自监督基础模型（如DINOv3）能够有效替代传统任务特定训练，通过重新审视经典局部特征匹配范式，可以在无需任何训练的情况下实现强大的零样本6DoF姿态估计，为无训练方法树立了新的标杆。

Abstract: We present B2TFPose, a training-free zero-shot method for 6DoF pose estimation of unseen objects from RGB images. Using a single frozen DINOv3 vision transformer as its only pretrained component within the pose estimation pipeline, B2TFPose extracts dense patch-level features that generalize across the synthetic-to-real domain gap without any task-specific fine-tuning, revisiting the classical local feature matching paradigm through the lens of large-scale self-supervised foundation models. Three contributions advance the training-free state of the art. A geodesic non-maximum suppression strategy retrieves a viewpoint-diverse template set for coarse-to-fine correspondence matching. Render-guided Re-Correspondence (RRC) synthesizes object-specific views at the estimated pose and re-establishes dense 2D-3D correspondences to sharpen the initial estimate without additional learned parameters. A multi-mask hypothesis selection strategy jointly scores competing segmentation candidates to resolve segmentation ambiguity. On the seven core datasets of the BOP Benchmark, B2TFPose achieves 40.7 mean AR without refinement and 56.4 with refinement, establishing state-of-the-art performance among training-free RGB methods and outperforming trained counterparts including GigaPose and GenFlow, at competitive inference speed.

</details>


### [118] [Uni-Light: An Ultra-Lightweight Framework via Uncertainty-Aware Knowledge Distillation for Brain Tumour Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06729)
*Libing Kuang,Soren Salehi,Ziling Wu,Ahmad P. Tafti,Armaghan Moemeni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Uni-Light，一个超轻量级3D脑肿瘤分割框架，通过多尺度卷积与不确定性感知知识蒸馏结合符号距离场边界损失，在BraTS2023-GLI和MSD-BTS数据集上大幅降低参数量(97.56%)、FLOPs(73.03%)和推理内存(81.58%)的同时，Dice分数平均超过SOTA模型1.47%，兼顾了分割精度与计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脑肿瘤分割方法计算负担沉重，难以在资源受限的临床环境中部署；而当前的轻量级架构又往往缺乏在复杂肿瘤区域保持分割保真度的能力，存在精度与效率之间的权衡困境。

Method: 提出Uni-Light框架，包含三个关键组件：(1)多尺度卷积以捕获不同尺度的肿瘤特征；(2)不确定性感知知识蒸馏方案，利用教师模型的不确定性引导学生在难分类区域学习；(3)符号距离场(Signed Distance Field)边界损失提供几何约束，增强分割边界的准确性。

Result: 在BraTS2023-GLI和MSD-BTS两个数据集上，Uni-Light相比SOTA模型减少了97.56%的参数、73.03%的FLOPs和81.58%的推理内存占用，同时Dice分数平均提升了1.47%，展示了出色的精度-效率平衡。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了在资源受限的临床场景中，超轻量级模型可以在保持甚至超越SOTA分割精度的前提下大幅降低计算开销。同时，教师模型的不确定性可作为一种数据驱动的监督信号，重新优先训练数据的分布，无需额外标注即可提升训练效果，为医学影像的数据工程提供了新思路。

Abstract: Accurate 3D brain tumour segmentation from multi-modal Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is essential for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning. Existing brain tumour segmentation methods often suffer from heavy computational demands, while current lightweight architectures frequently lack the capacity to maintain segmentation fidelity in complex tumour regions. To address these issues, we propose a novel ultra-lightweight framework (Uni-Light) that achieves high-fidelity segmentation with substantially reduced computational overhead. It combines multi-scale convolutions with an uncertainty-aware knowledge distillation scheme that directs the student model toward hard-to-classify regions, complemented by a Signed Distance Field boundary loss for geometric constraints. Experimental results on BraTS2023-GLI and MSD-BTS datasets demonstrate that Uni-Light reduces parameters by 97.56%, floating-point operations (FLOPs) by 73.03%, and inference memory footprint by 81.58%, while surpassing the state-of-the-art model by an average of 1.47% in Dice score, offering a highly competitive trade-off between segmentation accuracy and computational efficiency in resource-constrained clinical settings. This work also advances data engineering for medical imaging by demonstrating that teacher model uncertainty can be exploited as a data-driven supervisory signal, re-prioritising the training data distribution without requiring additional annotation.

</details>


### [119] [LASSNet: Level-Aware Availability-Conditioned Spatial-Semantic Fusion for Brain Tumor Segmentation with Missing MRI Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06733)
*Haobin Chen,Ao Chang,Rundong Wang,Zhicheng Li,Zhihao Tang,Heqin Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LASSNet提出一种层级感知、可用性条件化的空间-语义融合网络，用于处理多模态MRI脑肿瘤分割中一个或多个模态缺失的问题。该网络通过两个层级专用模块（HACF和TriRSF）在不同表示层级上进行条件化融合，在BraTS2019和BraTS2023上分别取得76.7%和83.2%的平均Dice分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态MRI的四个成像序列可能因成本、协议变化、扫描失败或患者状况而缺失。现有方法（重建、知识迁移、直接特征融合）未解决缺失模态融合是否应随表示层级变化的问题——高分辨率侧向特征保留空间细节，而压缩瓶颈特征编码语义和跨模态上下文，因此融合应同时基于模态可用性和特征层级进行条件化。

Method: 提出LASSNet，包含两个层级专用模块：(1) HACF（层级可用性条件化融合）通过计数归一化聚合、掩码条件化通道调制和局部3D细化构建四种侧向表征；(2) TriRSF（三尺度关系-空间融合）在多个瓶颈分辨率上建模可用模态描述符间关系及空间上下文，进行跨尺度聚合和可用性条件化全局空间注意力。共享的粗到细解码器从TriRSF语义出发逐步注入HACF特征，无需重建缺失输入。

Result: 在全部15种非空模态配置下，LASSNet在BraTS2019和BraTS2023上分别获得76.7%和83.2%的平均Dice分数（WT、TC、ET三个区域）。

Conclusion: 将缺失模态融合按特征层级区分处理（侧向空间细节与瓶颈语义分别采用不同的条件化融合策略）能有效提升缺失模态下的脑肿瘤分割性能，且无需显式重建缺失模态。

Abstract: Brain tumor segmentation from multimodal MRI relies on complementary evidence across four imaging sequences, yet one or more modalities may be unavailable because of acquisition cost, protocol variation, scan failure, or patient condition. Existing work has explored reconstruction, knowledge transfer, and direct feature fusion, but leaves open whether missing-modality fusion should change with representation level. High-resolution lateral features retain spatial detail, whereas compressed bottleneck features encode semantic and inter-modality context. We therefore hypothesize that fusion should be conditioned jointly on modality availability and feature hierarchy. We propose the Level-Aware Availability-Conditioned Spatial-Semantic Fusion Network (LASSNet), which contains two level-specialized modules. Hierarchical Availability-Conditioned Fusion (HACF) constructs four lateral representations using count-normalized aggregation of available modalities, mask-conditioned channel modulation, and local 3D refinement. Tri-Scale Relational-Spatial Fusion (TriRSF) models relations among available modality descriptors and spatial context across multiple bottleneck resolutions, followed by cross-scale aggregation and availability-conditioned global spatial attention. A shared coarse-to-fine decoder starts from TriRSF semantics and progressively injects HACF features, without reconstructing missing inputs. Across all 15 non-empty modality configurations, LASSNet obtains mean Dice scores of 76.7% and 83.2% over WT, TC, and ET on BraTS2019 and BraTS2023, respectively.

</details>


### [120] [Agentic Visual Generation: From Generative Models to Agentic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06758)
*Yinming Huang,Shuyuan Tu,Xi Yan,Jiahao Zhan,Zihan Yang,Zhen Xing,Hui Zhang,Tiehua Zhang,Yu-Gang Jiang,Zuxuan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套用于分类视觉生成系统"智能体化"程度的层级框架（L0-L4），依据控制器在生成过程中能直接控制什么决策来划分，而非依据模型大小、工具数量或训练方法等表面特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉生成系统正从单次调用演变为智能体化的控制过程，但缺乏一致标准来判断一个生成系统何时算"智能体化"。规划深度、工具使用、多角色协作和强化学习常被当作智能体化的证据，但这些都不必然决定控制器能做哪些生成决策。

Method: 作者提出按控制器在生成过程中能直接控制什么来组织该领域，定义了L0-Fixed Support到L4的五个层级：L1条件控制（仅准备输入）、L2执行控制（选择和调用内容修改操作）、L3结果自适应控制（观察中间输出并据此调整后续操作）、L4经验自适应控制（保留已完成任务经验并用于未来决策）。L0代表无控制器的固定支持系统。

Result: 该框架被应用于图像、视频、编辑、3D、世界模型、幻灯片和用户界面生成等多个领域，揭示了控制器能力如何演化以及其机制如何在不同层级间分布。

Conclusion: 这些层级描述的是逐步扩大的决策范围，而非模型规模、系统复杂度、输出质量、工具或角色数量或训练方法。该框架为视觉生成智能体领域提供了统一的分析标准。

Abstract: Visual generation is evolving from generative models used through a single invocation into agentic control processes that can plan, select tools, inspect intermediate synthesized outputs, revise failures, and reuse prior experience. In most existing systems, the controller is an LLM or VLM, while visual generation models serve as tools or executors. However, existing work lacks a consistent criterion for determining when a generation system becomes agentic. Planning depth, tool use, multi-role collaboration, and reinforcement learning are often treated as evidence of agenticity, even though none of them necessarily determines which generation decisions the controller can make. We organize the field according to what the controller can directly control in the generation process. At L1 Conditioning Control, the controller prepares the input to a predetermined generator but does not control which visual operation is executed. At L2 Execution Control, it selects and invokes actual generation, editing, rendering, or other content-modifying operations. At L3 Outcome-Adaptive Control, it observes an intermediate outcome and uses that observation to change a subsequent operation within the current task. At L4 Experience-Adaptive Control, it retains experience from completed tasks and uses that experience to change decisions on future tasks. L0 Fixed Support separately denotes generators, editors, evaluators, reward models, benchmarks, and fixed pipelines without a deployed controller that makes generation-level decisions. These levels describe a progressively broader decision-making scope rather than model size, system complexity, output quality, tool or role count, or training method. Applying this framework across image, video, editing, 3D, world, slide, and user-interface generation reveals how controller capabilities have evolved and how their mechanisms are distributed across levels.

</details>


### [121] [Unified Multi-Layer Subspace Modeling for Cross-Domain OOD Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06785)
*Gerhard Krumpl,Henning Avenhaus,Horst Possegger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PRISM，一种模型无关的后验OOD检测方法，通过将中间层与深层特征融合为统一的分层嵌入，估计ID主子空间，并结合类条件马氏距离与残差能量两种互补信号进行OOD检测，无需OOD校准的层权重调整，在多个跨领域基准上以单一默认配置达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后验OOD检测方法多从单一表征层（如logits或倒数第二层特征）提取分数，或通过深度选择/OOD校准加权来融合多层信息。然而OOD分布偏移类型多样，不同OOD类型和领域下最具判别力的表征层差异很大，导致固定层选择或OOD校准的聚合方法具有脆弱性。

Method: PRISM的核心思路是建模统一的多层特征表征而非对各层独立打分后聚合。具体地：(1) 将中间层与深层特征融合为单一的分层嵌入；(2) 估计ID主成分子空间；(3) 结合两个互补信号——投影子空间内的类条件马氏距离，以及正交于所学习流形的残差能量。该方法无需OOD调优的层权重，能同时捕捉子空间内的语义偏差和子空间外的异常。

Result: 在涵盖自然图像、医学影像和工业视觉检测的多个基准上，PRISM以单一默认配置在跨领域OOD检测中达到一致的SOTA性能，并用少量推理开销使其适用于实际部署。

Conclusion: PRISM通过统一多层特征表征与子空间建模的方式，避免了脆弱的分层加权选择，提供了一种鲁棒、跨领域一致且高效的OOD检测方案。

Abstract: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection remains a fundamental challenge for neural networks, whose predictions can be overconfident on inputs that deviate from the training distribution. Most post-hoc OOD detection methods derive scores from a single representation level (eg., logits or penultimate features) or combine multiple layers via depth selection or OOD-calibrated weighting. However, because OOD shifts are diverse, the most informative representation level can vary strongly across OOD types and domains, making fixed-layer choices and OOD-calibrated aggregation brittle. In this paper, we propose PRISM (Projected Representation with Intermediate-layer Subspace Modeling), a model-agnostic post-hoc OOD detection method that models a unified multi-layer feature representation rather than aggregating independently scored layers. PRISM fuses intermediate and deep features into a single hierarchical embedding, estimates an in-distribution (ID) principal subspace, and then combines two complementary signals: (i) a class-conditional Mahalanobis distance in the projected subspace and (ii) the residual energy orthogonal to the learned manifold. This simple design avoids OOD-tuned layer weighting while capturing both in-subspace semantic deviations and off-subspace anomalies. Across diverse benchmarks spanning natural images, medical imaging, and industrial visual inspection, PRISM achieves consistent state-of-the-art cross-domain OOD detection performance with a single default configuration across all evaluated domains and architectures. We further show that PRISM incurs minimal inference overhead, making it practical for real-world deployment.

</details>


### [122] [When Speech Meets Lips: Interpretable Audio-Visual Synchronization for L2 Pronunciation Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06788)
*Bowen Yu,Mingyu Huang,Yishen Liu,Yue Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释的视听同步框架，用于自动发音评估（APA），通过显式建模语音与嘴唇动作之间的时间对齐关系，引入帧级延迟轨迹和延迟稳定性指数（LSI），并为L2发音训练提供可操作的诊断反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有APA系统主要依赖声学信号，忽略了语音与发音器官运动之间的时间同步性，无法为L2学习者提供时序不匹配方面的诊断反馈，限制了计算机辅助发音训练的有效性。

Method: 提出可解释的音频-视觉同步框架，包含四个关键组件：特征编码、交叉注意力融合、延迟估计、稳定性量化，并引入帧级延迟轨迹与延迟稳定性指数（LSI）作为同步稳健性的量化指标，同时提供可视化支持。

Result: 通过对30名参与者（包括10名教师和20名来自不同母语背景的学生）的访谈评估框架的有效性，表明该框架能将隐式对齐转化为可解释的表征。

Conclusion: 该框架将自动评分与可操作的计算机辅助发音训练反馈相连接，弥补了现有APA系统在时序诊断方面的不足，数据集和补充材料已公开。

Abstract: Automatic Pronunciation Assessment (APA) systems have achieved strong performance with transformer-based models and self-supervised speech representations. However, most methods rely only on acoustic signals and overlook temporal synchronization between speech and articulatory movements, limiting diagnostic feedback on timing mismatches important for L2 pronunciation training. We propose an interpretable audio-visual synchronization framework that explicitly models speech-lip temporal alignment through feature encoding, cross-attention fusion, lag estimation, stability quantification, and visualization. The framework introduces frame-level lag trajectories and a Lag Stability Index (LSI) to quantify synchronization robustness. We also interviewed 30 participants, including 10 instructors and 20 students with diverse first-language backgrounds, to assess its effectiveness. By transforming implicit alignment into interpretable representations, the framework connects automatic scoring with actionable Computer-Aided Pronunciation Training feedback. Datasets and supplemental materials are available at https://www.robots.ox.ac.uk/~vgg/data/lip_reading/.

</details>


### [123] [Comparative Study of Anatomical and Learned Features in AI Models for Structural Brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06807)
*Boyang Yu,Miquel Lopez Escoriza,Long Chen,Arjun V. Masurkar,Narges Razavian,Carlos Fernandez-Granda*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在18个公开数据集（约80,000名参与者，覆盖7项临床任务）上系统比较了三种特征提取范式：解剖学表面/体积特征、CNN监督学习、ViT基础模型无监督预训练后微调。研究发现，基于解剖特征的线性模型即可匹敌复杂AI框架的诊断性能；CNN和预训练ViT隐式捕捉了解剖信息。作者进一步提出解剖分割预训练（ASP）方法，在基础模型预训练中融入解剖信息，在生物学年龄估计任务上超越现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI神经影像建模存在多种特征提取范式（传统解剖特征、CNN、ViT基础模型），但缺乏系统性的公平比较来评估这些范式在临床诊断任务中的真实性能差异，以回答"复杂的深度特征是否真的优于传统的解析特征"这一核心问题。

Method: 在大规模多数据集（18个数据集、80,000名参与者、7项任务）上对比三类范式；并提出ASP（Anatomy Segmentation Pretraining）方法，通过在基础模型预训练阶段引入解剖分割目标来增强模型对解剖信息的编码能力。

Result: 1) 基于解剖特征的线性模型在诊断性能上与复杂非线性AI框架（含基础模型）相当；2) CNN与预训练ViT隐式捕捉解剖信息，无需显式特征提取；3) ASP方法在生物学年龄估计任务上优于现有基础模型。

Conclusion: 复杂的深度学习特征在神经影像诊断中并不比传统的解剖特征线性模型更具优势，解剖信息的显式或隐式利用是关键；基础模型预训练中加入解剖先验（ASP）可进一步提升下游任务性能。

Abstract: In this work, we comprehensively evaluate three popular feature-extraction paradigms in AI-based neuroimaging modeling: (1) computation of anatomical surfaces and volumes, (2) supervised learning with convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and (3) unsupervised pretraining of vision transformer (ViT) foundation models, followed by supervised finetuning. Our study is based on 18 publicly available datasets containing 3D structural T1-weighted MRI scans from approximately 80,000 participants across seven distinct clinical tasks. We observe that a linear model based on anatomical features matches the diagnostic performance of complex nonlinear features learned by sophisticated AI frameworks, including foundation models trained on thousands of scans. Conversely, CNNs and pretrained ViTs learn features that implicitly capture relevant anatomical information, bypassing the need for explicit feature extraction. Building upon these insights, we propose Anatomy Segmentation Pretraining (ASP), a novel method to incorporate anatomical information during foundation-model pretraining, which outperforms existing models in biological age estimation.

</details>


### [124] [Disparity Has a Sign: Stereo Matching Beyond the Zero-Disparity Plane](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06809)
*Jian Shi,Xinge Yang,Chaoyang Wang,Wolfgang Heidrich,Peter Wonka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现现代立体匹配模型在视差穿越零点时会崩溃（EPE 上升 4.6-37 倍），因为标准管道从数据集、架构到评估协议都继承了非负几何，将 ZDP 置于无穷远。作者提出 ZDPShift 基准（7 部开源电影、21,495 对立体图像、五个 ZDP 位置、带符号密集真值），六个 SOTA 模型在 ZDP 移动后均崩溃（如 FoundationStereo 从 2.24px 升至 75.33px）。但通过仅用 SceneFlow 合成监督微调（不加数据/参数），误差可在整个有符号范围保持平坦，尤其仅训练解码器即可保持精度，说明预训练特征已具备负视差匹配能力，只是输出约定丢弃了它，且正视差域精度基本保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 立体内容（电影 3D、VR）常常包含位于零视差平面后方（负视差）的物体，但现有立体匹配模型在面对跨零视差时性能急剧下降。这一"盲区"根植于整个标准管道中：平行校正相机将 ZDP 置于无穷远，使得所有有限深度 d=fB/z≥0 恒成立，管道内既无法违背也无法测量负视差。

Method: 1) 提出 ZDPShift 基准：从七部电影摄影师创作的开放电影中渲染 21,495 对立体图像，每帧在五个 ZDP 位置渲染，带有密集有符号真值。2) 系统评估六个 SOTA 图像和视频立体匹配模型。3) 通过从 SceneFlow 合成监督进行训练（不添加新数据或参数），以及仅冻结预训练匹配特征、只训练解码器两种方式，来验证预训练特征是否已具备负视差能力。

Result: 六个 SOTA 模型在 ZDP 移动后均崩溃（FoundationStereo EPE 从 2.24px 升至 75.33px），约半数像素超过三像素误差。用 SceneFlow 合成监督训练后误差在整个有符号范围内保持平坦；仅训练解码器（冻结预训练特征）在所有六个骨干上表现相当（EPE 抖动在 0.2px 内）。正域精度在 KITTI、Middlebury、ETH3D、Sintel 上基本保留。

Conclusion: 预训练特征实际上已经扩展到它们从未训练过的负视差区域，只是输出约定（output convention）丢弃了该能力。问题不在底层匹配能力，而在于管道中人为构造的非负几何约束。

Abstract: Modern stereo matching models fail when disparity crosses zero, with end-point error (EPE) rising by 4.6-37$\times$. Yet stereoscopic content, from cinema 3D to VR, routinely contains objects behind the zero-disparity plane (ZDP), corresponding to negative disparities. The blind spot cascades through datasets, architectures, and evaluation protocols, all of which inherit the non-negative geometry. Rectified parallel cameras place ZDP at infinity, so every finite depth yields $d=fB/z \ge 0$ by construction, and nothing within the standard pipeline can violate, or even measure, a negative disparity. To measure it, we propose \textit{ZDPShift}, a benchmark of $21{,}495$ stereo pairs from seven cinematographer-authored open movies, each frame rendered at five zero-disparity-plane positions with dense signed ground truth. Six state-of-the-art image and video stereo matching models collapse once the plane moves. On identical scene content, FoundationStereo goes from $2.24$ px EPE to $75.33$px, with every backbone leaving roughly half of all pixels exceeding a three-pixel disparity error. What is missing, however, is not the underlying matching capability. % The capability itself, however, is already present. Training on supervision synthesized from SceneFlow, which adds no new data or parameters, keeps the error flat across the signed range. Training only the decoder, with the pretrained matching features frozen, performs comparably across all six backbones, with EPE jittering within $0.2$px. Thus, the pretrained features already extend to the negative regime they were never trained on, and only the output convention discarded it. Meanwhile, positive-regime accuracy on KITTI, Middlebury, ETH3D, and Sintel is largely preserved.

</details>


### [125] [Generalist Open-World Temporal Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06823)
*Cristian Sminchisescu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种"通用开放世界时间感知架构"(GOWTPA)范式，主张将感知与合成视为共享生成基座上的不同条件化过程，使识别、结构化预测、模拟推理等能力从同一时间多模态生成基座中涌现，作为多模态智能与物理AI的基础层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下一代AI系统需要原生的时间性与多模态能力（对话、感知、预测、推理、综合），但目前的生成式视频预训练虽涌现出跨模态与类推理能力，却通常通过语言探针或光写实视频来访问，显式的语义、几何和时序结构并未暴露。本文旨在提出一个能显式结构化的世界状态，支持理解、预测、反事实推理与可控合成。

Method: 提出GOWTPA范式：将感知与合成作为共享通用生成基座下的不同条件化(distinct conditionings)过程。识别、结构化预测和仿真作为同一生成基座的不同条件化而涌现；推理与具身策略则基于由此产生的世界状态构建。该体系推断几何、关节、语义、交互结构与不确定性，并在遮挡与视角变化下维持身份，跨物种、形态、机制与材料泛化。

Result: 本文为立场/框架性论文，论证生成式视频预训练可涌现跨模态与推理类能力，并提出GOWTPA作为互补范式——将通用时序感知定位为更广泛多模态智能与物理AI的潜在基础层。

Conclusion: 通用开放世界时间感知有望成为多模态智能与物理AI的基础层。通过将感知与合成统一为共享生成基座上的不同条件化，可实现显式结构化世界状态的建立，支撑理解、预测、反事实推理与可控合成，迈向真正时间性多模态的下一代AI。

Abstract: The next generation of artificial intelligence systems will likely be natively temporal and multimodal in both inputs and outputs: able to converse, perceive, predict, reason, and synthesize through a shared world representation. Realizing this requires a temporal perceptual substrate integrating sensory streams, language, and structured outputs within a multimodal world model. We seek a generalist open-world perceptual system that represents biological forms, natural physical structures, and artifacts, and their interactions, as a coherent, temporally persistent process. The model should infer geometry, articulation, semantics, interaction structure, and uncertainty from raw multimodal streams; maintain identity through occlusion and viewpoint change; generalize across species, forms, mechanisms, and materials; and abstain or expand its ontology when encountering the unknown. The objective is a structured world state supporting understanding, prediction, counterfactual reasoning, and controllable synthesis. Recent work suggests that some cross-modal and reasoning-like capabilities can emerge from large-scale generative video pretraining, reminiscent of language-model scaling. Yet these capabilities are often accessed through language probes or expressed through photorealistic video, leaving explicit semantic, geometric, or temporal structure largely unexposed. This paper articulates an alternative and complementary paradigm: perception and synthesis as distinct conditionings within a shared Generalist Open-World Temporal Perception Architecture (GOWTPA). Recognition, structured prediction, and simulation arise as different conditionings of the same generative substrate, while reasoning and embodiment-specific policies build upon the resulting world state. This positions generalist temporal perception as a potential foundation layer for broader multimodal intelligence and physical AI.

</details>


### [126] [A Shared-Backbone Approach for Multi-Task MedMNIST Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06838)
*Stefan-Dorian Gavril,Andrei Arhire,Adrian Iftene*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究多任务生物医学图像分类问题，在11个异构MedMNIST数据集上评估了三种骨干网络（带任务特定线性头），发现了MedMNIST API与评估环境之间的分辨率域偏移问题。通过解决该不一致性并优化架构特定的正则化，使用ConvNeXt-Tiny骨干配合标签平滑技术，最终在Tensor Reloaded竞赛中取得harmonic-mean macro-F1为0.73294的成绩，在官方竞赛阶段排名第六。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多任务生物医学分类要求模型能够跨异构模态和类别分布进行泛化，这是一个具有挑战性的实际问题，作者希望通过系统研究在不同数据集上的多任务学习方法，找出影响性能的关键因素。

Method: 在11个异构MedMNIST数据集上，使用三种骨干网络（backbones）配合任务特定的线性头（task-specific linear heads）进行评估，以每个任务macro-F1的调和平均值作为衡量指标。研究中识别并解决了MedMNIST API与评估环境之间的分辨率域偏移问题，并针对不同架构优化了正则化策略，最终采用ConvNeXt-Tiny骨干加标签平滑（label smoothing）的配置。

Result: 最佳配置（ConvNeXt-Tiny骨干+标签平滑）在Tensor Reloaded: Multi-Task MedMNIST竞赛中取得harmonic-mean macro-F1为0.73294的成绩，在官方竞赛阶段结束时排名第六。代码已公开在GitHub上。

Conclusion: 分辨率域偏移问题对多任务生物医学分类性能有显著影响，解决此问题并针对架构优化正则化可以有效提升模型性能。共享骨干加多任务线性头的架构配合适当的正则化策略是解决MedMNIST多任务分类的有效方案。

Abstract: Multi-task biomedical classification requires models to generalize across disparate modalities and class distributions. We study 11 heterogeneous MedMNIST datasets using the harmonic mean of per-task macro-F1. We evaluate three backbones with task-specific linear heads. We identify a resolution domain shift between the MedMNIST API and evaluation environment. Resolving this inconsistency and optimizing architecture-specific regularization substantially improved performance. Our best configuration, a ConvNeXt-Tiny backbone with label smoothing, achieved a leaderboard harmonic-mean macro-F1 of 0.73294 in the Tensor Reloaded: Multi-Task MedMNIST competition, ranking sixth at the close of the official competition phase. Our implementation is publicly available at: https://github.com/GavrilStefan-Dorian/A-Shared-Backbone-Approach-for-Multi-Task-MedMNIST-Classification

</details>


### [127] [RAIDAL: Redundancy-Aware Information Density Active Learning for CTC-Based Continuous Sign Language Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06843)
*Rafael A. Diniz Augusto,Gabriel L. Oliveira,Erickson R. Nascimento*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RAIDAL方法，通过重新利用CSLR模型中CTC解码器的对齐峰值来识别语义词级的时间证据，将基于表示的信息密度主动学习评分限制在解码器对齐的词汇区域，而非整个未过滤视频，从而在标注预算有限的大词汇量连续手语识别场景中实现更强的数据效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续手语识别(CSLR)的连续视频流标注成本高昂，限制了其发展。主动学习是降低成本的有效途径，但标准采集函数不适用于弱对齐的手语视频——手语执行与休息姿势、不规则停顿、类手语动作及时间冗余帧交错，这种时间冗余会干扰样本选择，因为采集分数可能受到与解码词汇序列无关的帧影响，从而扭曲视频的信息量评估。

Method: 作者发现现代CSLR模型已内置识别词级时间证据的机制——CTC解码器。尽管CTC解码器通常仅用于推理阶段，但其对齐峰值能指示模型在特征序列中定位每个预测词汇的位置，为零额外标注成本的主动学习采集函数提供时间结构来源。基于此，作者提出RAIDAL（Redundancy-Aware Information Density Active Learning），重新利用CTC解码器将基于表示的评分限制在解码器对齐的词汇区域，而非让采集函数暴露于整个未过滤的视频。

Result: 在三个数据集和两种架构上，RAIDAL在大词汇量、预算受限的设置中相较于竞争基线取得了最强的数据效率增益，在较小词汇量、大预算的设置中保持竞争力。代码已公开。

Conclusion: RAIDAL通过巧妙重新利用CTC解码器内部的已有结构，以一种零额外标注成本的方式解决了弱对齐视频中时间冗余对主动学习采样的干扰问题，为CSLR的主动学习提供了有效且实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Continuous sign language recognition (CSLR) is a key technology for accessibility, yet its development remains limited by the high cost of annotating continuous video streams. Active learning offers a path toward mitigating this cost, but standard acquisition functions are not designed for weakly aligned sign language videos, where sign executions are interleaved with rest poses, irregular pauses, sign-like motion, and temporally redundant frames. This temporal redundancy can undermine sample selection, as acquisition scores may be influenced by timesteps from regions that are not associated with the decoded gloss sequence, distorting the video's estimated informativeness. In this work, we show that modern CSLR models already contain a mechanism for identifying gloss-level temporal evidence: the CTC decoder. Although typically used only during inference, its alignment peaks indicate where the model localizes each predicted gloss in the feature sequence, providing a source of temporal structure for active learning acquisition functions at zero additional labeling cost. Thus, we introduce RAIDAL (Redundancy-Aware Information Density Active Learning), which repurposes the CTC decoder to restrict representation-based scoring to decoder-aligned gloss regions, rather than exposing the acquisition function to the entire unfiltered video. Across three datasets and two architectures, RAIDAL achieves its strongest data-efficiency gains over competing baselines in large-vocabulary, budget-limited settings, while remaining competitive in the smaller-vocabulary, large-budget setting. The code used in this work is publicly available at github.com/verlab/RAIDAL.

</details>


### [128] [Organization of Valence and Arousal in Vision-Language Representations of Built Environments: Insights from the EMOIS Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06870)
*Madoka Yonekura,Katsunori Kohda,Nobuhiko Muramoto,Takahiro Yamaguchi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍EMOIS数据集，包含1,544张真实建筑环境图像，每张图像由日本成年人进行效价和唤醒度评分（每张约120个评分）。利用CLIP表征进行预测和几何分析，揭示效价比唤醒度具有更强、更连贯的组织结构。回归分析取得高效价和高唤醒度预测性能（R²分别为0.865和0.807），并展示了基于示例的界面用于定性解释预测结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉感知建筑环境会影响人们在日常生活中的情感印象，但情感印象如何在视觉基础模型中被表征尚未被充分探索。缺乏系统的数据集和研究方法来调查这一问题。

Method: 构建EMOIS数据集（1,544张建筑环境图像，日本成年人通过网络调查提供约120个评分/图的效价和唤醒度标注）；使用CLIP表征进行预测性分析（回归）和几何分析；与OASIS数据集进行跨数据集比较；开发示例驱动的界面支持定性解释。

Result: 效价比唤醒度表现出更强且更一致的组织结构；跨数据集分析（与OASIS对比）揭示了两数据集间情感组织的差异；EMOIS内部回归分析对效价和唤醒度预测的R²分别为0.865和0.807（重复内部留出评估）。

Conclusion: 研究阐明了建筑环境在视觉基础模型中的情感表征方式，并将EMOIS确立为该领域未来情感计算研究的高密度标注资源。

Abstract: Visual perception of built environments contributes to the affective impressions that people form in everyday life. However, how these impressions are represented within vision foundation models remains largely unexplored. To support the systematic investigation of this subject, we introduce the Emotional Impression of Spaces (EMOIS) dataset, comprising 1,544 real-world built-environment images. Each image is annotated with image-evoked valence and arousal ratings collected from Japanese adults by conducting a large-scale web-based survey, with approximately 120 ratings per image. Using Contrastive Language--Image Pre-training (CLIP) representations, we perform predictive and geometric analyses to systematically investigate how valence and arousal are encoded and organized within the representation space. These analyses reveal that valence exhibited stronger and more coherent organization than arousal. Cross-dataset analyses with the Open Affective Standardized Image Set (OASIS), a benchmark dataset of general affective photographs, reveal differences in affective organization between the two datasets. Regression analyses demonstrate high predictive performance for valence and arousal within EMOIS, with mean coefficients of determination of 0.865 and 0.807, respectively, across repeated internal hold-out evaluations. Finally, we present an example-based interface illustrating how learned representations can support qualitative interpretation of predicted affective values. These findings can help elucidate affective representations of built environments and establish EMOIS as a densely annotated resource for future affective computing research in this domain.

</details>


### [129] [Novel Methods for Catheter and Guidewire Segmentation in X-ray Fluoroscopy under a Federated Learning Setting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06876)
*Chayun Kongtongvattana*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结构感知的联邦学习框架，用于血管内手术中导管和导丝的自动化分析。论文包含四项贡献：CathAction基准数据集（60万帧+4万分割掩码）、形状敏感损失（提升Dice达2.9点）、带形状敏感损失的联邦学习（结合投影梯度下降与对抗优化，在真实动物数据上mIoU提升超10点），以及结构感知扩散框架用于合成训练数据（数据匮乏下Dice从44%提升至51%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 血管内手术依赖X射线透视下对导管和导丝的实时可视化分析，对手术安全至关重要。然而学习型方法面临结构复杂、数据稀缺以及隐私法规限制无法跨机构集中训练的三大挑战。

Method: 1) 构建CathAction基准数据集；2) 设计形状敏感损失，将掩码变换为符号距离图在结构特征空间中比较；3) 将该损失扩展至联邦学习框架，并通过投影梯度下降加入对抗优化；4) 提出结构感知扩散框架合成导管/导丝视频序列，结合结构监督与域自适应重建目标。

Result: 形状敏感损失在五个骨干网络上Dice提升最高2.9点；联邦学习中客户端从4增至8时mIoU优于联邦平均最高3点；对抗优化在真实动物数据上mIoU提升超10点；扩散框架降低弗雷歇视频距离；数据匮乏下Dice从44%提升至51%，四个外部站点均有增益。

Conclusion: 该框架在保护隐私的前提下推进了导管和导丝分析，支持无需集中患者数据或大量人工标注的协作式训练，具有重要的临床转化价值。

Abstract: Endovascular procedures rely on real-time manipulation of thin instruments, catheters and guidewires, under X-ray fluoroscopy guidance, where accurate visual analysis is essential for procedural safety. Learning-based methods are constrained by structural complexity, data scarcity, and privacy regulations precluding centralised training across institutions. This thesis presents a structure-aware federated learning framework for catheter and guidewire analysis, with four contributions evaluated on real-animal and phantom data.
  A benchmark dataset, CathAction, is introduced for catheterisation analysis, with over 600,000 annotated frames and 40,000 segmentation masks. A shape-sensitive loss transforms masks into signed distance maps compared in a structural feature space, improving Dice coefficient by up to 2.9 points across five backbones.
  This is extended to federated learning with shape-sensitive loss, preserving geometric consistency under heterogeneous client data and outperforming federated averaging by up to three points in mean intersection-over-union as clients scale from four to eight. Federated learning with projected gradient descent adds adversarial optimisation, raising mean intersection-over-union by over ten points on real-animal data.
  Finally, a structure-aware diffusion framework synthesises catheter and guidewire video sequences, combining structural supervision with a domain-adaptive reconstruction objective, reducing Frechet video distance over a strong baseline while maintaining visual fidelity. Incorporating synthetic sequences into federated training raises the Dice score from 44 to 51 percent under data scarcity, with gains across four held-out sites.
  Together, these contributions advance privacy-preserving catheter and guidewire analysis, supporting collaborative training without centralising patient data or large amounts of manual annotation.

</details>


### [130] [Contextual Observer Grounding: Evaluating Situated Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06880)
*Mimo Shirasaka,Haochen Zhang,Yonatan Bisk*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了 POVBench（Point-of-View Benchmark），一个用于评估视觉语言模型能否从情境线索推断说话人视角并据此理解空间关系的基准测试。研究发现即使在观察者定位显式给出的情况下，最先进的 VLM 在根据方向性语言定位目标方面仍面临挑战，而显式拆解观察者相对空间推理可改善定位效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身任务中的语言指令推理需要从说话人的情境视角理解空间关系。人类依赖共享环境知识、活动上下文和常识来推断这种视角，但现有 VLM 虽表面具备空间推理能力，其能否从上下文线索推断说话人视角并据此解释情境化空间关系仍不明确。作者将这种能力称为"情境观察者定位"（contextual observer grounding），并希望通过构建基准来系统研究该问题。

Method: 构建了 POVBench 数据集，包含 3D 场景和查询，将自然的具身交流中的观察者定位形式解耦为三种类型：推断式（Inferred）、明示式（Stated）和给定式（Given）。给定多视角观测和自然语言句子，模型需要从情境化的空间和上下文线索中定位未见或未完全指定的目标。

Result: 在多种最先进的 VLM 上，即使观察者定位被显式给出，根据方向性语言定位目标仍然具有挑战性。实验发现，对观察者相对空间推理进行显式地分解（explicit breakdowns）能够改善目标定位性能。

Conclusion: 现有 VLM 在情境观察者定位能力上存在不足，即使观察者视角显式提供也难以可靠地根据方向性语言定位目标。将观察者相对空间推理进行显式分解是提升模型性能的有效途径，为未来改进具身空间推理模型提供了方向。

Abstract: Reasoning over language instructions in embodied tasks such as robotics often requires understanding spatial relations from a speaker's situated perspective. Humans infer such perspectives from shared environmental knowledge, activity context, and commonsense. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) appear capable of spatial reasoning, but their ability to infer a speaker's viewpoint from contextual cues and interpret situated spatial relations from that viewpoint remains unclear. We call this capability contextual observer grounding. To study this capability, we construct the Point-of-View Benchmark (POVBench), a dataset of 3D scenes and queries that disentangles Inferred, Stated, and Given forms of observer grounding in natural embodied communication. Given multi-view observations and a natural-language sentence, models must localize unseen or underspecified targets from situated spatial and contextual cues. Across state-of-the-art VLMs, localizing targets from directional language remains challenging, even when observer grounding is made explicit. We find that explicit breakdowns of observer-relative spatial reasoning improve target localization. Our project page is available at https://mimo-owl.github.io/POVBench/.

</details>


### [131] [BEFORE THE FLIP: Measuring Hidden Score Shifts In Quantized Vision Language Models Before The Answer Changes for Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06922)
*Sourajit Saha,Shubhashis Roy Dipta,Shaswati Saha,Nobin Sarwar,Yuxuan Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BEFORE THE FLIP方法，通过比较压缩引起的分数变化与替换图像token引起的分数变化，来测量VLM压缩后隐藏的分数变化（而非仅答案变化）。研究发现4-bit压缩比8-bit压缩更大程度地将yes/no分数差距推向替换输出方向，但逐问题调整权重精度并未显出可靠优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化压缩VLM后，虽然答案可能不变（如仍回答yes），但底层的分数/对数概率可能已发生显著变化（如yes与no之间的分数差距缩小）。这种隐藏变化无法通过检查输出答案来发现，因此需要一种方法来测量压缩导致的隐藏分数变化。

Method: 1. 引入BEFORE THE FLIP方法：将压缩引起的分数变化与替换图像token（用一个固定平均token）引起的分数变化进行比较。2. 逐组增加一个权重组的精度（从低bit到高bit），以识别哪些组添加额外bit有帮助。3. 测试为每个问题选择不同权重组是否比打乱的对照组有额外益处。

Result: 在8,277个图像token替换可测量影响分数的LLaVA问题中，4-bit压缩将yes或no分数差距推向替换输出的程度大于8-bit压缩。Qwen显示相同模式但差异较小。但9,000个LLaVA答案中仅265个在4-bit下改变。在1,024个校准问题中，逐问题选择权重组并未在任何测试的存储预算下优于两个打乱的对照组。

Conclusion: 压缩确实可以改变未变答案背后的分数，但不能证明逐问题调整精度具有可靠收益。

Abstract: Quantization makes vision language models (VLMs) cheaper to store and run by using fewer bits to represent their weights. While unchanged answers on visual question answering (VQA) after compression are an expected behavior, they can still hide changes in the underlying scores (log probabilities). For example, a model may still answer yes after compression, even as the score gap between yes and no shrinks. We introduce BEFORE THE FLIP to measure these hidden changes. Our method compares the score change caused by compression with the change caused by replacing the image's internal representations, or image tokens, with one fixed average token. We then increase the precision of one weight group at a time to identify where extra bits help, and test whether choosing different groups for each question offers benefits beyond shuffled controls. Among 8,277 LLaVA questions where image token replacement measurably affects the scores, 4-bit compression shifts the yes or no score gap farther toward the replacement output than 8-bit compression. Qwen shows the same pattern, but with a smaller difference. Yet only 265 of 9,000 LLaVA answers change at 4 bits. In a separate study of 1,024 calibration questions, choosing weight groups separately for each question does not outperform both shuffled controls at any tested storage budget. These findings show that compression can alter the scores behind unchanged answers, but do not establish a reliable benefit from adjusting precision for each question.

</details>


### [132] [Emo-DVS: A Multimodal Benchmark for Privacy-Aware Emotion Recognition with Event Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06928)
*Jiaqi Chen,Qinfu Xu,Hao Zhuang,Liyuan Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于事件相机的三模态(事件、音频、文本)情感分析基准和一个信息引导门控融合(IGF)框架，并引入了首个大规模事件情感分析数据集Emo-DVS，实验证明该方法达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RGB摄像头在情感分析中存在隐私风险，而事件相机虽能在硬件层面缓解隐私问题并具备高动态范围优势，但现有事件方法受限于数据集规模小、采集条件简单、依赖单一模态，难以应对复杂真实场景。

Method: 提出IGF框架：先在FAU子集上预训练事件编码器以捕捉细粒度面部动态，再采用自适应模态门控抑制各模态噪声，最后通过互信息最大化对齐跨模态鲁棒表示。同时构建了包含事件、音频、文本的三模态基准，并引入大规模事件情感数据集Emo-DVS（包含动态光照、FAU子集和情感子集）。

Result: 大量实验表明IGF框架在各项指标上达到最先进(SOTA)性能。

Conclusion: 通过事件相机的引入、大规模事件数据集的构建以及多模态融合框架的设计，有效解决了事件驱动情感分析在真实场景中的隐私、数据稀缺和单模态局限等问题。

Abstract: Emotion analysis is a fundamental task in computer vision, but its practical deployment remains constrained by the privacy risks inherent to conventional RGB cameras. Bio-inspired event cameras present a promising hardware-level solution because they capture asynchronous brightness changes, thereby reducing exposure of facial identity details while leveraging high dynamic range for robust perception under challenging illumination conditions. Despite these advantages, existing event-based methods struggle in complex real-world settings due to limited dataset scales, simple acquisition conditions, and reliance on single-modality visual cues. To address these, we establish a challenging tri-modal benchmark with event, audio, and text modalities and propose the Information-Guided Gated Fusion (IGF) framework, which first pre-trains an event encoder on the FAU subset of Emo-DVS to capture fine-grained facial dynamics, then employs adaptive modality gating to suppress modality-specific noise, and finally leverages mutual information maximization to align robust cross-modal representations. To alleviate data scarcity, we introduce Emo-DVS, the first large-scale event-based emotion analysis dataset, which couples dynamic illumination with the Facial Action Unit (FAU) subset and emotion subset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IGF achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [133] [Sub-Pixel Affine Registration of Space Debris Images via the Radon Point Spread Function](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06929)
*Shenshen Luan,Miaomiao Tian,Shuai Jiang,Yan Yang,Shuguo Xie,Zezhou Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Radon点扩散函数（RPSF）框架，用于解决低信噪比点目标多帧分析中的帧间仿射失准问题，仅需每帧对4个标量RPSF样本即可闭式估计平移和旋转，无需迭代优化、特征提取或插值，适用于资源受限的星上处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平台抖动和姿态调整引起的帧间仿射失准是多帧点目标分析的根本挑战。传统配准方法依赖空间强度相关性或图像特征，但低信噪比点目标图像中这些信息几乎缺失，亟需一种不依赖这些信息的高效配准方法。

Method: 引入Radon点扩散函数（RPSF）在Radon变换域表征点目标，推导出闭式框架，联合估计帧间平移和旋转，每帧对仅需4个标量RPSF样本。

Result: 仿真结果表明亚像素平移精度和在1° Radon角分辨率下平均旋转误差0.2556°。在包含地基和在轨观测的五个真实空间碎片数据集上验证，平均校准误差低于0.5像素，远超多帧处理所需的精度要求。

Conclusion: 该方法无需迭代优化、特征提取或插值，计算高效，适合资源受限的星载处理场景，且在实际空间碎片观测中达到亚像素校准精度，可有效支持可靠的多帧点目标处理。

Abstract: Inter-frame affine misalignment caused by platform jitter and attitude adjustments poses a fundamental challenge for multi-frame analysis of point targets in optical surveillance. Conventional registration methods rely on spatial intensity correlations or distinctive image features, both of which are largely absent in low-signal-to-noise-ratio point target imagery. We introduce the Radon Point Spread Function (RPSF) to characterize point targets in the Radon-transformed domain, and derive a closed-form framework that jointly estimates inter-frame translation and rotation from as few as four scalar RPSF samples per frame pair. The method requires no iterative optimization, feature extraction or interpolation, which is suitable for resource-constrained onboard processing. Simulation results confirm sub-pixel translation accuracy and a mean rotation error of 0.2556° at 1° Radon angular resolution. Validation on five real space debris datasets including both ground-based and in-orbit observations yields a mean calibration error below 0.5 pixels, substantially exceeding the precision required for reliable multi-frame processing.

</details>


### [134] [CARDEA: Auditable Reasoning Grounded in Spatial Evidence for End-to-End Coronary Angiography Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06931)
*Jia-Jen Lee,Shih-Yen Hou,Kee Koon Ng,Wei-Chun Wang,Shih-Sheng Chang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了CARDEA，一个用于有创冠状动脉造影（CAG）分析的统一大视觉语言模型，通过三阶段训练（视觉特征对齐、自蒸馏Chain-of-Box冷启动、可验证奖励强化学习），不仅能进行闭合式病理诊断，还能在零样本条件下生成可审计的开放式报告，优于无监督微调基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有创冠状动脉造影是冠心病诊断的金标准，但不同观察者间解读差异大。现有AI系统虽能提升一致性，但缺乏可审计的决策过程，且无法进行全面的开放式评估，削弱了临床医生的信任和临床采用准备度。

Method: CARDEA是一个统一的视觉语言大模型，作为CAG流程的推理核心。训练仅基于公开数据集和闭合式任务，分三个阶段：视觉特征对齐、自蒸馏Chain-of-Box冷启动、带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），其中CoB奖励鼓励在推理轨迹中使用边界框。评估了研究级诊断（优势性分类和复杂性评估），报告生成在训练中被排除，通过外部队列上进行零样本评估。

Result: 在分布内优势性分类上CARDEA略逊于专用分类器，但在域偏移下持平（准确率0.91）。复杂性评估与心脏科医生相当（准确率0.90）。只有RLVR改善了零样本报告生成，将血管严重度宏F1从0.513提升至0.686，是always-normal基线的两倍以上。CARDEA能从原始多视角视频端到端运行完整CAG流程，同时暴露可审计的空间证据。

Conclusion: 在可验证闭合式任务上的RLVR能够涌现出监督模仿无法实现的开放式报告能力。CARDEA提供端到端CAG分析并具备可审计的空间证据，但临床应用仍需与专家心脏病学家进行前瞻性验证。

Abstract: Invasive coronary angiography (CAG) is the gold standard for diagnosing coronary artery disease, but interpretation varies substantially among observers. Existing AI systems can improve consistency but lack auditable decision processes and are limited in comprehensive open-ended assessment, undermining clinician trust and clinical adoption readiness. We developed CARDEA, a unified large vision-language model that serves as the inference core of a CAG pipeline. It was trained solely on public datasets and closed-ended tasks in three stages: visual feature alignment, a self-distilled Chain-of-Box (CoB) cold start, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) with a CoB reward encouraging bounding-box use in the reasoning trace. We assessed its two study-level diagnoses, dominance classification and complexity assessment, against a dedicated classifier and two interventional cardiologists. Report generation was excluded from training and evaluated zero-shot across stages on an external cohort using vessel-severity macro-$F_1$. CARDEA trailed the classifier on in-distribution dominance but drew level under domain shift (accuracy, 0.91 [95% confidence interval (CI), 0.86 to 0.95]) and was comparable to the cardiologists on complexity assessment (accuracy, 0.90 [CI, 0.82 to 0.97]). Only RLVR improved zero-shot report generation, raising its vessel-severity macro-$F_1$ (0.686 [CI, 0.664 to 0.707]) above the untuned base model (0.513) and over twice the always-normal floor (0.312). CARDEA runs an end-to-end CAG pipeline from raw multi-view videos through keyframe selection to study-level diagnosis while exposing auditable spatial evidence behind its conclusions. RLVR on verifiable closed-ended tasks surfaced open-ended reporting ability that supervised imitation did not. Clinical use requires prospective validation against expert cardiologists.

</details>


### [135] [PRG-Fusion: Orchestrating Generative Priors with Reconstruction Evidence for Driving View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06948)
*Sipeng He,Jialei Chen,Zhen Fang,Dongchun Ren,Feng Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PRG-Fusion是一个用于驾驶场景视图合成的框架，结合了基于重建的方法和生成模型的优势。它从重建的驾驶场景中提取区域级退化证据，将其转换为Preserve、Repair和Generate（PRG）标签，作为区域感知时空合成的统一路由策略，分别指导3DGS外观保留、LiDAR引导的结构修复和视频先验驱动的内容生成。采用两阶段训练范式，先在稀疏LiDAR投影上建立几何控制，再在密集3DGS渲染上学习外观控制。在Waymo数据集上实现了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重建方法在视角偏离训练轨迹时会出现伪影和内容缺失，而生成模型难以保持时间与几何一致性。作者希望结合两者的优势，同时解决视角偏移下的真实感合成与时空一致性维护问题。

Method: 1) 从重建场景中提取区域级退化证据，转化为Preserve/Repair/Generate三分类标签；2) 使用这些标签作为统一路由策略，实现对3DGS外观保留、LiDAR结构修复和视频先验补全的分区域协同；3) 两阶段训练：先通过稀疏LiDAR投影建立几何控制，再通过密集3DGS渲染学习外观控制。

Result: 在Waymo数据集上的实验表明，PRG-Fusion在新轨迹视频合成任务中取得SOTA综合性能，在视觉质量和几何保真度上表现优越，同时在大轨迹偏移下保持具有竞争力的视图一致性。

Conclusion: 通过重建证据驱动的区域级生成先验编排策略，PRG-Fusion有效弥合了重建方法与生成模型之间的差距，为可扩展的闭环驾驶模拟提供了高质量的新轨迹视频合成方案。

Abstract: Synthesizing photorealistic driving videos along specified trajectories is essential for scalable closed-loop simulation. Reconstruction-based methods leverage neural rendering to synthesize geometrically consistent views, but often exhibit diverse artifacts and missing content when the viewpoint deviates from the training trajectory. In contrast, generative models can synthesize realistic views along arbitrary trajectories from vehicle sensor data, yet often struggle to maintain temporal and geometric consistency across frames. To combine the strengths of both, we propose PRG-Fusion, a framework for driving view synthesis that uses reconstruction evidence to orchestrate generative priors across regions. Specifically, we extract region-wise degradation evidence from reconstructed driving scenes and convert it into Preserve, Repair, and Generate (PRG) labels. At inference, these labels serve as a unified routing policy for region-aware spatiotemporal synthesis, orchestrating 3DGS appearance preservation, LiDAR-guided structural correction, and video-prior-driven content completion across Preserve, Repair, and Generate regions, respectively. We then follow a two-stage training paradigm, first establish geometric control from sparse LiDAR projections and subsequently learning appearance control from dense 3DGS renderings. Extensive experiments on Waymo demonstrate that PRG-Fusion achieves state-of-the-art overall performance in novel trajectory video synthesis, with superior visual quality and geometric fidelity while maintaining competitive view consistency under large trajectory shifts.

</details>


### [136] [Joint-Conditioned Stereo Surface Reasoning for Interaction Field Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06955)
*Yanlin Jin,Yifan Yang,Bowen Yang,Kai Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出JSSR（联合条件立体表面推理）方法，用于预测手-物体交互场。该方法将任务视为联合条件表面端点估计，利用时域立体网络同时预测3D关节点、直接交互场和每视角端点证据，并结合校准候选搜索与手共享候选支持机制，在SHOW3D交互场挑战赛中排名第三。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测手-物体交互场需要为每个手部关节定位最近的物体表面点，这些点通常来自小而部分遮挡的图像区域，传统方法难以在此类模糊观测下精确估计。

Method: 将任务建模为联合条件表面端点估计：每个关节有自己的最近端点，但同一手部的端点可共享局部表面证据。具体采用：(1)时域立体网络联合预测3D关节点、直接交互场及每视角端点证据；(2)校准候选搜索，利用关节特定图像兼容性和跨视角对应关系评估端点假设；(3)手共享候选支持机制，让关节利用共同表面证据；(4)学习残差门控，在上观测模糊时控制几何矫正。

Result: 该方法在SHOW3D交互场挑战赛排行榜上位列第三。

Conclusion: 联合条件表面端点估计结构结合共享表面证据与残差门控机制，能有效应对小区域、部分遮挡下的交互场预测挑战，验证了手-物体交互推理中关节间共享局部信息的重要性。

Abstract: Predicting hand--object interaction fields requires locating the nearest object-surface point for each hand joint, often from small and partially occluded image regions. We view this task as joint-conditioned surface-endpoint estimation: each joint has its own nearest endpoint, while endpoints from the same hand can draw on shared local surface evidence. This structure motivates Joint-Conditioned Stereo Surface Reasoning (JSSR). A temporal-stereo network jointly predicts 3D joints, a direct interaction field, and per-view endpoint evidence. Calibrated candidate search evaluates endpoint hypotheses using joint-specific image compatibility and cross-view correspondence. A hand-shared candidate support lets joints draw on common surface evidence, and a learned residual gate controls the geometric correction when observations are ambiguous. Our system built on this method ranked third on the SHOW3D Interaction Field Challenge leaderboard.

</details>


### [137] [MSSP: Multi-Scale Spatially-Constrained Partition for Unsupervised Semantic Segmentation of 3D Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06959)
*Zhenghao Zhang,Xinjie Wang,Wei Wang,Jun Zhang,Hanyun Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了MSSP框架，结合多尺度谱分析与空间约束聚类，用于无监督3D点云语义分割，在S3DIS和ScanNet上达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于超点的方法通常依赖固定粒度的谱分析，无法捕捉复杂室内场景中固有的层次化语义结构，且手工标注成本高昂。

Method: MSSP框架包含两部分：多尺度谱分析用于在多个聚类粒度下构建丰富的超点描述符；空间约束聚类通过限制超点合并仅发生在物理相邻区域，为高维特征空间提供结构先验，实现更干净的分割。

Result: 在S3DIS和ScanNet上，MSSP在无监督方法中取得了最佳mIoU，尤其在S3DIS上提升显著。

Conclusion: 消融实验揭示了"先正则化再丰富"的交互机制：多尺度特征单独使用不提升最终分割效果，但与空间正则化结合后变得高效，说明空间一致性是多尺度表示在超点聚类中发挥作用的前提条件。

Abstract: 3D point cloud semantic segmentation is essential for real-world spatial understanding, yet the prohibitive cost of human annotations motivates unsupervised approaches that require no labels. Existing superpoint-based methods typically rely on spectral analysis at a fixed granularity, failing to capture the hierarchical semantic structures inherent in complex indoor scenes. To bridge this gap, we present a Multi-Scale Spatially-Constrained Partition (MSSP) framework that combines multi-scale spectral analysis with spatially-constrained clustering. Multi-scale spectral analysis constructs enriched superpoint descriptors across multiple clustering granularities; however, the resulting high-dimensional feature space calls for a structural prior to translate into cleaner segmentation. Spatially-constrained clustering supplies this prior by restricting superpoint merging to physically adjacent regions, imposing the spatial coherence needed for multi-scale features to be effective. Extensive experiments on S3DIS and ScanNet show that MSSP achieves the best mIoU among unsupervised methods on the main benchmarks, with particularly significant gains on S3DIS. Notably, our ablation reveals a regularize-then-enrich interaction: multi-scale features alone do not improve final segmentation, yet become highly effective when coupled with spatial regularization, underscoring that spatial coherence is aprerequisite for multi-scale representations in superpoint clustering.

</details>


### [138] [DPSF-Net: A Dual-Prior Spatial-Frequency Network for Real-World Remote Sensing Image Dehazing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06962)
*Mei Lu,Shangliang Shao,Shanliang Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DPSF-Net，一种基于双先验（RGB + 暗通道先验图）的空间-频域联合网络，用于真实遥感影像去雾。网络包含空间-频率残差交互块、先验引导特征注意力模块和选择性核互补融合模块，在真实RRSHID基准上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实遥感影像去雾面临大气散射、空间不均匀雾和颜色失真共同导致的退化和光谱信息损失。现有深度学习方法多依赖RGB输入和空间域特征提取，难以将全局背景雾与局部地表细节分离。

Method: 1) 以模糊RGB图和暗通道先验(DCP)图作为联合输入，引入物理退化线索指导端到端特征学习。2) 空间-频率残差交互块：在多方向空间交互中引入FourierUnit分支以建模大尺度雾分量。3) 先验引导特征注意力模块：自适应融合先验特征与注意力特征以减少色彩偏移和结构失真。4) 选择性核互补融合模块：通过双向残差互补门控和选择性核融合筛选多尺度跳跃特征。

Result: 在真实世界RRSHID遥感去雾基准上达到SOTA性能，在多个合成数据集上保持竞争力，并在复原质量、参数量和计算复杂度之间实现了良好平衡。

Conclusion: 双先验空间-频率建模方法能有效支持真实遥感影像去雾任务，在效果与效率间取得良好折衷，验证了所提各模块的有效性。

Abstract: Real-world remote sensing image dehazing (RSID) remains challenging because atmospheric scattering, spatially non-uniform haze and colour distortion jointly degrade structural and spectral information. Most deep learning methods rely on RGB inputs and spatial-domain feature extraction, which limits their ability to separate global background haze from local surface details. Here, we propose DPSF-Net, a dual-prior spatial-frequency network built on MCAF-Net for real-world RSID. The network uses hazy RGB images and dark channel prior (DCP) maps as joint inputs, allowing physical degradation cues to guide end-to-end feature learning. A spatial-frequency residual interaction block introduces a FourierUnit branch into multi-directional spatial interaction to model large-scale haze components. A prior-guided feature attention module adaptively fuses prior and attention features to reduce colour shift and structural distortion. A selective kernel complementary fusion module screens multi-scale skip features through bidirectional residual complementary gating and selective kernel fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DPSF-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance on the real-world RRSHID remote sensing image dehazing benchmark and remains competitive across multiple synthetic datasets. Moreover, the proposed method strikes a favourable balance among restoration quality, parameter count and computational complexity, supporting the effectiveness of dual-prior spatial-frequency modelling.

</details>


### [139] [Re-calibrated Contrastive Loss for Transformation-Aware Prompt Conditioning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06967)
*Seungmin Oh,Seunghun Kang,Jongbin Ryu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对视觉-语言模型迁移学习的方法，通过变换感知的提示条件化（transformation-aware prompt conditioning）和重新校准的对比损失（re-calibrated contrastive loss）来改善迁移效果。该方法利用固定文本描述符标识图像变换，在变换层面统一图像和文本分支，同时通过新的损失函数缓解软目标交叉熵中正梯度稀释问题，将同类样本视为正样本而非独立实例。实验证明在分布偏移、迁移学习和少样本场景下均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型迁移学习方法忽视数据特征，直接复用预训练阶段的训练策略。它们将同类样本视为不同实例，且图像变换与配对文本提示相互独立，导致模型学习困难，限制了迁移学习效果且可能损害模型的泛化能力。

Method: 1) 变换感知提示条件化：使用固定文本描述符标识施加在配对图像上的变换，提供变换层面的一致性而无需改变类别语义，使图像和文本分支在变换层面对齐。2) 重新校准的对比损失：缓解当每个锚点具有多个有效正样本时，软目标交叉熵中的正梯度稀释问题，将同类样本视为正样本而非独立实例。

Result: 在分布偏移、迁移学习和少样本设置下的实验中，该方法相比现有方法表现出一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过变换感知提示条件化和重新校准的对比损失，该方法能够在不损害泛化能力的前提下，更有效地学习领域特定特征，实现更优的视觉-语言模型迁移学习。

Abstract: Ensuring effective transfer learning for vision-language models without compromising their generalization performance is crucial. However, many existing methods overlook data characteristics and simply reuse the training strategies adopted during pre-training. Specifically, they treat same-class samples as distinct instances and transform images independently of their paired text prompts, which makes model learning more difficult. We address these limitations through transformation-aware prompt conditioning and a re-calibrated contrastive loss. Fixed text descriptors identify the transformations applied to paired images, providing transformation-level consistency without altering class semantics. This design aligns the image and text branches at the transformation level, enabling richer representations while preserving the models' ability to generalize. In addition, our loss function mitigates positive-gradient dilution in soft-target cross-entropy when each anchor has multiple valid positives. During transfer, our approach treats same-class samples as positives rather than distinct instances, enabling the model to learn domain-specific features more effectively. Experiments across distribution shift, transfer learning, and few-shot settings demonstrate consistent improvements over existing approaches. Source code for our method is available at https://github.com/SoongE/ReCalCon.

</details>
