On CalCROP21, JEDI-B0 achieves 68.0 mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) with 4.04M parameters, improving over the standalone student by 16.0 points and coming within 2.0 points of the 70.0 mIoU achieved by the 639M-parameter teacher. We evaluate SegFormer B0, B1, and B2 students with 4.04M, 14.33M, and 28M parameters, respectively. Across all three variants, JEDI consistently outperforms response-, structure-, channel-, and relational-distillation baselines under the same teacher-student setting. These results show that persistent representation alignment is especially valuable under aggressive compression, substantially reducing model size and computation while preserving segmentation performance.

</details>


### [210] [Poisson Image Denoising Using Minimax Concave and Reweighted $\ell_1$ Penalties: Nonblind and Blind Approaches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07916)
*Reza Parvaz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于分数阶导数重加权ℓ1正则化和Minimax Concave Penalty (MCP)的图像去模糊方法，用于处理受泊松噪声和模糊影响的图像。该方法同时适用于非盲和盲去模糊场景，并采用ADMM算法求解非凸优化模型，通过实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像去模糊是医学和天文等科学领域的重要问题。泊松噪声和模糊会降低图像质量，且在盲去模糊情况下缺乏点扩散函数(PSF)的先验信息，使得问题更加复杂。总变分(TV)方法虽广泛使用，但罚函数的选择对其性能影响至关重要。现有方法在边缘保持方面仍有不足，需要更有效的正则化策略。

Method: 1) 采用重加权ℓ1正则化的分数阶导数来改善边缘保持能力；2) 使用Minimax Concave Penalty (MCP)——一种连续、促进稀疏性且近似无偏的正则化器，构建非凸优化模型；3) 该方法同时适用于非盲去模糊（已知PSF）和盲去模糊（未知PSF）两种情形；4) 提出基于交替方向乘子法(ADMM)的高效数值算法，并给出收敛性分析。

Result: 通过在多种图像上进行大量实验，验证了所提出的非盲和盲去模糊算法在泊松噪声下的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的结合MCP和分数阶导数重加权ℓ1正则化的ADMM算法，能有效解决泊松噪声下的图像去模糊问题，在改善边缘保持方面具有良好的表现。

Abstract: Images are important tools in various sciences. Despite the development of photo-taking tools, creating clear and image without noise remains challenging in practice. In particular, Poisson noise has an effect on medical and astronomical images, and reduces their quality. Additionally, blur is another factor that has an effect on image quality. The problem of image restoration becomes very complicated when we have no information about the Point Spread Function (PSF). These types of problems are known as blind case. However, in some images, such as some astronomical images, the type of PSF can be specified, and these types of problems are known as nonblind problems. Total Variation (TV) is a widely used method for solving such inverse problems, where the selection of the penalty function is the most critical factor that affects the method's performance. In this paper, to improve edge preservation, we employ a reweighted $\ell_1$-regularization of the fractional order derivative. Furthermore, we propose a nonblind and blind image deblurring approach under Poisson noise using the Minimax Concave Penalty (MCP), which is a continuous, sparsity promoting, and nearly unbiased regularizer. This formulation leads to a nonconvex optimization model. To solve the proposed model, we introduce an efficient numerical algorithm based on the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) and provide an analysis of its convergence. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm are demonstrated through extensive experiments on various images.

</details>


### [211] [TDDN: Text-aligned Diffused DINO Network for Puzzle Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07937)
*Harsha Patnala,Debopriyo Banerjee,Ayush Sunil Munot,Somak Aditya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TDDN模型，通过融合DINOv3和CleanDIFT表示构建DiffusedDINO感知编码器，并与RoBERTa-L对齐，仅用约59万对齐对即达到CLIP的图像文本检索性能，同时将密集预测精度提升三倍以上，并引入Puzzle Perception数据集测试细粒度空间理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视觉语言模型（VLMs）基于CLIP风格的ViT骨干网络，牺牲细粒度视觉细节以换取高层语义信息，导致缺乏结构化的细粒度视觉推理能力（如图像谜题）。这种细节损失会向下游任务传播，需要恢复感知能力。

Method: 1) 将DINOv3与CleanDIFT表示融合到感知编码器（DiffusedDINO）中；2) 将DiffusedDINO与RoBERTa-L进行文本对齐，得到TDDN模型；3) 使用冻结骨干网络和约59万对齐对进行训练；4) 构建Puzzle Perception数据集，包含分割和视觉问答任务。

Result: TDDN在图像文本检索上与CLIP持平并在四个设置中的三个超越CLIP；在ADE20K上mIoU从5.20提升至18.11（超3倍），在COCO-Stuff上从7.35提升至24.44；在分割基准上领先包括SigLIP 2在内的通用对比编码器；在Puzzle Perception上分割准确率从11.04翻倍至22.51。

Conclusion: 融合自监督细粒度表示（DINOv3/CleanDIFT）与语言对齐可以在不依赖大规模训练语料的情况下，同时保持文本对齐能力和显著提升的密集预测/细粒度感知能力，证明"感知-语言"两条能力线可以兼得。

Abstract: Structured visual reasoning, such as image puzzles, demands fine-grained visual perception, an ability current Vision Language Models (VLMs) lack. VLMs built on CLIP-based ViT backbones trade fine-grained detail for high-level semantics, and we show this loss propagates downstream. To recover it, we fuse DINOv3 and CleanDIFT representations into a perception encoder (DiffusedDINO) and align it with RoBERTa-L, yielding a text-aligned model TDDN that preserves this perceptual advantage: with frozen backbones and only $\sim$590K alignment pairs, TDDN matches CLIP on image-text retrieval, surpassing it on three of four settings. It does so while more than tripling CLIP's dense-prediction accuracy (ADE20K 5.20 $\to$ 18.11 mIoU, COCO-Stuff 7.35 $\to$ 24.44), despite CLIP's massive training corpus. TDDN leads on segmentation benchmarks among general-purpose contrastive encoders, including SigLIP$\,$2. We further introduce Puzzle Perception, a segmentation and visual question answering dataset that probes fine-grained spatial understanding, on which TDDN doubles CLIP's segmentation accuracy (11.04 $\to$ 22.51 mIoU).

</details>


### [212] [Bottom-up Modeling of Repeated Elements via Single Image Analysis-by-Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07939)
*Syrine Kalleli,Alexei A. Efros,Mathieu Aubry*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种仅从单张图像中自底向上发现重复元素的方法，无需大型标注数据集或分割掩码，仅依赖粗略尺度先验，通过学习可调图像空间原型和重建目标来识别和合成一致的物体实例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有重复元素发现方法依赖于大型标注数据集、多图像集合或物体分割掩码，这些前提条件在真实场景中往往难以满足。作者希望探索是否仅凭单张图像就能以完全自底向上的方式学习有意义的物体模型。

Method: 提出一种无监督学习方法：利用粗略尺度先验，通过重建目标学习图像空间中可调的原型（tunable prototype），使模型能够识别图像内重复的物体实例并合成一致的物体模型。

Result: 在FSC-147数据集的116张真实图像上验证了方法的有效性，成功学习了连贯的元素模型并捕捉了类内变化；与经典分解、联合对齐和3D物体建模方法相比，在重建质量和分解可解释性上表现更优，同时保持简单的2D公式。

Conclusion: 结果说明仅从单张图像学习即可实现有意义的物体发现，为无先验的重复元素挖掘提供了新的可能性。

Abstract: We address the problem of discovering repeated elements from a single image. In contrast to existing approaches that depend on large annotated datasets, curated multi-image collections, or object segmentation masks, we show that a single image can suffice to learn a meaningful object model in a completely bottom-up fashion, without any prior knowledge beyond a coarse scale prior. Our method learns a tunable image-space prototype of the repeated elements through a reconstruction objective, enabling the model to identify and synthesize consistent object instances within the same image. Experiments on 116 real images from the FSC-147 dataset demonstrate that our method successfully learns coherent element models and captures intra-category variation on challenging images. Qualitative results reveal superior reconstructions and interpretable decompositions compared to classical decomposition, joint alignment, and 3D object modeling methods, while maintaining a simple 2D formulation. These results suggest that meaningful object discovery can emerge from single image learning alone.

</details>


### [213] [ReactVAU: A Slow-Fast Decoupled Framework for Streaming Video Anomaly Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07941)
*Chia-Hui Chen,Shih-Ying Yeh,Fu-En Yang,Min-Hung Chen,Shang-Hong Lai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ReactVAU，一种面向实时流式视频异常理解的快慢解耦框架。它通过轻量级快速检测模块持续过滤异常、异常感知持久记忆保护关键视觉线索，以及仅在可疑事件时才被唤醒的重型慢推理模块，在严格的流式约束下同时实现了有竞争力的异常检测与因果推理性能，并显著减少了重型MLLM的调用次数以提升计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频异常理解(VAU)方法依赖全局时间采样的离线推理，违反因果性且无法部署于实时监控流；而通用流式视频模型虽满足因果访问，但在记忆压缩中会稀释罕见的瞬时异常，并会对长时间正常片段统一调用重型MLLM，造成资源浪费。

Method: ReactVAU包含三个协同组件：(1)基于空间网格折叠(SGF)的轻量级快速检测模块，用于持续异常过滤；(2)异常感知持久记忆(AAPM)，保护关键视觉线索免于时间衰减；(3)重型慢推理模块，正常流期间保持休眠，仅在可疑事件触发时被唤醒以进行语义验证与因果描述。

Result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，ReactVAU在严格的流式约束下运行，同时在异常检测和因果推理方面达到有竞争力的性能，并通过最小化重型MLLM调用显著提升计算效率。

Conclusion: ReactVAU通过快慢解耦的架构设计，有效弥合了离线VAU与通用流式模型之间的鸿沟，实现了实时流式场景下兼顾性能与效率的视频异常理解。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose ReactVAU, a Slow-Fast Decoupled Framework for real-time streaming Video Anomaly Understanding (VAU). Existing VAU methods rely on offline inference with global temporal sampling, which violates causality and prevents deployment in live surveillance streams. Conversely, general streaming video models satisfy causal access but dilute rare transient anomalies during memory compression and often invoke heavyweight MLLMs uniformly over long normal intervals. React VAU addresses this gap with three synergistic components: a lightweight Fast Detection Module based on Spatial Grid Folding (SGF) for continuous anomaly filtering; an Anomaly-Aware Persistent Memory (AAPM) that protects critical visual cues from temporal decay; and a heavyweight Slow Reasoning Module that remains dormant during normal streams and is awakened only by suspicious events for semantic verification and causal description. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ReactVAU operates under strict streaming constraints while simultaneously achieving competitive performance in both anomaly detection and causal reasoning, alongside significantly enhanced computational efficiency by minimizing heavyweight MLLM invocations. Project page is available at https://huiyuiui.github.io/React_VAU/

</details>


### [214] [TaskGuard: Task-Conditioned Restoration Utility for Risk-Aware Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08011)
*Vung Pham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TaskGuard，一个用于冻结的恢复与检测流水线的后置控制器，用于预测图像恢复干预是否对下游目标检测任务有益，而非仅仅看图像视觉质量是否提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像恢复常用于恶劣条件下的目标检测之前，但视觉上改善的图像不一定能改善下游检测任务。这种"恢复-任务不匹配"问题需要通过恢复效用预测来解决——即判断该恢复结果应该被采用还是应保留原始观测图像。

Method: TaskGuard通过表征实际恢复残差与检测器灵敏度的交互作用来预测干预是否对任务有益。利用精确的区域级反事实分析揭示图像内部的效用异质性；部署的伪梯度保留了统计上可靠的定向信息；特征组消融表明任务条件证据提供了超越检测器响应和残差统计的额外信息。

Result: TaskGuard仅在高斯退化上训练并冻结，随后迁移到未见过的运动模糊、雨天和散焦场景。在未见过的退化族上，TaskGuard将损失负向干预减少54.2%（家族宏观）和实际每图像检测退化减少37.0%（汇总），同时保留Always-Restore COCO AP的98.8%。在自然雨天DAWN数据集上，损失负向干预减少97.9%，同时保留去雨获得的AP改进的77.8%。

Conclusion: 研究表明恢复效用是特定干预的任务条件属性，而非仅由图像外观决定；TaskGuard能够有效预测并筛选出对下游检测任务有益的恢复操作，避免有害干预。

Abstract: Image restoration is commonly applied before object detection under adverse conditions, yet a visually improved image need not improve the downstream task. We study this mismatch as restoration utility prediction: given a degraded image and its candidate restoration, should the restoration be used or should the original observation be preserved? We introduce TaskGuard, a post-hoc controller for frozen restoration and detection pipelines. TaskGuard characterizes the realized restoration residual through its interaction with detector sensitivity and predicts whether the intervention is task-beneficial. Exact regional counterfactuals reveal substantial within-image utility heterogeneity, while a deployable pseudo-gradient preserves statistically reliable directional information. Feature-group ablation further shows that task-conditioned evidence contributes information beyond detector-response and residual statistics. The TaskGuard utility predictor is trained only on Gaussian degradation and frozen before final evaluation, then transferred to unseen motion blur, rain, and defocus. Across these unseen families, TaskGuard reduces lossnegative interventions by 54.2% (family macro) and practical per-image detection deteriorations by 37.0% (pooled), while preserving 98.8% of the Always-Restore COCO AP. On natural-rain DAWN, it reduces loss-negative interventions by 97.9% while retaining 77.8% of the AP improvement obtained by deraining. These results support restoration utility as a task-conditioned property of the specific intervention rather than image appearance alone.

</details>


### [215] [A Black-Box Adversarial Attack on Human Pose Estimation and Keypoint-Based Action Recognition Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08013)
*Kacper Mroczek,Michal Kepski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OKS Attack，一种基于决策的黑盒攻击方法，使用Object Keypoint Similarity（OKS）作为攻击反馈信号，直接针对人体姿态的空间结构而非包围框进行攻击，有效降级姿态估计和下游动作识别模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人体姿态估计和基于关键点的动作识别模型日益广泛部署，但其对抗攻击脆弱性研究不足。以往研究中用于视觉目标跟踪的时序一致黑盒攻击依赖于边界框重叠度量（如IoU），但人体姿态估计生成的是关键点配置而非包围框，框级相似度不适用于衡量姿态降级，亟需专门针对关键点结构的攻击方法。

Method: 提出OKS Attack，一种决策型黑盒攻击方法。用Object Keypoint Similarity（OKS）作为攻击反馈信号，直接针对人体姿态的空间结构而非包围框进行攻击。该方法不依赖模型梯度或置信度分数，仅基于关键点相似度反馈进行迭代优化攻击。

Result: 在Penn Action数据集上的实验表明：OKS Attack在不同姿态估计模型上一致降低姿态质量，平均OKS下降幅度在0.0802到0.1494之间；在跨数据集下游动作识别评估中，攻击将准确率降低6.18至13.86个百分点，优于查询匹配的随机噪声扰动；对自上而下和单阶段姿态估计模型均有效。

Conclusion: OKS Attack证明了基于关键点相似度（而非框级度量）的黑盒攻击可有效降级姿态估计和下游动作识别系统，填补了该领域对抗攻击研究的空白，源代码将公开以便后续研究。

Abstract: Human pose estimation and keypoint-based action recognition models are increasingly deployed as components of video understanding pipelines, yet their vulnerability to adversarial attacks remains insufficiently studied. Temporally coherent black-box attacks have been previously studied in visual object tracking, where the attack feedback can be defined using bounding-box overlap measures such as Intersection over Union (IoU). However, human pose estimation produces keypoint configurations rather than enclosing boxes, making box-level similarity poorly suited for measuring pose degradation. We propose OKS Attack, a decision-based black-box attack that uses Object Keypoint Similarity (OKS) as the attack feedback signal, directly targeting the spatial structure of human poses rather than their enclosing boxes. Experiments on the Penn Action dataset show that OKS Attack consistently reduces pose quality across evaluated pose estimators, with mean OKS decreases ranging from 0.0802 to 0.1494. In a downstream cross-dataset action-recognition evaluation, the attack reduces accuracy by 6.18 to 13.86 percentage points and outperforms query-matched random-noise perturbations. The attack is effective across both top-down and single-stage pose estimation models. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/KacperM33/OKS_attack

</details>


### [216] [Flexible Motion Generation from Language and Style References](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08032)
*Kai Weixian Lan,Bodie Criswell,Briana Fedkiw,Zhan Zhang,Joseph Teran,Daniel Holden*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlexMoGen是一个灵活的人体运动合成框架，结合自然语言描述和运动风格参考片段，生成既保留语义内容又忠实反映目标风格的高质量运动。该框架学习无风格监督的变分风格编码器，支持长序列和时间变化的多样风格合成，通过在统一架构中联合预训练风格编码器和文本到运动的潜在扩散模型，在内容保真度和风格表现之间达到最佳平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本提示在定义语义内容上有效，但在捕捉精细的风格细节（如时间节奏、肢体关节运动和表现力动态）方面存在局限。现有方法依赖离散风格标签，无法泛化到长序列或多风格生成场景。因此需要一种能同时利用文本语义和风格示例片段、且不依赖监督标签的灵活运动合成方法。

Method: FlexMoGen采用统一架构，联合预训练一个变分风格编码器（无需风格监督）和一个文本到运动的潜在扩散模型。通过轻量级适配模块调制运动风格，整合高效的相对位置编码方案，并在风格化与非风格化数据集上联合训练，以增强对未见过的文本-风格组合的泛化能力。

Result: 实验表明FlexMoGen在内容保真度和风格表现之间取得了最佳平衡，并支持长序列、时间变化及多样风格的运动合成，对未见过的文本-风格组合展现出强泛化能力。

Conclusion: FlexMoGen证明了通过文本结合风格参考片段进行运动合成是可行的，且不需要离散风格标签，为动画生成提供了更细致的用户控制，同时兼顾了语义内容保留和风格再现。

Abstract: We introduce FlexMoGen, a novel framework for flexible human motion synthesis conditioned on both natural language descriptions and motion style references. Text prompts are effective at defining semantic content, but they are often limited in capturing fine-grained style details such as timing, limb articulation, and expressive dynamics. A style example clip supplements the text by conveying these nuanced motion characteristics directly, enabling the model to preserve high-level intent while reproducing the desired stylistic traits. Given a text prompt and a style example clip, FlexMoGen generates high-quality motions that preserve semantic content while faithfully reflecting the target style, offering users greater control over the animation generation process. Unlike prior methods that rely on discrete style labels and do not generalize to long or multi-style generation, FlexMoGen learns a variational style encoder without style supervision and supports long, time-varying, multi-style synthesis. Our framework jointly pre-trains the style encoder and a text-to-motion latent diffusion model within a unified architecture, modulating motion style through a lightweight adaptation module. It integrates an efficient relative positional encoding scheme and is trained on both stylized and non-stylized datasets, enabling strong generalization to unseen text-style combinations. Experiments show that FlexMoGen achieves the best balance between content fidelity and style reflection.

</details>


### [217] [SAFER-Activities: A Dataset for Smart Assessment of Fall Events and Routine Activities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08038)
*Diwas Lamsal,Pramod Wickramatilake,Jednipat Moonrinta,Mongkol Ekpanyapong,Matthew N. Dailey*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了SAFER-Activities数据集，一个用于跌倒检测和身体活动监测的大规模视频数据集，包含66小时多相机视频、85,310个动作实例和30个动作类别的帧级标注，并专门设有轮椅使用场景子集。作者在室内、分布外和跨数据集测试集上对2D/3D骨架模型、冻结骨干的RGB模型及多模态融合策略进行了基准测试，发现骨架模型在领域偏移下泛化最佳，而融合冻结RGB特征在室内识别上有提升但分布外表现下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作识别数据集多为片段级别，缺乏在线动作识别所需的帧级细粒度信息，特别是在跌倒检测等需要及时干预的关键场景中。为行动不便人群（如轮椅使用者）提供精确的实时动作识别，需要更精细标注的数据集。

Method: 构建SAFER-Activities数据集：超过66小时多视角视频数据，85,310个动作实例，30个动作类别的帧级标注，含专门的轮椅使用场景子集；并基准测试2D和3D骨架模型、冻结骨干RGB模型以及多模态融合策略，评估在室内、分布外和跨数据集测试集上的表现。

Result: 骨架模型在领域偏移下泛化最佳；将冻结RGB特征与骨架流融合在室内识别上优于基线CNN1D，在轮椅子集上效果最明显，但在分布外场景下性能下降。跨数据集和定性评估证实训练于SAFER-Activities的模型能很好地迁移到未知环境和外部跌倒数据。

Conclusion: SAFER-Activities为跌倒检测和活动监测的鲁棒研究提供了宝贵的帧级标注资源，研究结果为未来多模态融合和领域泛化方法的优化指明了方向。数据集和代码已公开发布以支持社区研究。

Abstract: Smart healthcare monitoring systems require precise action recognition to ensure well-being and timely intervention in critical situations such as falls, particularly for mobility-challenged individuals. Existing datasets are often clip-based, lacking the frame-level detail needed to recognize actions online, as they unfold. To address this, we introduce SAFER-Activities, a dataset for fall detection and physical activity monitoring, with a dedicated subset for wheelchair use scenarios. It comprises over 66 hours of video data captured by multiple cameras, with 85,310 action instances and frame-level annotations for 30 action classes. We benchmark action recognition on SAFER-Activities with 2D and 3D skeleton models, RGB models with frozen backbones, and multimodal fusion strategies, and evaluate on in-lab, out-of-distribution, and cross-dataset test sets. Skeleton-based models generalize best under domain shift; fusing frozen RGB features with the skeleton stream improves in-domain recognition over the baseline CNN1D, most clearly on the wheelchair subset, but degrades out of distribution. Cross-dataset and qualitative evaluations confirm that models trained on SAFER-Activities transfer well to unseen environments and external fall data. To support research on robust fall detection and activity monitoring, we release the dataset and code at https://safer-activities.github.io/.

</details>


### [218] [MamMA: A Mamba-Based Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction Algorithm Considering Occupancy Map and Pedestrian Awareness States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08041)
*Juncen Long,Xiaofeng Jin,Gianluca Bardaro,Simone Mentasti,Matteo Matteucci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MamMA，一种基于Mamba的 pedestrian轨迹预测算法，结合占用网格地图和行人感知状态，在多个数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轨迹预测算法多使用俯视图图像提取行人周围障碍物信息，而移动机器人实际使用LiDAR生成局部占用地图，且机载视觉传感器提供包含行人精细行为信息的自我中心视角图像。为了更好地利用LiDAR和视觉传感器采集的信息，需要一种能结合占用地图和行人感知状态的新方法。

Method: MamMA将占用地图划分为patch，从每个patch提取障碍物特征以构建地图特征；将行人感知状态进行分类并纳入考量（因为感知状态影响行人的知觉和速度）；基于Mamba模型，利用不同类型的特征预测行人的未来轨迹。

Result: 在STCrowd、SiT、JRDB、ETH和UCY数据集上的实验表明，MamMA在平均位移误差（ADE）和最终位移误差（FDE）上均优于当前最先进的算法。

Conclusion: MamMA通过融合LiDAR占用地图信息和行人感知状态，有效提升了行人轨迹预测的准确性，适用于移动机器人在人机共存环境中的安全导航。

Abstract: Many pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithms have been proposed to improve the safety of navigation for mobile robots working in human-robot coexistence environments. Some pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithms extract information about obstacles near pedestrians from top-down view images to improve the accuracy of trajectory prediction. However, mobile robots typically create local occupancy maps using LiDAR, rather than top-down view images. Meanwhile, the vision sensors on board robots provide egocentric view images, which contain fine-grained behavioral information about the pedestrians near the robot. To better use the information collected by LiDAR and on-board vision sensors, we propose MamMA, a Mamba-based pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithm considering occupancy maps and pedestrian awareness states. MamMA divides the occupancy map by patches and extracts obstacle features from each patch to create map features. Pedestrian awareness states are divided and considered, as some studies show that awareness states affect the perception and speed of pedestrians. Furthermore, a Mamba-based model is proposed to predict the future trajectories of pedestrians based on different types of features. Experiments on the STCrowd, SiT, JRDB, ETH, and UCY datasets show that MamMA achieves better average displacement error and final displacement error than the state-of-the-art algorithms.

</details>


### [219] [A Quantitative Evaluation Framework for Temporal Explainability in Echocardiographic Video Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08043)
*Jiyoo Noh,Jonathan H. Chan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于评估超声心动图视频分割模型中Grad-CAM时间可解释性的定量框架，通过四个互补指标（时间一致性、显著图运动、解剖重叠和时间重叠）对比2D U-Net与ConvLSTM U-Net模型，发现中间ConvLSTM解释的稳定性低于最终预测解释，并指出传统逐帧度量无法区分有意义的特征演化与解释不稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习在超声心动图视频分割中已达到最先进水平，越来越多模型整合时间信息，但时间可解释性的定量评估在很大程度上仍未被探索。

Method: 提出包含时间一致性、显著图运动、解剖重叠和时间重叠四个互补指标的定量框架，在EchoNet-Dynamic数据集上对比基线2D U-Net与在不同时间步长上训练的ConvLSTM U-Net模型的Grad-CAM解释。

Result: 所有模型分割性能相当，但中间ConvLSTM解释表现出显著较低的显著一致性及更大的质心运动；Temporal Bottleneck解释比Encoder Bottleneck解释在所有步长上更稳定；最终ConvLSTM Decoder3解释与2D U-Net基本相当。

Conclusion: 该研究建立了时间可解释性的初步定量框架，并激励开发能够显式考虑医学视频模型中演化表征的时间感知XAI方法。

Abstract: Deep learning has achieved state-of-the-art performance in echocardiographic video segmentation, with an increasing number of models incorporating temporal information. However, quantitative evaluation of temporal explainability remains largely unexplored. We propose a quantitative framework for evaluating Grad-CAM explanations using four complementary metrics measuring temporal consistency, saliency motion, anatomical overlap, and temporal overlap. Using EchoNet-Dynamic, we compare a baseline 2D U-Net with ConvLSTM U-Net models trained across multiple temporal strides. While segmentation performance remained comparable across all models, intermediate ConvLSTM explanations exhibited substantially lower saliency consistency and greater centroid motion than final prediction explanations. Temporal Bottleneck explanations were significantly more stable than Encoder Bottleneck explanations across all strides, while final ConvLSTM Decoder3 explanations were broadly comparable to those of the 2D U-Net. Importantly, conventional frame-wise explanation metrics cannot determine whether variation in intermediate explanations reflects meaningful temporal feature evolution or explanation instability. These findings establish a preliminary quantitative framework for temporal explainability and motivate temporal-aware XAI methods that explicitly account for evolving representations in medical video models.

</details>


### [220] [Studying Image Tokenizers as Visual Languages in Unified Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09143)
*Siting Li,Zhengyang Wang,Simon Shaolei Du,Xi Chen,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个受控的纯自回归测试平台，通过追踪多模态持续预训练中文本、图像、T2I和I2T预测的任务特定验证损失，研究图像分词器在多模态联合建模中的作用。研究发现损失应按任务分析（具有不同的缩放行为和对分词器的排名），损失-性能关系取决于预测令牌空间（T2I损失跨分词器不稳定，而共享文本词汇上的I2T损失更一致），更好的重建并不必然带来更低的任务损失或更强的下游性能，且图像分词器的选择会影响联合优化下的文本建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像分词器定义了统一多模态模型的"视觉语言"，但现有研究通常通过隔离指标或仅生成/仅理解评价来研究，无法充分捕获视觉令牌与文本联合建模时的行为。作者希望建立一个更全面的评估框架，从任务特定验证损失的角度理解图像分词器在多模态联合训练中的表现。

Method: 构建一个受控的纯自回归测试平台，在文本、图像、T2I（文本到图像）和I2T（图像到文本）预测之间进行多模态持续预训练，追踪任务特定的验证损失。通过分析这些损失的缩放行为及其与下游性能的关系，研究多模态可学习性和分词器设计。作为案例研究，重新审视三个分词器设计维度：判别器、语义监督和词汇量大小。

Result: （1）损失应按任务分别分析，因为不同任务呈现出不同的缩放行为并对分词器给出不同的排名；（2）损失-性能关系依赖于预测令牌空间：固定分词器时T2I和I2T损失与生成质量相关，但跨分词器时T2I损失-性能关系随图像令牌空间变化，而I2T损失（基于共享文本词汇）提供更一致的信号，且与生成和视觉理解性能都相关；（3）更好的重建不一定带来更低的任务损失或更强的下游性能；（4）图像分词器选择可能影响联合优化下的文本建模。

Conclusion: 该测试平台为图像分词器作为视觉语言提供了补充视角，强调了图像分词器与文本在联合多模态训练中的相互作用。任务特定损失（尤其是共享文本词汇上的I2T损失）可作为跨分词器比较和下游任务预测的更可靠信号。

Abstract: Image tokenizers define the ``visual language'' of unified multimodal models, yet are commonly studied through isolated metrics or generation-/understanding-only evaluations. These evaluations do not fully capture how visual tokens behave when modeled jointly with text. We build a controlled pure-autoregressive testbed and track task-specific validation losses during multimodal continual pretraining across text, image, text-to-image (T2I), and image-to-text (I2T) prediction. We examine how these losses scale and relate to downstream performance, then use them to study multimodal learnability---how well image and text tokens are jointly modeled---and tokenizer design. We find that (1) losses should be analyzed by task, since they exhibit distinct scaling behavior and rank tokenizers differently. (2) The loss--performance relationship depends on the predicted token space: for a fixed tokenizer, T2I and I2T losses correlate with generation quality, but across tokenizers, the T2I loss--performance relationship shifts with the image-token space, whereas I2T loss, computed over a shared text vocabulary, provides a more consistent signal. I2T loss also correlates with both generation and visual understanding performance after supervised finetuning. Using losses as a lens, we show that (3) better reconstruction does not necessarily yield lower task-specific losses or stronger downstream performance, and that (4) image tokenizer choice can affect text modeling under joint optimization. As case studies, we revisit three tokenizer design axes---the discriminator, semantic supervision, and vocabulary size---to examine their effects on joint modeling and downstream performance. Together, our testbed offers a complementary perspective on image tokenizers as visual languages, highlighting their interplay with text in joint multimodal training.

</details>


### [221] [RFS-UNet: Decoder-Conditioned High-Resolution Skip Recalibration for Bone-Selective DRR Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08044)
*Xiaoyang Li,Yixuan Liu,Yuan Chai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RFS-UNet，在512²和256²高分辨率跳跃连接处，利用池化的编码器特征与对齐的解码器统计量进行有界残差通道重校准，验证了解码器状态作为高分辨率特征复用条件信号的有效性。在匹配种子对比中，RFS较仅编码器自校准（Self-RFS）提升验证PSNR 0.254 dB，三种子锁定测试PSNR从33.225±0.048升至33.537±0.128 dB，并在179/200例CT中降低MAE，平均降低3.91%，代价仅为0.117%参数与1.169%卷积运算增量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 骨选择性DRR合成依赖高分辨率编码器细节，但静态跳跃连接无法依据不断演化的解码器表征来条件化特征复用。作者提出疑问：相比仅编码器自校准，解码器状态能否为高分辨率跳跃复用提供额外有用信息。

Method: RFS-UNet在512²与256²跳跃连接处，使用池化的编码器统计量和对齐的解码器统计量，进行有界残差通道重校准（bounded residual channel recalibration），不改变骨干网络结构。通过消融设计（RFS对比Self-RFS）隔离解码器条件化的贡献。

Result: 在配对的seed-2026比较中，RFS较Self-RFS在验证集PSNR上提升0.254 dB。跨三种子，锁定测试PSNR从33.225±0.048提升至33.537±0.128 dB。RFS在179/200个留出CT病例中降低MAE，平均MAE降低3.91%。仅增加0.117%参数和1.169%的Conv2d运算量。

Conclusion: 实验结果支持解码器状态是受控配对投影合成中高分辨率特征复用的有效条件信号，且计算开销极小。

Abstract: Bone-selective digitally reconstructed radiograph (DRR) synthesis depends on high-resolution encoder detail, yet static skips cannot condition reuse on the evolving decoder representation. We ask whether decoder state adds useful information beyond encoder-only self-recalibration for high-resolution skip reuse. RFS-UNet uses pooled encoder and aligned decoder statistics for bounded residual channel recalibration at the 512^2 and 256^2 skips, leaving the backbone unchanged. In the matched seed-2026 comparison isolating decoder conditioning, RFS raises validation PSNR by 0.254 dB over Self-RFS. Across three seeds, locked-test PSNR rises from 33.225+/-0.048 to 33.537+/-0.128 dB; RFS lowers MAE in 179/200 held-out CT cases and reduces mean MAE by 3.91%. It adds 0.117% parameters and 1.169% counted Conv2d operations. These results support decoder state as a useful conditioning signal for high-resolution feature reuse in controlled paired projection synthesis.

</details>


### [222] [BrachistoneLR: A Brachistochrone-Inspired Learning-Rate Schedule and a Controlled Benchmark of Scheduling Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08069)
*Md. Sadekur Rahman Roni,Md. Jalal uddin Chowdhury,Moutusi Dash Nimi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究BrachistoneLR学习率调度策略，证明其本质上是半周期为E-1而非E的余弦退火变体，末端差异仅以E^-2速率衰减，属短水平效应。在72次运行、6种调度、3个数据集和4种架构的受控基准测试中，平滑下降调度显著优于常数率和日历式衰减，而BrachistoneLR与余弦退火及warmup-cosine在统计上无法区分（0.06精度点内）。作者结论是调度形状比参数化更重要，平滑调度的选择本身比选择哪种平滑调度更重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习率调度是深度网络训练中的关键选择，但常用调度策略多为启发式的，且已有比较研究因架构、数据集和预算同时变化而难以解读。需要在一个严格受控的条件下对各种调度策略进行公平比较。

Method: 作者首先从数学上定义BrachistoneLR——将最速降线（brachistochrone）的垂直坐标映射到峰值和基底学习率之间，并展示其等价于半周期为E-1的余弦退火。然后固定优化器、数据管道和评估协议，仅改变调度策略，在3个数据集（MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10）和4种架构家族（全连接、卷积、循环、残差）上对6种调度进行72次运行的基准测试。

Result: 平滑下降调度优于常数率和日历式衰减，优势随任务难度增大而增长，在CIFAR-10上达2.5个数据集均值精度点。BrachistoneLR、余弦退火和warmup-cosine彼此差异在0.06精度点和0.17平均排名内，单种子无法区分。BrachistoneLR在两种残差网络上最佳，且CIFAR-10均值最高，同时无需设置里程碑、衰减因子、预热长度或重启周期。

Conclusion: 调度形状比其参数化更重要；是否使用平滑调度的选择比在平滑调度之间的选择更重要；末端速率差异仅在短训练水平下值得关注。

Abstract: The learning-rate schedule is a consequential choice in training deep networks, yet the policies in common use are heuristic, and published comparisons are hard to read, because architecture, dataset, and budget tend to vary alongside the schedule. We study BrachistoneLR, a schedule built by mapping the vertical coordinate of the brachistochrone, the curve of fastest descent under gravity, onto the range between a peak and a floor rate. Expanding the definition shows it to be cosine annealing with the half-period set to E - 1 instead of E, the configuration a standard implementation gives when its period argument is one less than the number of epochs. The rate therefore reaches its floor at the last epoch trained rather than one epoch later, and we show this difference decays as E^-2, making it a short-horizon effect. We then benchmark six schedules over 72 runs on three image classification datasets (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10) and four architecture families (fully connected, convolutional, recurrent, residual), fixing the optimizer, data pipeline, and evaluation protocol so that only the schedule varies. Schedules that fall smoothly from peak to floor beat the constant rate and calendar-based decay by margins that grow with task difficulty, reaching 2.5 points of dataset mean on CIFAR-10. Within that leading group, BrachistoneLR, cosine annealing, and warmup-cosine lie within 0.06 accuracy points and 0.17 of a mean rank, which one seed per configuration cannot separate. BrachistoneLR is best on both residual networks and has the highest CIFAR-10 mean, and it sets no milestones, decay factor, warmup length, or restart period. We conclude that the shape of a schedule matters more than its parameterization, that the choice of whether to use a smooth schedule matters more than the choice among them, and that the terminal-rate distinction is worth attention only over short horizons.

</details>


### [223] [VI-Bench: Benchmarking Prompt Inversion from AIGC Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08079)
*Wulin Xie,Rui Zhao,Kecen Li,Xiujin Liu,Bokang Zhang,Zheng Liu,Xinwen Hou,Chen Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VI-Bench基准，基于1610万真实用户提示和900个人工验证的AIGC视频，用于评估视频提示反演（video prompt inversion）能力——即模型能否从AIGC视频中恢复出可重放的生成控制参数（如主体、动作、场景、风格、相机）。评估18个VLM后发现即便最强模型Inversion Score也仅0.632，揭示这是独立且未被充分评估的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准仅关注"描述视频内容"，但无法衡量模型是否恢复与生成相关的控制参数（如风格、相机行为等）以复现视频。这一能力对创意复用、编辑以及提示泄漏风险评估都至关重要，却缺乏专门的评测基准。

Method: 构建VI-Bench：基于1610万真实用户提示和900个人工验证AIGC视频；设计三个难度递进的设置（单次语义接地、风格与相机控制、多次组合反演）；覆盖五个生成关键维度（主体、动作、场景、风格、相机）；提出Inversion Score同时度量提示级对齐和视频级保真度；评估18个代表性VLM（2个专有+16个开源）。

Result: 最强模型仅达0.632的Inversion Score；当样本要求更丰富的控制和多次推理时性能急剧下降；模型常生成看似合理的提示，但再生成的视频与参考视频偏差显著。

Conclusion: 视频提示反演是一种独特且被低估的能力，要求模型将视觉理解转化为可复现的生成控制，现有VLM在此方面存在显著局限，亟需专门关注与改进。

Abstract: Recent advances in video generation have made prompt-based control increasingly central to AIGC video generation. Prompts specify what a video should depict and how it should be represented, controlling factors such as visual style or camera behavior. Understanding this recoverability is important both for creative reuse and editing, and for assessing prompt leakage risks. However, existing video understanding benchmarks do not measure this capability: a caption may describe what is visible, but a replayable prompt must recover the generation-relevant controls needed to reproduce the video. To address this gap, we introduce VI-Bench, a benchmark built from 16.1 million real-user prompts and 900 human-verified AIGC videos. VI-Bench spans three progressively harder settings, namely single-shot semantic grounding, control over style and camera behavior, and multi-shot compositional inversion, and evaluates five generation-critical dimensions: subject, action, scene, style, and camera. We evaluate 18 representative VLMs, including 2 proprietary and 16 open-source models on VI-Bench, using an Inversion Score that measures prompt-level alignment with the original prompt and video-level fidelity of the regenerated video. The results reveal substantial limitations: even the strongest model achieves only 0.632 on Inversion Score, performance degrades sharply as samples require richer control and multi-shot reasoning, and models often produce plausible prompts whose regenerated videos deviate from the reference. These findings show that video prompt inversion is a distinct and under-evaluated capability requiring models to transform visual understanding into replay-stable generative control.

</details>


### [224] [Marigold V2: Revisiting Diffusion Transformers for Monocular Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08084)
*Igor Pavlovic,Thiemo Wandel,Anton Obukhov,Luca Bartolomei,Andrey Davydov,Fabio Tosi,Matteo Poggi,Sabine Süsstrunk,Dengxin Dai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Marigold V2，通过重新设计训练配方（包括单步推理、量化友好、语义对齐和基于Sinkhorn损失的两阶段微调），将扩散Transformer（DiT）模型转化为单目深度估计器，在KITTI和ETH3D上相比先前最优方法提升16-26%的AbsRel，能生成更清晰锐利且在分布外数据上泛化良好的深度图，并可推广至表面法线估计和本征图像分解等密集回归任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目深度估计虽然领域成熟，但现有模型仍难以在分布外输入上泛化，且无法生成锐利细腻的深度图（如毛发、树叶等细节）。作者希望通过重新审视Marigold技术，解决这些长期困扰该领域的问题。

Method: 作者采用三种关键技术：(1) 从预训练的多步流匹配模型实现单步推断，并结合量化保持低成本运行；(2) 将模型内部表示与从真实深度标签提取的语义特征对齐，以消除朴素训练的伪影；(3) 采用基于新型Sinkhorn损失的两阶段微调协议来优化训练过程。

Result: 在KITTI和ETH3D数据集上相比先前最优方法在AbsRel指标上提升16-26%；生成的深度图更清晰干净，能解析皮毛、树叶和细发丝边缘等之前模型无法处理的细节；在表面法线估计和本征图像分解等其他密集回归任务上也达到最优性能。

Conclusion: Marigold V2证明了通过精心设计的训练配方，扩散模型架构可以被高效转化为高性能的密集预测任务求解器，不仅大幅提升深度估计质量与泛化性，还能泛化到其他视觉任务，验证了该范式的通用性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Monocular depth estimation is a ubiquitous yet highly ill-posed computer vision task, with downstream applications in scene reconstruction, computational photography, and robotics, among others. Despite the field's maturity, recent models still struggle to generalize to out-of-distribution inputs and to produce sharp and detailed depth maps. In this paper, we revisit Marigold, a set of techniques for repurposing modern image generation and editing models, powered by the diffusion transformer (DiT) architecture, into state-of-the-art monocular depth estimators. Our recipes target single-step inference from pretrained multi-step flow-matching models, with quantization where needed, preserving model capacity while remaining cheap to run. We analyze the artifacts of naive training and identify two effective remedies: aligning the model's internal representations with semantic features extracted from ground-truth, and adopting a 2-stage fine-tuning protocol built around a novel Sinkhorn-based loss. The results are crisper, cleaner depth maps that generalize well out-of-distribution, with 16-26% improvement in AbsRel over the previous best on KITTI and ETH3D. Qualitatively, our model resolves fur, foliage, and hair-thin edges that have eluded prior models. Furthermore, Marigold V2 achieves state-of-the-art results when applied to other dense regression tasks, such as surface normals estimation and intrinsic image decomposition. Project website: https://hf.co/spaces/huawei-bayerlab/marigold-v2-web

</details>


### [225] [SynthGait-19K: A Physically Grounded Synthetic Video Dataset for Gait Parameter Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08108)
*Soroush Mehraban,Xin Lei Lin,Vida Adeli,Majid Mirmehdi,Amirhossein Dadashzadeh,Clint Hansen,Andrea Iaboni,Babak Taati*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SynthGait-19k，一个基于物理原理的合成步态视频数据集，包含19,272个行走视频、6,427个MoCap序列和437个受试者，并开发了Gait2Vid框架将异构MoCap记录统一为SMPL模型并合成多样化的RGB行走视频。作者还引入GaitXFormer作为直接RGB参考模型，实验表明合成监督可有效迁移到真实视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单目视频中准确估计临床步态参数对可扩展的移动性评估很重要，但现有数据集规模小、视角受限、视觉多样性有限，限制了该领域的进展。

Method: 1) 构建SynthGait-19k数据集，包含19,272个行走视频，源自6,427个MoCap序列（437个受试者），配备SMPL运动和六项步态参数注释；2) 开发Gait2Vid框架，通过SMPL统一异构MoCap录音，在可控视角和场景外观下合成多样化RGB行走视频；3) 提出GaitXFormer作为直接RGB参考模型；4) 对直接RGB、基于姿态、生物力学和人体网格恢复等方法进行基准测试，并分析视角、训练数据规模和合成到真实域迁移。

Result: 1) 生成的视频与条件步态运动学保持一致，提取的步态事件与力板测量结果一致；2) 合成监督能有效迁移到真实视频，对GaitXFormer和基于姿态的架构均有效；3) 空间步态参数对视觉域偏移更敏感；4) 改进的HMR重建并不一定能转化为更好的下游步态估计。

Conclusion: 合成数据在不同表示架构上都能有效迁移至真实视频，证明了其广泛实用性。研究同时揭示了视觉域偏移对空间步态参数的显著影响，以及HMR重建质量与下游步态估计性能之间并非简单的正相关关系。

Abstract: Accurate estimation of clinically meaningful gait parameters from monocular video is important for scalable mobility assessment, yet progress is limited by the small scale, restricted viewpoints, and limited visual diversity of existing datasets. We introduce SynthGait-19k, a physically grounded synthetic video dataset containing 19,272 walking videos derived from 6,427 MoCap sequences across 437 subjects, with paired SMPL motion and annotations for six gait parameters. To construct the dataset, we develop Gait2Vid, which unifies heterogeneous MoCap recordings through SMPL and synthesizes diverse RGB walking videos under controllable viewpoints and scene appearances. We assess the generated videos for consistency with their conditioning gait kinematics and validate extracted gait events against force-platform measurements. Using SynthGait-19K, we benchmark direct RGB, pose-based, biomechanical, and human-mesh-recovery approaches and analyze viewpoint, training-data scale, and synthetic-to-real domain shift. We also introduce GaitXFormer as a direct RGB reference model for estimating gait parameters. Synthetic supervision transfers effectively to real videos across both GaitXFormer and a pose-based architecture, demonstrating utility across different representations. We further find that spatial gait parameters are more sensitive to visual domain shift and that improved HMR reconstruction alone does not necessarily translate to improved downstream gait estimation.

</details>


### [226] [DriveMotion: A Large-Scale Multi-Source Benchmark for Driver Motion Sequence Modeling and Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08117)
*Yuhang Wang,Chuheng Wei,Jingxin Yang,Xishun Liao,Hao Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DriveMotion是一个多源驾驶员运动预测基准数据集，包含393小时、133关键点、10Hz的驾驶运动序列，来自360名驾驶员。针对自然驾驶中长时间静止导致评估被持久性预测主导的问题，提出动力学锚定评估方法，围绕车辆操作放置预测窗口。实验表明该方法下学习模型预测误差比持久性预测降低15%，多源训练比单一数据源训练误差降低38%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有驾驶员数据集多侧重于从短视频片段识别预定义行为，而人体运动预测基准主要针对车外运动。缺乏专注于连续驾驶员运动预测的基准数据集，且自然驾驶中长时间静止使均匀采样评估被持久性（保持不动）预测主导，无法捕捉短暂但有行为意义的运动。

Method: 构建包含自然驾驶数据、公开车内视频和AIDE数据集的多源统一基准，包含133关键点和每关节有效性掩码及同步驾驶上下文。提出动力学锚定评估方法：从CAN信号离线识别车辆操作，将预测窗口放置在操作前后，推理时不向模型提供CAN信号。窗口围绕车辆操作（如变道、转弯）放置以捕捉驾驶员预备动作。

Result: 操作前窗口的手臂运动是路线匹配稳定驾驶对照组的3.4倍；在锚定窗口上，学习模型相比持久性预测误差降低15%；操作增强训练使预测派生的Part-State F1比零运动参考提高44%；多源语料训练使网络驾驶员预测误差比仅BATON训练降低38%。

Conclusion: DriveMotion提供了身份分离的数据划分、固定评估子集和参考实现，支持可复现的连续驾驶员运动预测评估。该基准揭示了车辆操作锚定评估的重要性，并证明多源数据融合能有效提升驾驶员运动预测的泛化能力。

Abstract: Driver motion can provide cues to ongoing behavior, attention, and near-term driving intent. However, most existing driver-centric datasets focus on recognizing predefined driver behaviors from short video clips, while human motion forecasting benchmarks largely target motion outside the vehicle. We introduce DriveMotion, a multi-source benchmark for continuous driver motion forecasting. DriveMotion contains 393 hours of 133-keypoint motion sequences at 10 Hz from 360 drivers, integrating naturalistic driving data, curated public in-cabin videos, and the AIDE dataset into a unified representation with per-joint validity masks and synchronized driving context. Naturalistic driving contains long periods of limited body movement, making uniformly sampled evaluation dominated by persistence and less sensitive to brief but behaviorally meaningful motion. To address this, we use dynamics-anchored evaluation, placing forecasting windows around vehicle maneuvers identified offline from CAN signals without providing CAN to the model at inference. Arm motion in pre-maneuver windows is 3.4x greater than in route-matched stable-driving controls. On these anchored windows, learned models reduce forecasting error over persistence by up to 15%, while maneuver-enriched training improves forecast-derived Part-State F1 by 44% over the zero-motion reference. Training on the full multi-source corpus further reduces forecasting error on held-out web drivers by 38% compared with BATON-only training. DriveMotion provides identity-disjoint splits, fixed evaluation subsets, and reference implementations for reproducible evaluation of continuous driver motion forecasting. The dataset and benchmark are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/HenryYHW/DriveMotion

</details>


### [227] [Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection via Group Sparse Low-Rank Tensor Factorization With Automatic Anomaly Grouping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08121)
*Quan Yu,Yu-Hong Dai,Xiongjun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于组稀疏低秩张量分解与自动异常分组的超光谱异常检测方法（GSAA），通过组稀疏约束刻画低tubal秩背景、引入潜分组图自适应推断异常分组，并在光谱与空间双域应用后融合形成GSAA-SS版本，采用带收敛保证的线性化ADMM算法求解，在五个真实数据集上取得优于现有方法的检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低秩张量超光谱异常检测方法存在两方面的局限：一是计算成本高；二是在刻画具有空间结构的异常方面灵活性有限，难以自适应地学习异常的空间分组模式。

Method: 1）对低tubal秩背景，通过对张量因子施加组稀疏约束来近似直接张量秩正则化，降低计算开销；2）引入潜分组图构建自动异常分组惩罚项，使异常组能够从数据中自适应推断而非像素级预先定义；3）将GSAA同时应用于光谱域和空间域，融合两域检测图得到谱-空版本GSAA-SS；4）开发带收敛保证的线性化ADMM算法求解。

Result: 在五个真实超光谱数据集上的实验表明，与多种最新方法相比，所提方法取得了优越的检测性能，同时保持了有竞争力的计算效率。

Conclusion: 组稀疏低秩张量分解配合自动异常分组机制能够有效兼顾检测精度与计算效率，谱空融合进一步提升了空间结构异常的刻画能力。

Abstract: Low-rank tensor modeling has become an effective tool for hyperspectral anomaly detection. However, existing methods still suffer from high computational cost and limited flexibility in characterizing spatially structured anomalies. To address these issues, this paper proposes a hyperspectral anomaly detection method based on group sparse low-rank tensor factorization with automatic anomaly grouping (GSAA). Specifically, the low tubal rank background is characterized by imposing group sparsity on tensor factors, which provides an efficient alternative to direct tensor rank regularization. For anomaly modeling, a latent grouping map is introduced to build an automatic anomaly grouping penalty, allowing anomaly groups to be adaptively inferred from the data rather than predefined at the pixel level. To further exploit complementary spectral and spatial information, GSAA is applied in both domains, and the resulting detection maps are fused to form a spectral--spatial version of GSAA, termed GSAA-SS. An efficient linearized alternating direction method of multipliers algorithm with convergence guarantee is developed to solve the resulting model. Experimental results on five real hyperspectral datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior detection performance and competitive computational efficiency compared with several state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [228] [Observe Before You Alert: Adaptive Driver Alerting with Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08130)
*Yuhang Wang,Lingyao Li,Hao Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VLAlert是一个基于视觉-语言模型的驾驶告警框架，将行车记录仪视频中的预警生成建模为SILENT、OBSERVE、ALERT三动作策略，通过OBSERVE动作实现自适应证据收集与感知-行动循环，在多个基准上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事故预测模型大多输出二元风险分数，需通过阈值处理模糊场景，无法解决"何时证据足够以发出警告"的顺序决策问题，缺乏在部分可观测条件下的自适应告警能力。

Method: 提出VLAlert框架：1) 将告警生成建模为SILENT/OBSERVE/ALERT三动作策略，其中OBSERVE作为内部证据收集决策，延迟不确定警告并改变下一观测窗口；2) 使用Qwen3-VL-4B作为安全证据生成器；3) 从结构化信念跨度（belief spans）池化隐藏状态，形成紧凑表示用于危险估计和策略预测；4) 构建统一的每帧基准VLAlert-Bench。

Result: 在VLAlert-Bench验证集上，VLAlert取得最高部署导向效用的DAUS 0.4878（对比Open-BADAS的0.4752），并将AUROC、AP_tick、F1_t和平衡准确率分别从0.610、0.176、0.276、0.581提升到0.689、0.195、0.297、0.648。在221个持有ADAS-TO-Critic片段上，R@5s从74.2%提升至88.7%，F1从0.585提升至0.686。

Conclusion: 自适应观测机制与安全导向的VLM表示能够为面向驾驶员的告警决策带来可量化的性能提升，验证了将预警生成作为序列决策问题的有效性。

Abstract: Driver alerting from dashcam video requires sequential decision-making under partial observability: a system must decide not only whether a scene is risky, but also when the evidence is sufficient to warn. Most existing accident anticipation models output a binary risk score, leaving ambiguous scenes to be handled by thresholding. We propose VLAlert, a vision-language alerting framework that casts warning generation as a tri-action policy over SILENT, OBSERVE, and ALERT. The OBSERVE action acts as an internal evidence-gathering decision that delays uncertain warnings and changes the next observation window, creating a lightweight perception-action loop for adaptive alerting. VLAlert uses Qwen3-VL-4B as a safety-evidence generator and pools hidden states from structured belief spans to form compact representations for danger estimation and policy prediction. We evaluate VLAlert on VLAlert-Bench, a unified per-tick benchmark from four real-world dashcam alert datasets, and further test transfer to held-out naturalistic ADAS takeover clips. On VLAlert-Bench validation, VLAlert achieves the highest deployment-oriented utility among tested baselines, with DAUS 0.4878 compared with 0.4752 for Open-BADAS, and improves AUROC, AP_tick, F1_t, and balanced accuracy from 0.610, 0.176, 0.276, and 0.581 to 0.689, 0.195, 0.297, and 0.648, respectively. On 221 held-out ADAS-TO-Critic clips, VLAlert improves R@5s from 74.2% to 88.7% and F1 from 0.585 to 0.686. These results indicate that adaptive observation and safety-focused VLM representations provide measurable gains for driver-facing alert decisions.

</details>


### [229] [MRI-Guided Reslice-Refined Cross-Slice SDF Reconstruction of the Left Ventricle from Cardiac MRI with Sparse Axial Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08148)
*Quanxin Zheng,Shuai Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MR-RS-SDFR，一种基于隐式符号距离场（SDF）的逐病例框架，用于从心脏磁共振（CMR）数据和稀疏轴向弱掩膜中重建连续的三维左心室心内膜表面。方法先利用轴向和纵向几何线索构建跨切片SDF初始化，再通过MRI边缘场法向对齐以及可微重切片Dice和轮廓一致性两路互补信号进行细化。在稀疏16层设置下达到0.928 Dice和3.80mm HD95，且优于协议匹配的全监督GHD+DVS基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 左心室心内膜表面三维重建面临监督信号仅在少量轴向切片上可用的挑战：穿平面几何约束弱，且自动生成的二维掩膜可能将分割误差传播至重建形状，导致现有方法精度受限。

Method: 1) 从轴向和纵向几何线索构建跨切片SDF初始化；2) 用两路互补信号精化SDF：MRI边缘场法向对齐（图像导出的边界线索，不依赖弱掩膜）和可微重切片Dice与轮廓一致性（保持与观测平面一致）。框架为逐病例（per-case）优化，无需额外训练。

Result: 在稀疏16设定下，使用Medical SAM3掩膜的最终MR-RS-SDFR重建达到0.928 Dice和3.80mm HD95。nnU-Net与Medical SAM3驱动的稀疏重建达到相同平均最终Dice。三种掩膜源下MR-RS-SDFR在Dice和HD95上均数值优于协议匹配的全监督GHD+DVS。最终Dice从稀疏4到稀疏16显著提升，随后在稀疏64处趋于饱和。

Conclusion: MRI引导的逐病例SDF细化在不同弱掩膜生成器和监督密度下均能保持有效，是一种稳健且可泛化的左心室表面重建策略。

Abstract: Reconstructing a three-dimensional left-ventricular (LV) endocardial surface from cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) data is challenging when supervision is available on only a small number of axial slices. Through-plane geometry is weakly constrained, and automatically generated two-dimensional masks can propagate segmentation errors into the recovered shape. We present MR-RS-SDFR, a per-case implicit signed distance field (SDF) framework that reconstructs a continuous LV surface from a CMR volume and sparse axial weak masks. The method first builds a cross-slice SDF initialization from axial and longitudinal geometric cues and then refines the field using two complementary signals: MRI edge-field normal alignment, which provides an image-derived boundary cue independent of the weak masks, and differentiable reslice Dice and contour consistency, which preserve agreement with the observed planes. We evaluate three weak-mask generators -- LOO TransUNet, LOO nnU-Net, and an off-the-shelf Medical SAM3 model used without MM-WHS-specific training or fine-tuning -- and five sparsity levels from 4 to 64 axial planes. In the sparse-16 setting, final MR-RS-SDFR reconstruction reaches 0.928 Dice and 3.80mm HD95 with Medical SAM3 masks. The upstream generators do not exhibit a single common ranking across 2D and dense 3D segmentation, and nnU-Net- and Medical-SAM3-driven sparse reconstruction achieve the same mean final Dice despite different upstream error profiles. Across all three sparse-16 mask sources, MR-RS-SDFR is numerically better than protocol-matched full GHD+DVS in both Dice and HD95. Final Dice improves markedly from sparse-4 to sparse-16 and then saturates at the reported precision through sparse-64. These results support MRI-guided per-case SDF refinement as a reconstruction strategy that remains effective across weak-mask generators and supervision densities.

</details>


### [230] [SciFigure2Code: An AI-Reconstructed Benchmark for Scientific Figure-to-Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08155)
*Wentao Li,Yibo Wu,Yizhe Chen,Ruixuan Chen,Jiangjie Qiu,Yijun Li,Zhao Leyi,Xiaonan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SciFigure2Code，一个AI重建的基准测试，用于评估从已发表科学图表中恢复"可呈现性"（presentation recovery）——即生成可编辑的Python程序来保留图表的排列方式和可读性，而非恢复原始测量数据或作者源代码。通过角色专业化Codex智能体生成、执行、视觉优化和审计"银标准"呈现程序，最终构建了含6,740个审核面板的数据集和含337个面板的SciFigureBench测试集。实验表明当前模型在执行、多组件布局、坐标轴、图例和科学标签方面仍显薄弱，Claude Opus 4.7在纯图像设置下表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学图表是研究声明被检视和复用的关键界面，但最终发表的面板很少公开生成它们所需的数据或绘图代码。从像素中恢复这种隐藏的出处（provenance）在数学上是不适定问题（underdetermined）。因此需要一种替代性评估范式——不是恢复原始数据，而是恢复图表的"呈现方式"，使其可被重建为可编辑程序，供他人检查、修改和复用。

Method: 采用角色专业化的Codex智能体协议，包括四个环节：(1) 生成——生成可编辑的Python呈现程序；(2) 执行——实际运行程序输出图表；(3) 视觉精炼——对输出进行视觉迭代优化；(4) 审计——审核银标准程序是否忠实捕捉了几何结构、视觉层次、编码、注释和排印。该"重建-审计"协议将已发表面板转化为可审计的参考包。数据集包含6,740个已审核面板，并构建了SciFigureBench——在31种图表子类型、5个领域、3个复杂度级别上平衡的337面板测试集。同时测试了14个零样本模型在纯图像和带标题辅助设置下的表现，并尝试了两阶段"先规划后编码"的提示策略。

Result: 14个零样本模型中，在纯图像和标题辅助两种设置下，模型在执行、多组件布局、坐标轴、图例和科学标签等方面仍表现薄弱。Claude Opus 4.7在纯图像总体得分（Overall）上最高，Claude Opus 4.6在标题辅助重建中领先，两阶段的"先规划后编码"提示方法在所有四个测试模型上均能提升Overall得分。SciFigure2Code提供了一个可审计的测试平台，用于评估能够构建可编辑且视觉忠实科学图表呈现的智能体。

Conclusion: SciFigure2Code的核心价值在于将"呈现恢复"（presentation recovery）确立为一个可评估、可审计的研究问题，区别于传统意义上不适定的"数据反推"。该基准为未来科学可视化智能体的开发提供了标准化测试床，暴露了当前LLM驱动的代码生成智能体在科学图表重建上的核心瓶颈——不仅是生成代码的能力，更是对科学图表视觉语言（几何、层次、标注、排印）的系统理解能力。这项工作为构建可编辑、视觉忠实的科学图表呈现系统奠定了评测基础。

Abstract: Scientific figures are the interface through which research claims are inspected and reused, but final published panels rarely expose the data or plotting code that produced them. Recovering this hidden provenance from pixels is therefore underdetermined. We introduce SciFigure2Code, an AI-reconstructed benchmark that instead evaluates presentation recovery: generating editable Python programs that preserve how a scientific panel is arranged and read. Role-specialized Codex agents generate, execute, visually refine, and audit silver-standard presentation programs that capture geometry, visual hierarchy, encodings, annotations, and typography without claiming to recover original measurements or author source code. This reconstruction-and-audit protocol turns final published panels into auditable reference packages; the resulting resource contains 6,740 reviewed panels and SciFigureBench, a balanced 337-panel test set across 31 chart subtypes, five domains, and three complexity levels. Across 14 zero-shot models in image-only and caption-assisted settings, execution, multi-component layouts, axes, legends, and scientific labels remain weak. Claude Opus 4.7 achieves the highest image-only Overall score, Claude Opus 4.6 leads caption-assisted reconstruction, and two-stage plan-then-code prompting improves Overall for all four tested models. SciFigure2Code provides an auditable testbed for agents that construct editable, visually faithful scientific figure presentations.

</details>


### [231] [Boundary Voting Network for Ambiguity-Aware Timestamp-Supervised Action Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08167)
*Runzhong Zhang,Yueqi Duan,Yang Chen,Weipeng Hu,Chen Cai,Suchen Wang,Yap-Peng Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出边界投票网络（boundary voting network），用于时间戳监督的动作分割任务。该方法通过将视频级全局先验知识层级化地传播到局部动作转换区域，缓解边界定位中的特征模糊问题，从而提升伪标签的稳定性和可靠性。在GTEA、50Salads和Breakfast数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间戳监督的动作分割中，边界定位存在固有不确定性——因为动作转换区域的特征区分度较低，导致生成的伪标签不够稳定可靠，进而影响训练出的分割模型性能。现有方法未能有效解决这一问题。

Method: 提出边界投票网络。核心思路：将视频级全局先验知识层级化地传播到局部动作转换区域。通过生成贯穿整个视频的关键动作表征作为"投票"，并定向作用于动作转换区域，使所有投票协同贡献于动作转换特征增强和边界定位精化。

Result: 在GTEA、50Salads和Breakfast三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明该方法有效，相较现有方法取得更优性能。

Conclusion: 通过全局知识向局部模糊区域的层级传播与投票机制，能够有效缓解动作转换区域的特征歧义，精化边界定位，从而提升时间戳监督下动作分割的整体性能。

Abstract: Timestamp-supervised action segmentation aims to segment and classify actions in untrimmed videos with a random frame annotated per action. Precisely localizing action boundaries from timestamp annotations is crucial for this setting, as it enables generating framewise pseudo-labels and applying the well-explored fully-supervised training. However, prevailing methods struggle with intrinsic uncertainty in boundary localization due to less discriminative features in action-transiting regions. This imprecise boundary estimation significantly reduces the stability and reliability of the generated pseudo-labels in ambiguous action-transiting regions, consequently resulting in performance deterioration of the trained segmentation models. In our paper, we introduce the boundary voting network that mitigates feature ambiguity by hierarchically propagating video-level global prior knowledge into local action-transiting regions. By generating key action representations as votes throughout the video and targeting action-transiting regions, all votes collaboratively contribute to action-transiting feature enhancement and boundary localization refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on GTEA, 50Salads, and Breakfast datasets.

</details>


### [232] [WSPolypNet: Weakly Supervised Polyp Localization in Colonoscopy Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08182)
*Giseong Hwang,Minjae Jo,Yeonghyeon Park,Kyeonghun Kim,Seoyeon Han,Donghoon Han,Haneul Kim,Yului Jeong,Insung Hwang,Pa Hong,Ken Ying-Kai Liao,Nam-Joon Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出WSPolypNet，一种仅使用视频级标签的弱监督结肠镜息肉定位框架，通过3D CNN生成CAM定位线索，并经多视角策略增强后作为点提示输入MedSAM2进行分割传播，在无需帧级空间标注的情况下实现了优异的定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结肠镜视频的密集帧级标注成本高昂，限制了完全监督方法的应用，因此需要一种仅依赖视频级标签（成本更低）即可实现息肉定位的弱监督解决方案。

Method: 1) 使用3D卷积神经网络以视频级监督训练生成类激活图（CAMs）以识别候选息肉区域；2) 采用多视角策略增强CAM定位线索；3) 将增强后的线索作为点提示输入MedSAM2，由MedSAM2在视频中传播分割掩膜，按息肉边界细化粗定位线索。

Result: 多视角设定下CorLoc在IoU阈值0.3/0.5/0.7下分别达到47.80%、43.68%和35.01%，显著优于单视角的36.87%、33.72%和27.94%；小型息肉的CorLoc@0.5从16.01%提升至30.97%；框架达到94.51%的召回率。

Conclusion: 实验结果证明了弱监督时空学习在显著减少空间标注需求的情况下进行结肠镜息肉定位的巨大潜力。

Abstract: Because dense frame-level annotation of colonoscopy videos is costly, we propose WSPolypNet, a weakly supervised framework for polyp localization using only video-level labels. WSPolypNet employs a 3D convolutional neural network trained with video-level supervision to generate class activation maps (CAMs), which identify candidate polyp regions without requiring frame-level spatial annotations. The CAM-derived localization cues are further enhanced using a multi-view strategy and provided to MedSAM2 as point prompts. MedSAM2 then propagates segmentation masks across the video, refining the coarse localization cues according to polyp boundaries. WSPolypNet achieved CorLoc scores of 47.80%, 43.68%, and 35.01% at IoU thresholds of 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7, respectively, compared with 36.87%, 33.72%, and 27.94% in the single-view setting. For small polyps, the multi-view strategy improved CorLoc@0.5 from 16.01% to 30.97%. The framework also achieved a recall of 94.51%. These results demonstrate the potential of weakly supervised spatiotemporal learning to substantially reduce spatial annotation requirements for polyp localization in colonoscopy videos.

</details>


### [233] [PhysFlow: Physics-Aware Optical Flow for Motion Controllable Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08215)
*Cong Wang,Hanxin Zhu,Yonglin Tian,Jiayi Luo,Ruiqi Song,Boyi Sun,Long Chen,Zhibo Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysFlow是一个两阶段视频生成框架，将视频生成分解为运动感知的光流生成和运动条件的外观合成，通过物理感知注意力模块建模运动属性与材料属性对运动的影响，并借助物理引擎构建的PhysVideo数据集提升生成视频的物理合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成模型虽然能生成视觉上吸引人的视频，但保证物理一致性和合理的动态仍然是一个根本性挑战，现有方法在物理真实性方面存在不足。

Method: 提出两阶段框架PhysFlow：(1) PA-Flow阶段，利用物理感知注意力模块建模运动属性和材料属性对全局运动和局部形变的影响，生成显式运动表征的光流视频；(2) FlowRender阶段，以解耦后的运动表征为引导，合成逼真纹理和外观。同时构建了基于物理引擎和3D-GS渲染的PhysVideo数据集，包含10K前景物体和50K视频序列，带有运动和材料属性标注，用于显式物理监督训练。

Result: 大量实验表明PhysFlow相比现有方法在保持高视觉保真度的同时，生成的视频具有更优的物理合理性。

Conclusion: 通过将运动与外观解耦、并以显式光流作为物理先验，PhysFlow有效提升了视频生成的物理合理性，证明了物理规律主要编码在运动模式中的观点。

Abstract: Video generation models have recently attracted substantial attention for their ability to generate visually compelling videos, yet ensuring physically consistent and plausible dynamics still remains a fundamental challenge, driving a growing line of research on physical realism in video generation. To address this challenge, motivated by the fact that physical regularities are primarily encoded in motion patterns, we propose PhysFlow, a novel two-stage framework for improving the physical plausibility of generated videos by decomposing video generation into motion-aware optical flow generation followed by motion-conditioned appearance synthesis. Specifically, PhysFlow consists of a physics-aware optical-flow video generator called PA-Flow and a flow-guided video generator called FlowRender. During the first stage, PA-Flow employs a physics-aware attention module to model how motion attributes and material properties influence global motion and local deformation, respectively, and generates an optical flow video as an explicit representation of motion. In the second stage, FlowRender leverages the decoupled motion representation as guidance to synthesize realistic textures and appearances, ultimately producing the final physically plausible video. To further support model training with explicit physical supervision, we construct PhysVideo, a physics-based video dataset generated with a physics engine and 3D-GS rendering, containing 10K foreground objects and 50K realistic video sequences with annotations of motion and material properties. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed PhysFlow generates videos with superior physical plausibility while maintaining high visual fidelity compared with existing methods.

</details>


### [234] [Drive by Hindsight and Foresight: Tool-Grounded Synergistic Reasoning over Hierarchical Memory for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08217)
*Baojie Chen,Zijun Jia,Jing Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出首个将分层记忆与主动工具调用紧密耦合于闭环推理框架中的自动驾驶VLM系统，通过场景级短期记忆和演进式长期记忆增强模型的主动感知与经验积累能力，7B模型在DriveLMM-o1上达到80.03推理分和79.09% MCQ准确率，超越最强基线7.74个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在自动驾驶中仍存在幻觉、时空感知弱和泛化受限等问题。近期方法虽通过CoT解释、RAG或静态工具输出注入丰富上下文，但模型既不会主动感知场景信息，也无法在回答后积累经验，缺乏主动性和持续学习能力。

Method: 提出三方面核心贡献：(i) 分层驾驶记忆——短期记忆维护动态场景状态，长期记忆检索可复用经验与工具策略；(ii) 记忆-工具协同推理框架——推理时根据场景状态和经验自适应调用工具，离线时将可复用经验巩固到长期记忆池；(iii) 数据生成与两阶段训练流程——通过多步教师rollout构建验证过的记忆-工具轨迹，用SFT和GRPO训练。

Result: 7B模型在DriveLMM-o1上达到80.03总体推理分和79.09% MCQ准确率，超越最强基线7.74个MCQ点，且跨基准泛化强。消融实验显示：短期记忆提升时空理解，STSBench准确率提升24.2点；离线长期记忆巩固在参数全部冻结下额外带来3.57点MCQ增益，展现持续自我进化能力。

Conclusion: 分层记忆的各组件互补协作——短期记忆增强时空感知，长期记忆实现参数冻结下的持续经验积累与自我进化，验证了记忆-工具协同闭环推理框架在自动驾驶场景中的有效性和泛化性。

Abstract: VLMs have shown promise for autonomous driving, yet still suffer from hallucination, weak spatio-temporal perception, and limited generalization. Recent methods improve reasoning and decision-making through CoT explanations, retrieval-augmented generation or the static injection of tool outputs. Although these mechanisms enrich the context, the model neither proactively perceives scene information nor accumulates experience after answering. To overcome these limitations, we present, to our knowledge, the first synergistic framework that tightly couples hierarchical memory with proactive tool invocation in a closed reasoning loop. Our contributions are threefold. (i) Hierarchical Driving Memory: a scene-level short-term memory maintains the dynamic scene state, and an evolving long-term memory retrieves reusable experience and tool strategies. (ii) Memory-Tool Synergistic Reasoning Framework: guided by the scene state and retrieved experience, the model adaptively invokes tools to refine its reasoning at inference time and consolidates reusable experience into a long-term memory pool offline. (iii) Data Generation and Two-stage Training Pipeline: verified memory-tool trajectories built by multi-step teacher rollout are used to train with SFT and GRPO. Our 7B model reaches an overall reasoning score of 80.03 and MCQ accuracy of 79.09% on DriveLMM-o1, surpassing the strongest baseline by 7.74 MCQ points and generalizes strongly across benchmarks. Notably, ablation and analysis studies validate the effectiveness of each component and further reveal the complementary roles of hierarchical memory. Short-term memory strengthens spatio-temporal understanding, improving STSBench accuracy by 24.2 points, while offline long-term memory consolidation yields an additional 3.57-point MCQ gain with all parameters frozen, demonstrating continual self-evolution through accumulated driving experience.

</details>


### [235] [SoftRerank: Hierarchical Soft Fusion with Candidate-Label Reranking for Long-Tailed Micro-Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08221)
*Yichi Zhang,Zhichao Xia,Yanjun Chi,Lingsi Zhu,Yuefeng Zou,Jun Yu,Qingsong Liu,Jianqing Sun,Shengping Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种细粒度微动作识别方法，结合InternVideo2.5全参数微调、层级软融合和轻量级候选标签重排序器，在MA-52数据集上达到79.99%的F1均值，并在ACM Multimedia 2026第三届微动作分析挑战赛中排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微动作是微妙、低强度的非语言行为，能提供细粒度人类状态（如情绪和意图）的线索。但由于其持续时间短、视觉变化微弱、不同类别间运动模式相似，识别非常困难。此外MA-52数据集的标签分布呈现长尾特性，进一步增加了识别难度。

Method: 1) 对InternVideo2.5进行端到端全参数微调；2) 在共享视频表征上附加粗分类头和组条件细粒度分类头，提升粗/细预测一致性；3) 采用层级软融合整合多粒度信息；4) 引入轻量级候选标签重排序器，利用困难样本和视频-标签匹配处理易混淆的细粒度动作；5) 对长尾分布使用类平衡采样和逆频率重加权来削弱常见类别的影响。

Result: 在MA-52数据集上达到79.99%的F1平均值，在ACM Multimedia 2026第三届微动作分析大挑战赛中排名第一。

Conclusion: 实验验证了所提方法的有效性，表明通过全参数微调、多粒度分类头一致性约束以及候选标签重排序等策略，能够有效解决微动作识别中细粒度混淆和长尾分布等核心挑战。

Abstract: Micro-actions are subtle, low-intensity non-verbal behaviors that provide cues to fine-grained human states, including emotions and intentions. Recognizing them remains difficult because they are brief, contain weak visual changes, and often exhibit similar motion patterns across categories. This paper addresses these challenges with a fine-grained micro-action recognition method that combines full fine-tuning of InternVideo2.5, hierarchical soft fusion, and a lightweight candidate-label reranker. For the long-tailed label distribution in MA-52, we use class-balanced sampling and inverse-frequency reweighting to reduce the effect of frequent classes during training. We fine-tune InternVideo2.5 end to end and attach coarse and group-conditional fine-grained classification heads to the shared video representation, improving the consistency between coarse and fine predictions. For ambiguous samples, the candidate-label reranker uses hard samples and video-label matching to focus on easily confused fine-grained actions. Experiments validate the proposed method, which achieves a 79.99% F1-mean on MA-52 and ranks first in the 3rd Micro-Action Analysis Grand Challenge at ACM Multimedia 2026.

</details>


### [236] [ActionSplice: In-Flight Action Editing for Interactive World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08230)
*Pardis Taghavi,Tingyu Guo,Jonas Lossner,Gaurav Pandey,Reza Langari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ActionSplice推理框架，解决分块自回归视频世界模型中动作更新与块生成不同步的问题。通过将问题形式化为反事实状态传输（CST），用轻量级校正器将中断的骨干表示传输到修订动作所诱导的匹配状态，无需重放已完成的计算。两种变体CST_R（更新整个活动块）和CST_T（保留时间前缀仅更新后缀）在多个基准上显著降低了LPIPS并实现了像素级加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分块自回归视频世界模型中，每个生成的块仅对应一个动作。当采样过程中收到新动作时，该动作必须等待下一块生成，导致延迟；或需要回滚重播已完成的评估，造成计算浪费。现有的条件直接交换（direct condition swapping）方式会产生语义不一致，因此需要一种不冻结模型和采样器、无需重放即可处理动作更新的推理机制。

Method: 提出ActionSplice推理框架：(1) 将动作更新问题形式化为反事实状态传输（CST）；(2) 使用轻量级校正器将中断的骨干网络表示传输到"若采用修订动作在相同求解步下"所对应的匹配状态；(3) 世界模型与采样器保持冻结，采样无需重放已完成评估即可恢复；(4) 提供两种变体：CST_R更新整个活动块，CST_T保留时间前缀仅更新后缀（时间拼接）。

Result: 在minWM-Wan Action2V和HY-WM1.5上：CST_R将回滚相对LPIPS分别降低61.5%和75.9%（相对于直接条件交换）；CST_T将后缀LPIPS降低56.1%和77.5%，并提供2.73倍和1.69倍的像素就绪加速（相对于等待策略）。在HY-WorldPlay协议下，CST_R达到PSNR 25.66 dB、SSIM 0.6902、LPIPS 0.1337（对比原始rollout）。

Conclusion: ActionSplice通过反事实状态传输框架有效解决了分块自回归世界模型中的动作-块异步问题，在保持生成质量（低LPIPS、高PSNR/SSIM）的同时实现了显著的计算加速，无需修改或重训练世界模型，为交互式视频生成和模型推理提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Chunk-autoregressive video world models typically condition each generated chunk on one action. An action received during sampling must therefore wait for the next chunk, condition future solver evaluations on a state produced under the previous action, or trigger rollback that repeats completed evaluations. We introduce ActionSplice, an inference framework that formulates this problem as Counterfactual State Transport (CST). A lightweight corrector transports the interrupted backbone-native representation toward the matched state induced by the revised action at the same solver step. The world model and sampler remain frozen, and sampling resumes without replaying completed evaluations. The retargeting variant $\mathrm{CST}*{R}$ updates the entire active chunk, while the temporal-splicing variant $\mathrm{CST}*{T}$ preserves a temporal prefix and updates only the suffix. Across minWM-Wan Action2V and HY-WM1.5, $\mathrm{CST}*{R}$ reduces rollback-relative LPIPS by 61.5% and 75.9% relative to direct condition swapping. $\mathrm{CST}*{T}$ reduces suffix LPIPS by 56.1% and 77.5%, respectively, while providing $2.73\times$ and $1.69\times$ pixel-ready speedups over waiting. Under the HY-WorldPlay protocol, $\mathrm{CST}_{R}$ obtains a PSNR of 25.66 dB, an SSIM of 0.6902, and an LPIPS of 0.1337 against the original rollout.

</details>


### [237] [CS-CLIP: Compositional Scene Graph-guided CLIP for Robust Compositional Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08242)
*SeongJun Jeong,Minjoon Jung,Woo Suk Choi,Youwon Jang,Byoung-Tak Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CS-CLIP，利用场景图识别组合元素并通过选择性掩码构建结构化负样本，仅保留与原标题最具矛盾性的负样本，迫使模型依赖组合结构而非表面线索，实现了SOTA的组合推理性能且保持通用视觉语言能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有组合感知VLM虽然在某些基准上表现良好，但受控分析显示它们存在元素特定偏差——在特定组合元素上甚至不如vanilla CLIP。这一发现表明当前方法未能均衡地处理所有组合元素（对象、属性、关系及其交互）。

Method: 1) 使用场景图来识别原始标题中的组合元素；2) 通过选择性掩码构建结构化负样本；3) 进一步筛选保留与原标题最具矛盾性的负样本，迫使模型依赖组合结构而非表面线索进行学习。

Result: CS-CLIP在组合推理任务上达到SOTA，在所有组合元素上均有稳健表现，同时保留通用能力（如跨模态检索和下游视觉推理），且比先前方法需要更少的训练样本。

Conclusion: 场景图引导的负样本构建能够有效克服组合元素特定偏差，实现均衡且稳健的组合推理能力，同时不牺牲通用视觉语言任务的性能。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrate strong performance across compositional reasoning benchmarks, which require reasoning over semantic perturbations of objects, attributes, relations, and their interactions. However, our controlled analysis reveals that existing compositionality-aware VLMs exhibit element-specific biases, often underperforming vanilla CLIP on certain compositional elements. To address this, we propose Compositional Scene Graph-guided CLIP (CS-CLIP), which uses scene graphs to identify compositional elements and construct structured negatives via selective masking. We further retain negatives that are most contradictory to the original caption, forcing the model to rely on compositional structure rather than surface cues. CS-CLIP achieves state-of-the-art compositional reasoning with robust performance across compositional elements. It also preserves general vision-language capabilities such as cross-modal retrieval and downstream visual reasoning, while requiring fewer training samples than prior methods.

</details>


### [238] [Tracking-by-detection in Multi-object Tracking: Survey and Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08265)
*Yujin Yang,Kyujin Shim,Kangwook Ko,Changick Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了基于检测的跟踪（TBD）范式下的多目标跟踪（MOT）技术，并从最小基线跟踪器出发，在多数据集上对相似度度量、数据关联、相机运动补偿和插值策略等方法进行公平评估，建立了强基线跟踪器，为设计稳健通用的MOT系统奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TBD方法虽然取得进展，但评估协议不一致——不同的基线跟踪器、超参数和数据集导致各模块的真实贡献难以客观比较，阻碍了公平评价和方法对比。

Method: 系统综述TBD-based MOT技术（包括相似度度量、数据关联、相机运动补偿、插值策略），从最小基线跟踪器出发，在多个异构数据集上公平评估每种方法的贡献，并累积构建均衡的方法集。

Result: 建立了一个强基线的跟踪器，验证了各模块在公平条件下的真实贡献，为稳健且适合实际部署的多目标跟踪系统设计提供了依据。

Conclusion: 通过统一的公平评估框架澄清了各模块的真实价值，为MOT领域的原则性系统设计提供了可靠的参照基线和方法学基础。

Abstract: Multi-object tracking (MOT) is an essential computer vision task that simultaneously tracks multiple objects in video sequences, with various applications in surveillance, autonomous navigation, and human-computer interaction. The tracking-by-detection (TBD) paradigm, which combines object detection with temporal association, has emerged as a leading approach, driven by innovative algorithms. Despite recent progress, fair evaluation of TBD-based methods remains a challenge. Many studies introduce modules such as similarity metrics, data association strategies, or motion models, but they are often evaluated under inconsistent protocols, with different baseline trackers, hyperparameters, and datasets. Such inconsistencies obscure the genuine contribution of each module and hinder objective comparison. This survey systematically reviews TBD-based MOT techniques, including similarity measurements, data association, camera motion compensation, and interpolation strategies. Starting from a minimal baseline tracker, we fairly evaluate the contributions of each method across diverse datasets and accumulate well-balanced methods. Our findings establish a strong baseline tracker and provide a foundation for the principled design of robust and versatile MOT systems suitable for real-world deployment.

</details>


### [239] [SAM3-O2D2: Zero-Shot Object Out-of-Distribution Detection by Object Class Prompting of the SAM3-Image Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08281)
*Lucas Görnhardt,Timo Bartels,Tim Fingscheidt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SAM3-O2D2，一种零样本分布外（OOD）目标检测方法。该方法利用SAM3图像基础模型，仅用检测器预测的类别进行提示，通过比较目标检测器与SAM3的预测结果来判断对象是否属于分布内（ID）。若SAM3在对应位置未检测到提示对象，则判定为OOD。实验在Pascal-VOC和BDD100K（ID）及MS-COCO和OpenImages（OOD）上取得新SOTA的AuROC和FPR95指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有目标检测器在部署中面对未见对象时容易过度自信，造成安全隐患。尽管已有方法借助CLIP等基础模型进行OOD检测，但这些方法在特征空间中进行评估，对定位误差和外观变化敏感；此外当前SOTA零样本方法推理时需进行昂贵扩散计算。因此需要更高效、更稳健的零样本OOD目标检测方法。

Method: 提出SAM3-O2D2方法：仅使用检测器预测的类别来提示SAM3图像基础模型，比较目标检测器与SAM3的预测结果。若SAM3在相应位置能检测到该提示对象，则为分布内对象（ID）；若SAM3检测不到提示对象，说明检测器预测与图像内容不匹配，判定为OOD。该方法高效地利用SAM3，避免了推理中的昂贵扩散计算。

Result: 在Pascal-VOC和BDD100K（ID数据集）以及MS-COCO和OpenImages（OOD数据集）上，SAM3-O2D2显著超越之前的零样本SOTA方法，在AuROC和FPR95指标上均取得新的SOTA成绩。

Conclusion: 通过利用SAM3的语义知识与目标检测器预测进行交叉验证，可以在零样本条件下高效、准确地检测OOD对象，避免特征空间中评估带来的局限性，同时不需要昂贵的扩散推理过程，为可靠目标检测提供了新思路。

Abstract: Object detectors have shown remarkable performance in various fields, among these medical imaging, surveillance, and autonomous driving. However, they are prone to overconfidence when encountering unseen objects in real-world deployments, causing potential safety issues. To address this, detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) objects is essential for reliable object detection. Modern approaches leverage the broad semantic knowledge of foundation models such as CLIP for post-hoc few- and zero-shot OOD detection. However, these methods typically perform OOD assessment in feature space, which can be sensitive to object detector localization errors and variations in object appearance. Moreover, the current state-of-the-art (SOTA) zero-shot method performs computationally costly diffusion in inference. In this work, for our proposed zero-shot object OOD detection method SAM3-O2D2, we employ the SAM3-image foundation model in an efficient manner. Specifically, we prompt SAM3 only with the object detector's predicted classes and compare the predictions of the object detector and SAM3. An object is in-distribution (ID), if SAM3 also detects an object at the corresponding location. If SAM3 does not detect the prompted object, this indicates a mismatch between the detector's prediction and the image content, suggesting that the object is OOD. Experimental results show that our method significantly surpasses the so-far zero-shot SOTA method. Specifically, we achieve new SOTA AuROC and FPR95 metrics over both ID datasets Pascal-VOC and BDD100K and both OOD datasets MS-COCO and OpenImages.

</details>


### [240] [Dreaming in Flow: Generative Grounding Feedback for Self-Evolving Unified Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08282)
*Ke Hao,Yuanzhi Liang,Tingxi Chen,Rui Li,Haibin Huang,Chi Zhang,Yun Gu,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出生成式接地反馈（GGF）框架，一种自进化的后训练方法，仅使用文本提示和模型自身的视觉经验来统一优化多模态模型的视觉理解与生成能力，无需配对的图像-文本监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型虽在同一网络中整合了视觉理解与生成，但两种能力通常被作为独立任务分别优化，缺乏相互促进的机制，难以在没有配对数据监督的情况下实现两者的协同进化。

Method: GGF包含两个核心方向：1) 流级反馈（Flow-level Feedback）：模型先根据提示生成视觉"梦境"，在相同的噪声潜在状态下比较文本、图像和修复条件的预测，将图像接地生成方向迁移到提示条件下；2) 梦境回放接地（Dream Replay Grounding）：通过字幕生成和重新想象来回放梦境，训练声明级证据在回放中保持一致，同时分离无关的视觉经验。两者联合优化，使生成为理解提供视觉证据，理解反过来细化后续生成。

Result: 在具有不同理解-生成集成设计的统一多模态模型上的实验表明，文本到图像生成能力获得一致提升，视觉理解性能也有适度改善。

Conclusion: GGF通过让模型自我生成视觉经验并在此经验上反馈优化，实现了生成与理解能力的双向促进，为无需配对监督的统一多模态模型后训练提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models integrate visual understanding and generation within a single network, yet the two capabilities are commonly optimized as separate tasks. We introduce Generative Grounding Feedback(GGF), a self-evolving post-training framework that uses only text prompts and the model's own visual experience. Given a prompt, the model first generates a visual ``dream.'' Flow-level feedback compares text-, image-, and repair-conditioned predictions at the same noisy latent state, transferring image-grounded generation directions to the prompt condition. Dream replay grounding replays this dream through captioning and re-imagination, training claim-level evidence to remain consistent across the replay while separating unrelated visual experiences. Jointly optimized, these two directions let generation provide visual grounding for understanding and understanding refine subsequent generation without paired image--text supervision. Experiments across unified models with different understanding--generation integration designs show consistent improvements in text-to-image generation together with modest gains in visual understanding.

</details>


### [241] [MARS-CLIP: Multi-Resolution and Attention Refined Zero-Shot Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08283)
*Nagito Saito,Shintaro Ito,Koichi Ito,Takafumi Aoki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MARS-CLIP框架，通过融合多分辨率特征和注入注意力细化机制，解决CLIP在零样本语义分割中因低空间分辨率和结构信息丢失导致的分割效果不佳问题，在六个数据集上显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP在零样本迁移中表现优异，但其低空间分辨率和结构信息丢失使其难以胜任密集预测任务（如语义分割），需要一种框架来克服这些限制。

Method: 提出两个关键策略：(i) 多分辨率特征提取模块，将局部细粒度特征与全局上下文融合以突破输入分辨率限制；(ii) 注意力细化机制，将中间层的空间和颜色偏置注入最终自注意力块，以精确恢复对象边界。

Result: 在六个公共数据集上的实验表明，MARS-CLIP显著优于当前最先进的方法。

Conclusion: MARS-CLIP通过多分辨率特征融合与注意力细化，有效解决了CLIP在零样本语义分割中的分辨率与结构信息损失问题，验证了其在密集预测任务中的潜力。

Abstract: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has demonstrated impressive capabilities in zero-shot transfer but often struggles with dense prediction tasks due to low spatial resolution and the loss of structural information. To address these limitations, we propose MARS-CLIP (Multi-resolution and Attention Refined Segmentation for CLIP), a novel framework for zero-shot semantic segmentation. Our approach introduces two key strategies: (i) a multi-resolution feature extraction module that fuses local fine-grained features with global context to overcome input resolution constraints, and (ii) an attention refinement mechanism that injects spatial and color biases from intermediate layers into the final self-attention block to accurately restore object boundaries. A set of experiments on six public datasets demonstrates that MARS-CLIP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [242] [Human-Centric Image Captioning with Subject-Centered Spatial Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08300)
*Bozhou Li,Jiahang Zhang,Yue Ding,Yushuo Guan,Bohan Zeng,Yiyan Ji,Xinlong Chen,Yang Shi,Yifan Dai,Yuran Wang,Chengzhuo Tong,Pengfei Wan,Yuanxing Zhang,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SPACE基准，用于系统性评估多模态大语言模型在人类中心场景中的主体空间理解能力（如左右方位、解剖结构绑定），并提出了包含数据构建与GRPO对齐的训练流程，显著改善了模型的主体中心空间推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM在通用图像描述中表现优异，但在人类中心场景中常出现结构性幻觉（如左右反转、解剖绑定错误）。然而现有基准由于整体描述性指标遮蔽了这些局部空间错误，无法有效暴露和量化该瓶颈，而这恰恰是虚拟人/视频生成、细粒度动作理解等下游应用的关键基础。

Method: 1) 提出SPACE基准，专注于主体中心空间理解评估；2) 构建专有数据构造与对齐管线：先从细粒度身体部位定位提取结构化空间提示，驱动两阶段标题重写以生成空间忠实的高质量训练数据；3) 设计基于rubric的奖励用于GRPO对齐，显式惩罚结构关键的空间错误。

Result: 实验表明当前主流MLLM在SPACE上普遍难以将描述锚定于主体的固有参考系；而所提框架显著提升了人类中心描述质量，尤其在主体中心空间推理方面，性能可媲美强闭源模型。

Conclusion: 主体中心空间理解是MLLM的一个关键短板，通过专门的数据构造与奖励对齐方法可以有效弥合这一差距，为高精度的人类中心下游应用奠定基础。

Abstract: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve remarkable performance on generic image captioning, they frequently suffer from structural hallucinations in human-centric scenarios. Accurately modeling human subjects is foundational for critical downstream applications, such as accurate avatar/video/image generation and fine-grained human action understanding. However, these tasks require highly precise subject-centered spatial grounding, such as distinguishing egocentric left/right laterality and maintaining correct anatomical-object bindings. Although catastrophic for structural integrity, these localized spatial inversions are often overshadowed by overall descriptive metrics in existing benchmarks. To systematically expose and quantify this bottleneck, we introduce SPACE (Subject-centric Poses, Appearance, and Characteristics Evaluation), a benchmark designed to evaluate subject-centered spatial understanding. On SPACE, we reveal that despite strong generic perception, current MLLMs consistently fail to ground descriptions in the subject's intrinsic frame of reference. To bridge this gap, we propose a specialized data construction and alignment pipeline. We first extract structured spatial hints from fine-grained body-part localization to guide a two-stage caption rewriting process, yielding highly spatially-faithful training data. Furthermore, we design a rubric-based reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that explicitly penalizes structurally critical spatial errors during alignment. Extensive experiments on SPACE demonstrate our framework significantly improves human-centric caption quality, particularly in subject-centered spatial reasoning, achieving performance competitive with strong closed-source models. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/JHang2020/SPACE-Eval.

</details>


### [243] [TRIUNE-Net: Harmonizing Scale, Shape, and Efficiency in Pancreatic Tumor Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08303)
*Amir Hossein Saleknia,Alireza Kheyrkhah,Sanaz Karimijafarbigloo,Reza Azad,Sina Houshmand,Ulas Bagci,Dorit Merhof,Alaa Sulaiman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TRIUNE-Net是一个轻量级统一架构，用于3D CT胰腺肿瘤分割，通过多尺度上下文聚合、串行线性可变形注意力、信息保持下采样三个协同创新来解决胰腺和肿瘤的尺度变异性、不规则形态及计算复杂性问题，仅用5.86M参数在MSD Pancreas和NVD Pancreas数据集上达到最先进性能。


<details>
