  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AVE方法依赖静态产品图像，无法捕捉时序线索、多角度视图和细粒度视觉细节；直接将视频VLM应用于AVE因缺乏领域知识而性能有限，而对其进行微调需要大量高质量数据和可观的计算资源。因此需要一种无需训练、低成本且能提升视频VLM性能的方案。

Method: ViS-CoT包含三个核心模块：(1) 视觉聚类筛选代表性帧；(2) 视觉搜索检索语义相似的产品知识以丰富属性线索；(3) 交错式思维链（CoT）推理模块，利用由字幕生成和自动语音识别得到的视觉对齐辅助文本，迭代细化推理，最终引导模型做出精确的属性预测。

Result: 在VideoAVE数据集的14个产品类别上的大量实验表明，ViS-CoT能够一致性地增强多个最先进的视频VLM，micro-F1平均提升17.91个百分点。

Conclusion: ViS-CoT作为一种训练免费、即插即用的流水线，有效弥补了视频VLM在电商AVE任务中领域知识不足的短板，显著提升了属性值提取性能，具有广泛的适用性和实用性。

Abstract: Existing approaches to visual attribute value extraction (AVE) primarily rely on static product images, failing to capture temporal cues, multi-angle views and fine-grained visual details. Directly applying video vision-language models (VLMs) to product AVE results in limited performance due to the lack of domain knowledge, and fine-tuning them requires extensive high-quality data and substantial computational resources. Thus, we propose visual search augmented chain-of-thought reasoning (ViS-CoT), a training-free, plug-and-play pipeline that can be easily applied to any open-source video VLM for video-to-text AVE in e-Commerce. Specifically, ViS-CoT employs visual clustering to identify representative frames, followed by visual search to retrieve semantically similar product knowledge that can enrich attribute cues. Next, an interleaved CoT reasoning module iteratively refines reasoning through visually-aligned auxiliary texts derived from captioning and automatic speech recognition. Finally, the integrated information guides the model toward accurate and fine-grained attribute predictions. Extensive experiments across 14 product categories on the VideoAVE dataset show that ViS-CoT consistently enhances multiple state-of-the-art video VLMs, achieving an average improvement of 17.91 percentage points in micro-F1.

</details>


### [345] [InsightChain: Optimized Chain-of-Insight Analytics for LLM-driven Data Visualization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06438)
*Hanya Sun,Chen Zhang,Sheng Liang,Yongyue Zhang,Yong Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出InsightChain四阶段可视化提示流水线(Explore-Focus-Test-Present)，模拟专家分析师的迭代推理过程；同时提出视觉引导的自动提示优化方法VG-COPRO，以及用于复杂数据可视化评估的洞察进度指标(IPM)。实验表明InsightChain优于其他提示基线，VG-COPRO在域内和跨域场景均提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动数据可视化方法往往将可视化生成视为从用户查询到图形或代码的单步映射，忽略分析师迭代分析推理的过程，缺乏可用的复杂可视化评估指标。作者希望模拟专家分析流程并进行有效的多阶段优化。

Method: 1) InsightChain：四阶段可视化提示流水线，模拟专家分析工作流；2) VG-COPRO：视觉引导的自动提示优化方法，联合优化多阶段可执行流水线；3) IPM：结合四个基于文本维度与一个视觉维度的评估标准，通过100链人工试点和跨十领域的300链代理评估验证。

Result: 公共数据集实验表明InsightChain持续优于其他提示基线；现有APO方法在该多阶段任务上无法获得一致的增益，而VG-COPRO在域内和跨域设置中均提升性能。

Conclusion: 多阶段提示流水线更符合专家可视化分析的本质；多阶段任务需要专门的视觉引导优化方法，VG-COPRO证明了其有效性；IPM为复杂数据可视化评估提供了新框架。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated data visualization, yet existing approaches often frame visualization generation as a single-step mapping from user query to figure or code, overlooking the iterative analytical reasoning process of expert analysts. We present InsightChain, a four-stage visualization prompting pipeline (Explore--Focus--Test--Present) that emulates expert analytical workflows, together with VG-COPRO, a vision-guided automatic prompt optimization (APO) method adapted to jointly optimize such multi-stage, executable pipelines. To address the evaluation gap for complex data visualization, we introduce the Insight Progression Metric (IPM), a rubric combining four text-based dimensions with a vision-based dimension. We assess IPM through a 100-chain human pilot and an expanded 300-chain agent-based evaluation spanning all ten domains. Experiments on public datasets show that InsightChain consistently outperforms competing prompting baselines. Existing APO methods fail to yield consistent gains on this multi-stage task, whereas VG-COPRO improves performance in both in-domain and cross-domain settings.

</details>


### [346] [Decomposing LLM-Judge Uncertainty to Target Expert Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06444)
*Ryan Lail*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于小型贝叶斯模型的方法，将LLM裁判的不确定性分解为偶发不确定性（专家群体真实分歧，标注无法减少）和认知不确定性（裁判自身的无知，标注可减少），从而指导专家标注资源的分配，优先标注裁判最无知而非最不确定的样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM裁判在大规模输出评估中需要专家标注，但仅依赖裁判的"升级信号"（总不确定性）来分配专家标注会产生误导，因为该信号混合了偶发与认知两类不确定性，前者无法通过更多标注来降低，只有后者值得投入专家资源。

Method: 采用小型贝叶斯模型对已收集的标签做回归，学习在多大程度上信任黑盒裁判的预测。通过简单公式分离出偶发不确定性和认知不确定性两个分量，无需采样或额外调用裁判。在真实人类分歧数据集（ChaosNLI）上验证认知排序优于总不确定性排序。

Result: 在已知真实答案的真实LLM裁判上验证了两个分量能够有效分离，且裁判声称的置信度与其实际错误并无对应关系。在ChaosNLI真实人类分歧数据上，认知不确定性排序相比总不确定性排序在相同专家标签下多消除83%的误差，尽管简单提升最少标注样本在此数据集上也表现相当。

Conclusion: 该方法能够估计裁判何处"无知"（认知不确定性）而非专家何处"真正分歧"（偶发不确定性），并据此指导专家标注，使有限的专家资源投入到最有价值的样本上。

Abstract: An LLM judge evaluates outputs at scale. Experts should label only where it is least sure. Its natural escalation signal conflates two uncertainties: aleatoric, real disagreement in the expert pool, which labels cannot reduce, and epistemic, the judge's ignorance, which labels do reduce. A small Bayesian model separates them: a regression on labels already collected learns how far to trust a black-box judge's prediction. Both components follow as simple formulas, with no sampling or further judge calls. The components isolate on a real LLM judge against exactly known truth, and stated confidence is no guide to its actual error. On real human disagreement (ChaosNLI) the epistemic ranking removes 83% more error than total uncertainty for the same expert labels, though simply escalating the least-labelled items does as well there. We demonstrate we can estimate where a judge is ignorant rather than where experts genuinely disagree, and propose using this to direct expert labelling.

</details>


### [347] [DFlow: Enabling Verifier Information Flow in Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06498)
*Yaojie Zhang,Linfeng Zhang,Bin Cui,Xupeng Miao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DFlow是一种提升LLM推理效率的块扩散投机解码框架，核心创新在于复用拒绝位置（rejected suffix）的验证器隐藏状态，使验证器信息在后续草稿轮次中流动，无需额外目标模型计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有块扩散投机解码方法在验证后只保留被接受的token前缀，丢弃被拒绝的后缀，导致这些位置的计算浪费，且草稿模型需要反复从零开始重构未来token的表示。作者观察到拒绝仅决定token能否被提交，但被拒位置的验证器表示仍包含对未来预测有用的信息。

Method: 提出DFlow框架：1）重用目标验证器在拒绝后缀产生的隐藏状态来引导后续草稿生成，不增加目标模型额外计算；2）引入自条件训练策略（self-condition train），将先前预测中产生的验证器表示反馈到后续预测中，以有效学习跨轮次的信息流动。基座为Qwen3模型。

Result: 在多样化的基准测试上，DFlow在Qwen3模型上相对DFlash一致地提升了草稿质量和接受长度（acceptance length）。

Conclusion: 通过让验证器信息跨草稿轮次流动，DFlow证明了被拒绝位置的表示并非无用，而是可作为后续预测的有效信号，从而实现更高效的投机解码。

Abstract: Block diffusion speculative decoding improves LLM inference efficiency by proposing a block of future tokens in parallel and verifying them with a single forward pass through the target model. However, existing methods retain only the accepted prefix and discard the rejected suffix, preventing the computation spent on these positions from benefiting subsequent drafting rounds and forcing the drafter to repeatedly reconstruct representations for future tokens from scratch. We observe that rejection only determines whether a proposed token can be committed, while the verifier representations at rejected positions can still provide useful information for subsequent predictions. Based on this observation, we propose DFlow, a simple yet effective framework that enables verifier information to flow across drafting rounds. DFlow reuses the hidden states produced by the target verifier for the rejected suffix to guide subsequent drafting without additional target computation. To effectively learn this information flow across drafting rounds, we introduce a self-condition train strategy that feeds verifier representations from earlier predictions back into subsequent predictions. Experiments on Qwen3 models across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that DFlow consistently improves draft quality and acceptance length over DFlash.

</details>


### [348] [ProcArena: A Multi-Scenario Benchmark for LLMs on Direct and Interactive PL/SQL Development from Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06527)
*Hang Zhang,Chaokun Wang,Yuzhi Pan,Ziyao Zhong,Shuo Cao,Yue Xue,Zeyu Huang,Xingwei Zhou,Fang Niu,Bofan Xie,Guanchen Ge,Leqi Zheng,Ziyang Liu,Xiannian Cao,Pengcheng Ge*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 ProcArena，一个基于执行的 NL-to-PL/SQL 基准测试，涵盖直接和交互两种模式、九个开发子场景、多数据库方言（PostgreSQL 和 Oracle），共含 3,998 个可执行任务。评估七种语言模型后发现最佳平均得分仅 62.2%（直接）和 57.8%（交互），表明真实场景下的 NL-to-PL/SQL 开发仍具挑战性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 NL-to-PL/SQL 研究大多只关注从完整 NL 需求直接生成 PL/SQL，而实际开发涉及从零开发、代码修改、调试、优化等多种场景，且需要直接生成或多轮交互。目前缺乏一个能综合评估多场景、直接与交互、多方言 NL-to-PL/SQL 开发的基准。

Method: 构建 ProcArena 基准：1) 包含 3,998 个可执行任务，覆盖 157 个数据库、九个开发子场景，支持 PostgreSQL 和 Oracle；2) 通过 Iterative Logic Enhancement 和场景特定适配器构造 Direct 任务；3) 通过 Knowledge Integration 和 Requirement Perturbation 构造配对的 Interactive 任务，同时保留可执行目标；4) 设计受控的 Solver-User Simulator 协议，允许模型澄清用户意图和检查数据库环境，但不暴露隐藏执行反馈。

Result: 在七个语言模型上评估发现，最佳平均得分在 Direct 模式下为 62.2%，Interactive 模式下为 57.8%，表明现有模型在现实 NL-to-PL/SQL 开发中表现有限，特别是在交互式场景中更具挑战性。

Conclusion: 真实场景下的 NL-to-PL/SQL 开发（尤其是交互式开发）对当前语言模型仍是开放难题，ProcArena 提供了一个全面的多场景评估基准，为后续研究指明方向。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for translating natural-language (NL) requirements into PL/SQL programs, attracting increasing attention from the database community. However, existing NL-to-PL/SQL efforts primarily focus on directly generating PL/SQL from complete NL requirements. In practice, PL/SQL development involves diverse scenarios, such as from-scratch development, code modification, debugging, and optimization, and may require either direct generation or multi-turn interaction. Yet, no comprehensive benchmark evaluates multi-scenario, direct and interactive, and multi-dialect NL-to-PL/SQL development. In this paper, we present ProcArena, an execution-based benchmark covering both Direct and Interactive modes. ProcArena comprises 3,998 executable tasks over 157 databases, spanning nine development subscenarios in PostgreSQL and Oracle. We construct challenging Direct tasks through Iterative Logic Enhancement and scenario-specific adapters, and derive paired Interactive tasks through Knowledge Integration and Requirement Perturbation while preserving executable targets. We further design a controlled Solver-User Simulator protocol that allows models to clarify user intent and inspect the database environment without exposing hidden execution feedback. Evaluating seven language models, we find that the best average scores are only 62.2% and 57.8% in Direct and Interactive, respectively, demonstrating that realistic NL-to-PL/SQL development remains challenging, particularly in interactive settings.

</details>


### [349] [LLMs Mirror Country-Specific Gender Patterns If Asked, but Skew Male When Generating Media in Local Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06545)
*Sharif Kazemi,Tanya Popli,Neil K. R. Sehgal,Sunny Rai,Niyati Malhotra,Victor Orozco-Olvera,Ana María Muñoz Boudet,Samuel P. Fraiberger,Sharath Chandra Guntuku,Manuel Tonneau*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文收集了美国、印度、肯尼亚和尼日利亚695名受访者对22种职业和家庭角色的性别关联数据，并评估了八种LLM在直接提问和媒体生成两种模式下的表现。研究发现模型在直接提问下能追踪调查基线，但在媒体生成中显著偏向男性，且英语提示会掩盖这种非西方地区的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM性别偏见评估基准依赖选择式（selection-based）格式而非长文本生成格式，且缺乏西方以外的本地性别关联基线数据，导致全球部署场景下的性别偏见被低估或遗漏。

Method: 从四个国家收集695名受访者的性别关联调查数据（针对22个职业和家庭角色）；在直接提问和媒体生成两种机制下评估八种LLM；对比英语和本地语言提示条件下的模型输出。

Result: 模型在直接提问下与调查基线吻合，但在媒体生成中显著更偏男性（尤其在本地语言环境中），与人类媒体中的男性偏见一致。英语提示下非美国地区的偏差更小而统计不显著，说明仅用英语或不分国别的评估会遗漏最常部署语言中的偏见。指令提示能方向性减少偏差，但会牺牲与调查基线的对齐度。

Conclusion: 评估LLM性别偏见需采用生成格式测试、本地语言提示以及本地收集的人类基线，方能准确反映全球部署场景下的真实偏见。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate media, but whether their content perpetuates gender stereotypes is unknown: standard benchmarks rely on selection-based formats rather than long-form generation, and surveyed baselines for local gender associations are scarce outside the West. We collect gender associations for 22 occupational and domestic roles from 695 respondents across the United States, India, Kenya, and Nigeria, and evaluate eight LLMs under two regimes: direct questioning and media generation. Models track the surveyed associations under direct questioning but skew substantially more male under media generation in major local-language cells, consistent with the male bias documented in human-produced media. Outside the US, the shift is much smaller and non-significant under English prompting, so English-only or country-agnostic evaluation would miss this bias in the languages where these models are most deployed. Instruction prompting reduces the shift directionally, but trades off against alignment with the surveyed associations. Evaluating LLM gender bias for global deployment therefore requires generation-format testing, local-language prompting, and locally-collected human baselines.

</details>


### [350] [Discovering Translation-Worthy Languages with E-Values](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06593)
*Wajdi Ben Saad,Safa Madiouni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于配对e-process的语言级路由器，用于多语言文本分类中的翻译路由决策，能在统计控制下持续比较直接分类与翻译辅助分类的效果，并在SIB-200和MASSIVE数据集上取得显著准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言文档分类中，翻译是否有助于提升预测效果因语言而异，统一翻译或基于启发式的语言分层方法缺乏统计控制的路径选择机制，需要一种能在保证统计有效性的前提下持续评估并路由的方法。

Method: 引入语言级路由器，基于配对e-process持续比较直接分类与翻译辅助分类的表现，在冻结路由策略前进行连续监控；采用家族错误率控制阈值280，将每个数据集14种合格语言中任一错误路由的概率上限控制在0.05。

Result: 在SIB-200和MASSIVE数据集上，路由器分别为15种语言中的4种和15种locale中的14种选择翻译，相比直接分类的保留集准确率分别提升8.14和16.70个百分点。全部28个决策在50种顺序排列及分组阈值下保持稳定。

Conclusion: 配对e-process能够实现统计受控、任意时间有效且可审计的多语言分类路由，为多语言文本处理中的翻译决策提供了理论严谨的有效方案。

Abstract: Choosing when to translate multilingual documents is a central routing problem in text classification: translation can improve predictions for some languages while degrading others or adding unnecessary computation. Uniform translation and heuristic language tiers do not provide statistically controlled route selection. We introduce a language-level router based on paired e-processes that continuously compares direct and translation-assisted classification before freezing a routing policy. A familywise-controlled threshold of 280 bounds the probability of any false route across 14 eligible languages per dataset by 0.05. On SIB-200 and MASSIVE, the router selects translation for 4 of 15 languages and 14 of 15 locales, improving held-out accuracy over direct classification by 8.14 and 16.70 percentage points, respectively. All 28 decisions remain stable across 50 outcome-independent orderings and relative to the per-group threshold. Our results demonstrate that paired e-processes enable statistically controlled, anytime-valid, and auditable multilingual classification routing.

</details>


### [351] [SAGE: A Hierarchical Framework for Evaluating Interpretive Literary Quality in Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06611)
*Tianyu Wang,Nianjun Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE——一个六层文学质量评估框架，结合基于规则的文本属性评估与基于LLM的阐释性质量评估（文化表征、情感深度、哲学参与），在100篇短故事的600项评估中验证，发现LLM叙事在情感-心理表征上接近人类水平，但在文化批判与哲学深度上差距约为两倍，揭示出可模式复制的文学能力与需立场投入的能力之间的边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自然语言生成（NLG）评估指标无法衡量叙事文学质量中的阐释性维度，如文化表征、情感深度和哲学参与度，因为这些方面需要深层解读而非表面模式匹配。

Method: 构建SAGE六层评估框架：将文本可观测属性的规则化评估与基于文化理论、情感理论和存在主义哲学的LLM阐释性评估分离；每个阐释层采用多轮迭代LLM评估并辅以独立交叉验证，实现跨评估器模型的测量级可靠性（98.8%收敛，>94%评分者间一致性）。

Result: 在100篇短故事的600项评估中验证，发现系统性的能力边界：LLM在情感-心理表征维度接近人类水平，但文化批判与哲学深度的差距约为情感维度的两倍；LLM生成的叙事在所有三个阐释维度上甚至低于商业类型小说。

Conclusion: 这一发现揭示了文学能力的分界：那些可从训练语料库中学习并模式复现的文学能力，与那些需要文化定位和哲学投入、仅靠模式匹配无法实现的立场性能力之间存在本质界限。

Abstract: Assessing the literary quality of narratives requires evaluating interpretive dimensions (cultural representation, emotional depth, and philosophical engagement) that existing NLG metrics cannot measure. We introduce SAGE, a six-layer evaluation framework that separates rule-based assessment of observable textual properties from LLM-based evaluation of interpretive qualities drawn from cultural theory, affect theory, and existentialist philosophy. Each interpretive layer is assessed through multi-round iterative LLM evaluation with independent cross-validation, achieving measurement-grade reliability (98.8% convergence, >94% inter-rater agreement) stable across evaluator models. Validated on 600 evaluations across 100 short stories, our central finding is a systematic capability boundary: emotional-psychological representation approaches human levels, while cultural critique and philosophical depth exhibit approximately double the gap. LLM-generated narratives score below even commercial genre fiction on all three layers. We interpret this as a boundary between pattern-reproducible literary capacities learnable from training corpora and stance-requiring ones demanding cultural positioning and philosophical engagement that pattern matching alone cannot provide.

</details>


### [352] [Mind the Gap: Exposing LLM Translation Blind Spots Using the AlphaMWE Multilingual Parallel Corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06634)
*Lifeng Han,Jiahui Liang,Anna Latusek,Karim El Haff,Amal Haddad Haddad,Josua Höfgen,Kilian Evang,Min Ma,Maryia Zhyrko*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文报告了WMT2026测试套件共享任务中多词表达（MWEs）对LLM机器翻译系统的影响。使用AlphaMWE多语言平行语料作为测试集，评估了31个MT系统在英语到中文、波兰语、德语、阿拉伯语（含标准阿拉伯语及两种方言）的翻译表现，结合自动与人工评估发现习语/MWE现象仍是翻译瓶颈，且人工评估能发现聚合分数掩盖的语言特定错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究LLM在多词表达（MWE）这一语言理解与翻译难点上的表现，检验MWE是否仍然是LLM翻译的瓶颈，特别是在方言和资源稀缺的语言对上。

Method: 使用AlphaMWE公开多语言平行语料作为测试套件，收集31个MT系统在6个语言方向的输出，先用BLEU、ChrF、BERT-score自动评估筛选每个语言对的Top3系统，再对选定系统进行人工评估。

Result: 研究发现：1）比喻性/MWE现象对LLM仍具挑战性；2）不同自动评估指标有时结论不一致；3）人工评估揭示了被聚合分数掩盖的语言特定错误。

Conclusion: MWE仍是影响LLM机器翻译质量的关键瓶颈，单一的自动评估指标不足以全面反映翻译质量，需要结合人工评估来发现语言对特定的深层问题。

Abstract: LLMs' performance on machine translation (MT) tasks is often dependent on the data availability in the specific domains and language pairs that they are trained upon. To examine if Multiword Expressions (MWEs) still set a bottleneck for LLMs regarding language understanding and translation, we report the system performances from the WMT2026 Test Suites shared task, for which we used the publicly available multilingual parallel corpus AlphaMWE as the test suites. We received 31 MT systems' outputs covering English to Chinese (zh), Polish (pl), German (de), Arabic (ar) including Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and two dialectal ones (Egyptian and Tunisian Arabic). We carried out automatic evaluations using BLEU, ChrF, BERT-score to select the Top3 systems per language pair, followed up with human evaluations on the selected systems. Our findings show that: figurative/MWE phenomena remain challenging; automatic metrics sometimes disagree; human evaluation uncovers language-specific errors hidden by aggregate scores.

</details>


### [353] [ECOKV: Geometry-Aware KV Cache Eviction via Complementary Diversity Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06663)
*Chin Ting Hsu,Yu-Syuan Xu,Ling Zou,Hsien-Kai Kuo,Wen-Huang Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ECOKV方法，通过几何感知的复合度量（欧氏距离+余弦相似度）改进KV缓存驱逐策略，并自适应加权多样性分数与重要性分数，同时压缩观测窗口以提升缓存利用率，实现SOTA压缩性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型的KV缓存存储带来严重的内存和计算开销，限制了其可扩展性。现有基于余弦相似度的多样性度量存在两个缺陷：归一化丢弃了幅度信息，且由于隐藏表示的各向异性，各层相似度值普遍偏高，导致多样性区分度不足。

Method: 1) 拆解现有多样性度量的能力，提出几何感知的复合度量，联合欧氏距离与余弦相似度从互补视角捕捉token多样性；2) 利用两个度量估计每个注意力头的冗余度，在token选择时对多样性分数和重要性分数进行自适应加权；3) 证明可大幅缩短常用的观测窗口（用于保留最近token），将更多缓存容量分配给信息量丰富的token。

Result: 大量实验表明，ECOKV在各种压缩比下达到SOTA性能，并能无缝集成到现有KV缓存驱逐方法中。

Conclusion: 论文分析了重要性与多样性之间的关系，并研究了跨层和注意力头的冗余模式，为KV缓存压缩提供了更深入的理解和更有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Although multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in diverse tasks, their scalability remains limited by the memory and computational overhead of KV cache storage. Recent KV cache eviction approaches incorporate a cosine similarity-based diversity metric with importance metrics to selectively retain critical key-value pairs. However, cosine similarity involves normalization that discards magnitude information, and it often yields uniformly high similarity values across layers due to the anisotropy property of hidden representations. In our study ECOKV, we rigorously deconstruct the capabilities of existing diversity metrics. Moving beyond simple measurement, we propose a geometry-aware composite metric that jointly leverages Euclidean distance and cosine similarity to capture token diversity from complementary perspectives. Furthermore, we use these two metrics to estimate the redundancy level of each attention head, allowing adaptive weighting between diversity and importance scores during token selection. Finally, we demonstrate that the observation window commonly employed to preserve recent tokens can be substantially reduced, thereby allocating more cache capacity to informative tokens and yielding consistent improvements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ECOKV achieves state-of-the-art performance under various compression ratios and can be seamlessly integrated with existing KV cache eviction methods. We further analyze the relationship between importance and diversity, and examine redundancy patterns across layers and attention heads.

</details>


### [354] [A Grapheme-Aware Indic Tokenizer for Tamil: Large-Scale Training and Intrinsic Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06690)
*Hari Krishnan K,Sudarsun Santhiappan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向泰米尔语的"字素感知"分词器（grapheme-aware Indic tokenizer），通过可逆的Unicode映射策略保留完整的字素簇后再进行WordPiece词表学习，从而解决泰米尔语基于字素书写系统导致多个Unicode码点表示单个可见字符的低效分词问题。实验表明，该分词器在碎片化和序列效率等内在指标上优于GPT-2、mBERT、mT5、mBART和NLLB五种主流多语言分词器，并达到了最高压缩比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然BPE、WordPiece和SentencePiece等分词器在多种语言上表现良好，但它们对形态丰富的印度语言（尤其是泰米尔语）分词效率低下。泰米尔语的字素书写系统可用多个Unicode码点表示单个可见字符，导致传统分词器产生不合理的词元边界，影响分词质量和下游性能。

Method: 提出一种字素感知的泰米尔语分词器，核心方法包括：(1) 在WordPiece词表学习之前，采用可逆的Unicode映射策略将文本转换为字素级（grapheme-level）表示，保留完整的字素簇；(2) 在大规模泰米尔语语料上训练分词器；(3) 通过综合内在评估框架（包括压缩效率、词元碎片化、信息密度、词表利用率）与五种主流多语言分词器进行对比。

Result: 在碎片化和序列效率导向的内在指标上，所提出的分词器在全部评估分词器中表现最强；在压缩比方面与最高水平持平。实验证明了字素感知预处理对泰米尔语分词的有效性。

Conclusion: 字素级表征优于单个Unicode码点级处理，能够产生语言学上有意义的词元边界，且与基于Transformer的语言模型完全兼容。该研究为形态丰富且书写系统复杂的印度语言提供了一种更高效的分词解决方案。

Abstract: Tokenization forms the foundation of modern Natural Language Processing (NLP) systems by transforming raw text into discrete units that neural language models can process. The effectiveness of this process directly influences vocabulary efficiency, sequence length, computational cost, and downstream model performance. Although multilingual tokenizers such as Byte Pair Encoding (BPE), WordPiece, and SentencePiece have performed well across numerous languages, they often segment morphologically rich Indic languages inefficiently. Tamil, in particular, poses unique challenges because its grapheme-based writing system can represent a single visible character with multiple Unicode code points. In this work, we present a grapheme-aware Indic tokenizer for Tamil that preserves complete grapheme clusters through a reversible Unicode mapping strategy prior to WordPiece vocabulary learning. By operating on grapheme-level representations instead of individual Unicode code points, the tokenizer produces linguistically meaningful token boundaries while remaining fully compatible with transformer-based language models. The tokenizer is trained on a large-scale Tamil corpus and evaluated using a comprehensive intrinsic evaluation framework that measures compression efficiency, token fragmentation, information density, and vocabulary utilization. Experimental evaluation compares the proposed tokenizer against five widely used multilingual tokenizers: GPT-2, mBERT, mT5, mBART, and NLLB. The proposed tokenizer achieves the strongest performance among the evaluated tokenizers on fragmentation- and sequence-efficiency-oriented intrinsic metrics, while matching the highest observed compression ratio. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of grapheme-aware preprocessing for Tamil tokenization.

</details>


### [355] [PARSER: Read in Parallel, Reason in Depth for Long-Context LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06702)
*Kun Li,Zexuan Qiu,Tianhua Zhang,Irwin King,Helen Meng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PARSER 是一种新型长文档推理框架，通过将阅读与推理解耦，使用并行子代理阅读文档、主代理通过迭代分散-聚合轮次进行深度推理，显著提升多跳问答性能和推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的顺序记忆代理将文档遍历与推理深度耦合，导致对证据位置的敏感性以及推理延迟随文档长度线性增长，这限制了长文档处理的效果与效率。

Method: PARSER 采用解耦架构：多个轻量子代理各自绑定一个分块并行阅读整个文档；一个主代理通过迭代的分散-聚合轮次进行推理——每轮向所有子代理广播查询，聚合返回的证据，并基于已发现信息形成更深入的后续查询。主代理通过强化学习优化，子代理使用冻结的现成模型。

Result: 在7K至896K上下文的多样多跳QA中，4B主干的PARSER平均超过最强顺序内存基线5.7分，在896K处超12.0分；9B主干超过DeepSeek-V4-Pro 6.3分。PARSER对证据位置、顺序和距离的扰动鲁棒，且推理延迟降低高达11倍。

Conclusion: 解耦阅读与推理的设计是一种有效的长文档处理范式转变，既能显著提升长上下文推理准确性和鲁棒性，又能大幅降低推理延迟，展现出优于顺序内存方法和大型闭源模型的潜力。

Abstract: Sequential memory agents process long documents by reading chunks one after another while maintaining a compact memory state, coupling document traversal to reasoning depth. This coupling introduces sensitivity to evidence placement and ties inference latency linearly to document length. We introduce PARSER, which decouples reading from reasoning. A bank of lightweight subagents each bound to a single chunk read the entire document in parallel, while a lead agent reasons in depth through iterative scatter--gather rounds: at each round it broadcasts a query to all subagents, aggregates the returned evidence, and formulates a deeper follow-up query conditioned on what has been found so far. This decoupled design concentrates all learnable behavior in the lead agent, which is optimized with reinforcement learning, while the subagents remain frozen off-the-shelf models. On multi-hop QA with contexts ranging from 7K to 896K tokens, PARSER with a 4B backbone outperforms the strongest sequential memory baseline by 5.7 points on average and by 12.0 points at 896K tokens. Scaling to a 9B backbone, PARSER surpasses DeepSeek-V4-Pro by 6.3 points. Controlled experiments confirm that PARSER is robust to perturbations in evidence position, order, and distance, conditions that cause large accuracy swings in sequential methods, while reducing inference latency by up to 11x.

</details>


### [356] [DianShi-RxnDB: A Large-Scale, Fine-Grained Organic Reaction Data Platform Built via a Fully Automated Pipeline for Researchers and AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06703)
*Yubin Wang,Xingjian Wei,Jiang Wu,Yinfan Wang,Boyu Zhu,Lin Zhang,Jianing Yu,Huazheng Zeng,Ruiyi Ding,Junyuan Gao,Jiaxing Sun,Lingli Ge,Haote Yang,Jingchao Wang,Aijia Guo,Qian Jiang,Yurui Zhao,Wenjian Zhang,Chen Zhu,Lijun Wu,Xiaolei Yang,Haodong Chen,Junjie Yuan,Zichao Ye,Shaowei Hou,Jing Ye,Jia Yu,Shan Wang,Lijun Wu,Jiantao Qiu,Chao Xu,Yuqiang Li,Guangyu Wang,Bowen Zhou,Dahua Lin,Conghui He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 介绍了DianShi-RxnDB，一个大规模、细粒度的有机反应数据平台，通过完全自动化的提取和标准化流程整合专利文本、图像和反应方案，涵盖USPTO和EPO 1976-2025年的有机合成专利，约2400万个反应实例，其中约1480万（61.7%）通过自动化质检。人工评估1300个样本的字段级准确率为92.95%，与Pistachio对比在去重记录数、粒度表示和字段级精确一致方面表现出优势。平台提供Web研究工作台和MCP服务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量的有机反应结构化数据对AI4Chem至关重要，但大量知识分散在专利文本、图像和反应方案中，缺乏大规模、细粒度且可直接使用的结构化数据资源。

Method: 构建一个完全自动化的提取和标准化流水线，整合专利文本、图像和反应方案三种来源；搭建DianShi-RxnDB平台，提供搜索、过滤、比较、溯源验证功能及MCP工具服务。

Result: 从USPTO和EPO 1976-2025年专利中产出约2400万反应实例，约1480万（61.7%）通过质检；人工评估1300个样本的字段级微平均准确率达92.95%；与Pistachio的匹配比较显示其在去重记录数、表示粒度和字段级精确一致方面具有优势。

Conclusion: DianShi-RxnDB提供了一个大规模、高精度、细粒度的结构化有机反应数据平台，兼具质检保证和可溯源特点，为AI4Chem研究和应用提供了重要数据基础设施。

Abstract: High-quality structured organic reaction data are essential for developing artificial intelligence for chemistry (AI4Chem), yet much of this knowledge remains dispersed across patent text, images, and reaction schemes. We present DianShi-RxnDB, a large-scale, fine-grained organic reaction data platform built via a fully automated extraction and normalization pipeline integrating patent text, images, and reaction schemes. Its corpus covers organic synthesis patents from the USPTO and EPO published between 1976 and 2025, yielding approximately 24 million reaction instances, of which approximately 14.8 million (61.7%) pass automated qualification checks. Each instance represents a specific single-step experiment recording participants, roles, quantities, temperatures, reaction times, yields, experimental procedures, and provenance links to source patents. In a manual evaluation of 1,300 sampled qualified instances, the micro-averaged field-level accuracy was 92.95%. A matched comparison with Pistachio further indicated advantages in deduplicated record counts, representation granularity, and field-level exact agreement. The platform provides a Web research workbench for searching, filtering, comparing, and source-verifying records, and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) service offering AI agents composable structured retrieval tools. DianShi-RxnDB is available at https://dianshi.opendatalab.org.cn/ .

</details>


### [357] [Event Interaction in Low-Rank Bottlenecks for Temporal Relation Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06731)
*Wei Sun,Tingyu Qu,Jesse Davis,Marie-Francine Moens*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出卷积瓶颈交互（CBI）架构，通过轻量深度卷积增强事件表示并结合逐元素乘法在低秩瓶颈内捕获事件交互，解决参数高效微调中时间关系抽取性能下降的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统时间关系抽取系统在全部参数可训练时表现良好，但在参数高效微调（如Adapter、LoRA）中，低秩瓶颈限制了信息流动，使事件间交互信号无法有效传递，导致性能明显下降。

Method: 提出CBI架构：首先应用轻量级深度卷积增强事件表征，然后在瓶颈内部使用逐元素乘法捕获有效的事件-事件交互，该设计具备理论依据且计算开销极小。

Result: 在五个数据集和七个骨干模型（Adapter和LoRA设置）上，CBI获得了一致且显著的提升，最高达到+31.7 micro F1，同时仅增加极小的计算成本。

Conclusion: 在低秩空间内进行显式交互建模对时间关系抽取至关重要，CBI为此提供了一种高效且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Temporal relation extraction determines whether an event occurs before, after, or simultaneously with another event, and therefore relies on accurately modeling how the two events interact. Mainstream systems achieve this by concatenating event spans or using shallow fusion, which works well when all model parameters are trainable. However, in parameter-efficient fine-tuning, low-rank bottlenecks restrict information flow and prevent these interaction signals from passing through, leading to clear performance drops. To address this limitation, we propose a theoretically grounded architecture, Convolutional Bottleneck Interaction (CBI), which first applies lightweight depthwise convolution to enhance event representations and then uses element-wise multiplication to capture effective event-event interactions inside the bottleneck. Across five datasets and seven backbone models in the Adapter and LoRA settings, CBI provides consistent and substantial gains, up to +31.7 micro F1, while adding minimal computational cost, showing that explicit interaction inside low-rank spaces is crucial for temporal relation extraction. The code is available at https://github.com/VRCMF/CIF.git.

</details>


### [358] [AuthBench: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for Authorship Representation across Genres and Lengths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06771)
*MaoXun Huang,Zhenxing Zhang,Claire Cardie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AuthBench是一个大规模多语言作者身份表示基准测试，包含428,150篇文档、153,825位作者，覆盖10种语言、9大主要体裁和4种文档长度，支持作者归属（同作者检索）和作者验证（同作者二分类）两项互补任务。在47个神经模型和3个非神经基线上的统一零样本协议测试显示，最佳检索模型仅达0.258 Success@5，最佳验证模型达0.076 EER和0.968 ROC-AUC，表明作者身份表示问题远未解决，且不同模型家族在两项任务上各有优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有作者身份基准测试往往碎片化，通常只覆盖狭窄的语言集合、单一体裁或有限的文档长度范围，难以评估现代表示模型是否真正具备泛化能力。作者身份信号在数字取证、抄袭分析、账号关联、虚假信息调查和机器生成文本检测等场景中至关重要，因此需要一个广泛、标准化且贴近现实的评估框架。

Method: 构建AuthBench大规模多语言基准，包含10种语言、9种主要体裁、66种细粒度体裁及四种文档长度分桶；设计两种互补任务（同作者检索的作者归属和同作者二分类的作者验证）；在统一零样本协议下对47个神经模型和3个非神经基线进行系统性评测。

Result: 最佳检索模型仅达0.258 Success@5；最佳验证模型达0.076 EER和0.968 ROC-AUC。排行榜显示检索与验证任务存在有意义的划分——不同模型家族分别在两项任务上领先，且跨语言、体裁和文档长度上存在显著性能差异，表明作者身份表示问题远未解决。

Conclusion: AuthBench不仅是一个新基准，更是一个诊断资源，用于研究作者身份表示在何时以及为何成功或失败。作者团队已公开发布基准数据、评估工具包及相关资源。

Abstract: Authorship signals matter in settings where writing style carries identity: digital forensics, plagiarism analysis, account linking, misinformation investigation, and machine-generated text detection. Yet current authorship benchmarks remain fragmented, usually covering only a narrow language set, a single genre, or a limited document-length regime, which makes it difficult to assess whether modern representations truly generalize. We introduce AuthBench, a large-scale multilingual benchmark for authorship representation that is designed to make this evaluation broad, standardized, and realistic. AuthBench contains 428,150 documents written by 153,825 individuals across ten widely used languages, 9 primary genres, 66 fine-grained genres, and four document-length buckets. It supports two complementary tasks: authorship attribution, formulated as same-author retrieval and authorship verification, formulated as same-author binary decision. We benchmark 47 neural models and three non-neural baselines under a unified zero-shot protocol. Results show that authorship representation remains far from solved: the best retrieval model reaches only 0.258 Success@5, while the best verification model achieves 0.076 EER and 0.968 ROC-AUC. The leaderboard also reveals a meaningful task split, with different model families leading retrieval and verification, and large performance differences across languages, genres, and lengths.
  These findings position AuthBench not only as a new benchmark, but as a diagnostic resource for studying when and why authorship representations succeed or fail. We release AuthBench, its evaluation toolkit, and benchmark data at https://github.com/mao-code/AuthBench and https://huggingface.co/datasets/MaoXun/AuthBench.

</details>


### [359] [Typed Federated Artifacts for the Agentic Web:Sharing Tool-Routing Knowledge Across Frozen,Heterogeneous LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06815)
*Abhijit Chakraborty,Ni Trieu,Vivek Gupta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SYNAPSE1，一种通过类型化联邦工件（typed federated artifacts）来共享工具路由知识的方法。相比扁平文本提示和权重适配器，类型化工件支持按字段隐私、争议解决和跨模型迁移。在StableToolBench上，联邦编目（20MB JSON/客户端/轮次）表现与集中式方案相差仅1.1点；类型化字段而非扁平字符串的展示价值为8.5（干净数据）和7.4（60%矛盾注入）分。在τ-bench零售任务中，各编目方案使GPT-4o逐步工具调用准确率提升至少6.7点。但论文提出两个警示：在数学代理和StableToolBench上，TF-IDF分类器击败所有LLM路由方案，因为基准测试池包含标签泄露，无法度量无标签工具的（真实）路由场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放网络中的代理由多家厂商运行冻结模型，需要保护历史隐私并相互教学工具调用。然而扁平文本（提示、示例池）难以区分噪声统计、合并规则和文档；权重与适配器无法跨平台迁移知识。作者希望提出一种更结构化的知识共享方式，使代理间能够安全有效地共享工具路由经验。

Method: 提出共享类型化联邦工件（schema验证的对象，具有每字段隐私、争议解决和跨模型迁移的明确定义字段），并实例化为SYNAPSE1——一个通用工具路由知识库。流程包括：删除192条垃圾条目和1,916条与测试查询重复/近重复的训练项；以类型化字段而非扁平字符串方式合并和渲染经验；在StableToolBench（3,180个工具）上进行联邦编目迁移实验，并在τ-bench零售任务中评估对GPT-4o代理的影响。

Result: （1）删除噪声/重复数据后，联邦编目在StableToolBench上与集中式方案相差仅1.1点（每客户端每轮20MB JSON）；（2）类型化字段渲染优于扁平字符串8.5点（干净数据）和7.4点（60%矛盾注入）；（3）类型化合并与类型化渲染不可分割——类型化合并但扁平展示的效果最差；（4）三种冲突策略无显著区别，表明争议日志并非关键驱动因素；（5）在τ-bench零售上，各编目方案使GPT-4o逐步工具调用准确率提升至少6.7点（归因于格式而非联邦经验）；（6）警示发现：TF-IDF分类器在标记数学代理和StableToolBench上分别超过所有LLM路由方案48和26点（主要为检索召回），原因是基准池包含每个所谓未见工具的标记查询以及过滤前所有测试查询的逐字副本——此类基准无法度量无标签工具的真实路由性能。

Conclusion: 类型化联邦工件作为一种跨平台代理知识共享形态具有可行性且有价值，但没有明显的额外联邦价值与格式改进之分。更重要的是，当前基准测试存在严重的标签/查询泄露，无法验证LLM在无标签工具上的路由能力，而真实世界的高价值路由场景恰恰面向无标签工具。论文警示社区需要设计能真正度量未见工具路由的基准。

Abstract: An open, networked web will allow agents to run frozen models from multiple vendors, keep their history private, and teach each other which tool to call and when. Flat text (prompts, example pools) makes it difficult for the protocol to distinguish between noise statistics, merging rules, and documentation. Weights and adapters cannot transfer that knowledge between platforms. We suggest sharing typed federated artifacts, schema-validated objects with well-defined fields for per-field privacy (described here, but measured), dispute resolution, and cross-model transfer, and instantiating them as SYNAPSE1, a common tool-routing knowledge. After deleting 192 garbage entries and 1,916 training items that duplicate or almost duplicate test queries, a federated compendium routes within 1.1 points of a centralized one at 20 MB of JSON per client each round on StableToolBench (3,180 tools). The same experience merged and shown to the router as typed fields rather than one flat string is worth 8.5 points on clean data and 7.4 under 60% injected contradiction. Crossing merge and rendering shows the halves are inseparable (the typed merge shown flat is the worst arm), while three conflict policies are indistinguishable, so the conflict log that motivated this work is not the On τ-bench retail, each compendium arm improves GPT-4o agents' per-step tool-call accuracy by at least 6.7 points, attributed to format rather than federated experience. Two cautionary findings conclude the paper: on a topic-labeled math proxy and StableToolBench, a TF-IDF classifier over the same labeled experience beats every LLM routing arm (by 48 and 26 points, mostly retrieval recall) because the benchmark's pool holds labeled queries for every supposedly unseen tool and every test query verbatim before our filter. It cannot measure routing to tools without labels, which routing exists for.

</details>


### [360] [XYBench: Can LLMs Respond Pragmatically to Queries with Misconceptions?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06842)
*Akhila Yerukola,Jena D. Hwang,Mingqian Zheng,Jenna Godsey,Hyunwoo Kim,Valentina Pyatkin,Jennifer Hu,Maarten Sap*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍XYBench基准，包含8,115个带有误解的用户查询（XY问题），评估LLM识别误解、引导用户走向务实解决方案的能力。实验表明当前最强LLM即使能识别务实答案，生成时也仍主要回答字面请求，与人类差距显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非专业用户在向LLM求助时常携带误解（如用正则解析XML），即XY问题。现有LLM评估多关注字面回答能力，而对识别用户深层意图及纠偏能力的系统性评估匮乏。

Method: 构建XYBench基准（8,115条跨技术与非技术领域的查询），设计评估范式依据合作回应理论，从三方面评判模型回复：务实解决方案的存在性和强调程度，以及误解识别能力。采用多选与生成对比实验及Oracle消融实验。

Result: 最强LLM回答字面请求的比例为0.75-0.92，而回答预期意图的比例仅0.33-0.71；误解识别能力最多63%，人类为79-90%。模型在多选设置中偏好务实回答，但生成时却普遍失败。Oracle实验显示提供用户意图能帮助但仍有大差距。

Conclusion: LLM的务实重定向（pragmatic redirection）能力仍是一项根本性未发展成熟的能力，揭示范式（识别误区并提供务实解答）与生成能力之间的显著鸿沟。

Abstract: When non-expert users ask LLMs for assistance, their queries can often have misconceptions (e.g., "How do I parse XML with regex?"). In such cases, often referred to as the XY-problem, LLMs must identify the misconception ("regex are fragile") and meaningfully direct the user toward a pragmatic solution that will address the root problem implicit in the request ("use an XML parser"). We introduce XYBench, a benchmark of 8,115 such queries, drawn from technical (StackOverflow/StackExchange) and everyday (WikiHow and a manually-curated subset) domains. We design an evaluation paradigm that assesses model responses along three criteria grounded in cooperative response theory: (a) presence and (b) emphasis on pragmatic solutions, and (c) identification of misconceptions. Our experiments show that even the strongest LLMs predominantly answer the literal request (0.75--0.92) and far less often the intended one (0.33--0.71), while substantially lagging behind humans at identifying misconceptions (at most 63% vs. 79--90%). Further, models overwhelmingly prefer pragmatic responses in a multiple choice setting yet consistently fail to generate them. Oracle ablation experiments show that providing explicit user intent at generation time helps; however a large gap remains, suggesting pragmatic redirection is a fundamentally underdeveloped capability in current LLMs.

</details>


### [361] [You Are What You Read: Misalignment via In-Context Persona Induction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06851)
*Kyuhee Kim,Benjamin Berczi,Cozmin Ududec*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现，仅通过将良性的传记事实作为普通对话上下文放入模型中，无需微调或有害行为演示，就能诱导模型扮演特定人物角色（称之为"人设诱导"）。跨9个人物和13个模型，身份采纳随事实数量呈S形上升，3-10个事实即可超过50%采纳率。无害人设可实现完全采纳且几乎不产生错位行为，而有害人设会在无关问题上以高达80%的比例表达其观点。内容过滤器对该方法检测率低（3% vs 直接指令的24-33%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究认为大模型的错位（misalignment）产生需要微调有害数据或提示词中直接演示不良行为。作者希望探索是否仅通过良性数据就能在上下文中诱导模型产生错位行为，从而揭示更隐蔽的对齐攻击面。

Method: 将9个不同人物（含无害和有害人设）的传记事实以普通对话形式放入模型上下文，不进行微调，也不在提示中展示任何有害行为。通过控制事实数量（3-10个），测量模型身份采纳率和错位行为率，并比较内容过滤器对该方法与直接指令的检测差异。

Result: 身份采纳随事实数量呈S形（sigmoid）上升，3-10个事实即达到50%采纳阈值。无害人设完全采纳且错位率几乎为零；有害人设则在无关问题上以高达80%的比例表达有害观点。内容过滤器仅标记3%的该攻击输入，而同等效果的直接指令被标记24-33%。格式化指令可以控制人设激活的时机。

Conclusion: 作者揭示了一种比现有认知更隐蔽的错位诱导方式：仅靠良性传记事实积累就能在上下文中触发有害行为，且能绕过现有内容过滤系统。这指出当前安全评估和过滤机制存在盲区，需要针对累积式上下文人设诱导制定新的防护策略。

Abstract: Broad misalignment has been produced by finetuning on narrow data, harmful or benign, and in context only by demonstrations of the undesirable behaviour itself. We show that benign data suffices in context, with no finetuning and no demonstration of harmful behaviour in the prompt. Biographical facts that converge on a single figure, placed in a model's context as ordinary conversational turns, lead it to answer as that figure on questions the facts never touch. We call this persona induction. Across nine personas and thirteen models, identity adoption rises sigmoidally with the number of facts and crosses 50% within 3 to 10 of them. Misalignment then tracks which figure is described. Harmless personas reach full adoption with near-zero misalignment, while harmful ones voice their characteristic views on unrelated questions, at rates up to 80%. A formatting instruction can gate when the persona activates. Because each fact is individually benign, accumulated biographical context is flagged by content filters on 3% of inputs against 24-33% for an equivalent direct instruction.

</details>


### [362] [AutoLexSteer: Automatic Contrast Construction for Lexical Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06879)
*Shuhe Wang,Lachlan Cowley,Eduard Hovy,Jey Han Lau*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Hangman，一种基于词义（word senses）的新型steering vector，以及AutoLexSteer——首个全自动构建steering vector的流程。AutoLexSteer利用从WordNet提取的密切相关词族来指定要避免的steering源和目标。该向量精度高，可在词和词义集合层面进行引导，并能控制诸如谄媚（sycophancy）等LLM行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Steering vectors已成为引导LLM输出的流行且有效的方法，但由于嵌入的不透明性，手工构建精确的steering vectors非常困难。需要一种自动化的、基于语义（而非模糊的嵌入）的方法来简化这一过程。

Method: 提出Hangman（基于词义运作的新型steering vector）和AutoLexSteer（全自动构建流程）。AutoLexSteer从WordNet中提取密切相关词族，用以同时指定需要避免的steering源以及期望的steering目标，从而在语义层面精确构建向量。

Result: 生成的steering vectors非常精确，能够在词级别以及词义（含义）集合级别进行引导，并且能够成功引导如谄媚行为等特定的LLM行为。

Conclusion: 基于词义的steering vector构建可全自动化实现，且比传统方法更精确，为LLM行为控制提供了更可控、基于语义的手段。代码和数据集已开源。

Abstract: Steering vectors have rapidly emerged as a popular and effective method for guiding the output of LLMs in very specific ways. But constructing accurate steering vectors is a difficult manual process due to the opacity of embeddings. We introduce Hangman, a novel type of steering vector that operates using word senses, as well as AutoLexSteer, the first fully automated process for building steering vectors. AutoLexSteer employs families of closely-related words extracted from WordNet to specify both the steering source to be avoided and the desired steering target. The steering vectors are quite precise, can be used to steer at the level of words and sets of word senses (meanings), and are able to steer certain LLM behaviors like sycophancy. The dataset and code can be found at https://github.com/ShuheWang1998/autolexsteer.

</details>


### [363] [Towards Bridging the Gap Between Offline and Iterative Alignment via Preference Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06893)
*Wenbo Zhang,Wenzhuo Zhou,Hengrui Cai,Zhengling Qi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出DP3O（Distilled Preference Probability Policy Optimization）离线对齐算法。通过对照实验发现迭代式DPO优于离线方法的关键在于显式偏好模型，DP3O先利用辅助LLM学习显式偏好模型，再将其知识蒸馏到策略优化中。理论上证明显式偏好建模比隐式形式有更好的估计误差控制，实证上DP3O超越最先进的离线方法，性能接近迭代DPO，训练时间节省约42%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回答两个核心问题：(i) 为什么迭代式DPO方法通常优于离线方法？(ii) 能否将这些优势融入离线对齐中？作者通过受控实验发现迭代过程中额外引入的显式偏好模型是其优于离线方法的关键因素。

Method: DP3O算法包含两个阶段：首先利用辅助LLM类别学习一个显式偏好模型，然后将该模型的偏好概率知识蒸馏到策略优化过程中。理论上通过显式偏好建模获得更好的估计误差控制，并通过方差缩减获得比硬标签DPO更紧的泛化界。

Result: 在广泛的基于聊天的任务和下游任务上，DP3O优于最先进的离线对齐方法，性能与迭代DPO相当，同时训练时间减少约42%，展示了其有效性和效率。

Conclusion: 离线对齐可以通过引入显式偏好模型来弥补与迭代方法的差距，DP3O证明了将迭代方法的优势以知识蒸馏方式融入离线框架是可行且高效的。

Abstract: Direct preference optimization DPO is a promising offline approach for aligning large language models (LLMs) due to its simplicity, computational efficiency, and implicit modeling of human preferences. Interestingly, iterative extensions of DPO have achieved stronger performance on academic benchmarks, raising two key questions: (i) Why do iterative methods generally outperform offline ones? (ii) Can their advantages be incorporated into offline alignment? To answer the first question, our controlled experiments reveal that the explicit preference model, additionally introduced in the iterative procedure, is a key factor behind its superiority over offline methods. This insight leads us to answer the second question affirmatively and propose Distilled Preference Probability Policy Optimization (DP3O), an effective and efficient offline alignment algorithm. DP3O first learns an explicit preference model using a helper class of LLMs and then distills its knowledge into policy optimization. Theoretically, we show that explicit preference modeling admits better estimation error control than implicit formulations, and that DP3O achieves a tighter generalization bound than hard-label DPO through variance reduction. Empirically, we evaluate DP3O on a wide range of chat-based and downstream tasks and show that it outperforms state-of-the-art offline methods, achieves performance comparable to iterative DPO, and reduces training time by about $42\%$, demonstrating both its effectiveness and efficiency.

</details>


### [364] [Dynamic-Programming-Guided Hierarchical BPE and Empirical Analysis of Vocabulary Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06898)
*Kenny Shao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出DH-BPE，一种基于动态规划和层次依赖感知剪枝的词汇构建方法，在固定模型可见词汇预算下改进压缩效果，相较于Standard BPE和多个基线在12K/16K目标词汇量上获得更优的聚合压缩，并在特定条件下超越MinGram-PP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准BPE通过贪婪对合并构建词汇表，但合并顺序并不一定能以最优方式分配固定大小的模型可见词汇用于压缩。需要一种能够考虑精确最小token分割下token曝光度与BPE训练层次依赖关系的词汇构建方法。

Method: DH-BPE从适度超采的BPE候选词汇出发，利用动态规划衡量候选的词元效用，并采用曝光引导、依赖感知的剪枝策略来挑选固定大小的模型可见词汇。该方法结合了精确最小token分割下的token曝光度与BPE训练产生的层次依赖结构。

Result: 在12K和16K目标词汇量的主要对比中，DH-BPE在共享精确最小token动态规划编码器下，聚合压缩一致优于Standard BPE、Pruned BPE和MinGram。MinGram-PP在主要对比中聚合压缩更强，但在交叉语料评估中，DH-BPE在过采样因子f=2.0和f=3.0时优于MinGram-PP；在12K下MinGram-PP仅在更大的候选池（f=4.0和f=5.0）下反转这一排序。

Conclusion: 定性分析表明，DH-BPE在更晚、更完整的BPE合并与可复用子词组件之间取得了平衡，为在固定模型可见词汇预算下改进词汇分配提供了一种实用方法。

Abstract: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) constructs vocabularies through greedy pair merging, but the resulting merge order does not necessarily allocate a fixed model-visible vocabulary optimally for compression. We propose Dynamic-Programming-Guided Hierarchical BPE (DH-BPE), a vocabulary-construction method that combines token exposure under exact minimum-token segmentation with the hierarchical dependencies induced by BPE training. Starting from a modestly overshot BPE candidate vocabulary, DH-BPE uses dynamic programming to measure candidate utility and applies exposure-guided, dependency-aware pruning to select a fixed-size model-visible vocabulary. We compare DH-BPE against Standard BPE and recent vocabulary-optimization baselines, including Pruned BPE, MinGram, and MinGram-PP, in primary evaluations at 12K and 16K target vocabulary sizes, with an additional 18K evaluation against MinGram only. Across the primary 12K and 16K comparisons, DH-BPE consistently improves aggregate compression over Standard BPE, Pruned BPE, and MinGram under a shared exact minimum-token DP encoder. MinGram-PP achieves stronger aggregate compression in the primary comparisons, but DH-BPE outperforms it at overshoot factors f = 2.0 and f = 3.0 in cross-corpus evaluation; at 12K, MinGram-PP reverses this ordering only with the substantially larger candidate pools at f = 4.0 and f = 5.0. Qualitative analysis further shows that DH-BPE balances later, more complete BPE merges with reusable subword components, providing a practical approach to improving vocabulary allocation under a fixed model-visible vocabulary budget.

</details>


### [365] [TurEngMix: A Text Corpus and Benchmark for Turkish-English Code-Mixed Language Identification and Named Entity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06963)
*Ilayda Dogan,Phuong-Anh Nguyen-Le,Julia Mendelsohn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍TurEngMix语料库，包含5.5K条土耳其语-英语代码混合社交媒体帖子（486,974个词元），并构建了包含15K专家标注词元的代码混合语言识别（LID）和命名实体识别（NER）基准。实验发现所有模型在混合语言词元上错误率较高，形态整合词元的NER错误率比纯语言词元高5.2-6.3倍，揭示形态整合是代码混合NLP的主要挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言处理系统在代码混合文本上表现不佳，尤其是低资源语言对。土耳其语-英语对尤为特殊，因为英语词干可以与土耳其语后缀结合形成单个混合语言词元，这对现有NLP系统构成独特挑战，但缺乏相关语料库和基准。

Method: 构建TurEngMix语料库（5.5K嘈杂社交媒体帖子），从中构建15K专家标注词元的土耳其语-英语代码混合LID和NER基准。评估解码器LLM（如GPT-4o、Qwen）和微调编码器基线在两个任务上的表现。

Result: 单语土耳其语和英语词元被可靠标注，但所有模型在混合语言词元的LID和NER上错误率都较高。对于形态整合词元，GPT-4o和Qwen的NER错误率分别是纯语言词元的5.2倍和6.3倍。

Conclusion: 形态整合（morphological integration）仍是代码混合NLP的未解决挑战。作者发布语料库、标注和代码以支持土耳其语-英语代码混合的计算和社会语言学研究。

Abstract: Natural language processing systems underperform on code-mixed text, particularly for low-resource language pairs. Turkish-English poses a further challenge: it lets English stems combine with Turkish suffixes to form single mixed-language tokens. We introduce TurEngMix, a corpus of 5.5K noisy, naturally occurring social media posts (486,974 tokens) rich in Turkish-English code-mixing. From this corpus, we construct a new Turkish-English benchmark for code-mixed language identification (LID) and named entity recognition (NER), comprising 15K expert-annotated tokens. Evaluating both decoder LLM and fine-tuned encoder baselines, we find that monolingual Turkish and English tokens are labeled reliably, but all models have high error rates on mixed-language tokens for both LID and NER. For morphologically integrated tokens, NER error rates were 5.2x and 6.3x higher for GPT-4o and Qwen, respectively. This highlights how morphological integration remains a challenge. We release the corpus, annotations, and code to support future computational and sociolinguistic research on Turkish-English code-mixing.

</details>


### [366] [CantoneseLLM v2: Reasoning in a Low-Resource Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06970)
*Tsz Chung Cheng,Chung Shing Cheng,Chaak Ming Lau,Cheuk Hei Chong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文开发并发布了CantoneseLLM v2，包括基于Qwen3 8B和30B-A3B的粤语大语言模型。通过CPT、chat-vector合并、SFT、DPO和RLVR等多阶段训练，系统评估了各训练阶段对粤语推理行为的影响。30B-A3B模型在HKCanto-Eval上达到73.16分，成功保留粤语推理行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 粤语使用广泛但书面语资源匮乏，缺乏大规模母语粤语推理语料用于模型训练，导致现有模型难以用粤语进行正确推理。

Method: 基于Qwen3 8B和30B-A3B，通过四阶段训练：CPT(7.84亿粤语及香港相关token) + chat-vector合并 + SFT + DPO + RLVR（以粤语语言和繁体中文为乘法约束）。

Result: 发现chat-vector合并可迁移指令遵循但保留推理语言；SFT缩短推理痕迹并降低基准性能；DPO恢复推理块格式但只恢复部分性能；RLVR引入粤语语言对齐并恢复丢失性能。30B-A3B模型达73.16分，仅比合并检查点低1.20分，同时保留粤语推理行为。

Conclusion: RLVR是多语言推理训练的关键手段，能同时实现语言对齐和性能恢复。团队发布了模型检查点、训练环境及十三年繁体中文Common Crawl数据集。

Abstract: Cantonese is widely spoken but remains low-resource in written data, with no large corpus of native Cantonese reasoning traces available for model training. We develop and release CantoneseLLM v2, comprising models based on Qwen3 8B and 30B-A3B. The models are trained through CPT on 784 million Cantonese and Hong Kong-related tokens, chat-vector merging, SFT, DPO, and RLVR. Evaluation across the training stages shows that chat-vector merging transfers instruction following but preserves the donor model's reasoning language, while SFT with limited Cantonese reasoning data substantially shortens or removes reasoning traces and reduces benchmark performance. DPO restores the reasoning-block format, particularly for the 8B model, but recovers only part of the lost performance. The RLVR training with Cantonese language and Traditional Chinese scripts as multiplicative constraints introduced Cantonese language alignment and restored the lost performance. The 30B-A3B model reaches 73.16 on HKCanto-Eval, within 1.20 points of its merged checkpoint, while retaining the Cantonese reasoning behaviour absent from that checkpoint. We release the model checkpoints, the training environments, and a thirteen-year Traditional Chinese Common Crawl dataset. The models can be accessed at https://huggingface.co/collections/hon9kon9ize/cantonesellm-v20

</details>


### [367] [Train Overcomplete, Deploy Compact: Scaling Recovery Capacity for Structured LLM Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06974)
*Seungmin Oh,Donggeon Lee,Jongbin Ryu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出OverRep框架，通过"过完备训练、紧凑部署"的原则解决结构化剪枝恢复阶段的能力-知识不对称问题，在恢复模块训练期间进行过参数化以吸收从原模型蒸馏的复杂知识，之后通过退火激活将过完备重参数化代数合并为等价的紧凑模块，在不增加推理开销的情况下显著提升保留推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型部署成本高（内存、延迟、能耗），结构化剪枝虽能降低成本，但其恢复阶段常因恢复模块的表示能力与被移除知识的复杂度不匹配而受限，这种"能力-知识不对称"成为剪枝性能的瓶颈。

Method: OverRep框架遵循"训练过完备、部署紧凑"原则：(1)训练期间临时对恢复模块进行过参数化，使其能吸收从原始模型蒸馏的复杂知识；(2)引入退火激活（annealed activation），在训练中支持非线性动力学，同时收敛到线性机制以便精确代数合并；(3)恢复后将过完备重参数化代数合并为数学等价的紧凑模块，保持推理时的架构和计算成本不变。

Result: 在三个骨干模型家族上，与强恢复基线相比，OverRep在25%和50%剪枝率下分别将保留推理性能提升最多5.5和8.4个点，同时内存使用和TFLOPs与现有恢复方法相当。

Conclusion: OverRep有效解决了结构化LLM剪枝中的能力-知识不对称问题，通过临时的过参数化与精确代数合并，在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升剪枝后模型的性能恢复质量。

Abstract: Large language models achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, but deployment remains costly because of memory, latency, and energy demands. Structured pruning reduces these costs by removing architectural components, yet its recovery stage is often limited by a mismatch between the recovery module's representational capacity and the complexity of the removed knowledge. We call this bottleneck the capacity-knowledge asymmetry and propose OverRep, an Overcomplete Reparameterization framework for structured LLM pruning. Following the principle of "train overcomplete, deploy compact", OverRep temporarily overparameterizes the recovery module during training to absorb complex knowledge distilled from the original model. After recovery, the overcomplete re-parameterization is algebraically merged into a mathematically equivalent compact module, preserving the pruned model's inference-time architecture and computational cost. OverRep further introduces an annealed activation that enables nonlinear training dynamics while converging to a linear regime for exact algebraic merging. Across three backbone families, OverRep improves retained reasoning performance over strong recovery baselines by up to 5.5 and 8.4 points at 25% and 50% pruning, respectively, while keeping memory usage and TFLOPs comparable to existing recovery methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/mmai-laboratory/OverRep.

</details>


### [368] [Aha-Flow Distillation: Flow Markers Matter in LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07036)
*Xiaodong Wang,Peixi Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"Flow Moment"这一推理模式（特征是持续、确认过程的表述，如"I'm doing"），与"Aha Moment"（修订和回溯导向）相对。作者构建Flow-CoT（通过改写推理轨迹中的话语标记，保留推理内容），并用于on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）的辅助监督。进一步提出Aha-Flow蒸馏（AFD），这是OPSD的双模态扩展，将不同类型特权信息与相应推理指令配对。在AIME25和HMMT25上，Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-4B均一致改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理方法主要关注Aha Moment（模型回溯修正的时刻），但忽略了另一种重要的推理模式——Flow Moment（持续确认过程的推理表述）。作者认为这两种模式的异构推理监督及组织方式可以提升模型推理能力。

Method: 1) 识别Flow Moment和Aha Moment两类推理模式及其语言标识（Flow Markers和Aha Markers）；2) 构建Flow-CoT：重写原推理轨迹的话语标记而不改推理内容；3) 提出AFD（Aha-Flow Distillation）：OPSD的双模态扩展——Aha分支保留简洁基于解的监督，Flow分支在直接自信推理指令下引入Flow-CoT；推理时只用标准反思指令。

Result: AIME25和HMMT25上，Qwen3-8B的Avg@12从60.8提升至61.3，Qwen3-4B从57.5提升至58.6（相对复现的OPSD基线）。消融实验显示，在相同Flow-CoT/Aha-CoT构成下，双模态训练将Avg@12从59.5提升至60.1，说明收益不仅来自异构推理监督的引入，还来自其组织方式。

Conclusion: Flow风格推理可作为纯训练信号（推理时不需要暴露），双模态组织（Aha+Flow）比单模态更有效地利用异构推理监督。代码已开源。

Abstract: We identify the Flow Moment, a reasoning pattern characterized by sustained, process-confirming verbalizations such as I'm doing, in contrast to the revision- and backtracking-oriented Aha Moment. We refer to their corresponding linguistic expressions as Flow Markers and Aha Markers, respectively. Based on this observation, we construct Flow-CoT by rewriting the discourse markers of original reasoning traces while preserving their underlying reasoning content, and use it as auxiliary supervision for on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). We further propose \textbf{Aha-Flow Distillation (AFD)}, a dual-mode extension of OPSD that pairs different forms of privileged information with corresponding reasoning instructions. The Aha branch retains concise solution-based supervision, while the Flow branch introduces rewritten Flow-CoT under a direct and confident reasoning instruction. At inference time, the model uses only the standard reflective instruction, so Flow-style reasoning serves purely as a training signal. Experiments on AIME25 and HMMT25 show consistent improvements across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B: AFD improves Avg@12 from 60.8 to 61.3 on Qwen3-8B and from 57.5 to 58.6 on Qwen3-4B over our reproduced OPSD baselines. Controlled ablations further show that, with the same Flow-CoT/Aha-CoT composition, dual-mode training improves Avg@12 from 59.5 to 60.1, indicating that the benefit comes not only from introducing heterogeneous reasoning supervision, but also from how it is organized during self-distillation. The code is available at https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/Aha-Flow-Distillation.

</details>


### [369] [A Hyperbolicity Atlas of Large Language Model Hidden States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07053)
*Zhichao Yang,Yuanze Hu,Gen Li,Qingchen Yu,Shiying Duan,Xinyu Wang,Ye Qiu,Zeming Liu,Guangxu Chen,Zhaoxin Fan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了当代LLM中prompt-token隐藏状态是否表现出Gromov双曲性（GH，即距离层面的树状结构度量）。通过818,904个样本-层测量，对十个开源模型在四个数据集上构建了覆盖参数规模、层深度、模型家族和输入领域四个轴的GH图谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然LLM隐藏状态是普通向量，但向量间的距离可能呈现出层级结构。此前缺乏对隐藏状态是否具有树状几何结构（Gromov双曲性）的系统性研究，作者希望填补这一空白，并探索这种结构沿不同轴的变化规律。

Method: 使用十个开源权重模型，在MATH500、HumanEval、WinoGrande、TruthfulQA四个数据集上进行818,904次样本-层测量，系统性计算GH值，并从参数规模、层深度、模型家族、输入领域四个维度构建GH图谱进行分析。

Result: 最清晰的模式来自层深度而非参数规模：中间层通常形成高相对双曲性平台，而最终层往往变得显著更加树状。规模效应较弱且非单调；同为7/8B参数的模型家族差异显著；输入领域与模型特化之间存在交互作用。

Conclusion: GH可作为实用诊断工具：能够揭示层级距离结构在何处出现、特化如何改变它，以及哪些模型-层-领域的组合值得更深入的分析。

Abstract: LLM hidden states are ordinary vectors, but the distances among those vectors may still show hierarchical structure. To our knowledge, this paper is the first systematic study of whether prompt-token hidden states in contemporary LLMs exhibit Gromov Hyperbolicity (GH), a distance-based measure of tree-likeness. Using 818,904 sample-layer measurements from ten open-weight models across MATH500, HumanEval, WinoGrande, and TruthfulQA, we build a GH map over four axes: parameter scale, layer depth, model family, and input domain. The clearest pattern is depth, not scale: middle layers usually form a high-relative-hyperbolicity plateau, while final layers often become substantially more tree-like. Scale effects are weak and non-monotonic, matched 7/8B model families differ strongly, and domains interact with model specialization. These findings make GH useful as a practical diagnostic: it shows where hierarchical distance structure appears, how specialization changes it, and which model-layer-domain comparisons deserve closer analysis.

</details>


### [370] [Where to Look and What to Use: Retrieve-Localize-Generate for Long-Term Conversational Memory Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07093)
*Yifan Wang,Xinkui Lin,Yongxiu Xu,Shen Gao,Ruochen Yang,Kun Huang,Yubin Wang,Jie Wu,Wei Liu,Jian Luan,Hongbo Xu,Shuo Shang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MemLoc 是一个用于长期对话记忆问答的统一 Retrieve-Localize-Generate 框架，通过多粒度记忆单元分解、熵驱动的粒度选择、跨会话图建模以及基于自我反思提示策略优化的推理定位器，解决证据碎片化和检索内容噪声引发的 lost-in-the-middle 问题，在四个基准上取得最先进的检索准确率和响应质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RAG 方法在长期对话记忆问答中面临两大挑战：(1) 时间上分散的会话导致证据碎片化，难以整合；(2) 检索到的会话包含噪声内容，触发 lost-in-the-middle 效应，降低 LLM 的利用能力。这两个问题制约了长期记忆问答的准确性和可靠性。

Method: MemLoc 提出统一的 Retrieve-Localize-Generate 三阶段框架。检索阶段：将会话分解为多粒度记忆单元，通过内部记忆图进行查询路由和熵级粒度选择，并通过跨记忆图建模会话间的语义与时间依赖，实现由粗到细的 top-K 记忆候选检索。定位阶段：提出基于自我反思提示策略优化（SHPO）训练的推理式证据定位器，通过渐进式精炼提取查询相关片段抑制噪声，并跨候选重排序去除冗余，生成带轻量位置 ID 的紧凑证据集。生成阶段：位置 ID 作为精确的接地信号引导 LLM 定位到正确记忆位置，减轻 lost-in-the-middle 效应，同时保留原始上下文完整性。

Result: 在四个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，MemLoc 在检索准确率和响应质量上均达到最先进水平，同时保持良好的效率。

Conclusion: MemLoc 通过检索-定位-生成的统一框架有效解决了长期对话记忆 QA 中证据碎片化与检索噪声两大难题，证明了推理式证据定位与位置 ID 接地信号在提升 LLM 长时记忆问答可靠性方面的有效性。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables large language models (LLMs) to answer questions by accessing external knowledge and has been widely adopted for long-term conversational memory question answering. However, existing methods suffer from two key challenges: (1) fragmented evidence scattered across temporally distant sessions, and (2) noisy content within retrieved sessions that triggers the lost-in-the-middle effect. To address these challenges, we propose MemLoc, a unified Retrieve-Localize-Generate framework for long-term conversational memory QA. For retrieval, MemLoc decomposes each session into multi-granularity memory units and performs query routing via an inner-memory graph with entropy-based granularity selection. It further models cross-session semantic and temporal dependencies through a cross-memory graph, enabling coarse-to-fine retrieval of top-K relevant memory candidates. For localization, we introduce a reasoning-based evidence locator trained with Self-reflective Hint Policy Optimization (SHPO), which performs progressive refinement by extracting query-relevant fragments within memory units to suppress noise and reranking across candidates to remove redundancy, producing a compact evidence set with lightweight location IDs. For generation, these IDs act as precise grounding signals that guide the LLM to the correct memory positions, mitigating the lost-in-the-middle effect while preserving original contextual integrity. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that MemLoc achieves state-of-the-art retrieval accuracy and response quality while maintaining efficiency. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Nikol-coder/MemLoc.

</details>


### [371] [Revisiting Complete Reasoning Traces for Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07103)
*Jaehui Hwang,Sangdoo Yun,Byeongho Heo,Dongyoon Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究发现LLM在监督微调（SFT）等后训练阶段学习完整推理轨迹收益有限，而截断的部分轨迹（甚至仅用端点）也能有效提升推理能力。通过注意力分析和token删除对照实验，发现中间推理token对最终推理质量贡献极小，说明冗余信息可以省略，让模型利用内部知识自行补全缺失步骤。该方法对RL和on-policy distillation等后训练方法同样有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM通常在后训练阶段利用预收集的完整推理轨迹来提升推理能力，但这些复杂交错的轨迹往往包含大量绕路和冗余信息。作者质疑：模型在SFT等后训练中是否真的需要学习完整的推理轨迹？

Method: 1）通过多次实验对比完整轨迹与部分轨迹（含重度截断）的训练效果；2）利用注意力机制分析和受控token删除实验来量化推理轨迹中中间token的贡献；3）进一步在RL和on-policy distillation等后训练方法中验证端点（endpoints）训练的有效性。

Result: 完整轨迹收益有限，即使重度截断的部分轨迹仍然有效；注意力分析和token删除实验均表明中间token对最终推理质量贡献极小；仅用端点训练能带来一致的推理行为改变，并对RL和on-policy distillation方法同样有效。

Conclusion: 推理轨迹中存在大量冗余token，去除冗余信息有助于模型利用内部知识从已知端点自行推断缺失步骤。这一发现挑战了"后训练需要完整推理轨迹"的传统假设，提示需要重新审视完整推理痕迹在后训练中的必要性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often post-trained on pre-collected reasoning trajectories to improve their reasoning capability. Such trajectories tend to be long due to complex, interwoven paths, which often include detours on the path toward the answer. However, it has been underexplored whether LLMs indeed benefit from learning complete trajectories in post-training, such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Starting from our pilot study, we find that full trajectories provide only limited benefit, while partial trajectories are effective even under heavy truncation. We analyze redundancy in reasoning trajectories through attention-based analyses and controlled token-removal studies, both of which show that intermediate tokens contribute minimally to final reasoning quality. This suggests that avoiding redundant information may allow LLMs to internally infer coherent alternatives by inferring missing steps from their internal knowledge, given known trajectory endpoints. Furthermore, we show that training LLMs using endpoints leads to consistent changes in reasoning behavior, and that it also benefits post-training methods based on reinforcement learning or on-policy distillation, highlighting the need to revisit complete reasoning traces. Code is available at https://github.com/naver-ai/revisiting-trace.

</details>


### [372] [The Illusion of Debiasing: Persona Steering Redistributes Rather Than Reduces Bias in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07117)
*Ziyue Feng,Hongbo Fang,James A. Evans*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究以人格条件化为可控探针，测量提示干预（system prompts/personas）从自我报告、开放生成到词级参数联想这一深度轴上的效应，发现层级化分离：人格可表面遵循但非结构性，提示干预主要作用于输出通道，存在结构可达性极限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然提示干预（系统提示、人格、角色指令）能可靠地重塑语言模型的输出，但尚不清楚这些干预究竟触及了模型的哪一层——是重构了内部结构，还是仅仅调制了输出通道？

Method: 以人格条件化作为受控探针，沿深度轴线（自我报告→开放生成→词级参数联想）测量干预效应，在三个经过指令微调的模型上进行实验，考察单特质指令遵循与人际特质间协方差再现能力。

Result: 发现层级化分离：模型能遵循单特质指令，但无法复现人类跨特质协方差。分离随深度加深：人格保持或放大封闭式QA偏差，改变绝对语气但不改变组间差异，且几乎不扰动已饱和的联想基线。

Conclusion: 基于提示的引导主要在输出通道运作，存在结构可达性极限，而这种极限可能被表面的可操控性所掩盖。

Abstract: Prompt-based interventions: system prompts, personas, role instructions, reliably reshape what a language model says, but it is unclear which layer they reach. Do they reconfigure internal structure, or only modulate the output channel? We use persona conditioning as a controlled probe, measuring its effects along a depth axis from self-report, through open-ended generation, to word-level parametric association, across three instruction-tuned models. We find a graded dissociation. Personas are legible but not structural: models follow single-trait instructions yet fail to reproduce human inter-trait covariance. The dissociation deepens with depth: personas hold or amplify closed-form QA bias, shift absolute tone while leaving between-group disparity unchanged, and barely perturb an already saturated associative baseline. Prompt-based steering thus operates in the output channel and has a structural reach limit that surface manipulability can mask.

</details>


### [373] [PTCG: Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07120)
*Eunbeen Son,Yohan Jo,Joonsuk Park,JinYeong Bak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出PTCG框架，结合Tree-of-Thoughts逐步生成与剪枝，以及说话人角色选择，生成多样且具有说服力的反驳论点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有反驳论点生成方法通常只生成单一论点，无法捕捉真实辩论中所需的多样性和说服力。

Method: PTCG框架包含两大核心组件：一是受Tree-of-Thoughts启发的逐步生成与剪枝机制；二是说话人角色选择，即从原始论点估计作者角色，并引入代表不同视角的说话人角色来实现观点采择，从而生成多样化的反驳论点。

Result: 通过LLM作为评判者、基于分类器的评估以及人类评估，PTCG在反驳论点的多样性和说服力方面均相较基线方法取得了一致的改进。

Conclusion: PTCG通过结合树状思维逐步推理与说话人角色建模，有效提升了反驳论点生成的多样性与说服力，为批判性思维和平衡话语的应用提供了可行方案。

Abstract: The ability to generate counterarguments is important for critical thinking and balanced discourse, yet existing approaches typically produce only a single counterargument, failing to capture the diversity and persuasiveness required in real-world debates. To address this limitation, we propose Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation (PTCG), a framework that combines Tree-of-Thoughts-inspired step-wise generation and pruning with speaker persona selection. By estimating the author's persona from the original argument and incorporating speaker personas representing distinct perspectives, PTCG operationalizes perspective-taking and enables the generation of diverse counterarguments. Results from LLM-as-a-Judge, classifier-based assessment, and human evaluations indicate that PTCG shows consistent improvements in both the diversity and persuasiveness of counterarguments compared to baseline methods.

</details>


### [374] [Line-Coupled Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07129)
*Shiyuan Li,Shaorong Zhang,Zhaorui Yang,Qian Zhang,Greg Ver Steeg,Bingyao Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出行耦合格语言模型（LCLM），一种自回归模型，通过共享因果上下文同时推进多行文本，每次前向传播平均生成2.94个内容token（881M参数），相比传统自回归模型1个token/前向传播，显著提升生成效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统自回归语言模型每步仅生成一个token，限制了每次前向传播的有效输出。现有的扩散模型、插入式解码和多token预测等方法要么增加训练时的token流量，要么难以预测强依赖的未来token，因此需要一种既能并行生成又不牺牲依赖建模的方法。

Method: LCLM将多行文本的token交织到单一因果序列中，为每行预测下一个token，并通过共享因果上下文将各行耦格。采用行交错旋转位置编码，保持标准next-token目标和因果注意力机制不变。

Result: 881M参数的LCLM每次前向传播平均生成2.94个内容token，验证交叉熵损失为2.44；而香草自回归基线为1.00 token/前向传播，损失2.39。即使LCLM每次前向传播生成16个token，损失仅比基线高0.09（2.34 vs 2.25）。

Conclusion: 跨行目标的依赖程度显著低于同行连续token，验证了行可作为有效的并行生成单元。LCLM在显著提升每次前向传播token产出量的同时，模型质量损失很小，为高效并行文本生成提供了新思路。

Abstract: Autoregressive language models generate one token per decoding step, limiting the useful output of each forward pass. Although diffusion models, insertion-based decoding, and multi-token prediction enable parallel generation, they either incur additional training-time token traffic or struggle to predict strongly dependent future tokens. We introduce the Line-Coupled Language Model (LCLM), an autoregressive model that advances multiple text lines together by predicting the next token for every active line while coupling the lines through shared causal context. LCLM interleaves line tokens into a single causal sequence and uses line-staggered rotary positions, retaining the standard next-token objective and causal attention. Controlled experiments show that cross-line targets are substantially less dependent than consecutive same-line targets, supporting lines as parallel generation units. With 881M parameters, LCLM produces an average of 2.94 content tokens per forward pass with a validation cross-entropy loss of 2.44, compared with 1.00 token per forward pass and a loss of 2.39 for the vanilla autoregressive baseline. Most notably, even when LCLM generates 16 tokens per forward pass, its loss is only 0.09 higher than that of the vanilla autoregressive baseline (2.34 vs. 2.25).

</details>


### [375] [Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Prompt Ensemble for Minor-Grain Breeding Information Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07134)
*Hang Zhao,Jiahao Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了RAME（Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Prompt Ensemble）框架，用于CCL2026-Eval任务5的小颗粒作物育种信息抽取（MGBIE），该框架无需训练，通过检索增强的少样本选择、三提示词集成和大规模重复采样投票，在排行榜上以0.499总分排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对小颗粒作物育种文献中12种实体类型和6种关系类型的联合抽取任务，需要一种无需训练、高置信度且能处理噪声预测的方法，以超越官方GPT-5.5基线。

Method: RAME包含三个核心组件：(i) 基于混合BM25-embedding检索器的检索增强少样本选择；(ii) 三提示词集成（Strict、Relaxed、Balanced），覆盖精确率到召回率的谱系；(iii) 大规模重复采样加多数投票以过滤噪声预测。基于DeepSeek-V4-Flash构建。

Result: RAME在排行榜上取得Total Score 0.499（NER 0.730，RE 0.346），排名第一，超越官方Track-A基线GPT-5.5的0.448，实现了11.4%的相对提升。

Conclusion: RAME证明了无需训练、通过检索增强与多提示词集成投票的方式能在领域信息抽取中取得优异表现，显著超越更强的基础模型基线。

Abstract: This paper presents our system for CCL2026-Eval Task 5: Minor-Grain Breeding Information Extraction (MGBIE), which jointly extracts 12 entity types and 6 relation types from minor-grain breeding literature. We propose RAME (Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Prompt Ensemble), a training-free framework that elicits multiple LLM outputs under controlled diversity and aggregates them by majority voting to obtain high-confidence predictions. RAME combines (i) retrieval-augmented few-shot selection via a hybrid BM25-embedding retriever, (ii) a three-prompt ensemble (Strict, Relaxed, Balanced) spanning the precision to recall spectrum, and (iii) large-scale repeated sampling with majority voting to filter noisy predictions. Built on DeepSeek-V4-Flash, RAME achieves a Total Score of 0.499 (NER 0.730, RE 0.346) on the leaderboard, ranking 1st and surpassing the official Track-A baseline powered by GPT-5.5 (0.448), representing an 11.4% relative improvement. Code is available at https://github.com/king-wang123/CCL26-RAME.

</details>


### [376] [Vishing-Tactics-Bench: Forecasting Exploitation Trajectories in Voice Phishing Calls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07151)
*Jeongmin Lee,Dongmyung Sul,Seung Yun,Jinxia Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Vishing-Tactics-Bench基准，将语音钓鱼（vishing）防御从事后欺诈分类重构为基于Endsley态势感知框架的实时危害预测任务。论文构建了6战术分类法，标注了5,645个合成中文电话中的35,340条诈骗者话语，并定义了"利用轨迹预测"（Exploitation Trajectory Forecasting）生存风格协议，用于预测通话中每个回合将走向的最终危害类型（信息收集或金融剥削）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音钓鱼是实时展开的威胁，通话结束后再做事后分类为时已晚。攻击者真正需要的是在通话进行中判断当前战术正朝着哪种具体危害（信息收集或金融剥削）发展，从而实现对危害的预测而非事后识别。

Method: 论文方法包括：(1) 将MITRE ATT&CK框架适配为6战术分类法Vishing-Tactics；(2) 构建标注35,340条诈骗者话语的数据集（5,645个合成中文电话）；(3) 提出Exploitation Trajectory Forecasting协议，这是一个针对两种终态危害的生存风格预测框架；(4) 使用三个指标（AP@k、C-index、发散误差）评估从马尔可夫启发式到微调大语言模型的多种基线模型。

Result: 实验表明战术轨迹可作为通话战术状态的可解释表征，支持针对特定危害类型的预测。分层提前时间分析在严格误报预算约束下，进一步确定了通话中轨迹信号能够产生早期预警的时间点。

Conclusion: 战术轨迹表示方法有效支持危害特定型预测，可用于下游干预选择应用，为实时语音钓鱼防御提供了新的研究范式。

Abstract: Voice phishing (vishing) unfolds in real time; by the time a call has ended and post-hoc classification is possible, the harm has already been done. The more actionable question is which concrete harm (Information Gathering or Financial Exploitation) an ongoing call is tactically progressing toward. We present Vishing-Tactics-Bench, a benchmark grounded in Endsley's situation-awareness (SA) framework that recasts vishing defense from after-the-fact fraud classification to harm projection: predicting at each turn whether the call will reach either terminal harm. We adapt MITRE ATT&CK to vishing as a 6-tactic taxonomy (Vishing-Tactics) and label 35,340 scammer utterances across 5,645 synthetic Chinese calls. We define Exploitation Trajectory Forecasting, a survival-style protocol over the two terminal harms with three metrics: AP@k, C-index, and divergence error. Baselines ranging from a Markov heuristic to fine-tuned LLMs show that the tactical trajectory serves as an interpretable representation of the call's tactical state, supporting harm-specific forecasting, which can then be used for the downstream application of intervention selection; a stratified lead-time analysis at a tight false-alarm budget further identifies at what point in a call the trajectory signal yields early warning.

</details>


### [377] [FreqBLiMP: Frequency-Controlled Minimal Pairs Reveal Robustness and Fragility of LLMs Under Lexical Rarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07153)
*Tyrone White,Yuki Arase*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了FreqBLiMP，一个频率控制的BLiMP扩展基准，通过按Zipf频率分布重新生成所有67个范式来测试语言模型在稀有词汇条件下的语法偏好稳定性。研究发现低频词会一致降低句子似然度，但整体对比可接受性准确率仅小幅下降，不过这种聚合稳定性掩盖了不同语言现象间的显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最小对基准（如BLiMP）虽然能评估语言模型的语言学知识，但忽略了词汇频率这一自然语言中普遍且高度偏斜的特性，因此无法检验语法偏好是否在涉及稀有词汇时保持稳定。

Method: 引入FreqBLiMP，在明确的Zipf频率机制下重新生成BLiMP的全部67个范式，同时保留每个最小对的语法对比，控制词汇频率变化而不破坏语法对比。随后对多个开放权重LLM家族在不同规模上进行评估。

Result: 词汇频率的降低会导致句子似然度持续单调下降，但整体对比可接受性准确率仅适度降低。然而这种聚合层面的稳定性掩盖了语言现象间的显著差异：LLMs在显性形态句法泛化上保持稳健，而在需要词汇项特定信息（lemma-specific）的现象上性能明显退化。

Conclusion: FreqBLiMP揭示了LLMs的语言知识在词汇频率变化下的不均衡脆弱性，为理解模型对稀有词汇语法结构的泛化能力提供了更细致的评估框架。

Abstract: Minimal-pair benchmarks such as BLiMP evaluate linguistic knowledge by testing whether language models (LMs) prefer acceptable sentences over minimally different unacceptable ones. However, these benchmarks largely ignore lexical frequency variation, despite lexical frequency being a pervasive and highly skewed property of natural language use. Consequently, existing evaluations do not test whether grammatical preferences remain stable when contrasts involve rare lexical items. We introduce FreqBLiMP, a frequency-controlled extension of BLiMP that regenerates all 67 paradigms under explicit Zipf-frequency regimes while preserving each minimal-pair's grammatical contrast. Evaluating multiple open-weight LLM families across scales, we find that decreasing lexical frequency produces a consistent, monotonic decrease in sentence likelihood, but only a modest reduction in overall contrastive acceptability accuracy. However, this aggregate stability masks substantial variation across linguistic phenomena, with LLMs remaining robust on overt morphosyntactic generalization while degrading on phenomena that require lemma-specific information.

</details>


### [378] [In-Place Instruction Following in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07160)
*Zheng Nie,Zherui Li,Jiaming Zhang,Kun Wang,Zhenhong Zhou,Yufei Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）的位置原位提示（IPP）能力，形式化定义了原位指令跟随（IIF）任务并构建分层基准IIF-Bench，提出面向IPP的后训练框架GRAFT（结合约束感知SFT与偏好优化），在四个dLLMs上将平均IIF分数从57.75提升至73.10（+15.35），同时保持通用生成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型通过双向迭代去噪生成文本，天然支持在任意输出位置锚定用户指定约束（原位提示/IPP），但现有研究缺乏对该能力的系统形式化定义、评测基准与针对性优化方法，导致该重要范式未被充分挖掘和提升。

Method: 1) 形式化定义原位指令跟随（IIF）任务；2) 构建IIF-Bench分层基准，涵盖字面、风格、话语功能三类约束，并配套基于rubric的局部-全局评估协议；3) 通过推理时注意力偏置探针揭示dLLMs在去噪时常忽略约束跨度；4) 提出GRAFT框架，结合约束感知的监督微调（SFT）与偏好优化进行后训练。

Result: 在四个代表性dLLMs上，GRAFT将平均IIF分数从57.75提升至73.10（+15.35分）；在字面约束和话语功能约束上分别获得15.91和15.57分的绝对提升，同时不损害通用生成能力。

Conclusion: 实证表明面向IPP的专门后训练（GRAFT）能有效缓解dLLMs对约束跨度注意力不足的问题，显著增强其原位指令跟随能力，为扩散式文本生成的约束可控性提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) generate text via bidirectional iterative denoising, naturally supporting user-specified constraints anchored at arbitrary output positions, a paradigm known as In-place Prompting (IPP). We formalize this as the In-place Instruction Following (IIF) task and construct IIF-Bench, a hierarchical benchmark spanning literal, style, and discourse-function constraints, paired with a rubric-based local-global evaluation protocol. An inference-time attention-bias probe suggests that vanilla dLLMs often under-prioritize constraint spans during denoising. We then propose GRAFT, an IPP-oriented post-training framework combining constraint-aware SFT and preference optimization. On four representative dLLMs, GRAFT raises the average IIF score from 57.75 to 73.10 (+15.35 points), with absolute gains of 15.91 and 15.57 points on literal and discourse-function constraints, while preserving general generation ability.

</details>


### [379] [CircuitLens: Reasoning Circuits as Data Selection Signals for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07183)
*Zhuofan Chen,Ziqian Jiao,Yikai Cui,Zhixin Cai,Jun Bai,Wenge Rong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出电路推理分数（CRS），一种基于冻结基础模型中46个推理敏感注意力头的对比消融分析的单一前向传播选择信号，用于无需奖励标签或回滚的RLVR训练数据选择。实验发现低注意力头参与度的十分位数据比高参与度的数据在基准上表现更好，且数据选择效果具有明显的边界条件和规模依赖性，说明RLVR数据选择是情境相关的而非固定的问题质量排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的RLVR数据选择标准（难度过滤、手工筛选、奖励轨迹评分）都将数据价值视为问题的内在属性，与将要学习该数据的模型无关。然而RLVR对训练数据的选择极其敏感，且现有方法忽略了数据与特定模型的动态交互关系。作者希望通过挖掘模型内部推理电路的活动模式，建立一种与特定模型架构相关联的数据选择信号。

Method: 通过对比消融（contrastive ablation）识别出46个对推理敏感的注意力头，在冻结基础模型上以单一前向传播计算CRS分数，无需奖励标签或rollouts。该方法基于更强的推理电路参与度能产生更好训练数据的直觉假设，将数据按CRS分数分位并评估不同分位数据的训练效果。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，最低CRS参与度十分位的数据在三个中等难度基准上优于随机选择（GSM8K +2.0pp、OlympiadBench +1.6pp、Minerva +2.9pp），而最高参与度十分位的改进更小且与中间分位无显著差异。边界条件：在领域筛选的数据池上无方法能区分彼此；在1.5B规模时有用方向相反；最低奖励训练条件反而产生最强下游泛化。

Conclusion: 该研究推翻了对"更强推理电路参与度产生更好训练数据"的直观假设，表明RLVR数据选择的效果依赖于具体训练情境（模型规模、数据池构成、奖励条件），不能简化为对问题质量的静态排序。CRS证明了数据价值是一个与模型和训练环境深度耦合的相对属性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is sensitive to which problems a model trains on, yet existing selection criteria--difficulty filtering, hand-curation, reward-trajectory scoring--assess data value as an intrinsic property of problems, independent of the model that will learn from them. We introduce Circuit Reasoning Score (CRS), a selection signal derived from 46 reasoning-sensitive attention heads identified via contrastive ablation, computed in a single forward pass on the frozen base model without reward labels or rollouts. CRS runs against the intuitive hypothesis that stronger reasoning-circuit engagement produces better training data: on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, the lowest-engagement decile improves over random selection on three medium-difficulty benchmarks (GSM8K +2.0 pp, OlympiadBench +1.6 pp, Minerva +2.9 pp), while the highest-engagement decile gains less and is indistinguishable from the middle decile. The advantage has boundary conditions: on a domain-curated pool no selection method separates from the others; at 1.5B scale the useful direction differs; and the lowest-reward training condition produces the strongest downstream generalization. Within the Qwen2.5-Math settings tested, RLVR data selection appears regime-dependent rather than reducible to a static ranking of problem quality.

</details>


### [380] [SIFTING: A Novel LLM-Based Framework for Structured and Transparent Information Extraction from Clinical Free-Text Reports, with Application to Tumor Staging in Lung Cancer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07185)
