### [652] [Structured Extrema Errors in Classical Surrogates for Viscous Burgers: A Physics-Consistent Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07952)
*Youssef Oubari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了四种经典机器学习代理模型（KRR、Ridge、ExtraTrees、Random Forests）逼近一维粘性Burgers方程时间演化时的局部误差。所有模型在预测极值附近均产生清晰的曲线分支误差，其中KRR误差与二阶空间导数（局部曲率）密切相关。误差分析表明KRR和Ridge存在粘性平滑不足的问题，而基于预测量的校正可同时降低一步误差和递归滚动误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解机器学习代理模型在逼近偏微分方程（特别是Burgers方程）时间演化时的系统误差结构，揭示误差背后的物理根源（如粘性扩散不充分），从而为改进代理模型的预测精度和递归稳定性提供理论依据。

Method: 直接在空间网格值上比较四种回归模型（RBF核KRR、线性Ridge、ExtraTrees、随机森林）；定义一步残差；分析残差与一阶/二阶空间导数的相关性；提出基于局部曲率的残差模型解释极值附近的二分支折叠结构；通过回归测试、空间对齐对照和谱测试检验粘性平滑是否充分；提出仅使用预测量的校正方法。

Result: 四种模型在极值附近均呈现明显的曲线分支误差；KRR误差与二阶空间导数关系远强于一阶导数；KRR和Ridge的粘性平滑不足假设通过多重测试得到一致支持（递归测试、空间对照、谱测试），但对树模型该物理解释较弱；基于预测量的校正同时改善了一步误差和递归滚动误差。

Conclusion: 代理模型的系统误差可以从物理项（Burgers方程的粘性扩散/对流项）角度加以解释和量化；曲率驱动的残差模型能够刻画误差几何结构；仅依赖预测量的校正策略可有效改善模型在递归预测中的性能，且该分析框架对不同机器学习模型具有可迁移性。

Abstract: We study the local errors of classical machine-learning surrogate models, which approximate the time evolution of the one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation. Four models are compared on the same prediction task, using the spatial grid values directly: radial basis function (RBF) kernel ridge regression (KRR), linear Ridge, ExtraTrees, and Random Forests. Across all four models, the one-step residual, defined here as the true value minus the predicted value at each grid point, forms clear curved branches near predicted maxima and minima. A more detailed analysis of KRR shows that these errors are much more strongly related to the second spatial derivative, which measures local curvature, than to the first spatial derivative. Near a smooth extremum, predicted value and curvature form a local two-branch fold. Under our local curvature-based model of the residual, this fold predicts a leading-order near-parabolic relation between predicted value and residual. This geometric result motivates a direct test of the Burgers advection (transport) and diffusion (smoothing) terms. For KRR and Ridge, regression tests on held-out trajectories, a control that breaks the spatial alignment of the diffusion term, and a spectral test of high-frequency content are consistent with insufficient viscous smoothing at moderate and high viscosity. In this case, the surrogate retains more small-scale structure than the true future state. The same physical explanation is much weaker for the tree models. Finally, a correction that uses only predicted quantities reduces both one-step error and error during recursive rollout, where each prediction is used as the next input.

</details>


### [653] [Streaming Hierarchical Inference with Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07956)
*Vitor Crista,Afonso Lourenço,Diogo Martinho,Goreti Marreiros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HINT框架，一种结合边缘检索与云端表格基础模型推理的分层推理方案，通过图基近似最近邻滑动窗口内存实现本地预测与不确定性估计，仅在必要时将不确定样本及其上下文卸载至云端TFM，在预测性能与通信成本间取得平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFMs）虽在上下文学习中表现出强大预测能力，但其在高吞吐量数据流中的部署面临通信开销和延迟挑战，现有方法难以兼顾预测性能与资源效率。

Method: 构建HINT分层推理框架：边缘端维护基于滑动窗口的图基近似最近邻内存，提供本地预测与不确定性估计；置信样本在本地处理，不确定样本连同检索到的上下文被选择性卸载至云端TFM推理；通过可调的卸载阈值和邻域检索策略平衡性能与通信成本。

Result: 实验表明HINT能够一贯地识别出有利的权衡点，即在预测性能与通信开销之间取得良好折中。

Conclusion: HINT验证了边缘-云分层推理范式对表格基础模型部署的有效性，通过不确定性驱动的选择性卸载策略，为TFMs在高吞吐量数据流场景中的实际应用提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) have recently demonstrated strong predictive performance through in-context learning, but their deployment in high-throughput data streams remains challenging due to communication overhead and latency. We propose \textit{HINT}, a hierarchical inference framework that combines edge-based retrieval with cloud-based TFM inference. A graph-based approximate nearest neighbor memory maintained over a sliding window provides local predictions and uncertainty estimates, allowing confident samples to be processed locally while uncertain instances are selectively offloaded, together with their retrieved context, to a cloud-hosted TFM. The framework exposes an offloading threshold and a neighborhood retrieval policy that can be varied to balance predictive performance and communication cost. Experiments show \textit{HINT} consistently identifies favorable trade-offs.

</details>


### [654] [$α$-Graph: Attention-Infused Normalizing Flow Approach to Tractable Graph Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07961)
*Thanh-Dat Truong,Sarah Alharbi,Susan Gauch,Xinghui Zhao,Marios Savvides,Khoa Luu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于注意力机制和归一化流的图建模方法（ANFA/α-Graph），通过可逆注意力机制和可学习查询的条件图归一化流，实现显式、可解释且易于处理的图结构建模，在三个基准数据集上取得了最先进的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的图建模方法依赖传统图神经网络和预训练方法隐式地学习图数据的潜在关系结构，无法捕捉复杂的图结构和输入间的相关性。

Method: 1) 提出无条件图归一化流（Unconditional Graph Normalizing Flow），结合可逆注意力机制来捕捉图数据的复杂关系结构；2) 引入带可学习查询的条件图归一化流（Conditional Graph Normalizing Flow with Learnable Queries），增强模型的表达能力并高效建模图结构数据中的相关性；3) 条件图归一化流在行为上与无条件变体相似，在增强表达能力的同时保持训练稳定性和效率。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的α-Graph方法具有有效性和最先进的（SoTA）性能。

Conclusion: α-Graph提供了一种显式、可解释且易于处理的图建模新范式，克服了传统方法隐式学习的局限，为图结构化数据的建模提供了更强大的方案。

Abstract: Graph modeling, a crucial task for representing complex relationships in graph-structured data, has achieved significant success in recent years. However, current graph modeling methods rely on traditional Graph Neural Networks and pre-training approaches to implicitly learn the underlying relational structure of graph data. Thus, these prior methods cannot capture the complex graph structure and correlations among inputs. In this paper, we introduce a novel Attention-based Normalizing Flow-based Approach\footnote{Our implementation and models will be released publicly for research reproducibility.} (ANFA or $α$) that provides an explicit, interpretable, and tractable Graph Modeling ($α$-Graph). In particular, we propose a new Unconditional Graph Normalizing Flow with an Invertible Attention Mechanism to capture the complex relational structure of graph data. To further enhance the expressiveness of the model, we introduce Conditional Graph Normalizing Flow with Learnable Queries that enables efficient modeling of correlations in graph-structured data. We show that our Conditional Graph Normalizing Flows behave similarly to Unconditional Graph Normalizing Flows, enhancing expressiveness while maintaining training stability and efficiency. Our experimental results on three benchmarks will illustrate the effectiveness and the state-of-the-art (SoTA) performance of the proposed $α$-Graph method.

</details>


### [655] [MetaKV: Adaptive KV Cache Compression for Constrained LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07966)
*Michael Wang,Keith Li,Roozbeh Bostandoost*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MetaKV 是一个自适应框架，根据每个输入提示词及用户指定的延迟和峰值内存预算，动态选择最优的 KV 缓存压缩配置，以在满足资源约束的同时保持推理准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 KV 缓存压缩方法在准确性、推理延迟和峰值内存利用之间各有不同的权衡，单一固定配置无法适用于不同的提示词和资源约束场景，需要一种自适应选择机制。

Method: MetaKV 使用轻量级预测模型来估计每个候选配置的端到端延迟、峰值内存和正确响应概率，然后选择最能满足延迟-内存约束同时保持准确率的配置。

Result: 在数学、科学、常识推理和阅读理解四个数据集上，评估了三种代表性压缩方法（KVQuant、H2O、RocketKV）的十种配置及未压缩的FP16配置。与最佳静态配置相比，MetaKV 在多种延迟和内存约束下将约束成功率（CSR）平均提高约 0.07，最高提高 0.135。

Conclusion: 结果表明，根据单个提示词和延迟-内存约束自适应调整 KV 缓存压缩配置能够带来显著的性能提升，验证了自适应压缩框架的有效性。

Abstract: Key--value (KV) cache compression is an effective way to reduce the memory overhead of large language model (LLM) inference, particularly for long-context workloads. However, existing compression methods make different trade-offs among accuracy, inference latency, and peak KV cache memory utilization, making a single fixed configuration unsuitable across different prompts and resource constraints. We introduce MetaKV, an adaptive framework that selects a KV cache compression configuration for each input prompt based on user-specified latency and peak memory budgets. MetaKV uses lightweight prediction models to estimate the end-to-end latency, peak memory, and probability of a correct response for each candidate configuration, and selects the configuration that best satisfies the latency-memory constraints while preserving accuracy. We evaluate MetaKV across ten configurations from three representative KV cache compression methods, KVQuant, H$_2$O, and RocketKV, together with an uncompressed FP16 configuration, on four datasets covering mathematics, science, commonsense reasoning, and reading comprehension. Across a wide range of latency and peak memory constraints, MetaKV consistently outperforms the best static configuration, improving constrained success rate (CSR), the fraction of prompts answered correctly while satisfying both constraints, by approximately 0.07 on average and up to 0.135. These results demonstrate the benefit of adapting KV cache compression to individual prompts and latency-memory constraints. Code is available at https://github.com/MichaelWang0505/MetaKV.git

</details>


### [656] [Heat Field Signatures: From Point Clouds to Smooth Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07975)
*Yuanqing Wang,Yapeng Tian,Baris Coskunuzer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HFS通过将点云提升为多尺度光滑环境热场，直接从成对距离计算闭式全局和局部签名，捕捉热浓度、内在维度、各向异性和尺度转变，并引入Heat Dimension Spectrum (HDS)作为多尺度几何组成的紧凑摘要。在亚细胞、神经元、树和蛋白质数据上优于强基线，在SCOP蛋白质折叠分类中比最强深度基线提升近24个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不规则点云的多尺度几何分析仍然困难，诸如局部维度、各向异性、密度变化和几何转变等量通常需要通过显式的邻域、流形或图构造来估计，或让神经网络从坐标中推断。缺乏直接从离散样本到几何分析的直接接口。

Method: HFS将点云提升为多尺度光滑环境热场族，从成对距离直接计算闭式全局和局部签名。引入Heat Dimension Spectrum (HDS)。HFS可作为闭式描述符、轻量学习表示或神经点云模型的特征通道。

Result: 在跨亚细胞、神经元、树和蛋白质数据的合成及真实基准上，HFS优于强点云和多参数持久性基线，同时大幅降低端到端成本。在SCOP蛋白质折叠分类上，仅用坐标就比最强深度基线提升近24个百分点，且独立HFS表示严格旋转不变。

Conclusion: HFS将经典热场转化为现代点云学习中多尺度几何分析的实用接口，提供了一种闭式计算、旋转不变且高效的多尺度几何描述方法。

Abstract: Bringing multiscale geometric analysis directly to irregular point clouds remains difficult: quantities such as local dimension, anisotropy, density variation, and geometric transitions are typically estimated through explicit neighborhood, manifold, or graph constructions, or left for neural networks to infer from coordinates. We introduce Heat Field Signatures (HFS), which lift a point cloud to a multiscale family of smooth ambient heat fields, providing a direct interface from discrete samples to geometric analysis.
  From this field, HFS computes closed-form global and local signatures directly from pairwise distances, capturing heat concentration, intrinsic dimension, anisotropy, and scale transitions. We further introduce the Heat Dimension Spectrum (HDS), a compact summary of multiscale geometric composition. HFS can be used as a closed-form descriptor, a lightweight learned representation, or a geometric feature channel for neural point-cloud models.
  Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks spanning subcellular, neuronal, tree, and protein data, HFS outperforms strong point-cloud and multiparameter-persistence baselines while substantially reducing end-to-end cost. On SCOP protein-fold classification, HFS improves over the strongest deep baseline by nearly $24$ percentage points using coordinates alone, while standalone HFS representations are exactly rotation-invariant by construction. More broadly, HFS turns a classical heat field into a practical interface for multiscale geometric analysis in modern point-cloud learning.

</details>


### [657] [Semi-Supervised Learning under Spatially Biased Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07982)
*Bright Wiredu Nuakoh,Francky Fouedjio,Stephen Bradshaw,Yaw Kwaafo Awuah-Mensah,Wei Hong Tan,Emet Arya,Ebenezer Afrifa-Yamoah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了半监督学习（SSL）在空间有偏采样场景下的失效机制。通过合成框架和多个真实空间数据集（PovertyMap-WILDS、加州房产、社会经济、美国空气质量监测），研究者区分了三种独立机制——边缘分布失配、空间自相关和空间非平稳性，并发现SSL性能并非渐进下降而是存在阈值式崩溃（约0.71-0.77），同时模型在标签不可用区域会过度自信。论文还提出了核加权局部散度指标来更稳定地诊断空间失配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准半监督学习假设标注和无标注数据共享共同的边缘分布，但在空间有偏采样（如偏好选址）下这一假设常被违反。作者旨在量化这种失配如何损害SSL表现、聚类和流形假设是否仍然成立，以及如何诊断这种失效，从而为实际部署中纳入无标签空间数据提供风险评估工具。

Method: 首先构建受控合成框架，通过三个独立参数分别调节标签采样集中度（边缘失配）、空间长度尺度（自相关）和非平稳强度。在此基础上结合PovertyMap-WILDS、加州住房、社会经济和美国空气质量等多组真实数据集，系统变化失配程度。分析手段包括分段回归变点检测、分布散度度量评估以及提出的核加权局部散度指标。

Result: 1) SSL性能在失配严重程度达到约0.71-0.77区间时出现阈值式而非渐进的崩溃；2) 空间非平稳性独立于边缘失配对性能造成损失；3) 模型在标签稀缺区域会变得过度自信；4) 提出的核加权局部散度指标比朴素局部方法能更稳定地估计空间失配。

Conclusion: 研究为空间有偏采样条件下SSL的可靠性提供了经验证据和诊断工具，揭示了性能崩溃的非线性特征和过度自信问题，建议实践者在将未标注空间数据纳入SSL工作流时应系统评估和诊断空间失配风险。

Abstract: Standard semi-supervised learning (SSL) typically relies on labelled and unlabelled data sharing a common marginal distribution. This assumption is often violated by biased spatial sampling mechanism, when labels are collected under spatially biased or preferential site selection. We treat this marginal mismatch, spatial autocorrelation, and spatial non-stationarity as three distinct mechanisms, varied independently via a labelled-sampling concentration parameter, a spatial length scale, and a non-stationarity strength parameter, and ask how mismatch degrades SSL, whether the cluster and manifold assumptions survive it, and how the resulting failure can be diagnosed. Using a controlled synthetic framework alongside PovertyMap-WILDS, California housing, socio-economic and US air quality monitoring datasets, we systematically vary the degree of mismatch while accounting for spatial autocorrelation and non-stationarity. Through a series of analyses including a segmented-regression changepoint, we show that in the synthetic generator, SSL performance does not degrade gradually but instead exhibits a threshold-like breakdown between approximately 0.71 and 0.77 once distribution mismatch becomes sufficiently severe. We further demonstrate that spatial non-stationarity contributes to performance loss independently of marginal mismatch and that models become increasingly overconfident outside the regions where labels are available. To support practical deployment, we evaluate several distribution-divergence measures as indicators of reliability and introduce a kernel-weighted local divergence metric that provides a more stable estimate of spatial mismatch than a naïve localised approach. These findings provide empirical evidence and diagnostic tools for better documenting the risk of incorporating unlabelled spatial data into semi-supervised learning workflows.

</details>


### [658] [Solving the Elastic Wave Equation with Physics-Informed Neural Networks: A Robust and Critical Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07983)
*Davide Staub,Ben Moseley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对PINNs在地震学中求解弹性波方程的能力进行了全面且批判性的评估，发现将波动物理知识嵌入网络架构（如自定义小波/平面波层）能显著提升精度，将相对L2误差降低约一半，并成功实现了对震源位置的条件化处理，为快速地震灾害检测铺平了道路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管PINN在求解偏微分方程方面展现出前景，但存在谱偏差和不稳定收敛等问题，且在地震学领域尚未被充分探索。因此需要对PINN求解地震学中弹性波方程的表现进行系统性、批判性的评估。

Method: 针对从恒定到高度非均匀的多种地震源和参数模型，系统测试了从无约束标准PINN到高度专门化架构的多种神经网络设计，并重点比较了嵌入物理原理（自定义小波层或平面波层结合编解码器）与常规架构的收敛性与精度差异。

Result: 实验表明，将波动物理知识整合进网络设计能显著提高精度，自定义小波/平面波层配合编解码器结构的一致相对L2误差约为标准PINN的一半；该架构在声波方程上也表现出普适性；此外成功实现了对震源位置的网络条件化。

Conclusion: 物理先验嵌入架构是提升PINN求解波方程精度的有效途径，条件化震源位置的PINN有望加速地震灾害检测与地震分析。

Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have recently emerged as a promising approach for solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), offering a meshfree alternative that integrates physical principles into the learning process. This presents a new paradigm compared to traditional discretization methods and purely data-driven machine learning techniques. While promising, PINNs are not a panacea; they inherit challenges such as spectral bias and unstable convergence. Moreover, their potential in seismology remains largely unexplored. In this work, we provide a robust and critical assessment of PINNs for solving the elastic wave equation in seismology. We investigate the performance of PINNs on problems with varying degrees of complexity across various seismic sources and parameter models, from constant to highly heterogeneous settings. A pivotal aspect of our work involves investigating whether embedding physical principles directly into the network architecture enhances convergence and accuracy. We test an extensive range of neural architecture designs, from unrestricted, uninformed PINNs to highly specialized ones. We find that integrating an understanding of wave physics into the network design significantly improves accuracy. For instance, introducing a custom wavelet or plane wave layer, coupled with encoder and decoder layers, consistently yields a relative $L_2$ error approximately half that of the standard PINN, as evidenced across numerous experiments. We further demonstrate that this novel architecture enhances accuracy when applied to the acoustic wave equation, underlying the versatility of our network. Another key contribution of our research is the successful conditioning of PINNs on seismic source locations. This signifies a considerable advancement towards rapid seismic hazard detection and seismic analysis.

</details>


### [659] [Automated Chest CT Protocol Selection via Large Language Model Derived Text Embeddings from Imaging Request Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07986)
*Zahra Hosseini,Mahan Pouromidi,Farzad Khalvati,Patrik Rogalla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLaMA-3.1-70B）特征嵌入与逻辑回归分类器结合的决策支持系统，用于从自由文本临床指征中自动推荐胸部CT扫描协议。在285,123例胸部CT请求中，系统达到79%的整体准确率和0.81的加权F1分数，与放射科医生表现相当且无显著差异（p=0.263），并在某些困难类别上表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前CT协议选择过程依赖人工操作，耗时且不一致。传统的机器学习方法（基于关键词或词袋模型）缺乏上下文理解能力，在稀有协议上的表现不佳。因此需要一种能够捕捉临床细微差别和措辞变化的自动决策支持系统。

Method: 采用回顾性研究设计，收集2017-2024年间285,123例胸部CT成像请求，按80/20划分训练与测试集。使用微调后的LLaMA-3.1-70B大语言模型对临床自由文本进行嵌入，将生成的特征输入逻辑回归分类器，预测18种CT协议标签。评估包括加权精确率、F1分数、准确率，并与放射科医生在300例独立专家共识病例上的表现进行对比。

Result: 系统在18种CT协议上达到加权精确率0.84、加权F1分数0.81、整体准确率79%。在300例专家共识病例上，LLM准确率为80%，放射科医生为83%，两者无显著差异（p=0.263）。熵分析显示LLM的协议使用更加均衡，表明变异性降低。在部分具有挑战性的类别上LLM表现超过放射科医生。

Conclusion: 基于LLM的推荐系统能够利用大规模自然文本语料的通用知识，准确地从自由文本成像请求中分配胸部CT协议，可作为需要语言理解输入的协议推荐工具的有效基础。

Abstract: Purpose: Accurate CT protocol selection is critical for diagnostic quality and patient safety, yet the current process is manual, time-consuming, and prone to inconsistencies. Prior Machine Learning methods using keywords or bag-of-words lack contextual understanding and perform poorly on rare protocols. We propose a decision support system using large language model (LLM) features to recommend protocols from free-text clinical indications, capturing clinical nuance and phrasing variation for more consistent, efficient selection.
  Methods: In this REB-approved retrospective study, 285,123 chest CT imaging requests from a large academic medical center (2017-2024) were split into training (228,099, 80%) and held-out test (57,024, 20%) sets. Each request included procedure names, clinical indication, HIS comments, and the selected protocol. Clinical text was embedded using a fine-tuned LLM, Meta's LLaMA-3.1-70B; these features input a logistic regression classifier predicting 18 protocol labels (e.g., PE, LDCT).
  Results: The pipeline achieved a weighted precision of 0.84, weighted F1-score of 0.81, and overall accuracy of 79% across 18 CT protocols. On 300 independent cases with expert consensus, the LLM reached an overall accuracy of 80% versus 83% for radiologists, with no significant difference (p = 0.263). Performance was comparable across most classes, with the LLM exceeding radiologists for some challenging categories, and entropy analyses indicated more balanced protocol use, suggesting reduced variability.
  Conclusion: An LLM-based recommendation system can leverage general knowledge from a large natural-text corpus to accurately assign chest CT protocols from free-text imaging requests, and may serve as a viable foundation for protocol recommendation tools where inputs require language understanding.

</details>


### [660] [HyCO: A Hybrid Neural Solver for Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07990)
*Yuheng Li,Di Yang,Haipeng Chen,Yanhai Xiong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HyCO，一种混合神经求解器，将顺序强化学习(RL)求解器与全局扩散模型(DM)求解器结合用于神经组合优化。RL求解器在早期构造阶段具有小边际遗憾但存在随步长复合误差超线性增长，DM求解器避免了步长复合但遗憾随剩余未解子空间维度线性或次线性增长。HyCO先用RL构造前缀，再自适应切换到条件DM完成剩余决策。作者建立了统一误差缩放理论框架，证明混合结构在显式误差缩放假设下获得严格低于任一骨干的期望遗憾，并存在唯一最优触发步，同时设计了基于策略熵和RL-DM分歧的轻量自适应触发器作为实际代理。实验表明HyCO在多样基准上优于两种骨干。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经组合优化中，顺序RL求解器和全局DM求解器分别存在互补的失败模式：RL面临horizon级复合误差（超线性遗憾增长），DM虽避免了该问题但其遗憾随剩余未解子空间维度增长。作者意图利用两者的互补性，通过混合推理获得更优的求解性能。

Method: 提出HyCO混合推理算法：先用RL求解器构造前缀解，然后自适应切换到条件DM完成剩余决策。方法包括：(1) 统一误差缩放理论框架，证明混合结构的期望遗憾严格低于任一单独骨干，并论证存在唯一最优触发步；(2) 设计轻量自适应触发机制，结合策略熵与RL-DM分歧作为轨迹级信号替代不可直接计算的期望遗憾级最优触发步。

Result: 在多个组合优化基准上的实验表明，HyCO相对两种骨干方法取得一致的性能提升，并验证了自适应触发机制的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过理论证明与实践验证，混合RL与DM求解器的推理范式能够互补各自的遗憾增长模式，取得优于单一骨干的性能，且自适应触发策略在实际轨迹上有效。

Abstract: Sequential reinforcement learning (RL) solvers and global diffusion model (DM) solvers for neural combinatorial optimization exhibit complementary failure modes under an optimization-regret view. The former enjoys small marginal regret in the early construction stage, but suffers from horizon-wise compounding errors with super-linear regret growth; the latter avoids horizon compounding but incurs linear or sublinear regret w.r.t. the dimension of the remaining unsolved subspace. We propose Hybrid Neural Solver for Combinatorial Optimization (HyCO), a hybrid inference algorithm that constructs a solution prefix with an RL solver and adaptively switches to a conditional DM to complete the remaining decisions. To characterize why such hybridization helps, when to trigger the handover, and how to realize it in practice, we first develop a unified error-scaling theoretical framework and prove that, under explicit error-scaling assumptions, i) the hybrid structure achieves strictly lower expected regret than either backbone alone, and ii) there exists a unique optimal trigger step that minimizes the hybrid regret. We then design a lightweight adaptive trigger that combines policy entropy and RL-DM disagreement to detect trajectory-level signals of the regime shift as a practical proxy, since the optimal trigger step is defined at the expected-regret level and is not directly computable on individual trajectories. Experimental results on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that HyCO achieves consistent improvements over both backbones and support the empirical effectiveness of adaptive triggering.

</details>


### [661] [Sharp Structure-Agnostic Minimax Risk for Partial Linear Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07997)
*Haichen Hu,David Simchi-Levi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文刻画了偏线性模型中当结果和治疗扰动由两个不同黑箱学习器估计时，系数估计的锐利结构无关极小极大风险，解决了Gu (2025)在双重机器学习中提出的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偏线性模型中的双重机器学习方法依赖两个黑箱学习器（一个估计结果扰动μ，一个估计治疗扰动π），但此前缺乏刻画这两个学习器各自逼近误差与随机误差如何共同影响目标系数估计风险的理论结果。这一开放问题由Gu (2025)提出，本文旨在解决。

Method: 本文通过每个扰动的逼近误差预算a_q和随机误差预算s_q（由局部Rademacher复杂度控制）来刻画学习器。核心新工具是面向一般双学习器问题的新型下界，通过构造四个有限混合检验实验，使用正交编码函数，将隐藏扰动分别置于两类学习器之外、仅治疗学习器之外、仅结果学习器之外、以及两类学习器之内，从而分别捕捉两个逼近误差的交互、两个不对称交互项以及联合估计难度。

Result: 得到极小极大均方误差的锐利率：E_n ≍ 1 ∧ {1/n + (a_μa_π + min{a_πs_μ+s_π², a_μs_π+s_μ²})²}，该结果与Gu (2026)的最新上界匹配。

Conclusion: 标准双重机器学习可能高估目标估计的内在难度；为学习器选择提供了目标特定的原则：逼近误差与随机复杂度必须在两个扰动学习器之间联合平衡，而非各自独立优化。

Abstract: We characterize the sharp structure-agnostic minimax risk for coefficient estimation in the partial linear model when the outcome and treatment nuisances are learned by two distinct black-box learners, which resolves the open problem in double machine learning posed by Gu (2025). For each nuisance \(q\in\{μ,π\}\), we characterize the available learner by an approximation-error budget \(a_q\) and a stochastic-error budget \(s_q\), with the latter controlled through localized Rademacher complexity. Writing \(\mathcal E_n\) for the minimax mean-squared error, we show that \[\mathcal E_n\asymp1\wedge\left\{\frac1n+\left(a_μa_π+\min\left\{a_πs_μ+s_π^2,\,a_μs_π+s_μ^2\right\}\right)^2\right\}.\] The main new ingredient is a novel lower bound for the general two-learner problem. Our proof constructs four finite-mixture testing experiments using orthogonal code functions. Across these experiments, the hidden perturbations are placed outside both learner classes, outside only the treatment learner class, outside only the outcome learner class, or inside both learner classes. These four configurations capture, respectively, the interaction between the two approximation errors, the two asymmetric interactions between one learner's approximation error and the other learner's learning error, and the joint estimation difficulty of learning both nuisances. Combining the four resulting lower bounds yields the displayed rate, which matches the latest upper bound in Gu (2026). Our result shows that standard double machine learning can overstate the intrinsic difficulty of target estimation and provides a target-specific principle for learner selection: approximation error and stochastic complexity must be jointly balanced across the two nuisance learners rather than optimized separately.

</details>


### [662] [Two-Scale Localized PCA-Net: Coarse-Global and Local-Residual Representations for Artifact-Reduced PDE Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08034)
*Mrigank Dhingra,Jordan Stout,Omer San*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Two-Scale Localized PCA-Net，将PDE解分解为粗尺度全局分量和局部残差校正，通过块平衡潜在目标耦合两种表示，并采用界面感知微调促进连续性，有效减少局部降维带来的块偏移和界面不匹配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 局部化降维可提升高维PDE算子学习可扩展性，但独立解码的局部块会引入块偏移、界面不匹配和伪高波数内容，需要一种能同时捕捉全局结构并减少局部伪影的表示方法。

Method: 将解分解为粗全局分量（紧凑全局PCA基）和局部残差校正（非重叠局部PCA基）；通过块平衡潜在目标耦合两种表示；可选界面感知微调通过重建损失和迹损失促进连续性。

Result: 在Poisson基准上，双尺度表示显著降低重建误差和可见块伪影，PCA拟合成本较重叠方法约减半；在异质Darcy流中，大幅降低界面误差和离散残差误差；消融研究表明主要改进来自双尺度输出表示，界面感知微调提供互补的连续性细化。

Conclusion: 将全局连贯结构从局部残差细节中分离，可为减少伪影的PDE算子学习提供高效表示方法。

Abstract: Localized dimensionality reduction improves the scalability of operator learning for high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs), but independently decoded local patches can introduce block offsets, interface mismatches, and spurious high-wavenumber content. We introduce Two-Scale Localized PCA-Net, which decomposes the solution into a coarse-global component and local residual corrections. A compact global PCA basis captures domain-scale structure, while nonoverlapping local PCA bases represent the remaining fine-scale residual. A block-balanced latent objective couples the two representations, and optional interface-aware fine-tuning further promotes continuity through reconstruction and trace losses. On Poisson benchmarks, the two-scale representation substantially reduces reconstruction error and visible block artifacts relative to plain and overlap-based localized PCA-Net while approximately halving PCA fitting cost relative to overlap. On heterogeneous Darcy flow, it strongly reduces interface and discrete-residual errors, with more modest reconstruction gains. Ablations show that the primary improvement arises from the two-scale output representation, while interface-aware fine-tuning provides complementary continuity refinement. Overall, separating globally coherent structure from localized residual detail provides an efficient representation for artifact-reduced PDE operator learning.

</details>


### [663] [Risk-Conditioned Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08064)
*Zixuan Liu,Fangzheng Wu,Brian Summa,Zizhan zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出风险条件化RLHF框架，训练单一策略并提供一个连续的风险控制接口，使用户在推理时无需重新训练或部署多个模型即可调节不同的风险厌恶程度，实验证明该策略能适应不同风险级别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在部署中可能出现罕见但严重的危害性生成，现有Risk-Averse RLHF通过优化CVaR来解决该问题，但只能针对固定的风险水平训练策略，无法在推理时调整风险厌恶程度，缺乏灵活性。

Method: 提出风险条件化RLHF框架，训练一个单一策略，该策略内置连续的风险控制接口（risk-conditioning），使模型能够在推理时根据不同用户需求动态调整风险厌恶程度。

Result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，单一的风险条件化策略能够在推理时适应不同的风险级别，实现灵活的风险感知LLM部署。

Conclusion: 该框架解决了固定风险水平训练的局限性，仅需一个模型即可实现多样化的风险控制需求，提升了LLM部署的灵活性和风险意识。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings where rare but severe harmful generations can have significant consequences. Existing Risk-Averse RLHF addresses this issue by optimizing Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), but it trains policies for fixed risk levels and therefore cannot adjust the desired degree of risk aversion at inference time. In this paper, we propose risk-conditioned RLHF, a framework that trains a single policy that provides a continuous risk-control interface, enabling users to select different degrees of risk aversion without retraining or deploying multiple risk-specific models. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that a single risk-conditioned policy can adapt to different risk levels at inference time, enabling more flexible and risk-aware LLM deployment.

</details>


### [664] [A Machine Learning Framework for Predicting Restaurant Food Waste to Support Sustainable Food Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08078)
*Md Mehedi Hasan Naeem,Md Ashraful Islam,Moumita Barua,Ishtiyak Ahmmad Araf,Md. Arefin Haque Mahir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个探索性机器学习框架，用于从运营和情境特征估算餐厅每日食物浪费量。基于整合需求记录、气象数据和时序事件指标构建了77,980条记录、27个特征的数据集，由于缺乏大规模实测数据，目标变量由运营合理假设推导。评估了四种回归模型，随机森林表现最佳（MAE 6.19 kg, R²=0.817），并公开了全部数据、代码和构建公式以确保可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 餐厅部门的食物浪费对环境的可持续性和经济效率构成重大挑战，但目前缺乏大规模、公开的食物浪费实测数据，迫切需要一种可从易于获取的运营与情境特征中估算食物浪费量的方法。

Method: 构建结构化数据集（整合餐厅需求记录、气象数据、时序事件指标），从运营合理性假设推导目标变量并公开构建公式；在考虑时间顺序的70-30训练测试划分基础上，采用5折时间序列交叉验证，评估线性回归、决策树、随机森林和梯度提升四种监督回归模型。

Result: 集成方法一致优于线性基线。随机森林在消除代数泄漏变量的真实特征子集上取得最佳性能：MAE 6.19 kg、RMSE 8.36 kg、R²=0.817。特征重要性分析识别出菜单多样性、运营面积和时序活动模式为主要预测驱动因素。

Conclusion: 该框架展示了从可获取的运营数据估算餐厅食物浪费的可行性，所有指标均明确限定在构建目标上而非实测验证。完整的公开资源支持复现，并为未来扩展到实测浪费数据的验证提供了基础。

Abstract: Food waste in the restaurant sector poses a substantial challenge to environmental sustainability and economic efficiency. This paper presents an exploratory machine learning framework for estimating daily restaurant food waste quantities from operational and contextual features. A structured dataset was constructed by integrating restaurant demand records, meteorological data and temporal event indicators, yielding 77,980 records across 27 features. Because large-scale ground-truth food waste measurements are not publicly available, the target variable was derived from operationally justified assumptions, with the complete construction formula and controlled stochastic variability disclosed for full reproducibility. Four supervised regression models, namely Linear Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest and Gradient Boosting, were evaluated under a chronological 70-30 train-test split that respects the temporal ordering of restaurant operations, augmented by 5-fold time-series cross-validation. All reported metrics are explicitly scoped to performance against the constructed target and do not imply validation against measured food waste. Ensemble methods consistently outperformed linear baselines. Random Forest attained an MAE of 6.19 kg, RMSE of 8.36 kg and $R^2$ of 0.817 on the realistic feature subset following systematic exclusion of algebraically leakage-prone variables. Feature importance analysis identified menu diversity, operational area and temporal activity patterns as the primary predictive drivers. The full dataset, target construction formula, codebase and experimental configurations are publicly released to support reproducibility and future extension to empirically measured waste data.

</details>


### [665] [Proactive Context-Forecasted Safety Constraints for Nonstationary Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08080)
*Tim Tomashevskiy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于上下文预测的前瞻性安全约束生成框架，用于非平稳强化学习环境中的安全保证。该框架从观测中推断潜在环境上下文，预测其未来演化，并据此构建适应预期条件的安全约束，使智能体能够主动规避危险区域而非事后反应。在驾驶环境的实验表明该方法能显著减少碰撞并保持任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习安全方法通常依赖于设计时定义的安全约束或在执行过程中被动更新约束，假设这些约束随时间保持有效。然而在非平稳环境中，环境上下文不断演变、驾驶布局发生变化，这些假设可能失效，导致智能体在风险发生前无法预见并规避危险。

Method: 提出一种基于上下文预测的前瞻性约束生成框架：(1) 从观测中推断潜在的隐式环境上下文；(2) 预测上下文的未来演化趋势；(3) 基于预测结果构建适应于预期条件的安全约束，使智能体能够前瞻性地避开不安全区域，而非在安全违规发生后被动反应。

Result: 在具有结构化上下文变化的驾驶环境中进行评估，包括非平稳强度扫描和额外的留出驾驶布局（高速公路、交叉路口、赛道等场景）。结果表明：前瞻性约束生成在已见和训练外非平稳强度下均大幅减少碰撞，且在不同留出布局下依然有效，同时保持可用的任务性能。

Conclusion: 基于上下文的约束生成是解决非平稳条件下安全强化学习的有前景方法，通过预测性生成安全约束，能够有效提升智能体在动态变化环境中的安全性，同时保持任务完成能力。

Abstract: Ensuring safety in reinforcement learning under nonstationarity requires anticipating changes in risk before they lead to unsafe behavior. Existing approaches typically rely on safety constraints defined at design time or updated reactively during execution, assuming that such constraints remain valid over time. However, in nonstationary environments with evolving contexts and changing driving layouts, these assumptions may fail.
  We propose a framework for proactive safety constraint generation based on context forecasting. The approach infers latent environmental context from observations, predicts its future evolution, and constructs safety constraints adapted to anticipated conditions. This enables the agent to proactively avoid unsafe regions instead of reacting only after safety violations occur.
  We evaluate the method in driving environments with structured context variation. The experiments include a sweep over nonstationarity intensities and additional held-out driving layouts, including highway, intersection, and racetrack scenarios. Results show that proactive constraint generation substantially reduces collisions under both seen and out-of-training nonstationarity intensities and generally remains effective across held-out driving layouts while maintaining usable task performance. These findings suggest that context-based constraint generation is a promising approach for safe reinforcement learning under nonstationarity.

</details>


### [666] [Learning Metamaterial Eigenmodes with Wavelet-Encoded Fourier Neural Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08102)
*Han Zhang,Alexander Ogren,Cynthia Rudin,Johann Guilleminot,L. Catherine Brinson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文展示了将傅里叶神经算子（FNO）与小波编码结合，能够学习和预测弹性波动方程在任意超材料几何中的多个本征模，相比有限元分析在消费级CPU上加速三个数量级，同时保持高保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经算子方法假设唯一的输入-输出映射，难以处理特征值问题中需要同时求解特征参数和多个有效特征模态的情况。

Method: 将傅里叶神经算子（FNO）与小波编码相结合来编码偏微分方程输入，利用小波编码与FNO双域（空间-频谱）结构的匹配性，实现连续值和二值几何上的确定性模态选择。

Result: - 单一模型可预测弹性波动方程的多个本征模（声波在任意超材料几何中的变形模态）；- 对连续值和二值几何均能实现确定性模态选择；- 相比有限元分析在消费级CPU上加速三个数量级，同时保持高保真度。

Conclusion: 这项工作为基于频谱神经算子的多模态偏微分方程求解器的输入编码设计提供了更广泛的设计启示，小波编码与FNO的结构匹配在特征值问题上展现出显著优势。

Abstract: Machine learning surrogates based on neural operators have shown broad applicability in solving forward PDE problems. However, eigenvalue problems, in which an eigenparameter and one of several valid eigenmodes must be simultaneously solved, remain difficult because standard operator learning formulations assume a unique input-output map. This work demonstrates that Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs), combined with wavelet-based encodings of PDE inputs, can learn and predict multiple eigenmodes of the elastic wave equation, corresponding to deformation modes of acoustic waves propagating through arbitrary metamaterial geometries. We provide a mechanistic explanation and experimental evidence for why wavelet encodings are well matched to the dual spatial-spectral structure of the FNO, enabling deterministic mode selection on both continuous-valued and binary-valued geometries within a single model, and for why prediction accuracy varies with geometric discontinuities. For metamaterial design, the resulting surrogate accelerates the simulation stage of the design cycle by three orders of magnitude relative to finite element analysis on a consumer-grade CPU, while preserving high fidelity. These results also carry broader implications for designing input encodings in other multi-mode PDE solvers based on spectral neural operators.

</details>


### [667] [Nyström Attention Matches Full Attention for Cross-Sectional Stock Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08106)
*Kunhan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统分解了MASTER模型中负责跨股票关系建模的inter-stock多头注意力模块（占42.5%参数和25%预测价值），发现其注意力近乎均匀（困惑度278/300），但均匀化会消除跨截面区分能力。谱分析揭示与均匀性的偏差是低秩的（有效秩~65，前10个模式捕获96.5%能量），解释了为何稀疏近似失败而Nyström低秩注意力（m=32）能在O(mN)复杂度下匹配完整O(N²)注意力。额外发现注意力与收益相似性负相关（rho=-0.614），图方法均退化，且在大规模（N~3500）情景下跨股票模块优势消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解MASTER模型中跨股票多头注意力模块的内部结构及其价值来源，解决"近似均匀的注意力为何仍具有判别力"这一悖论，同时探究其在大规模场景下的可扩展性与适用性边界。

Method: 通过系统化分解inter-stock注意力模块，结合困惑度测量注意力均匀性、谱分析（奇异值分解/SVD）分析偏离均匀性的低秩结构，并通过TOST等价性检验验证Nyström低秩近似与完整注意力的统计等价性（在N=300和N=800两个规模、多种子下验证），同时设计对照实验评估图方法、硬掩码等替代方案，并在N~3500规模下进行扩展性测试。

Result: （1）注意力近似均匀（困惑度278/300）但偏差呈低秩结构（有效秩~65，前10模式占96.5%能量）；（2）Nyström低秩注意力（m=32）在N=300（p=0.003）和N=800（p=0.034）均通过TOST等效性检验，实现O(mN) vs O(N²)的计算节省；（3）注意力与收益相似性负相关（rho=-0.614，控制行业/β/波动后仍为-0.627），表明模块在寻求互补性而非相关性；（4）图方法及硬掩码均退化，硬掩码甚至劣于完全移除模块；（5）N~3500时，所有跨股票模块均无法显著超越per-stock LSTM基线。

Conclusion: inter-stock注意力的价值在于其可压缩、动态、近全局的再分配机制，该机制高度适配低秩近似但抵抗稀疏化。其本质是在执行"互补性寻求"而非"相关性挖掘"。但该优势具有规模依赖性——在中等规模（N≤800）中显著，在N~3500的大规模场景中无法超越简单基线，提示跨截面建模收益的边界条件。

Abstract: MASTER's inter-stock multi-head attention -- the module responsible for modeling cross-sectional stock relationships -- accounts for 42.5% of model parameters and 25% of predictive value. We systematically decompose this module and uncover a surprising structure: the learned attention is near-uniform (perplexity 278/300), yet forcing exact uniformity eliminates all cross-sectional discrimination. Spectral analysis resolves this paradox: the deviation from uniformity is low-rank (effective rank ~65, top-10 modes capture 96.5% of energy), explaining why sparse approximations consistently fail while Nystrom low-rank attention (m=32 landmarks) matches full O(N^2) attention at O(mN) cost -- certified equivalent via TOST at both N=300 (5 seeds, Rank IC p=0.003) and N=800 (10 seeds, Rank IC p=0.034). Additional findings include: (i) attention anti-correlates with return similarity (Spearman rho = -0.614; on the industry-labeled subset, -0.645 unconditionally and -0.627 after controlling for industry, beta, and volatility), suggesting complementarity-seeking rather than correlation mining; (ii) all graph-based alternatives degrade performance, with hard masking worse than complete module removal; and (iii) at N ~ 3,500 with adapted architectures, no cross-stock module (GCN, Nystrom, or MASTER-style pipeline) significantly outperforms a per-stock LSTM baseline (n=4 seeds), indicating that the benefits observed at smaller scales do not trivially transfer. These results establish that the inter-stock attention's value resides in a compressible, dynamic, near-global redistribution that rewards low-rank approximation but resists sparsification.

</details>


### [668] [Sparse Data Augmentation for Optimization with Provable Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08133)
*Behrooz Tahmasebi,Melanie Weber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了非凸优化中数据增强的计算效率问题，提出用固定稀疏变换样本近似完全组增强目标，并证明梯度下降(GD)在该稀疏增强目标上仅需O((log|G|+log(1/δ))/ε²)次变换查询即可达到ε-稳定点，优于标准组随机梯度下降(group-SGD)的O(1/ε⁴)查询复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在几何机器学习中，数据增强通过平均变换数据上的经验损失来促进不变性，但完全增强目标需要访问变换群G中的每个元素，当G很大或只能通过采样访问时成本过高。因此需要研究是否能用优化前获取并复用的小型固定变换样本近似完全增强。

Method: 作者在适当正则性条件下，证明在稀疏增强目标上运行的梯度下降能够收敛到完全增强目标的ε-稳定点。证明技术建立随机组平均对完整组平均梯度场的均匀近似，利用组诱导算子的谱性质以及表示论工具，这些技术本身可能具有独立价值。

Result: 以至少1-δ的概率，稀疏增强目标上的GD只需O((log|G|+log(1/δ))/ε²)次组变换预言机查询即可返回完全增强目标的ε-稳定点。相比而言，标准的组随机梯度下降(group-SGD)每次迭代采样新变换，需要O(1/ε⁴)次查询。因此固定稀疏增强的GD在变换查询次数上同时优于完全增强上的GD和group-SGD。

Conclusion: 固定稀疏增强策略在变换查询效率上具有显著优势，为大规模几何机器学习中高效实现数据增强提供了理论保证。证明中采用的谱分析和表示论方法可能对其他相关问题有推广价值。

Abstract: In nonconvex optimization problems arising in geometric machine learning, data augmentation is commonly used to promote invariance by averaging empirical losses over transformations of the data. Computing the fully augmented objective, however, requires access to every element of the transformation group $G$, which may be prohibitively expensive when $G$ is large or accessible only through sampling. We study whether full augmentation can instead be approximated using a small, fixed sample of transformations acquired before optimization and reused thereafter. Under suitable regularity conditions, we show that, with probability at least $1-δ$, gradient descent (GD) on the resulting sparsely augmented objective returns an $\varepsilon$-stationary point of the fully augmented objective using $\mathcal{O}\bigl((\log |G|+\log(1/δ))/\varepsilon^2\bigr)$ group-transformation-oracle queries. By comparison, standard group stochastic gradient descent (group-SGD), which samples a fresh transformation at every iteration, uses $\mathcal{O}(1/\varepsilon^4)$ transformation queries. Therefore, gradient descent with fixed sparse augmentation requires fewer transformation queries than both GD applied to the fully augmented objective and group-SGD. Our proof techniques, which may be of independent interest, establish a uniform approximation of the full group-averaged gradient field by a random group average using spectral properties of group-induced operators and tools from representation theory.

</details>


### [669] [KBBQ: A Predictive Noise Law and the Limits of Spectrum Flattening in FP4 Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08135)
*Lexington Whalen,Yuki Ito,Ryo Sakamoto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了矩阵乘法中量化噪声的二阶理论，通过量化格式分配给每个元素的方差来刻画其特征。该理论统一了整数量化和浮点量化的噪声分析，并推导出闭式信噪比定律及最优上界。基于此分析，作者提出了KBBQ方法，在W4A4设置下超越现有最先进方法且无需额外部署计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有量化噪声理论大多局限于整数量化的一阶或特定格式分析，缺乏对浮点量化噪声的统一二阶理论框架，也无法精确刻画数据依赖性与函数保持变换下的理论极限。

Method: 论文首先建立量化噪声的二阶理论框架，用量化格式分配给每个元素的方差来表征噪声。通过常数方差刻画整数量化，用乘法性轮廓描述浮点舍入噪声，将数据依赖性约化为标量"参与因子κ"，从而得到闭式信噪比定律。进一步推导出闭式上界κ*，证明其不可被任何函数保持线性变换超越。基于此理论提出KBBQ方法，参数化变换接近该上界的程度。

Result: 在W4A4设置下，跨越四种基础模型和两种FP4格式，KBBQ在无需额外部署时计算的情况下超越了此前的最先进方法。

Conclusion: 该工作从理论上统一了整数与浮点量化的噪声分析框架，提供了可证明的最优上界，并据此设计了实用的高性能量化方法KBBQ，实现了理论与实践的双重突破。

Abstract: We develop a second-order theory of quantization noise in matrix multiplication in which the quantization format is characterized by the variance it assigns to each element. The constant variance profile of integer quantization recovers existing integer-noise theory, while the multiplicative profile of floating-point rounding reduces the data dependence to a scalar, the participation factor $κ$, yielding a closed-form signal-to-noise-ratio law. The resulting functional also admits a closed-form upper bound $κ^{*}$ that no function-preserving linear transform can exceed and that is attained by a recent state-of-the-art method. Building on this analysis, we introduce KBBQ (\textbf{K}appa-\textbf{B}raked \textbf{B}lockwise \textbf{Q}uantization), which parameterizes the extent to which a transform approaches this ceiling. At W4A4, across four base models and two FP4 formats, KBBQ outperforms the prior state of the art without additional deployment-time computation.

</details>


### [670] [GPU-Enabled Large-Scale Optimization Using Randomized Linear Algebra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08136)
*Pratik Rathore,Zachary Frangella,Parth Nobel,Xuning Hu,Madeleine Udell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了rlaopt，一个基于PyTorch的开源软件包，用于大规模优化和科学计算。它利用随机数值线性代数（RandNLA）技术，提供GPU加速的求解器，涵盖正定线性系统求解和带约束与正则化的凸经验风险最小化问题。rlaopt还提供建模语言，支持自动兼容性检查和问题分解，并支持通过迭代进行微分以用于超参数调优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管RandNLA算法已取得显著进展，但很少有实现能够将GPU加速与简单的优化问题描述接口结合起来，存在工具层面的空白。

Method: rlaopt提供基于RandNLA加速的多种GPU求解器，包括：加速共轭梯度的NystromPCG、加速算子分裂的NysADMM，以及加速随机梯度方法的SAPPHIRE。同时提供自然数学语法建模语言，自动检查求解器兼容性并完成问题分解，求解器还支持迭代过程的自动微分。

Result: 实验覆盖岭回归、有界多项逻辑回归和有界弹性网络，识别了随机预条件处理提升性能的场景，并展示了GPU执行带来的显著加速效果。

Conclusion: rlaopt填补了RandNLA算法在GPU加速与易用接口结合方面的空白，以Apache开源协议发布，代码已在GitHub和PyPI上公开可用。

Abstract: This paper introduces rlaopt, a PyTorch-based package for large-scale optimization and scientific computing using randomized numerical linear algebra (RandNLA). Despite substantial progress in RandNLA-based algorithms, few implementations combine GPU acceleration with a simple interface for specifying optimization problems. rlaopt addresses this gap by providing GPU-enabled solvers for positive-definite linear systems and convex empirical risk minimization with constraints and regularizers. These solvers use RandNLA to accelerate conjugate gradient (NystromPCG), operator splitting (NysADMM), and stochastic gradient methods (SAPPHIRE). Moreover, rlaopt includes a modeling language that lets users specify problems using natural mathematical syntax. rlaopt automatically checks compatibility with the selected solver and performs the required problem decomposition. The solvers also support differentiation through their iterations, enabling applications such as hyperparameter tuning. Experiments on ridge regression, bounded multinomial logistic regression, and bounded elastic net identify when randomized preconditioning improves performance and demonstrate substantial speedups from GPU execution. The package is open-source under an Apache license, with source code at https://github.com/udellgroup/rlaopt and version 0.1.0 available on PyPI.

</details>


### [671] [Topology-induced Operators Reveal Complementary Graph Representations without Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08152)
*Meng Qin,Jinqiang Cui,Hongwei Zheng,Weihua Li,Sen Pei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现，无需复杂的模型设计和梯度训练，仅通过将随机特征传播经过由随机游走和匿名游走诱导的隐式层次结构中，即可获得信息丰富的图嵌入。这两种无训练嵌入分别捕捉节点邻近性和结构角色，在多种任务上与经典及最新方法表现相当，且计算开销更低，结合使用还能进一步提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图表示学习领域过度关注设计越来越复杂的模型来将图拓扑转化为向量表示，但嵌入质量究竟取决于模型学习还是底层拓扑变换，这一问题尚不清晰。作者旨在探究在不依赖复杂模型和梯度训练的情况下，能否仅通过恰当的拓扑变换获得有效的图嵌入。

Method: 作者提出两种无训练的嵌入方法：(1) 将随机特征通过随机游走诱导的隐式层次结构进行传播，捕捉节点邻近性；(2) 将随机特征通过匿名游走诱导的隐式层次结构进行传播，捕捉节点结构角色。这两种方法均不需要梯度训练，计算开销低，且可组合使用。

Result: 两种无训练嵌入在节点级、边级和图级任务上与经典及最新方法（包括需训练的模型）表现相当，且计算量大幅降低，实现了良好的质量-效率权衡。将两种嵌入类型结合使用，在部分任务上可进一步提升推断质量。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，信息丰富的图嵌入可以来源于精心选择的拓扑变换，而非必须依赖复杂的学习过程。这挑战了图表示学习中对模型复杂性的一味追求，提示拓扑变换本身可能是嵌入质量的关键驱动因素。

Abstract: Graph representation learning has largely focused on designing increasingly sophisticated models to transform graph topology into vector representations, or embeddings. However, the extent to which embedding quality depends on model learning, rather than on the underlying topological transformations, remains unclear. Here, we show that informative embeddings can be derived without complicated model design and gradient-based training. Propagating random features through implicit hierarchical structures induced by random walks and anonymous walks yields embeddings that capture node proximity and structural role, respectively. These two training-free embeddings preserve complementary aspects of graph organization and perform competitively with classic and recent methods across various node-, edge-, and graph-level tasks. They often require substantially less computation, resulting in a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off. Combining the two types of embeddings further improves inference quality of some tasks compared with using either embedding type alone. Our results suggest that informative graph embeddings can arise from carefully chosen topological transformations before any learning operation is applied.

</details>


### [672] [Geodesic-informed Generative Diffusion Model For Topology-preserved Image Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08153)
*Nian Wu,Nivetha Jayakumar,Jiarui Xing,Miaomiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出IGG框架，将拓扑保持的测地线动力学原理融入扩散生成模型，在测地线形变空间中学习并合成多样样本，而非传统的图像强度空间，从而确保生成过程中的几何与拓扑一致性，并使形变过程可解释、物理可感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前生成扩散模型存在两大局限：(1)主要依赖图像强度和纹理信息，忽视底层对象几何，无法保证生成过程中的几何/拓扑一致性，这在计算解剖学、生物学和机器人等高风险领域至关重要；(2)无法显式学习或表示生成过程中的形状变化，形变动力学隐藏在网络参数中，导致变换过程不可解释且缺乏物理依据。

Method: 提出IGG（Image Generation informed by Geodesic dynamics）框架，将拓扑保持的测地线原理整合到基于扩散的生成过程中。与传统在图像强度空间操作的方法不同，IGG在测地线形变空间中学习并合成多样样本，将几何对象变化学习为从给定模板/源图像出发的光滑且可逆的光滑映射。

Result: 论文提供了公开可用的代码（https://github.com/nellie689/IGG），以支持可复现性。具体实验结果显示该框架在保证几何/拓扑一致性和提供可解释形变方面优于传统方法（论文摘要中未给出详细定量结果）。

Conclusion: IGG通过将测地线形变动力学引入扩散生成框架，有效解决了现有生成模型忽视几何一致性和形变不可解释的两大核心问题，为需要严格结构保持的高风险领域提供了一种更可靠、更可解释的图像生成方案。

Abstract: Generative diffusion models have emerged as a class of powerful techniques for various imaging applications, including but not limited to synthesis, reconstruction, and segmentation. Despite their success, current generative models pose two key limitations. First, they primarily rely on image intensity and texture information, with limited attention to underlying object geometry. As a result, they do not guarantee geometric or topological consistency during the generation process, which is a crucial requirement for high-stakes domains such as computational anatomy, biology, and robotics, where preserving object structure is critical. Second, existing models fail to explicitly learn or represent shape changes in the generative process. Such deformation dynamics remain occluded within network parameters; hence leaving the transformation process uninterpretable and physically uninformed. To address these challenges, we introduce IGG (Image Generation informed by Geodesic dynamics), a novel framework that integrates topology-preserving geodesic principles into the diffusion-based generative process. In contrast to conventional methods that operate in image intensity space, IGG learns and synthesizes diverse samples within geodesic deformation spaces, where geometric object changes are learned as smooth and invertible smooth mappings from a given template/source image. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/nellie689/IGG.

</details>


### [673] [SIM: Subspace Interaction-based Method for Token-Level Text Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08200)
*Kehan Yan,Yue Tan,Qingfeng Chen,Shiyuan Li,Yu Zheng,Yixin Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于子空间交互的令牌级文本异常检测方法（SIM），通过将高维令牌嵌入解耦为多个低维子空间来放大局部异常信号，并设计硬伪异常生成模块和概率边界损失来应对预训练语言模型的过平滑效应，在多个基准数据集上验证了其有效性、效率和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 令牌级文本异常检测虽能提供细粒度的异常定位，但现有方法依赖全局距离计算，导致局部异常信号被大量冗余的正常特征维度稀释；同时，预训练语言模型会不可避免地平滑掉表面异常，从而限制了令牌级异常检测的效果。

Method: SIM方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于子空间交互的异常检测器，将高维令牌嵌入解耦为多个低维子空间，放大隐藏在特定维度中的局部异常信号；(2) 硬伪异常生成模块，构造模拟被语义平滑所掩盖的细微异常的伪异常令牌；(3) 概率边界损失，将异常分数标准化为统计距离，促使异常实例显著偏离正态分布中心。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了SIM的有效性，并展示了其显著的效率、鲁棒性和可解释性。

Conclusion: SIM通过子空间交互和伪异常生成有效地解决了令牌级异常检测中信号稀释和过平滑两大难题，为细粒度文本异常检测提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Token-level text anomaly detection, as an emerging trend of text anomaly detection, moves beyond coarse-grained document-level detection by localizing anomalous tokens within text. By providing fine-grained abnormality prediction, token-level text anomaly detection plays a critical role in various real-world applications, such as spam filtering and fake news detection. However, existing methods still rely on the global distance calculation for scoring, during which the local anomaly signals are severely diluted by numerous redundant normal feature dimensions. Moreover, pre-trained language models used in these methods inevitably smooth out surface anomalies, further limiting their effectiveness in token-level anomaly detection. To address these limitations, we propose a Subspace Interaction-based Method (SIM for short) for token-level text anomaly detection. To prevent local signal dilution, SIM adopts a subspace interaction-based anomaly detector, which decouples high-dimensional token embeddings into multiple low-dimensional ones, amplifying localized anomaly signals hidden within specific dimensions. To counteract the over-smoothing effect, we design a hard pseudo-anomaly generation module to construct pseudo-anomalous tokens, simulating the subtle anomalies obscured by semantic smoothing. Also, a probabilistic boundary loss is developed to standardize anomaly scores into statistical distances, effectively enforcing anomalous instances to deviate significantly from the normal distribution center. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets verify the effectiveness of SIM and demonstrate its remarkable efficiency, robustness, and interpretability. The source code is available at: https://github.com/yankehan/SIM-TAD.

</details>


### [674] [CUNO: Curriculum and Preference Optimization for Stable Graph Unlearning under Mass Deletion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08244)
*Chenhan Zhang,Ali Braytee,Madhushi Bandara,Xin Hao,Paul J. Kennedy,Massimo Piccardi,Raymond Owen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CUNO，一个基于课程学习的图遗忘框架，通过按遗忘难度渐进式移除数据并采用分布级NPO目标，有效缓解大规模删除下的灾难性遗忘问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图遗忘方法在大规模删除比例下模型效用急剧下降（灾难性遗忘）。其根本原因是对所有被删除样本进行统一处理，忽视了图学习中不同节点因结构依赖而扮演不同角色、遗忘难度各异的特点。

Method: 提出CUNO课程式图遗忘框架：（1）按估计的遗忘难度将遗忘集排序，在多个阶段渐进式移除数据；（2）每个课程阶段采用分布级负偏好优化（NPO）目标，将模型从其原始行为中引导开，同时保持保留集性能。理论上证明当遗忘集难度跨度大时（大规模删除的自然条件），课程设计收益最大。

Result: 实验表明CUNO持续缓解灾难性遗忘：在20%删除率下保留74%的原始效用（现有方法仅26-53%），即使在50%删除率下仍能保持超过一半的原始效用。

Conclusion: 通过考虑样本遗忘难度的差异并采用渐进式课程移除策略，可以有效解决图学习中大规模删除带来的灾难性遗忘问题。

Abstract: Graph unlearning removes the influence of designated training data from a trained graph model without retraining from scratch. However, existing methods suffer a sharp drop in model utility under large deletion ratios (mass deletion), a phenomenon we refer to as catastrophic unlearning. We find that a key cause is the uniform treatment of all deleted samples, which is particularly damaging in graph learning: structural dependencies cause different nodes to play vastly different roles in the learned model, yet existing methods apply the same forgetting operation to the entire forget set. Based on this insight, we propose CUNO, a curriculum-based graph unlearning framework that removes the forget set progressively, ordering samples by their estimated unlearning difficulty across multiple stages. CUNO further employs a distribution-level negative preference optimization (NPO) objective at each curriculum stage that steers the model away from its original behavior on the current forget subset while preserving retained performance. Our theoretical analysis shows that the curriculum design is most beneficial when the forget set spans a wide range of unlearning difficulty, a condition naturally satisfied under mass deletion. Comprehensive experiments confirm that CUNO consistently mitigates catastrophic unlearning: at 20% deletion, it retains 74% of the original utility compared to 26-53% for existing methods, and maintains more than half the original utility even at 50% deletion. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cuno-D4FF.

</details>


### [675] [Revisiting Spectral Representations in Generative Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08253)
*Yuehao Wang,Peihao Wang,Hanwen Jiang,Ziyi Yang,Qixing Huang,Zhangyang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过共享的扰动核视角，将自监督谱表示学习与扩散生成模型联系起来，提出了一种谱表示对齐方法作为正则项融入扩散训练目标，在图像和3D点云生成任务上显著提升了生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在多种生成任务上表现优异，近期研究发现对扩散网络隐藏状态的表示对齐既能加速训练收敛又能提升采样质量，但其背后的协同机制尚不清楚，缺乏理论层面理解。

Method: 1) 从扰动核的共享视角建立自监督谱表示学习与扩散生成模型的理论联系；2) 提出自监督谱表示对齐方法来辅助扩散模型训练；3) 从几何角度阐明联合谱学习对扩散训练的益处；4) 证明谱对齐目标的优化等价于表示空间中的扩散分数蒸馏；5) 将谱正则化项融入扩散训练目标函数。

Result: 在图像和3D点云等多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在生成质量上取得了一致且稳定的提升。

Conclusion: 谱正则化项能够有效改善扩散模型的生成质量，且其理论机制可通过表示空间中的分数蒸馏与几何视角得到合理解释，为扩散模型训练与自监督表示学习的融合提供了新思路。

Abstract: Diffusion models have shown remarkable performance on diverse generation tasks. Recent work finds that imposing representation alignment on the hidden states of diffusion networks can both facilitate training convergence and enhance sampling quality, yet the mechanism driving this synergy remains insufficiently understood. In this paper, we investigate the connection between self-supervised spectral representation learning and diffusion generative models through a shared perspective on perturbation kernels. On the diffusion side, samples (e.g., images, videos) are produced by reversing a stochastic noise-injection process specified by Gaussian kernels; on the spectral representation side, spectral embeddings emerge from contrasting positive and negative relations induced by random perturbation kernels. Motivated by this, we propose a self-supervised spectral representation alignment method to facilitate diffusion model training. In addition, we clarify how joint spectral learning can benefit diffusion training from a geometric perspective. Furthermore, we find that the optimization of the spectral alignment objective is in an equivalent form of diffusion score distillation in the representation space. Building on these findings, we integrate a spectral regularizer into diffusion training objectives to improve the performance of diffusion models on multiple datasets. Experiments across images and 3D point clouds show consistent gains in generation quality. Code is released at https://github.com/yuehaowang/spectral-reg-diffusion.

</details>


### [676] [Convergence issues in Relational Concept Analysis based on AOC-posets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00054)
*Xavier Dolques,Agnès Braud,Alain Gutierrez,Marianne Huchard,Florence Le Ber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了形式概念分析（FCA）的一种扩展——关系概念分析（RCA）在使用AOC-偏序集而非完整概念格时的收敛性问题。研究表明，在基于格的RCA中收敛有保证，但使用AOC-偏序集时该保证失效。作者分析了收敛性丧失的原因，识别了可以保证收敛的条件，讨论了如何通过数据转换恢复收敛，并提出了一种保证收敛的变体方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RCA作为一种处理多关系数据的FCA扩展，能产生比FCA更丰富的结果，但计算和解释复杂度更高。在实践中，AOC-偏序集因只保留引入对象或属性的概念而比完整概念格更小、更易计算和使用。然而，虽然RCA原本定义在概念格上可保证收敛，但当实例化到AOC-偏序集上时这种收敛保证会丧失。理解这一收敛性丧失问题对于AOC-偏序集在RCA中的实际应用至关重要。

Method: 论文从三个方面系统研究AOC-偏序集上RCA的收敛性问题：（1）展示一般情况下收敛不再保证的原因；（2）识别可以确保收敛的条件；（3）讨论如何通过数据集转换恢复收敛。此外，提出一种收敛的变体过程：创建的关系属性永不删除，以保留AOC-偏序集结构为代价，换取收敛保证——尽管代价是可能包含最终结构中不存在概念的属性。

Result: 论文揭示了AOC-偏序集上RCA在一般情况下收敛性丧失的原因，找到了可保证收敛的特定条件，提供了数据集转换以恢复收敛的方法，并提出了一种收敛的变体过程——通过永不移除已创建的关系属性来确保收敛。

Conclusion: 虽然AOC-偏序集比完整概念格更紧凑、更适合实际应用，但将其用于RCA会引入收敛性问题。论文通过理论分析和提供收敛变体方案，在保留AOC-偏序集优势的同时解决了收敛性这一关键障碍，为AOC-偏序集在RCA中的可靠应用铺平了道路。

Abstract: Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) is an approach for conceptual classification building and rule discovery from a binary table describing a set of objects by a set of attributes. Extensions have been proposed to deal with non-binary and more complex data, such as Relational Concept Analysis (RCA) for multi-relational data. RCA aims to highlight groups of objects characterized by their relationships with other groups of objects. The richer and more complex nature of the underlying data allows RCA to produce richer results than FCA, at the expense of higher computational and interpretive complexity. The most commonly used conceptual classification structure in FCA is the concept lattice. However, in many applications, concept lattice substructures, such as AOC-posets, are preferred over the full lattice, either to mitigate combinatorial blow-up or to focus on the most informative parts of the structure. Indeed, in an AOC-poset, only concepts introducing an object or an attribute are represented, which makes AOC-posets smaller and easier to compute and use than concept lattices. Although RCA was originally defined on concept lattices, it can also be instantiated on AOC-posets. RCA is iterative and its convergence is guaranteed in the lattice-based setting, but this guarantee is lost when using AOC-posets. In this paper, we investigate this loss of convergence in detail. We show why convergence is no longer guaranteed in the general case, identify conditions under which it can still be ensured, and discuss how a dataset can be transformed to recover convergence. We also propose a convergent variant of the process, which preserves the AOC-poset structure: relational attributes, once created, are never removed, which guarantees convergence at the price of attributes that may refer to concepts absent from the final structures.

</details>


### [677] [Synergistic Fusion of Topological Structure and Temporal Semantics of Mobility for Urban Region Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08268)
*Namwoo Kim,Jeeyun Chang,Kanghoon Lee,Yoonjin Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MoSS框架，从人类移动数据中派生两种互补视图（序列视图捕捉逐小时进出流量，结构视图基于zigzag持续同调捕捉区域连接随时间涌现、持续和消解的模式），并通过协同模块的多阶交互提取跨视图联合信号，仅用移动数据即超越依赖辅助模态的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有城市区域嵌入方法虽然融合了移动数据与辅助模态，但忽略了人类移动的时序动态性——区域间连接随时间不断涌现、持续和消解。此外，主流融合策略只是加性地组合视图，未能捕捉到视图共现时才会出现的联合信号。

Method: MoSS包含三个关键组件：(1) 序列视图——保留每个区域逐小时流入/流出剖面；(2) 结构视图——基于zigzag持续同调图捕捉区域连接随时间演进的生命周期；(3) 协同模块——通过多度交互从视图共现中提取涌现的高阶跨视图表示。

Result: 在纽约市和芝加哥的大量实验表明，MoSS在三个下游任务上均达到最先进性能，且仅使用移动数据就超越了依赖辅助模态（如POI、地理位置）的基线方法。

Conclusion: 该工作表明移动数据的时序动态性本身蕴含丰富信息，通过对时序流动模式和时变连接结构进行互补建模与高阶协同融合，可以在不依赖外部辅助数据的情况下实现更优的区域表征。

Abstract: Urban region embeddings have shown promising results in diverse urban sensing tasks such as crime, income, and service-call prediction. Recent methods improve representation quality by integrating mobility data with auxiliary modalities, using cross-view attention or contrastive objectives to align heterogeneous features into a unified region representation. However, leveraging the temporal dynamics of human mobility remains under-explored. Regional inflow and outflow fluctuate throughout the day, and inter-region connections emerge, persist, and dissolve over time. Moreover, prevailing fusion strategies combine views additively and miss the joint signal that emerges only when views co-occur. To address these gaps, we propose Mobility Stream-Structure Synergy (MoSS), which derives complementary views from mobility data: a Sequence view that preserves each region's hourly inflow/outflow profile, and a Structure view based on zigzag persistence diagrams that capture how regional connectivity emerges, persists, and dissolves over time. A synergy module then extracts emergent representations from the co-occurrence of these views through multi-degree interactions, explicitly capturing higher-order signal across views. Extensive experiments on New York City and Chicago show that MoSS achieves state-of-the-art performance across three downstream tasks using mobility data alone, outperforming baselines that rely on auxiliary modalities.

</details>


### [678] [Neural Symbollic Regression Using Deep Learning and Sparse Modelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01102)
*Ravi Kumar U,Sumitra S*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种神经符号回归（NSR）框架，将神经网络作为函数预处理器，通过解耦流程先学习平滑、抗噪声的目标函数近似，再利用LASSO提取稀疏可解释的闭式表达式，并结合Ray Tune和ASHA调度进行分布式超参数优化。实验表明该方法在Nguyen基准上优于SINDy和非调优神经基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号回归方法（如遗传编程）存在可扩展性差、对噪声敏感的问题，而稀疏回归方法（如SINDy）依赖预定义的特征库，两者均难以在实际科学发现中平衡可解释性、鲁棒性和可扩展性。

Method: 采用解耦流水线：首先用神经网络在交互感知的非线性特征空间中学习目标函数的光滑噪声鲁棒近似；随后应用LASSO提取稀疏闭式表达式；并通过Ray Tune和ASHA调度进行分布式超参数优化以提升预测精度和符号保真度。

Result: 在Nguyen基准套件上，该方法在RMSE、噪声鲁棒性和分布外泛化方面持续优于SINDy和非调优神经基线；消融实验验证了特征交互、神经深度和调优策略的重要性。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了可扩展且可理解的神经符号框架，在神经逼近与稀疏方程发现之间建立了坚实桥梁，适用于科学机器学习领域。

Abstract: Symbolic Regression (SR) seeks to find succinct mathematical expressions that represent the fundamental relationships within data, providing interpretability and scientific understanding that exceeds that of black-box models. Nevertheless, traditional methods like Genetic Programming face challenges with scalability and are highly sensitive to noise, while sparse regression techniques such as SINDy rely significantly on predetermined feature libraries. In this work, we present a Neural Symbolic Regression (NSR) framework that treats neural networks as functional preconditioners for symbolic discovery. Our approach uses a decoupled pipeline: a neural network first learns a smooth, noise-robust approximation of the target function in an interaction- aware nonlinear feature space. LASSO is then applied to extract sparse, interpretable closed-form expressions. To improve predictive accuracy and symbolic fidelity by integrating distributed hyperparameter optimization with Ray Tune and ASHA scheduling. Experiments on the Nguyen benchmark suite show that our approach consistently outperforms SINDy and non-tuned neural baselines in RMSE, noise robustness, and out-of-distribution generalization. Ablation studies confirm the significance of feature interactions, neural depth, and tuning strategies. In general, this study presents a scalable and understandable neural-symbolic framework, creating a solid link between neural approximation and the discovery of sparse equations for scientific machine learning.

</details>


### [679] [Online Signature Verification Using Augmented Path Signature and T-Mamba](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08276)
*Ruiling Li,Danyu Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将增强路径签名（APS）描述符与T-Mamba模型集成的新型框架用于在线手写签名验证（OSV）。APS描述符通过时间和基点增强并计算滑动窗口路径签名，有效捕获几何结构和非线性通道间交互；T-Mamba模型通过混合设计（两个TCN块+时间扫描Mamba）同时学习局部时间模式和全局长距离依赖。在MCYT-100、SVC-2004 Task 2和DeepSignDB三个公开基准上取得最先进EER结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线手写签名验证对商业和金融应用至关重要，但现有的深度学习方法难以捕获高度判别的特征以及建模长距离依赖关系。

Method: 1) 构建APS描述符：先进行时间和基点增强，再计算滑动窗口路径签名（基于粗糙路径理论的非参数特征映射）；2) 设计T-Mamba模型：结合两个TCN块与时间扫描Mamba的混合架构，用于同时学习局部时间模式和全局长距离依赖。

Result: 在MCYT-100、SVC-2004 Task 2和DeepSignDB三个公开基准数据集上取得最先进的等错误率（EER），尤其在训练数据有限的情况下展现出有效性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 集成APS描述符与T-Mamba的框架能有效提升在线签名验证精度，代码已公开，为后续研究提供了可复现的基线。

Abstract: Handwritten signature verification is vital for personal authentication across commercial and financial applications. Although deep learning methods are widely adopted for online signature verification (OSV), they often struggle with capturing highly discriminative features and modelling long-range dependencies. To address these issues, we propose a novel framework that integrates the augmented path signature (APS) descriptor with the T-Mamba model. The APS descriptor first applies time and basepoint augmentations, then computes sliding-window path signatures. The path signature is a non-parametric feature map from rough path theory that effectively captures geometric structures and nonlinear inter-channel interactions. Inspired by the efficacy of state space models (SSMs) in sequence modelling, our T-Mamba model employs a hybrid design combining two temporal convolutional network (TCN) blocks with a time-scanning Mamba. This design enables the model to learn both local temporal patterns and global long-range dependencies, substantially improving verification accuracy. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art EERs on three public benchmark datasets (MCYT-100, SVC-2004 Task 2, DeepSignDB), validating its effectiveness and robustness, especially when the training data is limited. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/DLRL04/OSV-using-APS-and-T-Mamba.

</details>


### [680] [TC-Next: Zero-Shot Multimodal Cyclone Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02085)
*Zhe Wang,Sijie Chen,Yiming Luo,Daehyun Kim,Chien-Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TropicalCycloneNext（TC-Next），一个多模态深度学习模型，通过结合基础模型（如GraphCast）的大气动力/热力预报场和GridSat红外卫星图像，在6-24小时前预报热带气旋路径和强度。该模型仅在西太平洋的GraphCast预报上训练，却能零样本泛化到Pangu-Weather、IFS HRES和WeatherNext Cyclones等不同模型的预报场上，显著优于传统的基于规则的追踪器TempestExtremes及专用追踪器。消融实验证明多模态融合能提升各前置时间的路径误差和较长前置时间的强度预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热带气旋的路径与强度预测对防灾减灾至关重要，传统基于规则的追踪器（如TempestExtremes）方法存在局限，而深度学习基础模型产生的天气预报场尚未被充分利用于气旋追踪任务。作者希望构建一个多模态模型，利用基础模型的大气变量预报和卫星图像这两种互补信息，实现更准确且可跨模型泛化的热带气旋预报。

Method: 提出TC-Next多模态深度学习模型：(1) 融合两类输入——基础模型输出的大气运动学与热力学变量预报场（仅使用通用大气变量）以及GridSat红外卫星图像；(2) 仅在GraphCast对西太平洋的预报数据上训练；(3) 通过编码后融合两种模态进行气旋路径与强度预测，无需修改即可应用于其他基础模型的输出。

Result: (1) 使用GraphCast预报时，相比TempestExtremes，路径误差降低15%-44%，强度误差降低3-6倍；(2) 无需重新训练，直接应用于Pangu-Weather和IFS HRES预报场，性能仍优于TempestExtremes；(3) 零样本应用于WeatherNext Cyclones的2025年西太平洋季预报场，各前置时间强度误差更低，路径误差更低或相当；(4) 消融实验表明多模态融合在全部前置时间改善路径误差，在较长前置时间改善强度预测。

Conclusion: TC-Next证明了气象基础模型的数值预报场与卫星图像的多模态融合能够构建高性能且具备跨模型泛化能力的热带气旋追踪模型，优于传统规则方法。其仅依赖通用大气变量和零样本迁移能力使其具备较强的实用价值与可移植性，可为热带气旋预报提供新的技术路线。

Abstract: We present TropicalCycloneNext (TC-Next), a multimodal deep learning model that forecasts tropical cyclone track and intensity at $6$-$24$ h leads by leveraging a foundation model's forecast fields of atmospheric kinematic and thermodynamic fields and GridSat infrared satellite imagery. Trained only on GraphCast forecasts over the Western Pacific (WP), yet reliant only on generic atmospheric variables, TC-Next on GraphCast lowers track error by $15$-$44\%$ and intensity error by a factor of $3$-$6$ relative to a conventional, rule-based tracker, TempestExtremes; applied without retraining to the forecast fields of Pangu-Weather and IFS HRES, it stays ahead of TempestExtremes on both. Applied zero-shot to the generic weather fields of WeatherNext Cyclones on the 2025 WP season, TC-Next attains lower intensity error at every lead time, and lower or comparable track error, compared to that model's specialized direct tracker in a deterministic comparison. Our ablation studies show that our multimodal model is able to utilize the additional modality to improve performance in tracking errors at every lead time and in intensity prediction at longer lead times.

</details>


### [681] [Adaptively Incorporating Directional Hints into Zeroth-Order Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08277)
*Alexander Ryabchenko,Jian Qian,Wenlong Mou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CV-ZOD框架，通过控制变量法改进零阶梯度估计器，利用便宜的"方向提示"（方向线索）来加速非凸函数的零阶优化。算法在收敛速率上可在传统一阶O(1/T)和零阶O(d/T)之间插值，且不依赖预先知道提示质量，在仿真科学优化任务上表现出持续进步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零阶优化（无梯度）在非凸函数上收敛较慢（O(d/T)），但许多场景下可以获得廉价但可能不准确的方向线索（如线性子空间近似梯度方向）。如何自适应地利用这些提示同时保持对提示质量的鲁棒性，是一个待解决的问题。

Method: 提出Control-Variate Zeroth-Order Descent (CV-ZOD)框架：用控制变量（control variate）精化传统零阶梯度估计器，其中控制变量可根据方向提示设置。作者先分析了理论上的"神谕算法"（每一步最优设置参考向量和步长）的收敛速率，证明其在O(1/T)（一阶率）和O(d/T)（零阶率）之间插值，取决于轨迹上提示的质量；随后设计实用变体，在无需事先知道提示质量的前提下达到相同的理论保证（仅差对数因子）。

Result: 理论分析证明CV-ZOD的收敛速率随提示质量在传统零阶与一阶优化之间平滑插值；实用算法在无需提示质量先验知识下达到神谕算法的保证（差距为对数因子）。在基于仿真的科学优化任务中，展示了在非凸地形上持续进步，而零阶下降较慢、已有引导方法在引导退化时停滞。

Conclusion: CV-ZOD框架能够自适应地利用方向提示加速零阶优化，同时保持对提示质量恶化的鲁棒性。这为非凸的仿真式科学优化问题（如缺乏梯度但有廉价启发式方向的场景）提供了有效的新求解途径。

Abstract: We study zeroth-order optimization of non-convex functions with the aid of directional hints, which are cheap but potentially inaccurate approximations of the true gradient direction, given by linear subspaces at each iteration. To leverage these hints adaptively while maintaining robustness to their quality, we introduce Control-Variate Zeroth-Order Descent (CV-ZOD), a new framework that refines the classical zeroth-order gradient estimator with a control variate that can be set based on the directional hints. We first show that the oracle algorithm that optimally sets the reference vector and step size at each iteration achieves a convergence rate that interpolates between the first-order $O(1/T)$ rate and the zeroth-order $O(d/T)$ rate, depending on the quality of the hints along the trajectory. We then develop a practical variant of CV-ZOD that achieves the same oracle guarantee up to logarithmic factors, without any prior knowledge of the hint quality. We validate the method empirically on simulation-based scientific optimization tasks, demonstrating sustained progress on non-convex landscapes where zeroth-order descent is slower and existing guided methods stall as guidance deteriorates.

</details>


### [682] [ProToMEx: Rapid, Interpretable Explanations via Structured Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04265)
*Athina Georgara,Adarsh Valoor,Sarvapali D. Ramchurn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ProToMEx，一种基于概率主题模型（PTM）的新型可解释性框架，通过学习潜在的"主题"来揭示分类器决策背后的高层次语义结构，而非仅仅依赖特征重要性。该框架模型无关，能同时提供全局和局部解释，实验表明其保真度与SHAP和LIME相当，但生成局部解释的计算成本降低了约30-40倍，适合实时应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的后处理方法（如SHAP、LIME）主要集中于特征归因，即给单个特征分配重要性分数，但难以表达驱动模型决策的复杂组合模式。作者希望超越简单的特征重要性，揭示模型决策背后的潜在语义结构，同时解决现有方法计算成本高昂、不适合实时应用的问题。

Method: 提出ProToMEx框架，利用概率主题模型（PTMs）学习潜在"主题"，这些主题代表分类的不同高层次原因。该方法具有模型无关性，能够自然生成两类解释：（1）全局解释——描述模型整体行为；（2）局部解释——解耦特定预测中多个共同存在的原因。

Result: 在标准表格数据集和合成数据集上的实验表明，ProToMEx产生的解释保真度与SHAP和LIME相当，但生成局部解释的摊销计算成本显著降低，比SHAP和LIME快约30-40倍。

Conclusion: ProToMEx提供了一种超越特征归因的可解释性新范式，在保持解释质量的同时大幅降低计算开销，使其非常适用于实时应用场景。该工作为可解释性研究开辟了基于主题建模的新方向。

Abstract: Existing post-hoc explainers for machine learning classifiers primarily focus on feature attribution, assigning importance scores to individual features. While valuable, this approach struggles to articulate the complex, combinatorial patterns that often drive a model's decision-making process. To overcome this limitation, we introduce ProToMEx, a new paradigm for explainability that leverages Probabilistic Topic Models (PTMs). Our model-agnostic framework learns latent ''topics'' that represent distinct, high-level reasons for a classification, moving beyond simple feature importance to reveal underlying semantic structures. ProToMEx naturally provides both global explanations of a model's overall behaviour and local explanations that can disentangle multiple co-existing reasons for a specific prediction. We demonstrate empirically that ProToMEx not only produces explanations of comparable fidelity to popular methods like SHAP and LIME but also drastically reduces the amortised computational cost of generating local explanations, making it highly suitable for real-time applications. Specifically, we show that ProToMEx is ~30-40x faster than SHAP and LIME over standardised tabular datasets and synthetic datasets.

</details>


### [683] [HypLTSF: A Hyperbolic Geometric View of Multi-Scale Hierarchies for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08286)
*Namwoo Kim,Hyungryul Baik,Yoonjin Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HypLTSF框架，将多尺度时间序列预测中的层级抽象结构显式地嵌入到庞加莱球（双曲空间）中，通过径向约束和角度约束来几何化层级关系，在长期时间序列预测基准上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多尺度建模是长期时间序列预测的有效方法，但现有方法虽然在各尺度间交换信息，却将尺度间的层级结构视为信息交互的副产物，而非将其作为独立的几何结构加以显式建模。作者认为这种层级抽象本身值得被赋予具体的几何形式。

Method: HypLTSF将各尺度的表示嵌入到庞加莱球中，利用双曲空间体积指数扩张的特性自然容纳层级结构。为对齐几何与时间层级，施加两个约束：(1) 径向约束——按嵌入的抽象层级对表征排序；(2) 角度约束——将共享同一粗尺度祖先的细尺度模式进行聚类分组。

Result: 在长期时间序列预测基准上的大量实验表明，HypLTSF取得了最先进的性能，证明将多尺度层级显式建模为几何结构对预测是有效的。

Conclusion: 显式地将多尺度时间层级建模为几何结构（而非仅作为信息交换的副产物）是提升长期时间序列预测效果的有效策略。

Abstract: Multi-scale modeling has become an effective approach for long-term time series forecasting, capturing temporal patterns that range from fine-grained local dynamics to coarse global trends. Representations across these temporal scales are inherently hierarchical, with coarser scales abstracting and aggregating information from finer ones. While existing approaches readily exchange information across these scales, the hierarchy itself is typically left as an emergent byproduct of such interactions rather than captured as a geometric structure in its own right. In this paper, we introduce HypLTSF, a framework that endows the multi-scale hierarchy with a concrete geometric form by embedding scale-wise representations into the Poincaré ball, whose exponentially expanding volume naturally accommodates hierarchical structures. To align this geometry with the temporal hierarchy, HypLTSF imposes two constraints: (1) a radial constraint that orders embeddings by their level of abstraction, and (2) an angular constraint that groups fine-scale patterns sharing a common coarser-scale ancestor. Extensive experiments on long-term time series forecasting benchmarks show that HypLTSF achieves state-of-the-art performance, suggesting that explicitly modeling the multi-scale hierarchy as a geometric structure is effective for forecasting.

</details>


### [684] [EMBLEM: Enhancing Multi-script Table Detection through Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08330)
*Dhruv Kudale,Udhay Brahmi,Ganesh Ramakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了MANDALA（一个包含18种语言、15种文字、2323页文档的多语种表格检测数据集）和EMBLEM（一种基于掩码的多语种表格检测范式）。EMBLEM通过生成隐藏文字和字体细节的掩码图像，使模型专注于与文字无关的页面布局，仅使用英文掩码图像微调即可在MANDALA上获得20.8%的绝对F1提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习的表格检测模型在英文和中文文档上表现良好，但由于文字多样性以及标注数据稀缺，在多语种、多文字文档上表现不佳。亟需解决多语种表格检测中因文字差异导致的泛化问题。

Method: 1) 构建MANDALA数据集：手工标注2,323个含表格页面，覆盖18种语言和15种文字，涉及多个领域。2) 提出EMBLEM方法：生成掩码图像以隐藏文字和字体特定细节，使在丰富英文文档上预训练的模型能够聚焦于与文字无关的页面布局特征，实现跨语种迁移。

Result: 在三种表格检测架构上，EMBLEM在MANDALA数据集上一致优于强基线模型，同时在五个标准英文主导基准上保持竞争力。仅使用英文掩码图像微调（无多语种训练数据），在MANDALA上取得20.8%的绝对F1分数提升。

Conclusion: EMBLEM证明了掩码策略可以有效地将英文预训练模型的能力迁移到多语种表格检测任务，绕过了多语种标注数据稀缺的瓶颈。数据集和代码已开源发布。

Abstract: Table detection is a core task in document analysis, supporting downstream applications such as information retrieval, document reconstruction, and visual question answering. While existing deep learning models perform well on English and Chinese documents, they struggle with multilingual, multi-script documents due to script diversity and the limited availability of labeled data. To address this challenge, we introduce MANDALA (Multi-script Annotated Documents for Table Detection), a manually curated dataset of 2,323 table-containing pages spanning 18 languages and 15 scripts across diverse domains. We also propose EMBLEM, a masking-based paradigm for Multi-script Table Detection (MTD). EMBLEM generates masked images that conceal script- and font-specific details, enabling models pre-trained on abundant English documents to focus on script-agnostic page layout. Experiments across three table detection architectures show that EMBLEM consistently outperforms strong baselines on MANDALA while remaining competitive on five standard English-dominant benchmarks. Using only English masked images for fine-tuning, with no multi-script training data, EMBLEM achieves an absolute F1-score gain of 20.8% on MANDALA. We release MANDALA along with the accompanying code and models at https://github.com/IITB-LEAP-OCR/EMBLEM.git.

</details>


### [685] [Distillation as Probability Transport: Routed On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08337)
*Tianle Xia,Lingxiang Hu,Yiding Sun,Linfang Shang,Ming Xu,Lan Xu,Ning Zheng,Wei Xu,Jie Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RouteOPD（路由在线蒸馏），将在线策略蒸馏（OPD）重新定义为教师引导的概率运输问题。传统采样目标将教师分布简化为词元上的标量信用，仅指示词元概率升降但未指定重分配方式。RouteOPD将教师-学生局部分歧分解为学生过剩源和教师不足目标，并耦合为显式运输对，通过有界教师势优化成对对数几率，实现更精准的知识迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中，高效采样目标将教师分布简化为词元标量信用，只能指示词元概率应增减，却无法指明概率如何在词元间重新分配，导致知识迁移不精确。

Method: RouteOPD将局部教师-学生分歧分解为两类：学生过剩源（student-excess sources）和教师不足目标（teacher-deficit destinations），并将它们耦合成显式运输对。通过有界教师势（bounded teacher potential）优化成对对数几率（pairwise log-odds），并依据教师需求集中度自适应调整运输预算（transport budget）。整个方法在单一运输算子内同时引导更新方向并控制更新幅度。

Result: 在四种教师-学生设置及四个数学推理基准上，RouteOPD持续优于采样反向KL在线蒸馏（sampled reverse-KL OPD），同时展现出更高的路由保真度（routing fidelity）和更低的背景泄漏（background leakage）。

Conclusion: 实验结果验证了在在线策略蒸馏中显式建模概率运输的有效性，证明将概率转移结构化处理比简单的标量信用分配能带来更优的蒸馏性能。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher knowledge on student-generated trajectories, but efficient sampled objectives reduce the teacher distribution to scalar credit on individual tokens. Such credit indicates whether a token should gain or lose probability, yet leaves the corresponding redistribution unspecified. We recast OPD as teacher-guided probability transport and propose RouteOPD (Routed On-Policy Distillation), which decomposes local teacher--student disagreement into student-excess sources and teacher-deficit destinations and couples them into explicit transport pairs. RouteOPD optimizes pairwise log-odds toward jointly realizable targets obtained from a bounded teacher potential, while adapting the transport budget to the concentration of teacher demand. This formulation directs updates toward teacher-preferred destinations and controls their magnitude within a single transport operator. Experiments across four teacher--student settings and four mathematical-reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RouteOPD consistently outperforms sampled reverse-KL OPD, with improvements accompanied by higher routing fidelity and lower background leakage. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicitly modeling probability transport in on-policy distillation.

</details>


### [686] [Miles v0.1: Production-Level Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08368)
*RadixArk,:,Tom Chen,Mao Cheng,Shi Dong,Kangrui Du,Yanbin Jiang,Jiajun Li,Yiming Li,Tao Lin,Yusheng Su,Andy Ye,Yueming Yuan,Zhichen Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG
