Compared with end-to-end GNN pipelines, GraphFAS decouples feature aggregation from model training, enabling direct integration with tabular models and direct compatibility with TreeSHAPbased explanations. Deployed in Alipay, GraphFAS delivers orderof-magnitude improvements in engineering efficiency while showing strong performance against expert-driven and graph-learning baselines on large-scale graphs.

</details>


### [722] [Transformers as In-Context Samplers: From Closed-Form Diffusion to Estimation-Free Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08981)
*Arman Adibi,Alireza Jafari,Mohammad Ghavamzadeh,Hadi Daneshmand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明冻结的Transformer不仅可以通过上下文学习进行监督学习（如线性回归），还可以通过上下文样本模拟迭代式生成采样器。作者首先证明Transformer能实现闭式及平滑闭式扩散采样器，其中softmax注意力计算责任权重和加权经验均值，前馈层实现Euler更新。接着通过"语义主题采样"实验发现预训练语言模型的隐藏状态呈现两阶段几何结构（中间层趋向均匀球面参考，输出层回归主题相关结构），并观察到U型粒子能量模式。最后证明Transformer可以近似基于能量的采样器，构造出跨层的U型能量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前的理论研究已证明Transformer具备上下文学习能力，可扩展到线性回归等监督学习任务。本文希望进一步探究：上下文学习能否扩展到数据生成任务，即冻结的Transformer能否从头上下文中模拟迭代式生成采样，从而更深入地理解预训练语言模型的生成机制。

Method: 1) 理论上证明Transformer可构造闭式及平滑闭式扩散采样器，明确softmax注意力负责计算责任权重和经验均值，前馈层实现Euler更新；2) 在预训练语言模型上研究语义主题采样（同类别词语如动物、食物、城市组成的提示），分析标准化隐藏状态在层间表现出趋向均匀球面再返回主题结构的U型几何；3) 测量隐藏云上的粒子相互作用能量，观察到相同U型模式；4) 证明Transformer可近似基于能量的采样器以构造该U型能量。

Result: 理论证明与实验观察相互印证：Transformer既能实现扩散采样器也能近似能量基采样器；预训练语言模型在语义主题采样中确实展现了两阶段几何（先趋向均匀分布再结构化），并伴随U型能量模式，与理论构造一致。

Conclusion: 上下文学习的能力超越了监督学习，扩展到数据生成领域。这一发现揭示softmax注意力在生成采样中的具体角色，并为理解预训练语言模型如何在不同层间组织语义信息提供了新的理论框架和实证证据。

Abstract: A growing body of work establishes that large language models are not mere statistical memorizers, but are capable of in-context learning: performing inference at test time using only examples provided in the prompt, without any parameter updates. Prior theoretical work has shown that this capability extends to supervised learning tasks such as linear regression. We prove that in-context learning extends further to \emph{data generation}: frozen transformers can simulate iterative generative samplers from in-context samples. We first show that transformers can realize closed-form and smoothed closed-form diffusion samplers. The construction identifies a concrete generative role for softmax attention: it computes responsibility weights and weighted empirical averages, while feedforward layers implement Euler updates.
  To empirically relate these constructions to pretrained language models, we study \emph{semantic-topic sampling}: prompts consisting of words drawn from a common semantic category, such as animals, foods, or cities. Across transformer layers, the normalized hidden states exhibit a two-stage geometry: they move toward a uniform spherical reference in intermediate layers and then return to structured, topic-dependent representations near the output. We further measure an interacting-particle energy on these hidden-state clouds and observe the same U-shape pattern. We then prove that transformers can approximate an energy-based sampler, constructing the same U-shape energy across the layers.

</details>


### [723] [Physics-Informed Deep Learning for False Ventricular Tachycardia Alarm Reduction in the ICU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08992)
*Athanasios Papastathopoulos-Katsaros,Alexandra Stavrianidi,Zhandong Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合1D SE-ResNet、ICU真实数据增强和基于Windkessel三元素血液动力学模型的可微前向模拟作为物理信息辅助重建任务的深度学习框架，用于减少ICU中假性室性心动过速(VT)警报。在VTaC基准的严格实时协议下，相比先前最先进方法提升了5点Challenge Score，消融实验证实物理信息目标函数是性能提升的主要驱动因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 假性室性心动过速(VT)警报是ICU中警报疲劳的主要原因之一，现有方法未能有效利用跨模态（ECG与动脉血压波形）的生理一致性来区分真实VT与伪迹。

Method: 采用1D SE-ResNet作为主干网络，结合ICU场景真实的数据增强策略；引入基于三元素Windkessel血液动力学模型的物理信息辅助重建任务，通过可微前向模拟要求网络潜在表示生成生理上合理的动脉血压波形，从而惩罚由伪迹驱动的ECG模式。

Result: 在VTaC基准的严格实时协议（10秒报警前窗口）下，方法相比先前最先进水平获得5点Challenge Score提升。物理信息目标函数为主要性能驱动因素，带来准确性提升、2倍标签效率和更局部化且临床有意义的ECG片段。

Conclusion: 物理信息驱动的跨模态一致性约束能有效区分真实VT与伪迹引发的假警报，且该方法在标签效率和临床可解释性方面均有显著优势，为ICU警报疲劳问题提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: False ventricular tachycardia (VT) alarms are a leading contributor to alarm fatigue in intensive care units. We propose a deep learning framework combining a 1D SE-ResNet with ICU-realistic data augmentations and a physics-informed auxiliary reconstruction task based on the three-element Windkessel hemodynamic model, implemented as a differentiable forward simulation. By requiring the network's latent representation to produce physiologically plausible arterial pressure waveforms, artifact-driven ECG patterns are penalized while true VT remains coherent across modalities. Evaluated on the VTaC benchmark under a strict real-time protocol (10-second pre-alarm window), our method achieves a 5-point Challenge Score improvement over prior state-of-the-art. Ablation studies confirm that the physics-informed objective is the primary performance driver, providing gains in accuracy, 2x label efficiency, and more localized and clinically meaningful ECG segments.

</details>


### [724] [Let It Go or Learn to Self-Correct: Continuous Diffusion for Constrained Discrete Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09009)
*Mariia Drozdova,Stéphane Liem Nguyen,François Fleuret*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现标准扩散采样在全局约束的离散任务（如数独、图连通性、拉丁方、N皇后）上效果不佳，因为保持接近当前噪声状态会导致早期错误难以纠正。仅从模型干净预测中直接采样，无需重训，即可将数独有效性从31%提升至95%。作者提出自校正训练方法，使模型暴露于自身预测，从而增强推理时错误的鲁棒性，显著提升标准采样器性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准DDPM采样在连续域表现良好，但在具有全局约束的离散任务中，早期离散错误难以撤销，导致标准扩散采样可能保留早期错误，即使模型的干净预测信息量充足。这种训练与推理之间的不匹配需要被解决。

Method: 1) 比较标准采样器与直接从模型干净预测采样的效果；2) 引入自校正训练（self-correction training），在训练过程中将模型自身预测暴露给模型，增强其对推理错误的鲁棒性。

Result: 仅改变采样方式（直接使用干净预测），数独有效性从31%提升至95%，其他离散任务也有持续改进。自校正训练进一步提升了标准采样器的性能。

Conclusion: 连续扩散模型可以学习非平凡的全局约束，但离散推理任务需要更好的训练-推理对齐：要么通过减少对早期决策承诺的采样器，要么通过训练模型纠正自身的推理时错误。

Abstract: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) generate samples by starting from noise and repeatedly denoising while keeping each update close to the current noisy state. This behavior is effective in many continuous domains, but its role is less clear for globally constrained discrete tasks, such as Sudoku, graph connectivity, Latin squares, and N-queens. In such settings, early discrete errors can be difficult to undo. As a result, standard diffusion sampling may preserve early mistakes, even when the model's clean predictions are informative. We compare standard samplers to sampling directly from the model's clean prediction. Without retraining, this single change improves Sudoku validity from 31% to 95%, with consistent gains across the other discrete tasks. We hypothesize that staying close to the current noisy state is harmful because the reverse trajectory can drift off the forward noising distribution the model was trained on. To reduce this train-test mismatch, we further introduce self-correction training, which exposes the model to its own predictions, improving robustness to errors that arise during inference. This substantially improves the performance of standard samplers. Our results suggest that continuous diffusion models can learn nontrivial global constraints, but discrete reasoning tasks require better alignment between training and inference: either through samplers that reduce commitment to early decisions, or through training that teaches the model to correct its own inference-time errors.

</details>


### [725] [Do Reasoning Representations Help Humans Evaluate LLM Outputs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09038)
*Jaewoo Lim,Sungbok Shin,Sanghyun Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过受控人类实验研究六种推理表示格式作为人类面向界面的效果，发现推理表示存在感知偏好与实际评估支持之间的错位：参与者偏好规划和分解式表示，但更简单的思维链反而更好地支持验证、信任和可解释性；偏好表示还带来校准风险（正确轨迹上误报更多、信任度高但验证意愿低）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理表示被越来越多地用作大语言模型输出的解释，但现有评估多采用以模型为中心的准则（如答案准确性和忠实性），忽视了推理表示是否真正帮助人们评估模型响应。这促使研究者从人机交互视角审视推理表示作为人类面向界面的价值。

Method: 采用受控人类研究，测试六种推理格式，涵盖不同复杂度的任务；基于网页框架随机化任务领域、问题实例和表示顺序；收集结构理解、错误检测与定位（细粒度判断）、信任校准等维度的评估数据。

Result: 发现感知偏好与人类评估支持之间存在错位：参与者偏好规划和分解式表示，但简单思维链更支持验证、信任和可解释性；偏好表示带来校准风险，表现为对正确轨迹产生更多误报、高信任却低验证意愿。

Conclusion: 表明推理表示作为解释界面的设计与以模型为中心的质量指标之间存在根本张力，提示未来在设计人类面向的推理表示时不能仅依赖模型中心的标准，而需考虑人类评估的实际需求和校准效果。

Abstract: Reasoning representations are increasingly used as explanations for large language model outputs. Yet they are typically evaluated with model-centric criteria, such as answer accuracy and faithfulness, leaving it unclear whether they help people evaluate model responses. In this work, we study reasoning representations as human-facing interfaces rather than proxies for model reasoning ability. We conduct a controlled human study of six reasoning formats across tasks of varying complexity, supported by a web-based framework that randomizes task domains, problem instances, and representation order. The study collects fine-grained judgments of structural understanding, error detection and localization, and trust calibration. Our study shows a mismatch between perceived preference and support for human evaluation. Participants prefer planning- and decomposition-based representations, but simpler chain-of-thought traces better support verification, trust, and interpretability. Preferred representations also introduce calibration risks, with more false alarms on correct traces and high trust despite low willingness to verify.

</details>


### [726] [Training-Free Task Vectors for LLM Behavioral Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09054)
*Gabriel J. Perin,Lucas Boscaini,André Araujo,Nina S. T. Hirata*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出训练无关任务向量（TFTVs），无需微调即可计算任务向量，通过前向传播统计将激活引导向量映射为秩一权重空间编辑，支持行为增强、抑制与组合，在大语言模型行为控制上表现优于现有编辑与引导基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统任务向量依赖微调模型与预训练模型之间的权重差来计算，成本高昂且限制了事后模型编辑的实用性。作者希望消除对微调的依赖，使任务向量方向的发现更加高效可行。

Method: 提出TFTVs方法：仅利用前向传播统计（无需微调），将激活引导向量（activation steering vectors）映射为秩一（rank-one）权重空间编辑。该方法满足算术性质，可直接支持通过加法进行学习、通过减法实现遗忘，以及多个编辑的复合。

Result: 在大语言模型行为控制任务上，TFTVs能持续放大、抑制和组合目标行为，同时保留通用知识与问题求解能力。与多种编辑和引导基线相比，TFTVs实现了更强的特质控制，且效用保持更好或相当。

Conclusion: 该工作为事后模型编辑及更广泛的训练无关模型控制开辟了新方向，代码已公开在项目网站上。

Abstract: Task vectors enable post-training model editing by identifying semantically meaningful directions in weight space, typically computed as the difference between a fine-tuned model and its pretrained initialization. However, this reliance on fine-tuning makes discovering such directions costly and limits the practicality of post-training model editing. To address this limitation, we introduce Training-Free Task Vectors (TFTVs), a novel method to compute task-vector-like directions without requiring fine-tuning. Our method maps activation steering vectors to rank-one weight-space edits using only forward-pass statistics, while satisfying arithmetic properties that directly support learning via addition, forgetting via subtraction, and the composition of multiple edits. Empirically, we evaluate TFTVs on large language model behavioral control tasks and show that they consistently amplify, suppress, and compose target behaviors while preserving general knowledge and problem-solving skills. We also validate our method against other editing and steering baselines, experimentally demonstrating that TFTVs achieve stronger trait control with better or competitive utility preservation. We hope our work opens new directions for the community in post-training model editing and broader training-free model control. Code is available on the project website: tftv-llm.github.io.

</details>


### [727] [PlayTrain: An Efficient Reinforcement Learning Framework for LLM-Generated Adaptable JavaScript Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09059)
*Ryan Truong,Lance Ying,Samuel J. Gershman,Kazuki Irie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PlayTrain框架，利用大语言模型从最小化人类提示生成JavaScript游戏，并通过高效流水线将这些游戏接入标准gym环境，实现单GPU节点上超过100万次决策/秒的像素级RL训练，支持Atari和ProcGen游戏的克隆与修改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视频游戏环境（VGEs）的开发或修改需要大量手工编码，过程繁琐耗时，制约了强化学习研究的发展。作者希望通过LLM自动化游戏生成，降低VGE开发门槛。

Method: PlayTrain结合两个核心能力：(1) 利用LLM从极简人类提示符稳健生成JavaScript游戏；(2) 构建高效pipeline使任意JS游戏能在标准gym环境中运行。JS格式兼顾了人类玩家可玩性与RL智能体可训练性。

Result: 成功克隆了Atari和ProcGen等知名游戏，以简单JS形式实现端到端像素级智能体训练，在单个GPU节点上速度超100万agent决策/秒；还支持创建修改版游戏，包括新测试集、程序化生成逻辑或动态变化。

Conclusion: PlayTrain重塑了RL视频游戏环境的开发范式——只需通过LLM生成和修改单个JS文件即可完成VGE开发，并开辟了多项有前景的未来RL研究方向。

Abstract: While many video-game environments (VGEs) have played crucial roles in advancing reinforcement learning (RL), developing novel VGEs or modifying existing ones to support new features, has been a laborious process requiring extensive hand-coding. Here we present PlayTrain, an RL framework that combines the abilities of large language models (LLMs) to robustly generate JavaScript (JS) games from a minimal human prompt, and an efficient pipeline that can run any JS game in a standard 'gym' environment. Not only are recent LLMs particularly good at writing JS code, but the JS format also allows users to easily play generated VGEs, while PlayTrain enables us to train RL agents on the exact same games. We demonstrate multiple use cases of PlayTrain, including cloning well-known Atari and ProcGen games in simple JS, where PlayTrain trains pixel-based agents end-to-end at over 1M agent-decisions per second on a single GPU node; and creating modified versions thereof (e.g., that support novel test sets, procedural generation logics, or game dynamics). Through PlayTrain, we reimagine RL VGE development: all we need is a single JS file, generated and modified through an LLM. We discuss promising future RL research directions that PlayTrain unlocks.

</details>


### [728] [Multi-Task Learning for Sparsely-Labeled Time Series: A Case Study on Cold-Hardiness Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09062)
*Aseem Saxena,Paola Pesántez-Cabrera,Jonathan Magby,Markus Keller,Alan Fern*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个真实世界的多任务学习（MTL）案例研究，用于时间过程建模，该研究面临数据有限且标签在时间上稀疏的挑战。具体应用于农业领域中的葡萄抗寒性预测问题，利用循环神经网络（RNNs）从天气时间序列数据预测每日抗寒性。研究开发了多种MTL架构，在不同品种间共享数据，并在MTL和迁移学习设置下评估，结果显示某些架构能持续优于单任务学习和最先进的科学模型，且一个同时学习抗寒性和发芽预测的单一MTL模型能进一步提升两个任务的预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 葡萄冷抗寒性预测是一个重要的农业问题，它影响种植者何时采取昂贵的防冻措施。然而，冷抗寒性在不同品种间的响应各不相同，且每个品种的真实数据在时间上稀疏且有限，这使得传统的单任务学习方法难以有效建模。需要探索多任务学习方法以充分利用有限数据并提升预测准确性。

Method: 采用循环神经网络（RNNs）进行每日冷抗寒性预测，将不同葡萄品种视为不同任务，开发多种多任务学习（MTL）架构来组合不同品种的数据。同时将研究扩展到一个定性的但相关的任务——发芽（budbreak）预测，探索单独的MTL模型能否同时学习两个任务。

Result: 实验结果表明不同MTL架构间存在显著差异，某些架构能够持续优于单任务学习和最先进科学模型。对于发芽预测也得到类似结果。此外，一个同时学习发芽和冷抗寒性两个任务的单一MTL模型能够进一步提高两个任务的预测精度。

Conclusion: 多任务学习架构的选择对预测性能有显著影响，精心设计的MTL架构能够在数据稀疏的条件下有效利用多品种和多任务数据，优于单任务学习和传统科学模型。这为农业时间序列预测中的有限数据问题提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: We present a real-world case study of multi-task learning (MTL) for temporal process modeling from limited data with temporally sparse labels. Specifically, we investigate multi-task learning for the important agricultural problem of predicting grape cold hardiness, which is the temperature at which lethal freezing occurs. Cold hardiness changes in response to weather and is difficult to measure directly in the field. Thus, growers rely on predictions to decide when to apply costly frost mitigation measures. We apply recurrent neural networks (RNNs) for daily cold-hardiness prediction from time series weather data. A major challenge is that the cold hardiness response varies across plant cultivars and ground-truth data for each cultivar is temporally sparse and limited. To address this challenge, we investigate multi-task learning (MTL) approaches for combining data, where different tasks correspond to different cultivars. We develop a variety of MTL architectures and evaluate them in both MTL and transfer learning settings. Our results show significant differences between architectures and that certain architectures are able to consistently outperform single-task learning and state-of-the-art scientific models. Additionally, we show similar results for the qualitatively different, but related, task of budbreak prediction. Further, improved accuracy for budbreak and cold hardiness is achieved by a single MTL model that simultaneously learns both tasks.

</details>


### [729] [ThinkPrior: Zero-Rollout Difficulty Priors for Cold-Start Prompt Selection in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09075)
*Tommy Sha,Skylar Zhai,Siqi Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ThinkPrior方法，针对RLVR+GRPO训练中零优势"静默组"浪费rollout的问题，利用外部验证器锚点在一次离线扫描中构建Beta先验，在首个目标策略rollout之前实现零rollout的难度先验，通过期望可学习性进行提示选择，减少了39%的静默组浪费并对计算预算进行再分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在RLVR+GRPO训练中，当组内所有rollout全对或全错时，优势为零的"静默组"不提供任何奖励-优势梯度，但这些组却消耗了39%的rollout。此外，基于历史的提示选择需先花费目标策略rollout估计难度，存在冷启动和rollout浪费问题。

Method: ThinkPrior利用外部验证器在离线单遍扫描中构建难度先验，用验证器评分的通过率为Beta后验提供外部锚初始化，在首个目标策略rollout之前获得零rollout难度先验。随后按期望可学习性选择提示，并从训练结果更新后验，不改变损失函数和优化器。可与DAPO等方法组合使用。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B的16个种子实验上，ThinkPrior将早期静默组减半以上，步骤30的浪费rollout减少近五分之一，最终准确率无显著差异。在250提示池的固定预算下属于资源再分配而非净节省；ThinkPrior+DAPO组合使生成rollout减少10.6%，同时保持3840 rollout的更新预算。

Conclusion: ThinkPrior通过外部锚点实现了零rollout的难度先验选择，有效减少了静默组的rollout浪费，且不影响最终精度。但固定预算下是资源再分配而非净节省，需要目标策略后验持续更新以维持效果。

Abstract: In reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trained with group relative policy optimization (GRPO), the KL-free reward-advantage term studied here depends on within-group reward variation. If all rollouts in a group are correct or all are wrong, their group-relative advantages are identically zero; these zero-advantage silent groups provide no reward-advantage gradient, yet uniform sampling spends 39% of a run's rollouts on them. History-based prompt selection must first spend target-policy rollouts to estimate difficulty, creating a cold start with rollout waste; ThinkPrior instead uses an external anchor in one offline pass to construct a zero-rollout difficulty prior before the first target-policy rollout. The verifier-scored anchor pass rate supplies an external-anchor initialization for a Beta posterior; ThinkPrior selects by expected learnability and then updates from training outcomes, changing neither the loss nor the optimizer. On Qwen2.5-Math-7B across sixteen seeds, ThinkPrior more than halves early silent groups and cuts wasted rollouts through step 30 by nearly a fifth, while we detect no difference in final accuracy. On this 250-prompt pool the fixed-budget result is a reallocation rather than a net saving. The measured ThinkPrior+DAPO composition reduces generated rollouts by 10.6% while both arms retain the same 3840-rollout update budget. The prior requires no target-policy rollout before the first selection, but the posterior thereafter uses target-policy outcomes.

</details>


### [730] [Curriculum Learning as Transport: Understanding Curricula with Wasserstein Geodesics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09099)
*Changho Shin,David Alvarez-Melis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Wasserstein课程路径框架，将课程学习表示为离散难度水平上训练分布的轨迹，从而解耦难度定义、排序、暴露量和进度等耦合设计选择。在12个任务、33个难度轴的校准合成套件中，发现课程效应强烈依赖上下文，不存在通用最优策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 课程学习受到多个耦合设计选择（难度定义、样例排序、每级暴露量、跨级训练进度）的共同支配，难以隔离真正有效的因素。这种耦合性阻碍了对课程学习机制的理解和归因。

Method: 提出Wasserstein课程路径——一种基于最优传输的框架，将课程表示为离散难度水平上训练分布的轨迹。通过该框架在固定训练预算下隔离排序（ordering）、匹配暴露（matched exposure）、端点平滑度（endpoint smoothness）和节奏（pacing）的独立效应。

Result: 课程效应高度依赖上下文：没有单一策略在任务、难度轴和预算间占据主导；课程主要改变固定预算的最有效分配位置。易到难排序相对暴露匹配的静态采样提升了困难水平的表现，证明该收益不能仅由累积暴露解释。端点平滑度和节奏显著影响课程在难度谱系上生效的位置。

Conclusion: Wasserstein课程路径提供了系统隔离课程学习设计因素的统一视角，支持扩展到通过学习几何实现自适应节奏以及超越一维排序的结构化难度空间。

Abstract: Curriculum learning is governed by several coupled design choices---how difficulty is defined, how examples are ordered, how much exposure each level receives, and how quickly training moves across levels---making it hard to isolate what actually helps. We present Wasserstein curriculum paths, a simple transport-based framework that decouples these factors by representing curricula as trajectories of training distributions over discrete difficulty levels. Across a calibrated synthetic suite with 12 tasks and 33 difficulty axes, we use this framework to isolate the effects of ordering, matched exposure, endpoint smoothness, and pacing under fixed training budgets. We find that curriculum effects are strongly context-dependent: no single strategy dominates across tasks, difficulty axes, and budgets, and curricula mainly change where a fixed budget is spent most effectively. Within this framework, easy-to-hard ordering improves hard-level performance relative to exposure-matched static sampling, showing that the benefit is not explained by cumulative exposure alone. We further show that endpoint smoothness and pacing substantially affect where along the difficulty spectrum a curriculum is effective. Finally, we show that the same transport view naturally supports extensions to learned pacing through geometry and to structured difficulty spaces beyond one-dimensional orderings.

</details>


### [731] [When Does Scale-Invariant Optimization Become Unstable? An Exact Schedule Law with Weight Decay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09116)
*Hasan Amin,Wei-Kai Chang,Rajiv Khanna*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了归一化神经网络中一个精确的离散时间定律：单一标量控制学习率调度和权重衰减的相互作用，在参数范数增长与几何自淬灭效应之间产生尖锐边界，将有效学习率划分为收缩主导和扩张主导两个截然不同的区域。通过精确分析一个完全可解的归一化回归模型，证明该平衡点本质不稳定，恒定学习率配合权重衰减会导致周期性行为。统一的齐次优化器框架进一步揭示自适应方法在归一化下系统性地表现出更弱的稳定化能力，并在多种神经网络和数据集上验证了这一定律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 归一化使神经网络的大部分结构近似尺度不变，形成学习率调度与权重衰减通过参数范数相互作用的隐藏反馈回路。理解这一相互作用机制对于掌握训练动态、优化器行为和调度设计至关重要，但目前缺乏精确的数学描述。

Method: 推导出精确的离散时间定律：单一标量捕获所有调度和衰减驱动力，范数增长诱导几何自淬灭。通过完全可解的归一化回归模型将动力学降至二维做精确分析，研究平衡点的稳定性。提出统一的齐次优化器框架揭示不同优化器在自淬灭强度上的结构性二分。

Result: 该定律在多种动态系统和神经网络（MLP、CNN、GPT2，以及MNIST、CIFAR、wikiText、OpenWebText）中以高精度成立。通过识别该标量可直接控制训练过程，性能在预测边界处急剧达到峰值。自适应方法在归一化下呈现出系统性更弱的稳定化。

Conclusion: 该研究隔离出尺度不变优化的单一控制量，为训练动力学、优化器行为和调度设计提供了精确且可操作的视角，在常量学习率与权重衰减下无法稳定维持内部平衡，而产生由离散时间雅可比结构驱动的循环行为。

Abstract: Normalization renders large parts of neural networks effectively scale invariant, inducing a hidden feedback loop in which learning-rate schedules and weight decay interact through the parameter norm to control the effective step taken by the optimizer. We show that this interaction is governed by an exact discrete-time law: a single scalar quantity captures all schedule and decay forcing, while norm growth induces an opposing geometric self-quenching effect. This yields a sharp boundary that cleanly separates contraction- and expansion-dominated effective learning rate regimes. To understand the underlying mechanism, we provide exact analysis of a fully solved normalized regression model where the dynamics reduce to two dimensions and show that the balance point is intrinsically unstable, implying that constant learning rate with weight decay cannot stably maintain an interior equilibrium and instead produces recurrent behavior driven by discrete-time Jacobian structure. We further extend this perspective across optimizers through unified homogeneous-optimizer framework that reveals a structural dichotomy in self-quenching strength, providing a first-principles explanation for why adaptive methods exhibit systematically weaker stabilization under normalization.
  Across dynamical systems and neural networks (MLP, CNN, GPT2 / MNIST, CIFAR, wikiText, OpenWebText), the predicted law holds with high precision and enables direct control of training via the identified scalar, with performance peaking sharply at the predicted boundary. Together, these results isolate a single governing quantity for scale-invariant optimization, providing a precise and actionable lens on training dynamics, optimizer behavior, and schedule design in modern deep learning. Code is available in https://github.com/shasanamin/normalized-optimization-dynamics.

</details>


### [732] [Nearly Tight Rademacher Bounds for Sparsely Activated Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09130)
*Xiaoyu Li,Zhizhou Sha,Jiaojiao Jiang,Junbin Gao,Andi Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究单隐层ReLU网络中"输入依赖性稀疏"（不同输入激活不同隐藏单元）的统计复杂度。作者证明在宽度s、每输入最多k个激活单元条件下，经验Rademacher复杂度边界为O(WR·min{k,√(sk/m)·log³ᐟ²}) + kB/√m，消除了以往显式的维度因子（对数除外），并给出了匹配的下界。文章还揭示了输入域的重要性：零偏置网络在球上的稀疏性强制至多2k个非零单元；偏置与WR相当时恢复最坏情况速率。同时获得agnostic minimax excess-risk界O(min{1,√(s/(km))})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际中ReLU网络虽然整体可激活大量隐藏单元，但单个输入通常只激活少数单元（输入依赖性稀疏）。此前Awasthi等的模型缺少对这种稀疏性与网络统计复杂度之间关系的精细刻画，且复杂度界中存在显式的维度依赖。理解这种"依赖于输入的稀疏性"如何影响泛化界是理论机器学习中的重要问题。

Method: 作者采用支持保持覆盖（support-preserving cover）与单个归一化chaining论证来推导上界，消除了显式的维度因子。通过i.i.d.边际分布构造下界以匹配上界（除对数因子外）。为研究输入域的影响，作者分别分析零偏置网络在球上的退化情形（稀疏性强制至多2k个非零单元），以及偏置与WR相当的情形（恢复最坏情况速率），后者通过球冠（spherical-cap）构造证明，且不假设稀疏性仅存在于采样支持上。

Result: 得到了宽度s、每输入至多k个激活、权重偏置界W,B条件下的Rademacher复杂度上界R(S)≤CWR·min{k,√(sk/m)·log³ᐟ²(2m)} + kB/√m，去除了显式维度因子（至多对数）。匹配的i.i.d.下界表明跨输入改变激活单元会保留宽度依赖。输入域分析显示：零偏置在球上稀疏的网络复杂性为O(kWR/√m)，而偏置与WR相当时在球上恢复最坏情况速率。同时获得阶为min{1,√(s/(km))}（至多对数）的agnostic minimax excess-risk界。

Conclusion: 本文完整刻画了输入依赖性稀疏ReLU网络的统计复杂度，证明维度因子的实际影响至多为对数级别。核心见解是：稀疏性在不同输入间变化时仍然保留宽度依赖，且输入域的形状（球 vs 一般域）以及偏置大小对复杂度有根本性影响——零偏置会因几何约束自动限制有效单元数，而足够大的偏置则允许达到最坏情况复杂度。这为理解深度学习中的稀疏激活与泛化关系提供了理论基础。

Abstract: An input may activate few hidden units even when different inputs collectively use an entire network. We study the statistical complexity of this input-dependent sparsity in the one-hidden-layer ReLU model of Awasthi et al. (COLT 2024). For width $s$, at most $k$ active units per input, and effective weight and bias bounds $W,B$, every size-$m$ sample in the class's fixed radius-$R$ input domain satisfies $\mathcal{R}(S)\le CWR\min\{k,\sqrt{sk/m}\log^{3/2}(2m)\}+kB/\sqrt m$. A support-preserving cover and a single normalized chaining argument remove the previous explicit dimension factor, up to logarithms. Lower bounds on appropriate i.i.d. marginals match up to those logarithms, showing how changing active units across inputs retains a width dependence. The input domain matters: zero-bias networks sparse on the entire ball have at most $2k$ nonzero units and complexity $O(kWR/\sqrt m)$, whereas bias bounds comparable to $WR$ restore the worst-case rate on that same domain in only logarithmic dimension. A spherical-cap construction proves the latter claim without assuming sparsity merely on the sampling support. For a specified normalized bounded loss and biases comparable to $WR$, we also obtain agnostic minimax excess-risk bounds of order $\min\{1,\sqrt{s/(km)}\}$ up to logarithms.

</details>


### [733] [NOAH: Learning the Full Patient Journey. A Longitudinal Multimodal Time-Aware Model for Representation and Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09140)
*Tobias Susetzky,Raphael Rehms,Dmitrii Seletkov,Özgün Turgut,Michelle Espranita Liman,Lisa Steinhelfer,Rickmer Braren,Daniel Rueckert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NOAH，一个时间感知、任务无关的生成式Transformer模型，用于表示和预测完整的多模态患者旅程。NOAH基于MIMIC数据集家族的5.59亿临床事件构建，能原生处理医学图像、时间序列、数值信号、分类事件及结构化与非结构化临床记录，支持自回归预测、零样本分类和反事实干预模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI模型难以捕捉真实世界多模态患者数据的复杂不规则时间动态和固有随机性。已有方法多为判别式、局限于少数模态、受限于封闭分类词汇表、把时间当作单调归纳偏置，或在预测未来患者状态方面能力有限。

Method: NOAH采用双向时间集成机制和变分潜空间，用以刻画患者状态的连续演变及临床轨迹的随机性。作为生成式Transformer，它能以自回归方式预测，支持可选时间控制、零样本分类及反事实干预模拟。

Result: 在临床结局探查、15个ICD章节和29种合并症的预测，以及时间至事件预测中均表现优异，能够生成信息丰富且具有预测力的患者状态表征。

Conclusion: NOAH是该领域首个真正全面的多模态生成式模型，能够无缝处理多样化模态和复杂时间动态，为个性化临床护理和数字医学中的智能预测系统提供了通用、任务无关、可扩展的基础。

Abstract: The digitization of healthcare has generated vast, longitudinal, and multimodal patient records over a lifetime, yet fully exploiting these data to represent and predict patient state trajectories remains a critical challenge. Current AI models often struggle to capture the complex, irregular temporal dynamics and inherent stochasticity of real-world multimodal patient data. Existing AI approaches for modeling longitudinal patient records are predominantly discriminative, limited to a few modalities, constrained by closed categorical vocabularies, treating time as a monotonic inductive bias, or they are limited in forecasting future patient states. We introduce NOAH, a time-aware, task-agnostic, generative transformer model representing and forecasting the full multimodal patient journey. NOAH features a novel bidirectional time integration and a variational latent space to capture the continuous evolution of patient states and the stochasticity of clinical trajectories. Built from over 559 million clinical events from 431,000 hospital visits of 299,000 patients across the MIMIC dataset family, NOAH natively processes medical images, time-series and numeric signals, categorical events, as well as structured and unstructured clinical records. NOAH is the first truly holistic generative model in its field, enabling autoregressive forecasting with optional time control, zero-shot classification, and counterfactual intervention simulation. It generates highly informative and predictive patient state representations that demonstrate strong performance in probing for clinical outcomes, 15 ICD chapters, and 29 comorbidities, as well as in time-to-event prediction. Seamlessly handling diverse modalities and complex temporal dynamics, NOAH provides a versatile, task-agnostic, scalable foundation for intelligent predictive systems in personalized clinical care and digital medicine.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

### [734] [Beyond Right and Wrong: Evaluating Second-order Social Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05437)
*Sunny Rai,Jinyi Kuang,Reyhan Jamalova,Annie Lou,Cristina Bicchieri,Niyati Malhotra,Victor Hugo Orozco-Olvera,Ana Maria Munoz-Boudet,Lyle H Ungar,Sharath C Guntuku*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种评估大语言模型（LLMs）元规范推理能力的新框架，并发布了多视角数据集NormReact（450个规范违规场景）。研究发现LLMs过度预测负面制裁，且随社会距离增加与人类判断的一致性下降，显示出对现实社会规范执行中容忍与克制的低估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往AI对齐研究主要关注一阶社会规范（教导模型什么是可接受/不可接受的），但社会智能不仅需要规范识别，还需要预判谁将执行规范以及如何执行（如公开羞辱或监禁）。这类二阶期望（元规范）被忽视，现有研究缺乏系统评估LLM元规范推理能力的方法。

Method: 提出一个评估LLM元规范推理的双维度框架：情感评估（emotional appraisal）和行为反应（behavioral response）；设计两个分类任务：预测违规者的自我调节和观察者的他者调节；构建多视角数据集NormReact，包含450个规范违规场景，手工标注了违规者性别和观察者社会亲近度维度下的情绪与行为反应。

Result: 六个模型的评估显示：LLMs描绘了一个更严酷的社会世界，过度预测人类认为会无动于衷的负面制裁场景；随着社会距离增加，LLM与人类判断的一致性下降。

Conclusion: 在冲突调解、政策模拟等规范敏感领域，AI系统可能产生扭曲的社会规制图景——过度代表惩罚，而低估真实世界规范执行中特有的容忍、克制和关系校准。

Abstract: Previous AI alignment efforts have focused primarily on first-order social norms -- teaching models what is socially acceptable or unacceptable (e.g., `do not steal'). However, social intelligence depends not only on norm recognition, but also on anticipating who will enforce it and how (e.g., public shame or even imprisonment). These second-order expectations, known as metanorms, govern how people respond when social rules are broken. We introduce a novel framework for evaluating metanorm reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) along two dimensions: emotional appraisal and behavioral response, and propose new classification tasks, namely, predicting self-regulation in violators, and other-regulation in observers. We release a multi-perspective dataset, NormReact, of 450 norm violation scenarios, hand-annotated for emotions and behavioral responses across norm violators' gender and observers' social closeness. Current LLMs portray a harsher social world: across six models, they overpredict negative sanctions where humans would expect inaction, and alignment with human judgments deteriorates as social distance increases. These findings suggest that AI systems in norm-sensitive domains from conflict mediation to policy simulation, may risk producing a distorted picture of social regulation: one that over-represents punishment and under-represents the tolerance, restraint, and relational calibration that characterize actual norm enforcement in real world.

</details>


### [735] [CriticGen: Generation-Aware Evaluation as Actionable Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05439)
*Huifang Du,Zecheng Zuo,Sen Wang,Chenghao Fan,Haofen Wang,Yehui Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CriticGen是一个细粒度、生成感知的大语言模型评估框架，通过生成实例特定的评估维度和评分标准作为动态评分细则，将评估转化为可执行的答案改进控制。实验表明其在评分相关性、标准质量和答案改进率上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型评估方法过于粗粒度且与生成过程脱节，产生的解释过于泛化，无法为模型改进提供可操作的反馈，缺乏针对性和可行性。

Method: CriticGen框架首先在高层次类别（如主观、客观、自推约束）下生成样本特定的评估维度和评分标准，这些标准随后作为动态评分细则，共同生成分数、理由、可执行的改进建议和修正后的答案。通过评分细则条件化的精炼过程，使模型能够诊断缺陷并进行针对性的答案改进。

Result: 相关度/覆盖率从3.33/4.03提升至3.97/4.24；Pearson相关系数0.9556，Spearman相关系数0.9560；标准依据理由和可执行建议的F1从0.6369/0.5994提升至0.7554/0.7900；反馈使73.17%的答案得到改进，93.28%的非退化率。

Conclusion: 细粒度评估应当兼具实例特异性和可操作性，CriticGen通过将评估转化为可执行控制，实现了更高质量的评分细则、更强的评分一致性和可靠的答案改进效果。

Abstract: Current evaluation methods for large language models are coarse-grained and decoupled from generation, producing generic explanations that fail to provide actionable feedback for model improvement. We propose CriticGen, a fine-grained, generation-aware evaluation framework that turns evaluation into actionable control for answer improvement. CriticGen first generates sample-specific evaluation dimensions and scoring criteria under high-level categories such as subjective, objective, and self-derived constraints. These criteria then serve as a dynamic rubric for jointly producing a score, a reason, an executable refinement suggestion, and a refined answer. This rubric-conditioned refinement process enables models to diagnose flaws and perform targeted answer improvement. Experimental results show that fine-grained evaluation should be both instance-specific and actionable. CriticGen induces higher-quality rubrics, improving relevance/coverage from 3.33/4.03 to 3.97/4.24. CriticGen also achieves the best score correlations, with 0.9556 Pearson and 0.9560 Spearman, and raises the F1 of criterion-grounded reasons and executable suggestions from 0.6369/0.5994 to 0.7554/0.7900. Crucially, its feedback translates into reliable answer improvement, improving 73.17% of answers with a 93.28% non-degradation rate.

</details>


### [736] [When Does Memory Help? A Cost-Aware Evaluation of Long-Term Memory in Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05441)
*Shweta Mishra,Shashank Mishra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MERIT基准与测试框架，用于评估工具使用型LLM代理中长期记忆的边际效用。通过在三个领域开展23,440个评分片段（成本$42.57），发现记忆能显著提升依赖型任务成功率（从0.00升至0.55-1.00），但在事实更新场景下嵌入检索表现出不稳定性，结构化事实存储与LLM摘要的写时更新机制表现更优；记忆实现方式改变可使任务成功率变动多达60个百分点，且完整重放始终经济性不佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期记忆评测（如LoCoMo、LongMemEval）仅通过对话历史问答衡量记忆，无法评估记忆事实是否真正改变工具使用代理的实际行为。论文旨在填补这一空白，以边际效用和显式成本核算方式评估记忆对任务执行的真实价值。

Method: 构建MERIT基准与测试框架，包含三个领域的工具使用片段任务；任务对早期片段事实的依赖通过自动化泄漏检查验证；设计难度阶梯（含更新事实回忆）；实施受控记忆损坏；对所有记忆操作进行完整token与美元计量。开展两代模型试点与预注册的3模型x3种子网格实验。

Result: 记忆将依赖型任务成功率从泄漏验证的0.00下限提升至0.55-1.00。更新事实场景下，嵌入检索在不同模型间表现不稳定（0.30-0.95，最大种子差距0.45），代理仅55%的时间基于正确检索值行动；写时更新存储（结构化事实存储及LLM摘要）保持0.70-1.00，混合方案反而不如单独事实存储。最新模型抽查重现该模式。更换记忆实现可致任务成功率最多变动60个百分点，全量重放从未经济划算，最优条件每美元边际效用达2.7-3.9倍。

Conclusion: MERIT证明应以任务执行的边际效用而非对话问答来衡量记忆价值；不同记忆实现（尤其是事实更新处理）对代理行为影响显著，嵌入检索在动态事实场景下可靠性欠缺；框架与数据全部开源供社区复现与扩展。

Abstract: Long-term memory for LLM agents is evaluated today by conversational recall benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval), which measure question answering over dialogue history, not whether remembered facts change what a tool-using agent does. We present MERIT (Memory Evaluation for Realistic Instrumented Tasks), a benchmark and harness that measures the marginal utility of memory for task-executing agents under explicit cost accounting. MERIT provides episodic tool-use tasks in three domains whose dependence on earlier-episode facts is verified by an automated leak check; a difficulty ladder ending in updated-fact recall; controlled memory corruption; and full token and dollar metering of every memory operation. Across 23,440 scored episodes ($42.57), a two-generation pilot on gpt-4.1-mini and a preregistered 3-model x 3-seed grid (GPT-4.1, Claude Haiku 4.5; memory side held fixed), memory lifts dependent-task success from a leak-verified floor of 0.00 to 0.55-1.00. On updated facts, embedding retrieval collapses unpredictably (0.30-0.95 across models; max seed gap 0.45), and agents act on a correctly retrieved value only 55% of the time, while update-on-write stores (a structured fact store and, notably, LLM summarization) remain at 0.70-1.00; the hybrid is worse than the fact store alone. A latest-generation spot-check (Claude Sonnet 5, gated on a clean full-replay control) reproduces the pattern. Swapping a memory's implementation moves task success by up to 60 points, and full replay is never economical: the best condition per domain delivers 2.7-3.9x its marginal utility per dollar. We release the benchmark, harness, and all traces.

</details>


### [737] [AutoFyn Technical Report: Non-Parametric Expert Iteration for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05446)
*Adib Hasan,Daniel Schaffield,Akashnil Dutta,Tarik Adnan Moon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoFyn是一个受Expert Iteration算法启发的agent harness框架，通过更新持久化状态而非模型权重来适应冻结模型。每个回合从全新的模型会话开始，通过显式接口（持久化记忆文件、报告、仓库状态）重新引入持久信息。在多轮迭代中利用orchestrator探索多种方案，并由任务验证器提供客观奖励反馈，将奖励蒸馏回持久状态以更新下一轮的有效策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法通过更新模型权重来提升agent性能，成本高昂且不灵活。AutoFyn希望证明仅通过维护和更新持久化外部状态，就能让冻结模型在多轮迭代中持续改进，从而实现无需权重更新即可适应复杂任务的效果。

Method: AutoFyn采用Expert Iteration风格的循环框架：每一轮从全新的模型会话开始，持久信息仅通过显式接口（如持久化记忆文件、报告、仓库状态）重新引入。回合内，orchestrator协调专业agent探索、规划和构建多种替代方案，任务验证器验证工作并提供客观奖励。该奖励被蒸馏回持久状态，更新下一轮的有效策略。

Result: 在2026年国际数学奥林匹克竞赛的六个新问题上，所有有能力提升的模型在AutoFyn下的得分都高于其供应商自身的编码agent。AutoFyn在Spider 2.0 dbt基准测试上构建了排名第一的agent，并在Next.js、MetaMask、pnpm、Warp、LiteLLM、Langflow和Open WebUI中产出了16个由维护者确认的漏洞公告。

Conclusion: AutoFyn证明了一种"权重无关"的agent改进范式：通过精心设计的持久化状态和验证接口，冻结模型也可以在多个任务领域（奥数数学、数据科学、网络安全）中取得显著成果，为未来agent系统提供了一种可扩展且无需重训练的自适应框架。

Abstract: We introduce AutoFyn, an agent harness inspired by the Expert Iteration algorithm, adapting a frozen model across many rounds by updating persistent state from verified reward signals rather than model weights. Each round begins from a fresh model session, and durable information is reintroduced only through explicit interfaces such as persistent memory files, reports, and repository state. Within a round, an orchestrator explores, plans and builds many alternative approaches with specialized agents, while a task-grounded verifier verifies the work and supplies an objective reward for measuring progress. This reward is distilled back into the persistent state, which updates the effective policy for the next round. In this technical report, we formalize this loop and describe its persistent state and verification interfaces. We then demonstrate its use in three domains, namely olympiad mathematics, data science, and cybersecurity. On the six fresh problems of the 2026 International Mathematical Olympiad, every model with room to improve scores higher under AutoFyn than in its provider's own coding agent. AutoFyn also built the top-ranked agent on the Spider 2.0 dbt benchmark, and has produced $16$ maintainer-confirmed vulnerability advisories in Next.js, MetaMask, pnpm, Warp, LiteLLM, Langflow, and Open WebUI.

</details>


### [738] [Damage-Aware Bandit Pruning for Vision and Language Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05448)
*Salem Ameen,Sunil Vadera*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将Transformer结构化后训练剪枝中的单元选择问题建模为"损伤感知的多臂老虎机"问题，在固定评估预算下，通过成对损伤（掩码损失减去基线损失）平滑有界奖励来驱动UCB风格策略或分数Beta Thompson Sampling，逐步顺序添加被抑制的单元。实验覆盖多种语言和视觉Transformer模型，显示老虎机方法相比预算贪婪选择通常能降低性能退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化后训练剪枝需要选择完整的、抑制后仅造成有限退化的功能单元，但如何在固定的候选评估预算下高效、准确地选择最优单元集是一个挑战。现有方法（如随机、幅度、静态显著性、预算贪婪）可能无法充分利用成对批内评估信息，或受批次间变化干扰。

Method: 将单元选择形式化为损伤感知的多臂老虎机问题。在相同批次上计算"掩码损失-基线损失"作为成对损伤以减少批次间波动；使用平滑有界奖励驱动UCB风格策略或分数Beta Thompson Sampling两种算法；最终通过顺序逐步添加单元构建掩码，并直接在原始稠密检查点上功能性地置零所选单元。

Result: 在WikiText-2、LAMBADA和Imagenette上覆盖GPT-2、OPT、Pythia、Qwen2.5、SmolLM2、ViT-B/16、DeiT-Tiny和Swin-Tiny共8种模型，与随机、幅度、静态显著性和预算贪婪方法对比。5个种子的实验中，老虎机方法在成对语言模型比较中通常优于预算贪婪。28个重点比较中23个置信区间排除零，11个配对检验p<0.05，BH校正后116个全族测试中有6个q<0.05。ViT-B/16和Swin-Tiny的匹配评估表明其收益不能仅由更大评估预算解释。

Conclusion: 老虎机式单元选择在结构化剪枝中展现出优于贪婪基线的潜力，尤其是成对损伤评估有效减少了批次间方差带来的干扰。但统计显著性在多重校正后有所减弱，表明收益虽存在但在部分测试中不够强，且本文仅讨论功能性结构抑制而非物理压缩或加速。

Abstract: Structured post-training pruning of transformers requires selecting complete functional units whose suppression causes limited degradation. We formulate structured-unit selection for language and vision transformers as a damage-aware multi-armed bandit problem under a fixed candidate-evaluation budget. Attention heads and MLP channel groups are temporarily masked on calibration batches. Paired damage is the masked loss minus the base loss on the same batch, reducing batch-to-batch variation. A smooth bounded reward drives either a UCB-style policy or fractional-Beta Thompson Sampling, and the final mask is constructed sequentially by adding one unit at each step. The selected units are functionally zeroed in the original dense checkpoint; therefore, the reported parameter effects represent effective structural suppression rather than physical compression or measured speedup. Experiments on WikiText-2, LAMBADA, and Imagenette cover GPT-2, OPT, Pythia, Qwen2.5, SmolLM2, ViT-B/16, DeiT-Tiny, and Swin-Tiny, with comparisons against random, magnitude, static-saliency, and budgeted-greedy selection. Across five seeds, the bandit methods usually reduce degradation relative to budgeted greedy in the paired language-model comparisons. Of 28 comparisons highlighted in the paper, 23 bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero and 11 paired tests have p < 0.05; six have q < 0.05 after Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the full family of 116 dataset-wise tests. Matched-evaluation results for ViT-B/16 and Swin-Tiny indicate that their gains are not explained solely by a larger candidate-evaluation budget.

</details>


### [739] [Compiling VGDL into Causal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05459)
*Mohit Jiwatode,Bodo Rosenhahn,Alexander Dockhorn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个确定性框架，将用视频游戏描述语言（VGDL）编写的游戏编译为动态结构化因果模型（DSCM），通过直接翻译游戏组件为结构方程，实现与真实游戏机制绝对一致的因果保真度，支持反事实推理和因果强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习智能体常依赖虚假相关性，而大语言模型容易幻觉游戏规则，两者都难以准确捕捉游戏环境的因果机制。虽然因果强化学习能提升可解释性，但缺乏将复杂游戏机制形式化映射到因果模型的系统性方法。

Method: 提出确定性编译框架，将VGDL描述的游戏直接编译为动态结构化因果模型（DSCM）。不依赖从游戏轨迹推断或LLM输出，而是直接翻译游戏组件（精灵动力学、交互规则、终止条件）为显式结构方程，每个游戏tick表示从时刻t到t+1状态变量的因果转移。

Result: 该方法保证对ground-truth游戏机制的绝对因果保真度，生成的模型提供透明的因果路径，支持反事实推理、因果强化学习智能体训练以及程序化内容验证。

Conclusion: 该框架在符号化游戏描述与因果化游戏AI之间建立了原则性桥梁，为游戏领域的因果建模提供了形式化基础。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning and large language models often struggle to accurately capture the causal mechanics of game environments. Standard reinforcement learning agents tend to rely on spurious correlations, while large language models are prone to hallucinating game rules. Although causal reinforcement learning improves interpretability, there is currently no formal methodology to map complex game mechanics directly into causal models. To address this, we propose a deterministic framework that compiles games specified in the Video Game Description Language into Dynamic Structural Causal Models. Rather than inferring causal structures from gameplay traces or noisy large language models' outputs, our methodology directly translates game components, including sprite dynamics, interaction rules, and termination conditions, into explicit structural equations. Each game tick represents a causal transition from state variables at time $t$ to $t+1$. By establishing this grounded mapping, the approach guarantees absolute causal fidelity to the ground-truth game mechanics. The resulting models offer transparent causal pathways that support counterfactual reasoning, causal reinforcement learning agent training, and procedural content validation. This framework provides a principled bridge between symbolic game descriptions and causally grounded game AI.

</details>


### [740] [ARC-Bench: Closed-Loop Replanning Masks Broken Action Ranking in Frozen JEPA World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05461)
*Zhengshu Zhang,Zhiyuan Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现奖励无关的潜在世界模型（JEPA-WM）所依赖的"潜在空间接近度可排序动作"这一核心假设在实际预训练模型中严重且结构性地失效。作者提出ARC-Bench基准协议进行审计，证明官方检查点的动作排序存在系统性反转，并通过降低规划器重规划频率导致成功率崩溃的实验，揭示了闭环重规划掩盖了这一缺陷的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励无关的潜在世界模型通过冻结潜在空间中距离（候选动作的未来嵌入到目标嵌入的距离）来评分动作，这隐式假设了"潜在接近度与真实代价一致"（即latent rankability）。作者希望直接审计这一假设是否成立，因为现有评估多依赖闭环成功率，可能掩盖底层排序质量问题。

Method: 提出ARC-Bench协议：(1) 无泄漏、固定候选人的评测设置；(2) 对官方发布的JEPA-WM检查点在导航和操作式控制任务中测试候选动作排序正确性；(3) 用受控视觉骨干消融（DINOv2替换为V-JEPA 1/2的ViT-L/ViT-G编码器）排除偶然因素；(4) 通过 provenance、欠训练、匹配预算骨干控制和指标循环性控制排除琐碎解释；(5) 通过降低规划器重规划频率测量成功率下降，验证闭环重规划掩盖排序缺陷的假设。

Result: 官方操作任务检查点中得分最高的候选动作几乎总是次优的；同样的排序反转出现在迷宫域。缺陷在更换视觉骨干（V-JEPA编码器）后依然存在。通过降低重规划频率，导航和操作域的成功率均崩溃，且由频繁重规划挽救的情节在PointMaze首规划诊断中富含严重首规划排序失败案例。控制实验排除了来源、欠训练和骨干差异等琐碎解释。

Conclusion: 闭环成功率系统性地高估了冻结潜在表征的排序能力。闭环重规划"掩盖"了底层潜在空间规划器的排序缺陷——ARC-Bench提供了测量工具，掩盖机制提供了解释，这对依赖自适应、摊销或重规划来绕过潜在空间规划器缺陷的方法提出了重要警示。

Abstract: Reward-free latent world models plan by scoring candidate actions with distances in a frozen latent space: an action is preferred if its predicted future embedding lands closer to the goal embedding. This silently assumes that latent closeness is action-rankable, i.e., that ordering candidates by latent distance agrees with ordering them by true cost. We audit this assumption directly. We introduce ARC-Bench, a no-leak, fixed-candidate protocol that measures whether frozen JEPA-style objectives rank candidate actions correctly, and apply it to official released JEPA-WM checkpoints across navigation and manipulation-style control. The assumption fails, severely and structurally: on the official manipulation audits the top-scored candidate is almost always suboptimal, and the same inversion appears in the maze domains. A controlled visual-backbone extension shows that the defect persists when DINOv2 is replaced by video-pretrained V-JEPA 1 and V-JEPA 2 encoders at ViT-L/ViT-G scale. Provenance, undertraining, matched-budget backbone controls, and metric-circularity controls rule out trivial explanations. We then explain why this defect has stayed invisible: closed-loop replanning masks it. When we reduce the planner's replanning frequency, success collapses in both a navigation and a manipulation domain, and the episodes rescued by frequent replanning are enriched for severe first-plan ranking failures in the PointMaze first-plan diagnostic. Closed-loop success rates therefore systematically overstate the rankability of frozen latent representations. ARC-Bench supplies the measurement, and the masking mechanism the explanation, for methods that adapt, amortize, or replan around latent-space planners without directly auditing released JEPA-WM action rankability.

</details>


### [741] [RAPID: Reliability-Aware Pair Importance Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05481)
*Ali Mahdavi,Azadeh Zamanifar,Amirfarhad Farhadi,Omid Kashefi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RAPID（可靠性感知的配对重要性蒸馏）方法，解决示例间关系蒸馏中全对计算复杂度高、均匀子采样效率低的问题。RAPID将可靠性门控的关系目标与自适应支持配对提议分离，并采用精确逆提议校正使损失和梯度估计器相对于门控小批量目标条件无偏。在AG News和SST-2两个文本分类任务上，可靠性门控的关系蒸馏取得了最高平均学生准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 示例间关系蒸馏通过匹配小批量中示例间的关系来传递教师模型的表征几何结构，但计算全部配对具有批大小二次复杂度，而均匀子采样可能低效使用有限的关系预算。因此需要更高效的关系配对选择策略。

Method: RAPID将教学信号分解为两个模块：(1) 可靠性门控的关系目标，通过校准的教师熵确定哪些教师关系应被强调；(2) 自适应支持配对提议，利用分离的学生-教师残差决定评估哪些关系。采用精确逆提议校正确保损失和梯度估计器对门控小批量目标条件无偏。

Result: 在AG News（BERT到DistilBERT蒸馏，3个配对种子，关系预算256）上，可靠性门控关系蒸馏达到最高平均准确率94.285±0.054%；RAPID以94.241±0.025%位居第二。在SST-2（DistilBERT到DistilBERT蒸馏，预算64）上，分别为88.800±0.532%和88.685±0.462%。两者均优于交叉熵基线（94.154±0.124%和87.271±0.162%）。

Conclusion: 实验结果支持模块化观点：目标可靠性与评估优先级是可分离的设计维度。可靠性门控目标产生最高平均准确率，而自适应提议保持在种子级变化范围内，表明这两个组件可以独立设计和优化。

Abstract: Inter example relational distillation transfers a teacher's representation geometry by matching relations among examples within a mini batch. Computing all pairs has quadratic complexity in the batch size, whereas uniform subsampling may use a limited relation budget inefficiently. We introduce Reliability Aware Pair Importance Distillation, or RAPID, which separates a reliability gated relational target from a full support adaptive pair proposal. Reliability determines which teacher relations are emphasized, while calibrated teacher entropy and detached student-teacher residuals determine which relations are evaluated. Exact inverse proposal correction makes the loss and gradient estimators conditionally unbiased with respect to the gated mini batch target. We evaluate RAPID in two text classification settings: AG News with BERT-to-DistilBERT distillation using three paired seeds and a relation budget of 256, and SST-2 with DistilBERT to DistilBERT distillation using three paired seeds and a relation budget of 64. Reliability gated relational distillation achieves the highest observed mean student accuracy on both datasets: 94.285 plus or minus 0.054 percent on AG News and 88.800 plus or minus 0.532 percent on SST-2. RAPID ranks second, achieving 94.241 plus or minus 0.025 percent and 88.685 plus or minus 0.462 percent, respectively, compared with 94.154 plus or minus 0.124 percent and 87.271 plus or minus 0.162 percent for the cross entropy baseline. Pilot evaluations are counted toward the same total budget as the main relation evaluations. Across both settings, the gated target yields the highest mean accuracy, while the adaptive proposal remains within seed-level variation. These results support the modular view that target reliability and evaluation priority are separable design dimensions.

</details>


### [742] [PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN: Prior-Guided Joint Probabilistic Forecasting of Clinical Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05488)
*Weizhi Nie,Rihao Chang,Weijie Wang,Yuting Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN框架，用于ICU患者多变量生理信号的联合概率预测。该框架融合了缺失感知时间编码器、软器官系统先验、患者特定关系、Kolmogorov-Arnold消息传递和低秩多变量Student-t分布头。在MIMIC-IV队列上，该方法在概率预测指标(NLL、CRPS)上表现优异，但基于轨迹衍生的风险评分在临床事件检测上弱于专用分类器，表明准确预测不代表校准的事件检测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床恶化是通过耦合的、部分可观测的轨迹展开的，而非单一诊断标签。现有方法多关注分类任务而忽视了轨迹本身的联合概率建模，缺乏对多变量生理信号之间相互依赖关系和缺失模式的系统性建模。

Method: 提出一个"轨迹优先"框架，核心组件包括：1)缺失感知的时间编码器处理部分观测数据；2)软器官系统先验编码生理信号间的先验关联；3)患者特定关系学习个体化模式；4)非线性Kolmogorov-Arnold消息传递捕获复杂交互；5)低秩多变量Student-t分布头用于联合概率预测。使用24小时历史预测未来6小时的多变量生理指标。

Result: 在6,882名患者、54,694个窗口的MIMIC-IV队列上，13个模型的评估中获得了第二低的归一化MAE(0.377±0.000)和最低的RMSE(0.527±0.000)。相对确定性TimeKAN降低MAE 0.52%。边际NLL为0.664，CRPS为0.273。经验覆盖率在名义50%/80%/95%区间上分别为0.533/0.831/0.958。移除关系结构导致最大消融损失。轨迹衍生的风险评分AUROC为0.603，弱于专用GRU-D分类器的0.650。

Conclusion: 联合轨迹预测是一个可检查的中间任务，能提供良好的点预测与概率预测性能，但准确的生理预测本身并不能保证校准好的事件检测器。这揭示了预测准确性与临床决策支持之间存在的鸿沟，提醒研究者需要在预测框架内显式设计事件检测能力。

Abstract: Clinical deterioration unfolds through coupled, partially observed trajectories, not a single diagnostic label. We introduce PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN, a trajectory-first framework for joint probabilistic forecasting of multivariate physiology. It combines missingness-aware temporal encoders, a soft organ-system prior, patient-specific relations, nonlinear Kolmogorov-Arnold messages, and a low-rank multivariate Student-t head. We evaluate 24-hour histories and six-hour forecasts on a frozen MIMIC-IV-derived cohort of 6,882 patients and 54,694 windows. Across five seeds and 13 models, PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN obtains the second-lowest normalized MAE (0.37727 +/- 0.00029) and the lowest RMSE (0.52656 +/- 0.00034). It reduces MAE by 0.52% relative to deterministic TimeKAN. For probabilistic forecasting, it reaches a marginal NLL of 0.66380 and a CRPS of 0.27301. Empirical coverage is 0.533, 0.831, and 0.958 for nominal 50%, 80%, and 95% intervals. Removing relational structure causes the largest ablation loss. Increasing covariance rank improves joint likelihood but has little effect on point accuracy. A trajectory-derived risk score remains weaker than a dedicated GRU-D classifier (AUROC 0.603 versus 0.650), which limits the present clinical claim. Joint trajectory forecasting therefore provides an inspectable intermediate task, but accurate physiology forecasts alone do not ensure a calibrated event detector.

</details>


### [743] [Does Splitting a Triage Decision Across Agents Hide Bias or Help Catch It? A Multi-Agent Simulation Study of LLM-Based Resource Allocation Under Audit Capacity Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06949)
*Paul-Peter Arslan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了将生死攸关的资源分配决策从单一LLM代理转移到角色分工的多代理流水线（评估、分配、独立审计）后，人口统计学偏见是否发生变化。通过在合成灾难分诊模拟器上运行192个情节（2,304个案例对），发现单代理与九代理流水线在偏见发生率上无显著差异（6.9% vs 6.1%），但审计容量对偏见被捕获有显著影响：30%的偏见结果完全未被检测，审计过载时升至43.8%，而将审计队列按风险重排序可将覆盖率从65.6%恢复到91.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究表明单个LLM在生死资源分配中存在人口统计学偏见，但实际部署通常使用带审查环节的多代理流水线。作者希望研究偏见在这种更贴近真实部署的多代理架构中如何表现，因为此类系统可能被设计为通过独立审计来降低偏见风险。

Method: 使用合成灾难分诊模拟器，创建除人口统计学属性外临床完全相同的成对案例。比较单代理控制条件与九代理流水线（含评估、分配、独立审计三个角色），在三个独立变化的压力维度下运行192个情节（2,304个解决案例对），并使用GPT-4o-mini。进行后续实验测试按估计风险而非先来先服务对审计队列排序的效果。

Result: 偏见发生率在两种条件下无显著差异（6.9% vs 6.1%，p=0.498）。但审计容量对偏见是否被捕获有显著影响：30%的偏见结果未被检测，审计过载时升至43.8%，未过载时降至18.4%。此效应主要由覆盖率驱动（过载时从100%降至65.6%，p<0.001）而非被审查案例上的判断质量退化。将审计队列改写为按风险排序可将覆盖率从65.6%恢复到91.7%（p=0.028）。

Conclusion: 向LLM代理流水线添加独立监督并不能消除偏见产生，但审计机制在捕获已发生的偏见中起关键作用，且其有效性主要受覆盖率的限制而非判断质量。在资源受限下，通过风险感知的队列排序可显著恢复审计覆盖率。作者诚实地报告了局限性：单一模型、样本量有限、无对抗性复制。

Abstract: Prior benchmarking work has shown that a single large language model (LLM), forced to make life-or-death resource-allocation decisions, exhibits measurable demographic bias. Real deployments, however, rarely use a single agent: they use pipelines, with review steps meant to catch exactly this kind of failure. We study what happens to bias when the same decision is distributed across a role-differentiated multi-agent pipeline (assessment, allocation, independent audit) instead of made and checked by one model alone. Using a synthetic disaster-triage simulator with paired cases that are clinically identical except for one demographic attribute, we run 192 episodes (2,304 resolved case pairs) on GPT-4o-mini comparing a single-agent control condition to a nine-agent pipeline under three independently varied pressure dimensions. We find no measurable difference in how often biased outcomes occur between the two conditions (6.9% vs. 6.1%, p = 0.498). We do find a large and significant effect of audit capacity on whether bias is caught: 30.0% of biased outcomes go entirely undetected, rising to 43.8% when the auditor is overloaded and falling to 18.4% when it is not. Decomposing this effect shows it is driven almost entirely by coverage (whether a case is reviewed at all, which collapses from 100.0% to 65.6% under load, p < 0.001) rather than by degraded judgment on the cases that are reviewed (81.6% vs. 85.7%, p = 1.000, direction reversed). A follow-up experiment shows that reordering the audit queue by estimated risk, rather than first-come-first-served, recovers most of the lost coverage under the same capacity constraint (65.6% to 91.7%, p = 0.028). We discuss the implications for any system that adds independent oversight to an LLM agent pipeline under resource constraints, and report the study's limitations honestly: one model, modest sample sizes, and no adversarial replication.

</details>


### [744] [SciLitBench: Benchmark and Design Principles for LLM-Powered Systematic Literature Reviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05505)
*Miguel Zabaleta,Baihan Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SciLitBench，一个覆盖标题摘要筛选、全文筛选和模式引导数据提取的多阶段系统综述基准，包含42,981条检索记录、1,012篇全文和888篇纳入论文的标注。通过对22个开源大语言模型的评估，发现明确纳入/排除标准可提升标题摘要筛选F2达28.8%，研究者撰写的理由使全文筛选提升15%；但数据提取可靠性显著下降，最强模型仅能恢复30%的评估证据和25%的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统综述需要在数千条记录中进行持续的人类判断，然而现有LLM评估通常孤立地研究各个综述阶段，缺乏能够真实反映整个综述流程的多阶段基准。

Method: 构建SciLitBench多阶段基准，涵盖标题与摘要筛选、全文筛选及模式引导的数据提取三个任务，收集42,981条检索记录、1,012篇全文和888篇纳入论文的标注，并在6个模型家族的22个开源权重LLM上进行系统评估。

Result: 明确纳入/排除标准使标题摘要筛选F2提升28.8%；研究者撰写的理由使全文筛选提升15%。数据提取表现差异巨大，出版年份准确率0.97但计算方法Jaccard重合度仅0.37；最强模型仅恢复30%的评估证据和25%的局限性。

Conclusion: SciLitBench揭示了高召回率筛选与证据完整提取之间的实际性能边界，为评估LLM辅助证据综合提供了可复现的资源，表明LLM在筛选阶段表现可靠但提取阶段存在显著瓶颈。

Abstract: Systematic reviews require sustained human judgment across thousands of records, yet existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) typically examine review stages in isolation. We introduce SciLitBench, a multi-stage benchmark spanning title and abstract screening, full-text screening, and schema-guided data extraction, with 42,981 retrieved records, 1,012 full texts, and annotations for 888 included papers. Across 22 open-weight LLMs from six model families, explicit inclusion and exclusion criteria improve title and abstract screening $F_2$ by 28.8\%, while researcher-authored rationales improve full-text screening by 15\%. Data extraction reveals a different reliability regime: performance declines from 0.97 accuracy for publication year to 0.37 Jaccard overlap for computational approach, while the strongest models recover only 30\% of annotated evaluation evidence and 25\% of limitations. SciLitBench identifies a practical boundary between high-recall screening and evidence-complete extraction and provides a reproducible resource for evaluating LLM-assisted evidence synthesis.

</details>


### [745] [The Failure Happens Before the Drift: The Social Dynamics of Values in LLM Agent Societies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05514)
*Farah Atif,Sougata Saha,Monojit Choudhury*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于World Values Survey（WVS）的模拟框架，让具有不同文化背景和沟通风格的LLM智能体进行纵向、涉及价值观的对话。通过约4000次对话、1200个人物设定、15个话题和三种模型（GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Gemma-4-E4B），评估了价值忠实度、价值漂移和对话真实性。研究发现超过50%的人物设定从一开始就无法表达其分配的WVS档案，2-7%在重复对话后发生漂移；去除人口统计细节虽能改善某些模型的忠实度，但无法改变整体趋势——模拟的价值分布仍系统性偏离分配的WVS档案。相比人类对话，模拟对话在风格一致性和语义多样性之间呈现不同的权衡，往往内容多样但风格重复。结论是当前LLM智能体虽能生成看似合理的对话，但在代表和长期保持多样化人类价值档案方面仍是有限的代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地被用作社会科学研究中人类参与者的替代品，但能否忠实地模拟人类社会多样且冲突的价值体系仍不清楚，这构成了研究的基本动机。作者希望检验LLM代理在价值观模拟方面的保真度和可靠性。

Method: 构建了基于World Values Survey（WVS）的模拟框架，涉及1200个人物设定、15个话题、三种不同规模/能力的模型（GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Gemma-4-E4B），进行约4000次对话实验。通过纵向对话测试价值忠实度（能否一开始就表达指定价值观）、价值漂移（重复对话后是否偏离）以及对话真实性。此外还进行了消融实验（去除人口统计细节）以检验其影响。

Result: 超过50%的人物设定从一开始就无法忠实表达分配的WVS价值档案；2-7%在重复对话后发生价值漂移。去除人口统计细节在部分模型上可改善忠实度，但整体上模拟价值分布仍系统性偏离WVS档案。与人类对话相比，模拟对话在风格一致性与语义多样性之间呈现不同权衡：内容多样但风格重复。

Conclusion: 当前LLM智能体虽然能够生成看似合理的对话，但在表征和长期保持多样化人类价值档案方面仍然是有限的代理工具，不能简单替代真实人类参与者用于价值观相关研究。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used as proxies for human participants in social science research, yet it remains unclear whether they can faithfully simulate diverse and conflicting human value systems. We present a World Values Survey (WVS)-grounded simulation framework where culturally diverse agents with different communication styles engage in longitudinal, value-laden discussions. Across approximately 4,000 conversations involving 1,200 personas, 15 topics, and three models (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Gemma-4-E4B), we evaluate value faithfulness, value drift, and conversational realism. We find that more than 50\% of personas fail to express their assigned WVS profiles from the outset, while 2-7\% drift after repeated conversations. Ablations removing demographic details improve faithfulness for some models but do not change the broader trend: simulated value distributions still systematically deviate from the assigned WVS profiles. Compared to human discussions, simulated dialogues show a different trade-off between stylistic consistency and semantic diversity, often producing content-wise varied but stylistically repetitive exchanges. These findings suggest that current LLM agents can generate plausible conversations, but remain limited proxies for representing and preserving diverse human value profiles over time.

</details>


### [746] [SCAFFOLD: Self-Improving Web Agents via Recursive Parametric Skill Abstraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05511)
*Bowei He,Xiaokun Zhang,Meng Ding,Xue Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Scaffold，一个自我改进的视觉Web智能体框架，通过参数化可执行技能、递归层次组合、最小描述长度准则压缩技能库以及周期性蒸馏回模型权重，实现了技能的有效累积与复用。在WebArena、VisualWebArena和Online-Mind2Web上比最强技能增强基线提升11.1-17.2个绝对成功率点，并在五次自我改进迭代中呈现单调增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Web智能体大多孤立学习每个任务，丢弃累积的程序性知识；虽然已有技能增强框架尝试改进，但将技能库视为扁平或两层提示端缓存，缺乏压缩冗余和递归组合技能的机制化手段。

Method: (i) 在多重实例抽象约束下，从成功轨迹中诱导参数化可执行技能；(ii) 维护递归构成的层次结构，高层技能调用低层技能；(iii) 通过最小描述长度(MDL)准则和行为等价性检查压缩技能库；(iv) 将技能增强的轨迹周期性地蒸馏回模型权重以内化抽象。

Result: 在WebArena、VisualWebArena及Online-Mind2Web的保留测试集上，较最强技能增强基线提升11.1-17.2绝对成功率点；五次自我改进迭代中成功率单调提升，未出现技能库崩溃。

Conclusion: Scaffold验证了通过递归技能组合与MDL压缩，能够实现视觉Web智能体的持续自我改进与程序性知识的内化，为技能增强型Web智能体提供了更系统的架构方案。

Abstract: Web agents need to navigate visually rich, long-horizon interfaces that change across sites, yet most previous agents still learn each task in isolation and discard the procedural knowledge they accumulate. Recent skill-augmented frameworks take an important first step, but they treat the skill library as a flat or two-tier prompt-side cache and offer no principled mechanism for compressing redundancy or composing skills recursively. We introduce \textsc{Scaffold}, a self-improving framework for visual web agents that (i) induces parametric, executable skills from successful trajectories under a multi-instance abstraction constraint, (ii) maintains a recursively composed hierarchy in which higher-level skills invoke lower-level ones, (iii) compacts the library via a minimum-description-length (MDL) criterion and behavioral equivalence checking, and (iv) periodically distills skill-augmented trajectories back into model weights to internalize the abstractions. Across WebArena, VisualWebArena, and a held-out split of Online-Mind2Web, \textsc{Scaffold} improves success rate by $11.1$--$17.2$ absolute points over the strongest skill-augmented baseline and shows monotonic gains across five self-improvement iterations without library collapse. We release the code and documents in the Github \href{https://github.com/BokwaiHo/SCAFFOLD}{repository}.

</details>


### [747] [Reasoning-Aware Compression: Identifying and Protecting Vulnerable Reasoning Circuits for Energy-Efficient LLM Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05512)
*Leonard Twagirayezu,Prasenjit Mitra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种推理感知的压缩框架，通过细粒度分析LRM中各模块对INT4量化的敏感性，选择性将最脆弱电路恢复为FP16，在五个推理基准上实现了优于均匀量化的帕累托最优压缩点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型(LRM)部署时能耗巨大，但现有压缩方法对所有组件采用均匀量化，可能破坏关键的推理电路。需要一种能识别并保护推理关键路径的压缩方法。

Method: 在五个推理基准上结合硬件级别GPU能量测量进行量化条件基准测试；通过扰动扫描对196-224个(layer, projection)组合进行逐模块INT4脆弱性画像，然后选择性将最敏感电路恢复为FP16。

Result: 三个发现：(1) INT4量化可能因延长推理链而增加能量，GSM8K上25%功耗降低反而变成净能量增加；(2) 脆弱性具有任务依赖性，数学推理中注意力投影更关键，逻辑推理中敏感性模式因架构而异；(3) 选择性压缩达到均匀方法无法企及的帕累托最优点：R1-Qwen-7B Top-10%在ProofWriter上比FP16提高12个百分点且能量降低9.7%。

Conclusion: 选择性压缩相比均匀量化能更有效地在推理性能和能耗之间取得平衡，该方法在五个推理基准的留出数据上均得到验证。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) impose substantial energy costs during deployment, yet current compression methods apply uniform quantization across all components, risking damage to critical reasoning circuits. We present a reasoning-aware compression framework that benchmarks quantization conditions across five reasoning benchmarks, GSM8K, FOLIO, MATH-500, ProofWriter, and MuSiQue, with hardware-level GPU energy measurement; profiles per-module INT4 vulnerability across all 196-224 (layer, projection) pairs via a perturbation sweep on a held-out calibration split, then selectively restores the most sensitive circuits to FP16. Three findings emerge. First, INT4 quantization can increase energy by extending reasoning chains; a 25% power reduction becomes a net energy increase on GSM8K. Second, vulnerability is task-dependent: attention projections are more critical for mathematical reasoning, and sensitivity patterns differ by architecture in logical inference. Third, selective compression achieves Pareto-optimal points inaccessible to uniform methods: R1-Qwen-7B Top-10% on ProofWriter gains +12 pp over FP16 at -9.7% energy, validated on held-out data across five reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [748] [EdgeMem: LLM-Free Agent Memory Construction and Retrieval via Evidence-Preserving Multi-Anchor Hypergraph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05553)
*Zeyang Cui,Jiannong Cao,Zhiyuan Wen,Bo Yuan,Junlan Feng,Shengyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EdgeMem是一种基于多锚点超图的智能体记忆方法，通过保留原始交互轮次并利用内容、时间、情节三种线索进行组织，避免LLM生成式压缩带来的信息丢失和额外开销。检索直接返回原始证据，LLM仅用于最终答案生成。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上表现优异，LoCoMo上达到最高严格评分61.01（对比58.70），且构建和检索无需生成式LLM调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆方法通常将交互历史压缩为摘要或LLM生成的表示，这存在两个问题：重复生成增加计算成本，且在未知未来查询需求前就可能丢弃包含答案的关键细节。因此需要一种无需生成式压缩、能完整保留原始信息的记忆方法。

Method: EdgeMem的核心原则是保留原始交互轮次，并通过内容、时间、情节三类互补线索对它们进行组织。具体实现采用多锚点超图结构（multi-anchor hypergraph），通过轻量级局部处理构建，无需生成式LLM调用。检索时直接返回来源证据，LLM仅在最终答案生成阶段被使用，实现结构化访问多会话历史与忠实保留原始对话的结合。

Result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S数据集上取得了强大的检索和基于记忆的问答性能。在LoCoMo上，在七个复现系统使用共享提示的条件下，EdgeMem获得了最高的严格裁判得分（61.01对比58.70）。同时，其构建和检索阶段不需要任何生成式LLM调用。

Conclusion: EdgeMem证明保留并组织原始证据（而非生成式记忆管理）为智能体记忆提供了有效且高效的夯实基础，在无需生成式LLM参与构建和检索的情况下实现了卓越的记忆问答性能。

Abstract: Agent memory allows LLM agents to use earlier interactions when answering new queries. Existing methods often compress interaction histories into summaries or other LLM-generated representations. Repeated generation adds cost and can discard answer-bearing details before the system knows what a future query will require. We propose EdgeMem, an agent-memory method built around a simple principle: preserve original interaction turns and organize them through complementary content, temporal, and episodic cues. EdgeMem realizes this principle with a multi-anchor hypergraph constructed by lightweight local processing. Retrieval directly returns source evidence and reserves LLM use for final answer generation, combining structured access to multi-session histories with faithful retention of the original conversation. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show strong retrieval and memory-grounded question answering; on LoCoMo, EdgeMem achieves the highest strict-judge score among seven reproduced systems under a shared prompt (61.01 versus 58.70), while construction and retrieval require no generative-LLM calls. Overall, EdgeMem shows that preserving and organizing source evidence provides an effective and efficient foundation for agent memory without generative memory management.

</details>


### [749] [When and What to Teach: Budget-Aware Online Adaptation for Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05513)
*Jianwei Zhang,Sihan Cao,Pengcheng Zheng,Ya Wen,Pei Ke,Kuien Liu,Shen Gao,Wei Dong,Yang Yang,Chaoning Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对Web智能体在线部署时需依赖轻量级本地模型并借助强教师模型进行在线教学的问题，提出了预算感知的轨迹修剪框架（Score-Guided Online Teaching with Budgeted Trajectory Trimming），通过可解性感知的教师门控决定何时查询教师，以及分数引导的回合选择机制决定保留哪些信息回合，在MiniWoB和TimeWarp上实现了与基准相当的首次通过成功率，同时平均减少22.6%的教师调用和52.1%的学生训练计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web智能体在真实环境部署需要持续在线适应，但部署强大的专有模型成本过高，因此需依赖轻量级本地模型并通过更强教师模型的在线教学进行后部署演化。然而标准的交互式反馈成本高昂，传统基于轨迹级别的偏好优化浪费预算在无法解决的回合和冗余的执行回合上。

Method: 提出预算感知框架，系统性地编排"何时教"和"教什么"：1) 集成了可解性感知的教师门控（solvability-aware teacher gate）来决定何时查询教师模型；2) 采用分数引导的回合选择机制（score-guided turn selection）决定保留哪些信息量大的训练回合，实现对轨迹的预算化修剪。

Result: 在MiniWoB和TimeWarp基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在保持与基线相当的首次通过成功率的同时，平均减少22.6%的教师调用次数和52.1%的学生训练计算量。

Conclusion: 通过预算感知的在线教学框架，可以有效降低Web智能体在线适应过程中教师模型调用和学生训练的计算成本，实现高效且经济可行的在线学习，代码已开源。

Abstract: Web agents have achieved significant success in automating complex internet tasks but deploying them in real-world environments requires continuous online adaptation. Given that deploying powerful proprietary models remains commercially cost-prohibitive, practitioners must rely on lightweight local models that evolve post-deployment via online teaching from a stronger teacher. However, standard interactive feedback imposes prohibitive costs. We show that conventional trajectory-level preference optimization wastes budget on both unresolvable episodes and redundant execution turns. To resolve these inefficiencies, we propose \textbf{Score-Guided Online Teaching with Budgeted Trajectory Trimming}, a budget-aware framework that systematically orchestrates \textbf{when} and \textbf{what} to teach. Specifically, our framework integrates a solvability-aware teacher gate to dictate \textbf{when} to query the teacher model and a score-guided turn selection mechanism to decide \textbf{what} informative turns to retain. Extensive experiments on MiniWoB and TimeWarp demonstrate that our method achieves comparable first-pass success while reducing teacher calls by 22.6\% and student training compute by 52.1\% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjw131f1fc/budgeted-online-teaching.

</details>


### [750] [What LLM Trading Agents Actually Do in Production: A Six-Month, Population-Scale Record from Two Fleets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05663)
*T. J. Barton,Chris Constantakis,Patti Hauseman,Annie Mous,Alaska Hoffman,Brian Bergeron,Hunter Goodreau*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文呈现了约六个月的、生产环境下的自主语言模型交易代理的大规模连续测量记录，覆盖DX Terminal Pro（3505个用户注资金库、真实ETH交易、21天）与DXAP实时alpha舰队（500-599个用户创建代理、Hyperliquid永续合约）。记录包含750万次单模型调用、约30万次链上操作及23.1万次多工具回合。四大核心发现：运行层对行为的决定性影响远超策略文本、仓位规模对波动性"失明"、代理几乎未捕获其触及的上行空间、两个舰队均无方向性优势。所有结论通过日聚类推断、排列零假设及共同费用重述检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管自主语言模型交易代理已投入生产，但其真实行为缺乏大规模、连续、种群级的测量记录。本文旨在用真实生产数据回答：这类代理的实际行为由什么驱动？它们能否盈利？它们的决策质量如何？从而为这一快速扩张但缺乏实证研究的领域建立基础性事实。

Method: 对两个同源设计体系的自主语言模型交易代理进行真实生产环境下的连续记录与测量，覆盖约六个月、750万次模型调用。通过固定效应模型（agent fixed effects）、断点回归（leaderboard top-3 cut的1.75x路由）、波动性分位分析、有利偏移分析（MAE/MFE）、配对回放联赛（416个生产场景）等方法进行统计分析。

Result: 四大发现：(1) 运行层（风险滑块、固定效应、排行榜渲染边界）对行为的解释力远超策略文本，风险滑块每级+0.425杠杆、固定效应吸收60%方差、排行榜前3名产生1.75x因果路由；(2) 仓位规模波动性失明——中位杠杆在所有波动性分位均为5.0x，单一姿态滑块单元（11%头寸）承担62%清算；(3) 上行捕获极低——43.2%仓位24h内达到+300bps以上有利偏移，但其中49.3%以负回报平仓，机械括号可挽回每仓位+39.0bps；(4) 无方向性优势——DXAP舰队不盈利且落后匹配零售基准（往返胜率41% vs 50%），前沿模型决策质量在统计上不可区分，但选择稳定性差异显著。

Conclusion: 自主语言模型交易代理在生产中的行为主要由运行层设计而非策略文本来驱动，它们在仓位规模管理与上行捕获方面存在系统性缺陷，且尚不具备方向性交易优势。论文以17条方法学准则收尾作为行业实践规范，并坦诚记录自身撤回经历，强调该领域需要更严谨的实证标准。

Abstract: We present a continuous, population-scale measurement record of autonomous language-model trading agents operating in production across two systems with one design lineage: DX Terminal Pro (3,505 user-funded vaults trading real ETH in Base memecoin markets for 21 days, February to March 2026) and the DXAP live alpha fleet (500 to 599 user-created agents all-history, 91 to 117 concurrently active, trading Hyperliquid perpetuals, June to August 2026). The record spans roughly six months, 7.5M single-model invocations with about 300K onchain actions, and a further 231,638 multi-tool turns producing 14,596 fills. Four findings carry the paper. First, the operating layer determines behavior more than anything written in strategy text: a risk slider explains leverage (+0.425 per level), agent fixed effects absorb 60% of variance, and a leaderboard render boundary causally routes selection (regression discontinuity 1.75x at the top-3 cut). Second, sizing is volatility-blind: median leverage is 5.0x in every volatility sextile, and one posture-slider cell (11% of the book) holds 62% of liquidations. Third, agents capture almost none of the upside they reach: 43.2% of positions saw at least +300 bps of favorable excursion within 24h, yet 49.3% of those closed with a negative trade return; a mechanical bracket recovers +39.0 bps per position. Fourth, neither fleet shows a directional edge. The DXAP fleet is not profitable and trails a matched Hyperliquid retail benchmark (41% vs. 50% roundtrip win rate). A paired-replay league of frontier models on 416 captured production scenarios finds decision quality statistically indistinguishable at this horizon, while choice stability differs sharply across model families. Every headline survives day-clustered inference, permutation nulls, and a common-fee restatement; the paper closes with a 17-rule methodology canon bought with our own retractions.

</details>


### [751] [CUSP: Decomposable Collective Uncertainty for Multi-Agent Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05708)
*Chung-En Johnny Yu,David Garcia,Brian Jalaian,Nathaniel D. Bastian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CUSP（Collective Uncertainty through Semantic Opinion Pooling），一个无需训练的、面向异构视觉-语言模型（VLM）集成的不确定性量化框架。该方法将多个VLM的响应映射到共享语义空间，池化为语义意见，并输出两个互补的系统级信号：集体不确定性和模型间冲突（JSD）。实验表明，在静态多模型集成中集体不确定性在小型模型场景表现最佳，JSD在商用模型场景最强；在多步多智能体系统中，集体不确定性也能有效检测系统失败与排序弃权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM集成虽能提升多模态推理能力，但单个模型的置信度或集成答案的置信度都无法衡量系统层面的可靠性。研究者希望提出一个能同时反映系统整体不确定性以及模型间分歧程度的框架，且不需要token logits或校准标签，适用范围广。

Method: CUSP框架包含三步：1) 将多个异构VLM的响应映射到共享的语义响应空间；2) 将这些语义响应池化为一个"池化语义意见"；3) 输出两个互补的信号：集体不确定性（池化意见的离散程度）和JSD（模型级意见间的冲突）。其中未归一化的集体熵可精确分解为各模型语义熵均值与JSD之和，从而将总离散度与模型冲突分离。

Result: 静态集成中：小模型场景下集体不确定性是最强信号（预测错误检测AUROC 0.764，弃权AUARC 0.889），优于多数投票与朴素选择基线4.7至15.8个百分点，且随集成规模增大优势扩大；商用模型场景下JSD最强（AUROC 0.819，AUARC 0.910），硬答案冲突排序AUROC最高0.982。池化预测精度较平均单模型提升5.6-13.0个百分点。多步多智能体系统中，子代理集体不确定性以AUROC 0.619超越随机检测系统失败，弃权排序AUARC为0.699居所有信号之首。

Conclusion: CUSP提供了一种无需训练、无需logits/校准标签的通用系统级不确定性框架，能有效量化多VLM集成的可靠性与模型冲突，同时提升预测精度，适用于开源与商用模型以及多智能体系统。

Abstract: Aggregating heterogeneous vision-language models (VLMs) can improve multimodal reasoning, but neither an individual model's confidence nor that of the aggregated answer measures reliability at the system level. We present CUSP (Collective Uncertainty through Semantic Opinion Pooling), a training-free uncertainty quantification framework that maps multiple VLM responses to a shared semantic response space, pools them into a pooled semantic opinion, and reports two complementary system-level signals: collective uncertainty, the dispersion of the pooled opinion, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD), the conflict among the model-level opinions. Within this pooled semantic opinion, the unnormalized collective entropy decomposes exactly into the mean of the models' individual semantic entropies and the JSD, separating total dispersion from model conflict. Requiring neither token logits nor calibration labels, CUSP applies to open-weight and commercial VLMs alike. In static multi-VLM ensembles, collective uncertainty is the strongest signal in the small-model regime (0.764 AUROC for prediction-error detection, 0.889 AUARC for abstention), outperforming uncertainty baselines majority voting and naive selection by 4.7 to 15.8 points and widening its margin as the ensemble grows; JSD is strongest in the evaluated commercial regime (0.819 AUROC, 0.910 AUARC) and ranks hard-answer model conflict with AUROC up to 0.982. The pooled prediction also improves accuracy over the average single model by 5.6 to 13.0 points. Over the full trajectory of a multi-step, multi-agent system, subagent collective uncertainty ranks system failures above chance (0.619 AUROC) and gives the best abstention ordering among the evaluated signals (0.699 AUARC).

</details>


### [752] [Beyond "AI Helps Humans": Decision-Targeted Evaluation Design for Human-Agent Teams in the Agentic Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05527)
*Hamed Khosravi,Xiaoming Huo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TEAM-Design规则，用于在有限回放预算下决定哪些任务应该接受仅人类回放、哪些应该接受仅智能体回放，以评估人-AI协作工作流是否优于两种替代方案（人类单独或智能体单独）。该规则根据缺失基线结果的可预测性和比较难度来分配回放概率，并已在6个临床场景和编码基准上进行了评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在人-AI协作工作流部署中，关键问题是判断该工作流是否同时优于"仅人类"和"仅智能体"两种基线方案。然而一旦部署，这两种替代结果不可观测，需要回放实验来恢复，而回放受限于预算。现有方法（智能体基准、方差采样、贝叶斯信息方法）均未直接针对这一决策问题进行设计。

Method: TEAM-Design为每个任务赋予两个回放概率（分别对应两个基线）。该规则在缺失基线结果难以从已知信息预测、或该比较更难确立时提高回放概率，在回放成本高时降低概率。作者证明了该规则能解决这一预算约束下的设计问题，并证明从记录概率中随机抽取回放仍能控制错误判定工作流优于两种替代方案的概率。

Result: 在6个临床场景（无人-AI工作流同时优于两种替代方案）和1个编码基准（存在优于两者的工作流）上进行了重新分析，并在合成设计和基于真实胸部X光阅片研究的半合成设计上评估。TEAM-Design在两种比较中一方明显更难判定时表现最佳，但在两种比较难度相近时可能劣于基于方差的分配方法。

Conclusion: TEAM-Design提供了一种针对部署决策的预算分配策略，其有效性与两种基线比较的不对称性密切相关。当比较难度差异明显时表现出色，而当比较难度相当时可能不如方差基准方法。

Abstract: Wherever a coding agent works under engineer supervision, or a clinical model assists a radiologist, the deployment question is whether to keep the human-AI workflow or replace it with the human alone or the agent alone. The human-AI workflow is worth keeping only if it beats both of those alternatives. Yet once it is deployed, neither alternative outcome is observed: recovering one means replaying the task under that alternative, and every replay costs expert time or compute. Under a fixed replay budget, the design question is therefore which tasks should be more likely to receive a human-only replay, and which an agent-only replay. Existing methods do not directly target this decision. Agent benchmarks do not choose which missing baseline to measure, variance-based sampling ignores which of the two comparisons is closer to failing, and Bayesian information methods focus on learning model parameters instead of making the deployment decision. We propose TEAM-Design, a rule that gives every task two replay probabilities, one per baseline. It raises a probability where the missing baseline outcome is hard to predict from what is already known about the task and where that comparison is harder to establish, and lowers it where replay is expensive. We prove that the rule solves this budgeted design problem, and that drawing the replays at random from recorded probabilities still controls the chance of wrongly declaring that the workflow beats both. We reanalyze 6 clinical settings, where no human-AI workflow beats both alternatives, and a coding benchmark, where one does, then evaluate TEAM-Design on synthetic designs and on a semi-synthetic design built from a real chest X-ray reader study. TEAM-Design works best when one of the two comparisons is clearly harder to settle than the other, and can do worse than variance-based allocation when the two are similarly difficult.

</details>


### [753] [Deep belief networks are exact](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05572)
*Gleb Smirnov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文证明任意定义在{-1,1}^n上的严格正概率分布都可以通过有限参数的sigmoid置信网络精确表示，回答了Sutskever和Hinton提出的开放性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sutskever和Hinton此前提出了一个开放性问题：sigmoid置信网络是否能够精确表示任意严格正概率分布？此前只知道近似表示的结果，精确表示的结论未知。

Method: 将Sutskever和Hinton的概率共享近似方法升级为精确表示，利用Brouwer不动点定理完成证明。

Result: 证明了所有{-1,1}^n上的严格正概率分布都可以由有限参数的sigmoid置信网络精确表示。

Conclusion: 该结果回答了Sutskever和Hinton的开放问题，表明sigmoid置信网络在精确表示任意严格正布尔分布方面具有完全的表示能力。

Abstract: We prove that every strictly positive probability distribution on \(\{-1,1\}^n\) is represented exactly by a sigmoid belief network with finite parameters. This answers a question of Sutskever and Hinton. The proof upgrades their probability-sharing approximation to exact representation using Brouwer's fixed-point theorem.

</details>


### [754] [Time-Varying Data as Sheaves: an Invitation to Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09056)
*Wilmer Leal,Benjamin Merlin Bumpus,Jana K. Nickel,Johan García,James Fairbanks,Warren Dixon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了"叙事理论"（theory of narratives），一个用于建模任意数学类型时变对象的抽象框架，并通过三个案例分别探讨了时变数据表示间的信息损失、时变数据的系统分解与不变量、以及控制理论中多智能体系统在切换通信拓扑下的建模问题。核心观点是：一个合适的抽象视角能够组织和引导跨越多样数学与科学领域的研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代科学与工程日益依赖时变数据，但用于建模时间现象的数学工具通常在不同的学科中独立发展，导致共同原理被遮蔽，跨领域的思想迁移受到限制。作者希望提供一个统一框架来弥合这一差距。

Method: 本文提出叙事理论（theory of narratives）作为时变对象的抽象框架，并通过三个"小插图"（vignettes）展示其应用：(1) 分析不同时间数据表示之间切换时的信息损失；(2) 系统地将时变数据分解为简单组件并获取描述结构复杂度的不变量；(3) 将框架应用于控制理论，建模具有切换通信拓扑的多智能体系统。

Result: 三个案例分别展示了叙事理论在信息损失量化、结构分解与不变量提取、以及多智能体控制系统建模方面的可行性，共同佐证了该抽象框架的普适性和实用性。

Conclusion: 叙事的核心信息是：合适的抽象视角能够组织和引导跨越数学与科学各个不同领域的研究，其价值远超任何单一的具体应用成果。

Abstract: Modern science and engineering increasingly rely on time-varying data, yet the mathematical tools used to model temporal phenomena are often developed within separate disciplines, obscuring common principles and limiting the transfer of ideas across fields. This chapter presents the theory of narratives, an abstract framework for time-varying objects of any mathematical kind that supports both theoretical investigations and applications. To illustrate this perspective, the chapter develops three vignettes, each illustrating a different research direction. The first addresses a general concern: What information loss can occur when switching between different representations of temporal data?
