Method: 采用横断面调查设计，收集零售、医疗、IT和电信四个行业的100名参与者数据。使用Spearman相关系数和有序逻辑回归（IBM SPSS）进行分析，并通过Hayes PROCESS Model 4（5000次bootstrap抽样）进行平行中介分析。

Result: 双变量相关性弱且不显著（r<0.19, p>0.06）。回归分析发现CRM（beta=0.717, p=0.002）和CKM（beta=0.581, p=0.009）是CE的显著正向预测因子，MDM直接效应为正但不显著（beta=0.346, p=0.071）。模型解释了CE方差的20.5%（Nagelkerke R²=0.205）。中介分析未发现MDM通过CRM或CKM对CE的显著间接效应，H4假设未获支持。

Conclusion: CRM和CKM是CRI框架中驱动客户参与的核心因素，MDM则作为基础性数据质量赋能者，其战略价值需通过支撑CRM执行和知识管理来实现。鉴于样本量和横断面设计限制，研究结论应视为探索性发现，未来需在更大样本和纵向设计中验证，尤其是在受数据治理规定约束的BFSI领域。

Abstract: This study examines how Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Master Data Management (MDM), and Customer Knowledge Management (CKM) jointly constitute a Customer Relationship Intelligence (CRI) framework for enhanced Customer Engagement (CE). A cross-sectional survey of 100 participants across retail, healthcare, IT, and telecommunications sectors was analysed using Spearman rho correlation and ordinal logistic regression (IBM SPSS). Bivariate correlations were weak and non-significant (r<0.19, p>0.06). Regression identified CRM (beta=0.717, p=0.002) and CKM (beta=0.581, p=0.009) as significant positive predictors of CE; MDM showed a positive but non-significant direct effect (beta=0.346, p=0.071). The model explained 20.5% of CE variance (Nagelkerke R^2=0.205). Parallel mediation analysis (Hayes PROCESS Model 4, 5,000 bootstrap samples) found no significant indirect effects of MDM on CE via CRM (IE=0.021, 95% BC CI [-0.072, 0.121]) or CKM (IE=0.032, 95% BC CI [-0.061, 0.126]); Hypothesis H4 was not supported. CRM and CKM emerge as the principal drivers of CE within the CRI framework, while MDM functions as a foundational data quality enabler whose strategic value is realised through its enabling effect on CRM execution and knowledge management. Findings should be treated as exploratory given the sample size and cross-sectional design. Future research should replicate with larger sector-specific samples and longitudinal designs, particularly in regulated BFSI contexts where MDM architecture is shaped by data governance mandates.

</details>


### [791] [SCIRIGOR:Evaluating Open-Ended Scientific Analysis Beyond Final Scores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06192)
*Bowen Liu,Shuo Nie,Bodong Du,Xiaomeng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SciRIGOR框架和基准，用于评估科学编码智能体的证据支撑多模态科学分析能力。基准包含100个来自6个领域17个子领域的科学文章案例，通过重建类型化证据图，将工件保真度与关系有效性分离，并评估完整的claim-support路径。对11种agent/模型配置的评估显示，没有系统在软证据链分数上超过62.6%，严格全链成功率仅18.0%，表明内部一致性不等于科学正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学编码智能体产生相互依赖的代码、结果、图表和声明，但仅评估最终输出无法确定其结论是否真正被科学证据支持。现有评估方法忽略了对从数据到声明完整链条的验证。

Method: 作者设计了SciRIGOR评估框架：(1) 从科学文章中构建100个案例的重建证据图；(2) 将工件（artifact）保真度与关系（relational）有效性分离评估；(3) 对完整的claim-support路径进行评分，并定位最早的不支持关系；(4) 使用源真实备选路径来兼容科学上等价的分析与可视化方案。

Result: 在11种agent/模型配置的完整基准测试中，声明与忠实和不忠实结果的一致性率几乎相同（91.8%对比91.0%），但没有任何系统超过62.6%的软证据链分数或18.0%的严格全链成功率。

Conclusion: 内部一致性并不能证明科学正确性：评估必须沿着从数据到声明的完整路径验证支持关系。这揭示了当前科学编码智能体在科学推理方面存在重大不足，需要更严格的评估范式。

Abstract: Scientific coding agents produce interdependent code, results, figures, and claims, yet evaluating final
  outputs alone does not establish whether their conclusions are scientifically supported. We formulate
  evidence-grounded multimodal scientific analysis, requiring agents to produce executable analyses and claims
  supported by results and visualizations from the same run. We introduce SciRIGOR, an evaluation framework and
  benchmark comprising 100 cases from scientific articles across six domains and 17 subfields. The framework
  reconstructs typed evidence graphs, separates artifact fidelity from relational validity, and scores complete
  claim-support paths while localizing the earliest unsupported relation. Source-grounded alternative paths
  accommodate scientifically equivalent analyses and visualizations. We evaluate 11 agent/model configurations.
  On full-benchmark runs, claims agree with faithful and unfaithful results at nearly identical rates (91.8%
  versus 91.0%). Yet no system exceeds 62.6% on the soft evidence-chain score or 18.0% strict whole-chain
  success. These findings show that internal coherence does not establish scientific correctness: evaluation
  must verify support along the complete data-to-claim path.

</details>


### [792] [Predicting Wind Turbine Power Using Machine Learning and Weather Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06194)
*Khivishta Boodhoo,Isaac Triguero,Josh Plumbly,Bruce Nicolson,Nicholas Watson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究开发了线性回归和人工神经网络（ANN）模型来预测海上风力涡轮机的功率输出，仅使用天气条件数据以增强适用性。研究了数据量、特征选择和数据预处理的影响。ANN模型表现最佳（R²=0.98，MAE=194），优于基线模型（R²=0.94，MAE=441），且利用附近气象站的独立天气数据集实现跨涡轮机迁移应用，并能识别低功率时段以优化维护调度，每次维护可节省约2000kW。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海上风力涡轮机的维护会导致强制停机从而降低发电效率，准确的功率预测有助于识别低功率时段进行维护排程。然而，数据量、特征选择和数据预处理对功率预测模型性能的影响尚未被充分研究，且现有模型在不同涡轮机之间的可迁移性有限。

Method: 开发了一个线性回归基线模型用于性能对比，以及更复杂的人工神经网络（ANN）模型来预测风力涡轮机的功率输出。仅使用天气条件作为输入以增强可应用性。研究了多种数据预处理技术，并分别用一个月和一年的数据训练模型以考察数据量和预处理的影响。使用随机森林回归器进行特征选择。

Result: ANN模型提供了最高的预测精度，R²分数为0.98，平均绝对误差低至194，优于基线模型（R²=0.94，MAE=441）。模型性能与过往研究相当，且利用附近气象站的独立天气数据集，可推广到不同位置的风力涡轮机。ANN模型成功识别了2个月内4小时的低功率预测时段，每次维护事件可节省约2000kW的功率输出。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了基于天气条件的ANN模型可用于风力涡轮机功率预测及维护调度优化，虽未超越过往研究的性能范围，但独特的优势在于使用附近气象站的独立数据集，实现了对类似风力涡轮机的跨位置可迁移性，为未来实际应用提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Offshore wind turbines are widely used to generate renewable energy, but their maintenance can result in decreased efficiency due to forced shutdowns. Accurate wind turbine power predictions can identify periods of low power that would be ideal for scheduling maintenance. However, the effects of data volume, feature selection, and data preprocessing on the performance of such power prediction models have not been thoroughly studied. Besides, current models have limited transferability between different wind turbines. Therefore, this study developed a baseline Linear Regression for performance comparison with a more complex Artificial Neural Network model to predict the power output of a wind turbine, using weather conditions only to enhance applicability. A range of data preprocessing techniques were studied, and models were trained on one month and one year of data to determine the effects of data preprocessing and volume on model performance. Feature selection was explored using a Random Forest Regressor. The best results from the different models showed that the Artificial Neural Network models provided the highest accuracy, with an R2 score of 0.98 and a low Mean Absolute Error of 194, when compared with the baseline model (R2 score of 0.94 and Mean Absolute Error of 441). The model performance is comparable to the range of results in past studies, with the advantage that the proposed method leverages a separate weather dataset from a nearby weather station, enabling future applications for similar wind turbines in different locations. The Artificial Neural Network model was then used to identify 4-h periods of low power predictions over 2 months (simulating application for future periods), providing power output savings of approximately 2000 kW for each maintenance event.

</details>


### [793] [AutoKD: Autonomous Knowledge Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06366)
*Qinwen Ge,Bo Ni,Haowei Fu,Ngoc N. Tran,Erik Blasch,Tyler Derr*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoKD是一个基于LLM多智能体的自主知识发现框架，它能够进行计算化和累积性的科学发现，通过将已验证的发现持久化到洞察图中，实现开放式探索循环和后续研究引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据密集型领域的科学发现受限于人类带宽，数据增长远超人类阅读、推理和综合的速度。现有的LLM多智能体系统虽能自动化部分研究流程，但存在两个局限：一是验证环节无法自动化，二是每次运行是一次性的，缺乏发现结果累积和引导后续研究的机制。

Method: AutoKD由六个协调的LLM智能体组成协作的开放式发现循环。核心创新在于：被接受的发现被存储在持久的"洞察图"（insight graph）中，该图同时充当长期记忆和探索导向机制，使验证过的发现能够持续存在并引导后续研究。

Result: 在三个不同数据集上从两个角度进行评估：一是开放式质量（与已发表发现对比），二是条件质量（通过文献衍生查询评估）。结果表明AutoKD能够覆盖已知发现，并发现补充人类驱动研究的实质性新发现。

Conclusion: AutoKD证明了计算化和累积性的自主知识发现是可行的，能够在一定程度上缓解人类带宽对科学发现速度的约束，实现与人类研究互补的发现能力。

Abstract: Scientific discovery in data-rich domains is currently constrained by human bandwidth: the growth in the volume and complexity of real-world data far outpaces the rate at which researchers can read, reason, and synthesize. Recent LLM-based multi-agent systems have begun to automate portions of the research cycle, but they target hypothesis generation in settings where validation cannot itself be automated, and each run is one-shot, with no mechanism for findings to accumulate or steer subsequent inquiry. This paper introduces AutoKD, a multi-agent framework for autonomous knowledge discovery that is both computational and cumulative, allowing validated findings to persist and inform subsequent inquiry. Six coordinated LLM agents collaborate in an open-ended discovery loop, where accepted findings are stored in a persistent insight graph that serves as both long-term memory and an exploration-steering mechanism. We evaluate AutoKD on three diverse datasets from two perspectives: Open-ended Quality against published findings, and Conditioned Quality via literature-derived queries. Across both evaluation perspectives, AutoKD covers known findings and surfaces substantive discoveries that complement human-driven research. Our code is available at https://github.com/GeQinwen/AutoKD.

</details>


### [794] [Building Trustworthy Graph-Agentic RAG for Social Good: Architectures, Failure Propagation, and Assurance by Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06391)
*Vijay Bommireddy,Raviteja Bommireddy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了图代理检索增强生成（Graph-agentic RAG）在公共利益场景下的设计与评估框架，提出了"证据到行动"的故障链分析与"契约式保障"建设蓝图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图代理RAG系统结合了结构化证据与自适应控制器，在涉及跨文档、实体、时间或机构关系的场景中很有价值，但其耦合的故障路径可能导致图构建缺陷传播为检索证据并影响后续控制决策。在注重新鲜度、授权、可追溯性、监督和补救的社会公益应用中，需要系统的设计与评估方法。

Method: 论文按图基质、图生命周期、代理功能、协调模式和权威边界五个维度组织文献，区分了基于图的检索与依赖观测的图控制。进而将报告的风险综合为"证据到行动的故障链"，并提出"按构造保证"蓝图，包含五项接口契约（证据、检索、推理、能力与委派、结果），使溯源、时间有效性、授权、不确定性和可恢复性在系统边界处显式化。

Result: 提供了一个公益信息设计的示例来展示该框架如何约束图结构、权限、弃权机制和操作权威。同时推导了一个覆盖图断言、轨迹、声明、协调和结果的评估议程。

Conclusion: 该框架通过将溯源、时间有效性、授权、不确定性及可恢复性显式化于系统边界，为图代理RAG系统在公共利益场景中提供了"按构造保证"的蓝图，兼顾答案质量之外的新鲜度、授权、可追溯性、监督与补救等关键考量。

Abstract: Graph-agentic retrieval-augmented generation combines structured evidence with adaptive controllers that can plan retrieval, traverse relations, verify intermediate claims, delegate subtasks, and use tools. This combination is useful when answers depend on relations across documents, entities, time, or institutions, but it also creates coupled failure paths: a defect in graph construction can become retrieved evidence, alter later control decisions, and propagate toward a consequential outcome. We examine how such systems should be designed and evaluated for social-good settings in which freshness, authorization, traceability, oversight, and recourse matter alongside answer quality. We organize the literature by graph substrate, graph lifecycle, agent function, coordination pattern, and authority boundary, and distinguish graph-based retrieval from observation-dependent graph control. We then synthesize reported risks as an evidence-to-action failure chain and propose an assurance-by-construction blueprint comprising five interface contracts for evidence, retrieval, reasoning, capability and delegation, and outcome. These contracts make provenance, temporal validity, authorization, uncertainty, and recoverability explicit at system boundaries. An illustrative public-benefit information design shows how the framework constrains graph structure, permissions, abstention, and operating authority. Finally, we derive an evaluation agenda spanning graph assertions, trajectories, claims, coordination, and outcomes.

</details>


### [795] [From Concentration to Differentiation and Back: Routing Effective Rank in MoE Reasoning Cohorts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06403)
*Kang Chen,Sihan Zhao,Yixin Cao,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出路由有效秩（routing effective rank, deff）作为无标签诊断指标，用于衡量MoE模型推理过程中多rollout内部计算的组织结构。在十个MoE配置和五个基准上，deff呈现可复现的"低-高-低"轨迹（98.5%的3125个队列成立），并通过精确分解将轨迹归因于共性模式质量迁移（约2/3）与残差谱维度（约1/4）。推理努力（token预算加倍）将峰值延迟2.59个八度并扩展高秩期，其效应体现在时机与时长而非峰值幅度上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时扩展产生大量推理rollout，但目前缺乏标准的无标签方法衡量推理展开过程中内部计算如何重组。理解MoE推理队列的分化与再集中机制对可解释性和推理质量控制至关重要。

Method: 基于MoE专家路由相似性构建跨rollout图，引入熵有效维度（entropy-effective dimensionality）即deff来度量该图的维度。进行精确分解，将队列级共性模式质量与残差谱维度分离；通过跨架构比较和推理预算调控来分析轨迹时序与幅度。

Result: deff在98.5%的3,105个模型-问题队列中呈现低-高-低轨迹，峰值时机随架构与推理努力系统变化。共性模式再分配占轨迹约2/3，残差谱贡献约1/4。非一致队列中，共性模式聚焦度提升可预测同答案可恢复性；推理努力将峰值延迟2.59个八度并一致扩展高秩期，但峰值幅度不变。

Conclusion: 路由有效秩提供了一种可分解、无标签的谱学视角，将MoE推理队列的结构监测与答案选择分离，精确定位推理努力效应在于时序与时长而非峰值幅度，为理解MoE推理队列的分化和再集中建立了原则性诊断框架。

Abstract: Test-time scaling produces cohorts of reasoning rollouts, yet there is no standard label-free account of how their internal computation reorganizes as inference unfolds. We introduce routing effective rank deff, the entropy-effective dimensionality of a cross-rollout graph built from MoE expert-routing similarity. Across ten MoE configurations and five math/science benchmarks, deff exhibits a reproducible low-high-low trajectory, with a prominent interior maximum in 98.5% of 3,105 model-question cohorts: routing similarity is concentrated early, maximally differentiated at intermediate budgets, and reconcentrated later, and the timing of this maximum varies systematically with architecture and reasoning effort. An exact decomposition separates cohort-wide common-mode mass from residual spectral dimensionality: common-mode reallocation accounts for about two thirds of the trajectory, while the residual spectrum contributes about one quarter and retains substantial variation beyond the common mode. The decomposition further localizes behavior: among non-unanimous cohorts, increases in common-mode concentration strongly predict same-answer recoverability, and higher reasoning effort delays the maximum by 2.59 octaves (doublings of the token budget) and consistently expands the high-rank period across all four tested architectures, locating the effort effect in timing and duration rather than peak amplitude. Correctness comparisons separate structural monitoring from answer selection, positioning routing effective rank as a decomposable, label-free diagnostic of cohort organization - a principled spectral lens on how MoE reasoning cohorts differentiate and reconcentrate over inference time.

</details>


### [796] [Causal Attribution for Agentic Decisions: Estimators, Coupling, and a Traceability Specification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06445)
*Ajay Pravin Mahale*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对高风险AI系统（特别是Agentic系统）的可追溯性记录规范问题，提出估计量框架并分析其在事后因果归因中的失效条件。作者区分了边际总效应与共同随机数总效应，并引入固定下游的自然直接效应。研究发现两种估计量均以相同方向失效：在边际估计量下，因果惰性步骤与决定性步骤具有相同的总效应（代数恒等式）；在共同随机数下，决定性步骤在约十分之一的翻转运行中总效应恰好为零，但其直接效应为0.25且实际发挥作用。作者推导了保持直接效应可估计的耦合方法及其退化闭式解，并揭示在抑制情形下介导份额会超过1，使基于自然排序的方法失效。此外，论文发布的是预注册而非实验结果（因研究窗口内缺少实时管线），但贡献了符合欧盟AI法案第86条（2026年8月2日生效）与第12条/附件IV（2027年12月2日延迟生效）时间差的追溯性规范。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险AI系统提供者必须保存使决策可追溯的记录，但对于Agentic系统，尚不清楚记录应包含什么内容才能实现事后因果归因。欧盟AI法案造成了时间缺口：第86条的解释权于2026年8月2日已生效，而能为此提供证据的第12条日志记录和附件IV文档却被推迟至2027年12月2日。这一法规日历差距促使研究者需要明确追溯性规范的具体要求。

Method: 提出估计量框架，区分边际总效应与共同随机数总效应两种估计目标；引入固定下游下的自然直接效应；通过手工推导验证估计量；构造"种植链"（planted chain）实验场景，对比因果惰性步骤与决定性步骤的行为；推导保持直接效应可估计的耦合方法及其退化闭式表达式；分析介导份额在抑制情形下的性质。

Result: 两种估计量均以相同方向失效：在边际估计量下，因果惰性步骤与决定性步骤的总效应在所有运行上完全相同（代数恒等式而非偶然）；在共同随机数下，决定性步骤在执行步骤翻转的运行（约十分之一）上总效应精确为零，而其直接效应为0.25且明显发挥作用，证明精确零不表示步骤无作用。直接与介导路径相悖（抑制）时，介导份额超过1，将受抑组件排在纯介导者之上。

Conclusion: 现有因果归因估计量在Agentic系统的可追溯性记录需求上存在系统性缺陷，不能作为事后归因的可靠基础。由于实时管线不可用，论文以预注册形式发布实验设计而非结果，并基于此贡献了弥合欧盟AI法案追溯时间差的规范化文件规范，为后续合规实现提供必需的标准。

Abstract: A provider of a high-risk AI system must keep records that make a decision traceable, and for agentic systems it has not been established what those records must contain for post-hoc causal attribution to be possible. We give the estimator framework and then the conditions under which it fails. We separate the marginal total effect that prior work measures from a common-random-numbers total effect that isolates a step's own contribution, add the natural direct effect under a pinned downstream, and check the estimators against hand derivations. Both estimands then fail, in the same direction. Under the marginal estimand a causally inert step has the identical total effect to the decisive one on every run of our planted chain, an algebraic identity and not a coincidence at one draw. Under common random numbers the decisive step returns exactly zero on the runs where the executing step flips, about one in ten, while its direct effect there is 0.25 and it demonstrably acts; an exact zero does not certify that a step did nothing, and we put that here rather than in the limitations. We derive the coupling that keeps the direct effect estimable once contexts diverge, with a closed form for its degradation, and show that the mediated share on which a natural ranking is built is not a share under suppression: where the direct and mediated paths oppose, it exceeds one and ranks a suppressed component above a pure mediator. We publish the discrepancy experiment's pre-registration rather than a result, because the live pipeline it requires was not available in the study window. We contribute the traceability specification such a filing would need, against a gap the Act's calendar opens: Article 86's right to an explanation has applied since 2 August 2026, while the Article 12 logging and Annex IV documentation that could evidence one were deferred to 2 December 2027 by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.

</details>


### [797] [A Unified Policy Architecture (UPA): The Governance Kernel for Enterprise AI Operating Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06543)
*Prabhu Raghav,Balamurugan Pandi,Arul Vivek,Shek Mohammed,Sridhar S*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出统一政策架构（UPA），作为企业AI操作系统的治理架构，为自主AI代理、工具、工作流、记忆、企业资源及代理间交互提供统一的治理模型，将政策控制扩展到运行时义务、人工审批、合规、审计证据和治理评估等方面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业AI正演变为企业操作系统，其中自主AI代理能够规划、推理、使用记忆、调用工具、执行工作流并与其他代理协作。现有授权、安全、护栏和合规机制碎片化，未以统一系统的方式治理自主AI，形成新的治理挑战。

Method: UPA提供了统一政策模型，涵盖治理AI和代理、工具、工作流、记忆、企业资源及代理间交互和企业业务规则。包括声明式政策语言基础、政策评估语义、可扩展插件、行业政策包和企业治理评估框架。

Result: 提出了UPA作为企业AI操作系统的治理架构，将政策控制从单纯授权扩展到运行时义务、人工审批、合规、审计证据和治理评估，并识别了多代理协调、溯源感知政策和有状态运行时治理的扩展方向。

Conclusion: UPA为构建安全、可问责、可治理的自主AI企业操作系统提供了基础。

Abstract: Enterprise AI is evolving into an Enterprise Operating System where autonomous AI agents can plan, reason, use memory, invoke tools, execute workflows, and collaborate with other agents. This shift creates a new governance challenge: existing authorization, security, guardrails, and compliance mechanisms are fragmented and are not designed to govern autonomous AI as a unified system.
  This paper introduces the Unified Policy Architecture (UPA), a governance architecture for Enterprise AI Operating Systems. UPA provides a unified policy model for governing AI and agents, tools, workflows, memory, enterprise resources, and agent-to-agent interactions and enterprise business rules. It extends policy control beyond authorisation to include runtime obligations, human approvals, compliance, audit evidence, and governance evaluation.
  We present UPA's governance model, declarative policy language foundations, policy evaluation semantics, extensible plugins, industry policy packs, and an evaluation framework for enterprise governance. We also identify extensions for multi-agent coordination, provenance-aware policies, and stateful runtime governance. UPA provides a foundation for building secure, accountable, and governable Enterprise Operating Systems for autonomous AI.

</details>


### [798] [MARBO: Relational Belief Grounding for LLM Agents in Social Deduction Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06563)
*Hwang Yechan,Bae Sangjun,Kim Jeongmo,Bang Sangwoo,Han Seungyul*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MARBO框架，一种基于关系信念的偏好优化方法，用于社交推理游戏中使紧凑型大语言模型智能体在不确定条件下做出策略一致的行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的LLM智能体方法通过提示和偏好优化提升游戏表现，但没有显式地将动作与游戏内言论锚定在关系信念之上，导致策略上不一致的行为，尤其在紧凑型LLM智能体中尤为突出。

Method: MARBO是一种信念锚定的偏好优化框架，利用关于隐藏角色和团队阵营的关系信念来引导策略决策与游戏内言论；仅在行为由可靠的关系信念支撑且产生策略上有利的社会结果时提供偏好反馈。

Result: 在代表性社交推理游戏上的实验表明，MARBO使紧凑型LLM智能体持续优于现有基线。

Conclusion: 通过信念锚定的偏好优化，可有效提升紧凑型LLM智能体在社交推理游戏中的策略一致性与整体表现。

Abstract: Social deduction games (SDGs) require agents to reason under partial observability by maintaining relational beliefs about hidden roles and team alignments. While recent LLM-agent approaches improve gameplay through prompting and preference optimization, they often optimize actions and in-game speech without explicitly grounding them in such beliefs. This frequently leads to strategically inconsistent behavior, especially for compact LLM agents. We introduce Multi-Agent Relational Belief Optimization (MARBO), a belief-grounded preference optimization framework that leverages relational beliefs to guide strategic decisions and in-game speech. MARBO provides preference feedback only when behaviors are supported by reliable relational beliefs and lead to strategically favorable social outcomes, encouraging more consistent learning under uncertainty. Experiments on representative SDGs show that MARBO enables compact LLM agents to consistently outperform existing baselines. The Code is available on https://github.com/PleaseTakemeAway/MARBO.

</details>


### [799] [A Translational Note on AI Safety Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06573)
*Madhava Gaikwad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 近期研究表明自动化红队比人类红队能发现更多漏洞且成本更低，但作者指出这一比较存在方法论上的混淆：基准测试衡量的是对预定危害集的搜索彻底性，而非对人类评估者能力的全面评价。作者提出"威胁模型覆盖缺口"概念，并论证需要部署情境不同于开发者的评估者来弥补这一缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反驳"自动化红队使人类评估者变得多余"的结论。作者指出该结论基于对评估目标的错误测量——基准只衡量预定义危害集内的搜索效率，无法覆盖基准之外的新危害（如非英语提示中的危害）。

Method: 借鉴学术密码学和临床试验中的类似盲点（内部有效性≠外部覆盖），提出"威胁模型覆盖缺口"概念，并以当前开源权重模型的非英语提示危害为例进行论证。

Result: 在当前的开放权重模型中确认了覆盖缺口确实存在——英语基准无法发现非英语提示中浮现的危害。

Conclusion: 需要部署情境不同于开发者的人类评估者来弥补威胁模型覆盖缺口，这基于方法论上的覆盖率论证，而现有的评估框架本身无法自发产生这类评估者。

Abstract: Recent studies report that automated red-teaming finds more vulnerabilities, at lower cost, than human red-teaming on standard AI safety benchmarks, and some read this as evidence that human evaluators are becoming dispensable. The comparison measures one thing and the conclusion claims another. A benchmark measures how thoroughly an attacker searches a predefined set of harms, fixed in advance by the developers, and a harm left out of that set is invisible to any attacker working inside it, automated or not. The same blind spot appeared in academic cryptography and in clinical drug trials, where an evaluation that was internally valid stayed silent about the population it was never pointed at. We call the AI-safety version the \emph{threat-model coverage gap}, and find that it persists in a current open-weight model, where harms surface in non-English prompts that English benchmarks miss. Closing it requires evaluators whose deployment context differs from the developers'. The case for those evaluators is methodological, grounded in coverage, and the existing evaluation frame is unlikely to produce them on its own.

</details>


### [800] [SerenAI: State-transition system inspired by text-based world AI models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06647)
*Elvin Babayev,Artem Sinitsa,Arash Hajisharifi,Kabir Bakhshaei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SerenAI系统，这是一个受世界模型启发的状态转换系统，旨在为审计不可约束的自由文本生成提供可验证的预测而非纯文本输出。通过两阶段适应训练（参数高效微调+基于验证器的强化学习），在50,000个因果示例上进行训练，相较8B开源基线在结构化输出、因果增量、状态转换等指标上有显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专业工作流程虽广泛使用大语言模型，但在法律、运营或财务等要求严格的工作流中，解释不可约束的自由文本生成通常是不可行的。现有LLM生成的自由文本难以满足专业工作流对可审计性和可验证性的要求，因此需要一种能输出可验证预测而非纯文本的系统。

Method: SerenAI是一个状态转换系统，输入环境描述、状态和动作后输出四项内容：因果增量、逻辑上可推导的下一状态、有效性奖励和终止信号。训练采用两阶段适应：先进行参数高效微调（PEFT），再进行基于验证器的强化学习（RL），在50,000个因果示例（覆盖12个环境、10个推理领域）上训练。

Result: 与8B开源权重基线相比：JSON有效性从85.0%提升至93.2%，模式有效性从55.0%提升至84.0%，精确结构化输出匹配从0.0%提升至41.5%，因果增量精确匹配从0.0%提升至41.5%，结果状态精确匹配从0.0%提升至42.0%，奖励精确匹配从1.0%提升至80.5%，终止精确匹配从38.0%提升至81.5%。

Conclusion: 支持验证器兼容适应可改善结构化转换预测这一较窄的声明，但尚未建立法律级可靠性。论文还规定了针对基于证据的法律工作流的验证协议，包括校准、人类监督和主权本地部署等要求。

Abstract: Although professional workflows leverage large language models widely, the interpretation for auditing unconstrained free-text generation is usually intractable if such generation demands legal, operational or financial workflow. We hereby demonstrate a text based system called SerenAI - inspired by world-models, it is a state transition system that outputs verifiable predictions rather than merely text: Provided with a description of the environment, state, and actions, the generated output contains 4 items: causal deltas that causally effect the given state, a next state that can logically follow from the given state and action, a validity reward, and a termination signal. For the released proto-model, we employ 2 steps of adaptation training, namely parameter efficient fine-tuning followed by verifier based RL over 50,000 exampled cause and effects in 12 environments spanning 10 reasoning domains. Compared to an initial internal evaluation of an 8B open-weight baseline, SerenAI increased JSON validity from 85.0% to 93.2%, schema validity from 55.0% to 84.0%, exact structured-output match from 0.0% to 41.5%, causal-delta exact match from 0.0% to 41.5%, resulting-state exact match from 0.0% to 42.0%, reward exact match from 1.0% to 80.5%, and termination exact match from 38.0% to 81.5%. These support the narrower claim that verifier-compatible adaptation can improve structured transition prediction. They do not yet establish legal-grade reliability. Accordingly, the paper also specifies a validation protocol for evidence-grounded legal workflows, calibration, human oversight, and sovereign on-premise deployment.

</details>


### [801] [A Computational Implementation of a Goal-Directed Theory of Affect](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06654)
*Bernhard Hilpert,Tamás Szűcs,Joost Broekens,Agnes Moors*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了目标导向理论（GDT）情感计算的首次高保真计算实现，将情感视为智能体内部处理循环中差异检测与动作选择相互作用的涌现副产品，并通过骰子/走廊任务模拟验证了复杂情感轮廓（如预期的"上升"与失败的"坠落"）可从简单交互中自然涌现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 情感计算建模长期面临张力：传统的基于快照的评估模型过于描述性，而细粒度、信号驱动的架构往往缺乏适当的心理学基础。本文旨在弥合这一差距，建立一个有心理学依据且细粒度的计算框架。

Method: 采用GDT框架，将情感视为目标差异检测与动作选择之间的持续交互所涌现的功能性副产品，而非事后标签。通过设计骰子/走廊任务等一系列原则性模拟实验，隔离多步目标追求过程中的情感特征与动态。确保每个计算组件都能直接映射到心理学理论的相应组成部分。

Result: 实验表明，复杂的情感轮廓（如预期的"上升"和失败的"坠落"）能从目标差异与动作选择预期之间的简单交互中自然涌现，无需额外的专用模块。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了一个透明、可测试的框架，支持持续的"模拟-实证"研究循环，推动领域从"黑箱"启发式方法转向对情感的细粒度、机制性理解，并将情感整合进智能体行为的核心。

Abstract: Computational modeling of emotion has long faced a tension between descriptive, "snapshot-based" appraisal models and granular, signal-driven architectures that often lack appropriate psychological grounding. This paper addresses this gap by presenting the first high-fidelity computational implementation of the Goal-Directed Theory (GDT) of affect. In this framework, affect is not a post-hoc label but a functional byproduct emerging from the continuous interplay between discrepancy detection and action selection within an agent's internal processing cycles. We evaluate the model through a series of principled simulations (Dice/Corridor tasks) designed to isolate affective signatures and dynamics during multi-step goal pursuit. Results demonstrate that complex affective profiles, like an anticipatory "lift" and a failure "crash", emerge naturally from simple interactions between goal-discrepancy and action-selection expectancies without requiring additional dedicated modules. By ensuring every computational component maps directly to components of the psychological theory, this work establishes a transparent, testable framework that enables a continuous "simulation-empiry" research loop. Our work contributes to moving the field beyond "black-box" heuristics toward a granular, mechanistic understanding of affect, integrated into the core of agent behavior.

</details>


### [802] [We Built a Mirror and Mistook It for a Mind: Causal Liability and the Fallacy of AI Consciousness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06715)
*Afshin Khadangi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文挑战了当代关于机器意识辩论中的隐含假设——即"AI"本身已是可拥有意识的实体。通过区分现象意识、内省报告和人类投射性内省，作者提出生成系统能以一称形式返回人类内在性的语言痕迹，却不一定存在相应的现象承载者，将此称为"AI意识谬误"。随后引入因果责任理论（CLT），其中CLT-I以责任封闭性作为候选承载者的判准，CLT-II则提出更强猜想：责任封闭性是最小现象主体性的充要条件。作者通过跨模型家族的开源权重因果审计进行操作化验证，结果支持CLT-I区分在实验上可处理，并能将因果承载者结构与一称表现分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前机器意识辩论隐含了一个未经检视的前提：把"AI"预设为意识可归属的那类实体。作者希望剥离这一假设，澄清现象意识、内省报告与因果承载者之间的概念混淆，并提供一个可实验检验的框架来区分意识归属、因果承载者个别化与意识构成的本体论问题。

Method: 理论层面：提出AI意识谬误，区分现象意识、内省报告和人类投射性内省；引入因果责任理论（CLT-I与CLT-II）。实验层面：实施开放权重因果审计，涵盖多种模型家族。关键技术手段包括强迫判别以产生持续下游分歧、激活修补以检测因果中介、以及活体与复制自适应状态在匹配随机性下的行为对比、分离重建以在流程替换时保留计算状态但切断构成性连续性与不可委托继承。

Result: 强迫判别产生持续的下游分歧；激活修补显示强因果中介；活体与复制的自适应状态在匹配随机性下行为完全一致；分离重建能在流程替换后保留计算状态，同时在协议上破坏构成连续性与不可委托继承。这些结果表明CLT-I的区分具有实验可追踪性，并能将因果承载者结构与一称表现加以分离。

Conclusion: 该框架将意识归属、因果承载者个别化与意识构成这一独立形而上学问题三者分离，证明AI意识谬误可被实验性地识别与规避，且因果责任理论提供了可操作化的判准来个别化潜在的意识承载者，同时避免将一称语言表现误当作现象意识存在的证据。

Abstract: The contemporary debate over machine consciousness begins from a concealed assumption: that the object called "AI" already constitutes the kind of entity to which consciousness could belong. This paper challenges that assumption by separating phenomenal consciousness, introspective report, and human projective introspection, then arguing that generative systems can return linguistic traces of human interiority in first-person form without thereby identifying a phenomenal bearer. We call the resulting inference the AI Consciousness Fallacy. We then introduce Causal Liability Theory (CLT). CLT-I proposes liability closure as a criterion for individuating a candidate bearer: a physically continuing process becomes the non-delegable inheritor of constraints generated by its own endogenous discriminations. CLT-II advances the stronger conjecture that liability closure is necessary and sufficient for minimal phenomenal subjecthood. An open-weight causal audit operationalizes CLT-I across multiple model families. Forced discriminations produced persistent downstream divergence; activation patching showed strong causal mediation; live and copied adaptive states were behaviorally identical under matched randomness; and detached reconstruction preserved computational state across process replacement while, by protocol, breaking constitutive continuity and non-delegable inheritance. These results show that CLT-I distinctions are experimentally tractable and can dissociate causal bearer structure from first-person performance. The framework therefore separates consciousness attribution, causal bearer individuation, and the independent metaphysical question of consciousness constitution.

</details>


### [803] [Monte Carlo-Based Ex-Ante Assessment of the Green Benefits of an AI-Driven Smart Agriculture Platform in Hainan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06737)
*Zhaoyang Li,Ruijie Zhang,Zhaoji Sun,Lu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究以海南热带农业AI决策平台为对象，构建了从摇篮到农场门的农业碳核算模型，通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估平台干预的绿色价值。结果表明在全面采用下，农药、化肥、灌溉用水和碳强度中位数分别降低23.5%、21.0%、16.5%和21.5%，并建立了可复现的绿色价值事前评估框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能农业平台被视为中国化肥农药减量、节水减碳的关键载体，但缺乏统一的定量框架来评估其绿色价值，需要建立可量化、可校准的评估方法学。

Method: 构建覆盖农药化肥生产、田间N2O、灌溉用电和水稻CH4的cradle-to-farm-gate碳核算模型；将平台干预转化为可量化的传导参数；针对海南三个场景（芒果、冬种蔬菜、水稻/南繁，面积加权40%:30%:30%）进行蒙特卡洛模拟传播参数不确定性，并进行Sobol敏感性分析和收敛性检验。

Result: 全面采用下，农药使用中位数减少23.5%（90%区间15.0%-33.2%），化肥减少21.0%（13.8%-28.9%），灌溉水减少16.5%（10.9%-23.5%），碳强度降低21.5%（16.1%-27.2%）。化肥减量≥15%达标概率90.6%，碳减排明确概率98.1%，但节水≥20%达标概率仅约20%。Sobol分析显示测土推荐和有机替代联合解释约83%的碳强度减排方差。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了可复现、可校准的事前绿色价值评估与试点观测设计方法学，但节水目标的实现需要结合具体场景给出针对性表述。

Abstract: Smart agriculture platforms are widely regarded as key carriers for implementing China's pesticide and fertilizer reduction, water-saving and carbon-reduction agendas, yet a unified quantitative framework for assessing their green value is still lacking. Taking an AI-driven decision platform for tropical agriculture as the object (integrating large-language-model question answering, multimodal pest diagnosis, IoT sensing, satellite remote sensing, and a closed-loop field record system), this study builds a cradle-to-farm-gate agricultural carbon accounting model covering pesticide and fertilizer production, field N2O, irrigation electricity and paddy CH4, translates platform interventions into quantifiable transmission parameters, and propagates parameter uncertainty by Monte Carlo simulation over three Hainan scenarios (mango, winter vegetable, rice/nanfan, area-weighted 40%:30%:30%). Under full adoption, median reductions are 23.5% (90% interval 15.0%-33.2%) for pesticide use, 21.0% (13.8%-28.9%) for fertilizer, 16.5% (10.9%-23.5%) for irrigation water, and 21.5% (16.1%-27.2%) for carbon intensity. Attainment probabilities are high for fertilizer reduction >=15% (90.6%) and clear carbon decline (98.1%), but only about 20% for aggregate water saving >=20%, favoring scenario-specific statements. Sobol first-order indices show soil-test recommendation and organic substitution jointly explain about 83% of the variance of aggregate carbon-intensity reduction. Convergence tests show 10,000 iterations stabilize all statistics; conservative/baseline/optimistic scenario bounds are reported. The framework offers a reproducible, calibration-ready methodology for ex-ante green-value assessment and pilot observation design.

</details>


### [804] [Simulating the Marginal Green Contribution of AI Modules in a Smart-Agriculture Platform: Evidence from Two Monte Carlo Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06740)
*Zhaoyang Li,Ruijie Zhang,Zhaoji Sun,Lu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对智能农业平台将AI诊断、IoT感知与决策推送打包导致各组件绿色效益不明的问题，通过两个受控仿真实验将组件显式化：实验1分解AI能力→农户行为→农资减量链条，证明AI模式较传统农技推广在农药减20%和化肥减15%概率上显著占优；实验2对比现状、IoT工程改造及AI灌溉调度三种方案，显示AI调度额外贡献5个百分点水节约并使稻田甲烷减排达30.5%。敏感性分析表明农户采纳率而非算法精度是达成绿色目标的主要瓶颈。提供了一个组件级绿色价值评估与推广策略优化的可复现仿真框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能农业平台通常将AI诊断、IoT感知和决策推送捆绑成单一产品，导致无法厘清各组件对绿色效益的具体贡献，资源分配决策缺乏定量依据。作者希望从平台级整体评估深入到组件级显性化建模，为平台各功能模块的独立价值评估和优化投入方向提供证据。

Method: 在前期平台级蒙特卡洛评估基础上，本文构建两个受控仿真实验。实验1沿"AI能力→农户行为→农资投入削减"链式建模，将农药/化肥削减分解为可避免盲目施用比例×处方有效性×决策触达率×采纳率的乘积，比较经验农技推广模式与AI模式；实验2对比现状(P0)、IoT工程改造(P1)、P1加AI灌溉调度(P2)三种方案，评估水量节约与稻田甲烷排放，并做敏感性分析考察农户采纳率、诊断精度和土壤水分传感误差的影响。

Result: 实验1：AI模式下达到农药削减20%的概率为20.7%（基线），诊断精度0.95且采纳率0.85时可升至49%，而传统推广模式该概率基本为零；化肥削减15%的概率从接近零提升至52.0%。实验2：中位聚合节水从P0的7.8%升至P1的11.0%和P2的16.0%，AI较纯工程改造额外贡献5.0个百分点；AI调度下稻田CH4减排30.5%，优于人工操作的19.8%，水稻灌溉-甲烷子系统碳强度下降27.9%。两个实验的敏感性分析一致表明：农户采纳率是绿色目标达成的首要瓶颈而非算法精度，且AI数据融合对土壤水分传感误差具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 本研究提供了一套可复现的组件级仿真框架，能够分别量化智能农业平台中AI诊断、IoT感知与决策推送等组件的绿色价值，并识别出农户采纳是制约绿色目标实现的关键瓶颈，从而为平台厂商和政府相关部门在推广策略优化与资源配置上提供定量决策依据。

Abstract: Smart agriculture platforms usually bundle AI diagnosis, IoT sensing and decision push into a single package, so the green benefit attributable to each component remains unclear and resource-allocation decisions lack quantitative evidence. Building on a previous platform-level Monte Carlo assessment, this paper makes the components explicit and runs two controlled simulation experiments. Experiment 1 follows the chain from AI capability to farmer behavior to agrochemical input reduction, modeling pesticide/fertilizer reduction as avoidable blind-application share times prescription effectiveness times decision-touch coverage times adoption rate, and compares an experienced-extension mode with the AI mode: the probability of reaching 20% pesticide reduction is essentially zero in the extension mode but 20.7% at baseline, up to 49% with diagnosis accuracy 0.95 and adoption 0.85 under AI; the probability of 15% fertilizer reduction rises from near zero to 52.0%. Experiment 2 compares current practice (P0), IoT engineering retrofit (P1), and P1 plus AI irrigation scheduling (P2): median aggregate water saving rises from 7.8% (P0) to 11.0% (P1) and 16.0% (P2), with AI adding 5.0 percentage points beyond engineering; paddy CH4 reduction reaches 30.5% under AI scheduling versus 19.8% under manual operation, and the rice irrigation-methane subsystem carbon intensity declines 27.9%. Sensitivity analyses of both experiments consistently indicate that the primary bottleneck for meeting green targets is farmer adoption rather than algorithm accuracy, and that AI data fusion is robust to soil-moisture sensing errors. This work provides a reproducible simulation framework for component-level green-value evaluation and promotion-strategy optimization of smart agriculture platforms.

</details>


### [805] [Reason Through the Latent! Making Latent Visual Reasoning Necessary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06746)
*Suhyeong Park,Junha Jung,Jaewoo Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出因果视觉循环推理（CVRR），通过强制循环计算成为唯一的图像条件路径来进行潜在视觉推理。CVRR从问题隐藏状态初始化循环，反复重读固定视觉证据，并在解码前移除视觉状态和原始多模态KV缓存，确保只有最终循环状态携带图像信息。实验表明该方法在多个基准上保持强劲性能，而兼容的潜在推理器即使重新训练也无法恢复同等视觉能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在视觉推理旨在通过隐藏状态计算而非显式文本思维链进行多模态推理。然而，一个关键问题是：视觉信息存在于潜在状态中，并不保证模型实际依赖该状态产生答案，因为可能存在其他图像条件路径。作者希望区分"潜在信息性"与"实际用于预测的潜在计算"，通过因果约束确保推理真正依赖循环视觉计算。

Method: CVRR（因果视觉循环推理）保持预训练视觉能力的同时，使循环计算成为产生预测所必需的唯一图像条件路径。具体做法包括：(1) 在预训练视觉语言模型融入图像后，从问题隐藏状态初始化循环；(2) 重复更新该状态并反复读取相同的固定视觉证据；(3) 在解码前移除视觉状态和原始多模态KV缓存，确保只有最终循环状态向答案传递图像条件信息。

Result: 在V*、MMVP、BLINK和MME-RealWorld-Lite四个基准上，CVRR在严格接口下保持强劲性能；而兼容的潜在推理器即使在同一约束下重新训练，也无法恢复可比的视觉能力。因果干预实验表明，当问题保持不变时，预测对循环内容仍然敏感，并且持续的视觉证据会因果性地修正循环轨迹。

Conclusion: CVRR成功证明了可以通过架构约束确保潜在推理真正因果地依赖视觉信息，将"潜在信息性"与"实际用于预测的潜在计算"区分开来。该方法为潜在视觉推理提供了一条保证视觉证据被实际使用而不是仅仅存在于隐藏状态的路径，对未来可解释性和可信赖的多模态推理研究具有重要意义。

Abstract: Latent visual reasoning aims to perform multimodal reasoning through hidden-state computation rather than explicit textual chains of thought. However, visual information being present in a latent state does not imply that the model actually relies on that state when producing its answer, especially when alternative image-conditioned paths remain available. We introduce \textbf{C}ausal \textbf{V}isual \textbf{R}ecurrent \textbf{R}easoning (CVRR), which preserves pretrained visual competence while making recurrent computation the required image-conditioned path to prediction. CVRR initializes recurrence from the question hidden state after the pretrained vision-language model has incorporated the image, then repeatedly updates this state while re-reading the same fixed visual evidence. Before decoding, visual states and the original multimodal KV cache are removed so that only the final recurrent state carries image-conditioned information to the answer. Across the $V^*$, MMVP, BLINK, and MME-RealWorld-Lite benchmarks, CVRR retains strong performance under this strict interface, while compatible latent reasoners fail to recover comparable visual competence even when retrained under the same constraint. Causal interventions further show that predictions remain sensitive to recurrent content when the question is held fixed, and that persistent visual evidence causally revises the recurrent trajectory. These results distinguish latent informativeness from latent computation that is actually used for prediction.

</details>


### [806] [Improving Proficiency and Efficiency of Android GUI Agents via Self-Generating Tool Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06792)
*Juyong Lee,Woogyeol Jin,Kimin Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DroidTool框架，通过自生成工具（以Python函数形式操作应用状态）增强Android智能体，采用智能体工作流（包括提议、实现、测试生成与执行、修复）自动化创建工具，并使用关系测试提升测试覆盖率和前置条件准备。实验表明，增强后的GUI智能体在AndroidWorld、B-MoCA和MobileSafetyBench基准上平均性能提升约4.47个百分点，交互次数减少约20.05%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合动作空间（GUI动作+工具动作如API访问）的Android智能体研究不足，主要障碍在于为每个应用手动创建工具成本过高，需要自动化工具生成方法来降低人力消耗。

Method: 提出DroidTool框架，工具以Python函数形式实现并操作应用状态。采用四阶段智能体工作流：提议（proposal）、实现（implementation）、测试生成与执行（test generation and execution）和修复（repair）。在工具验证阶段，构建跨相关工具的关系测试（relational tests），而非单独测试每个工具，从而自然准备测试前置条件并提升测试覆盖率。

Result: 在AndroidWorld、B-MoCA和MobileSafetyBench三个代表性基准上，使用生成工具增强的GUI智能体相比纯GUI智能体，平均性能提升约4.47个百分点，交互次数减少约20.05%。

Conclusion: 自生成工具能够以较低人力成本显著提升Android智能体的性能和效率，关系测试策略是确保生成工具质量的关键方法。

Abstract: Android agents using a hybrid action space that combines GUI actions and tool actions (e.g., accessing application data via APIs) remain largely underexplored, mainly due to the excessive effort required to create tools. To address this gap, we introduce DroidTool, a framework for augmenting the agents with self-generated tools, which are realized as Python functions operating on application states (e.g., a database). To create tools with minimal human labor, DroidTool employs an agentic workflow featuring stages: proposal, implementation, test generation and execution, and repair. Notably, when testing the created tools for verification, it constructs relational tests across relevant tools for natural preparation of appropriate test preconditions and improved test coverage, rather than testing each tool separately. The GUI agents augmented with the generated tools achieved approximately 4.47%p higher performance with approximately 20.05% fewer interactions than the GUI-only agents, averaged across representative benchmarks: AndroidWorld, B-MoCA, and MobileSafetyBench.

</details>


### [807] [Unsound Search with Policy and Value Networks in Legends of Code and Magic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06816)
*Dustin Rubin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了在不完全信息集换式卡牌游戏（LoCM）中使用不可靠（unsound）搜索方法的可行性。作者通过模仿学习亚军策略构建前馈网络，结合对手牌堆先验采样进行搜索，在严格配置下以51.35%胜率击败冠军ByteRL，且搜索加成达到+24.6个百分点，同时该智能体对最佳响应攻击的抵抗能力优于ByteRL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集换式卡牌游戏（CCG）属于具有巨大信念状态空间的不完全信息游戏（LoCM中为2^101），目前冠军智能体ByteRL不使用搜索，且有工作声称由于信念状态数量庞大，基于枚举的搜索在该类游戏中不可用。作者希望验证不可靠搜索在该类游戏中是否可行且有益。

Method: 1) 测量三个先前定义的属性，确认LoCM处于完美信息蒙特卡洛缺陷代价较低的优势区域；2) 通过对亚军NeteaseOPD进行模仿学习，构建策略与价值前馈网络；3) 从对手牌堆先验中采样世界进行搜索（该先验基于亚军选牌构建）；4) 使用LoCM官方裁判与时间限制进行10,000场预注册游戏评估；5) 复制已发表的针对ByteRL的最佳响应攻击，并对自身智能体的两种搜索配置应用相同攻击协议。

Result: 严格配置下，搜索智能体以51.35%（95% CI [50.37, 52.33]）战胜ByteRL。无搜索时该智能体仅得26.8%胜率，加入搜索提升+24.6个百分点。针对最佳响应攻击，两种搜索配置在每次迭代中都比ByteRL抵抗得更好。

Conclusion: 在LoCM这类不完全信息游戏中使用不可靠搜索能够产生更强且更具鲁棒性的智能体，反驳了此前认为此类搜索在该游戏类型中不可行的观点。同时指出不可靠搜索可能被利用，但其在本场景下带来了显著的性能提升与防御韧性。

Abstract: Decision-time search in perfect and imperfect information games with enumerable belief states are effective methods for game AI. Collectible card games are imperfect information games with large belief states. Legends of Code and Magic is a collectible card game competition where the belief states are $2^{101}$. The Legends of Code and Magic (LoCM) champion, ByteRL, plays with no search. Other works claim sound enumeration-based search is unusable in the genre due to the number of belief states. We measured three previously defined properties that predict where theoretically unsound perfect information Monte Carlo's defects are cheap and found LoCM sits in the favorable region. Starting with imitation learning of the runner-up policy, NeteaseOPD, we created a policy and value feed-forward network. Our agent searches over worlds sampled from a prior over the opponent's deck built from the runner-up's drafts. Using our strictest configuration in the battle phase we beat ByteRL with a win percentage of 51.35% 95% CI [50.37, 52.33], over 10,000 pre-registered games using the LoCM official referee and time limit. Search is not a minor factor on the matchup between our agent and ByteRL. Without search this agent scores 26.8% and adding search adds +24.6 points. Unsound search in imperfect information games could be exploitable. We replicate a published best-response attack against ByteRL. We then apply the same attack protocol to two search configurations of our agent, and each one resists it better than ByteRL at every iteration. In LoCM unsound search gives us a stronger and more resilient agent.

</details>


### [808] [Formation of structural attractors in neuromorphic systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06826)
*Yurii Parzhyn,Alexander Schwarzmann,Mykyta Lapin,Kostiantyn Bokhan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究不变结构学习（ISL）理论，提出了一种非优化的概念形成方法，将学习视为超图空间中向结构吸引子的收敛过程，而非全局损失函数的最小化。论文涵盖数学形式化、计算验证和神经生物学解释三个层面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统机器学习依赖全局损失函数的优化方法，而作者希望探索一种基于结构收敛的非优化学习范式，并试图与神经生物学机制建立联系。

Method: 论文分三部分展开：(1) 数学层面形式化结构约简过程，证明有限收敛性、类结构吸引子的存在唯一性及吸引子图的自组织；(2) 计算层面在经典图像识别任务上验证该机制，无需反向传播且仅需极小的训练数据集；(3) 神经生物学层面提出树突树中结构吸引子实现、神经编码作为内部吸引子动力学的投影等可测试假设。

Result: 证明了ISL模型的数学一致性和计算可行性——在极小数据集上、无反向传播条件下成功完成图像识别任务；同时提出了与树突计算、突触可塑性和神经回路结构组织相关的可检验生物学假设。

Conclusion: ISL提供了一种不同于传统优化范式的概念形成理论，具有数学严格性和计算可行性；其神经生物学假说为实验验证提供了明确方向，但明确声明这些机制是可检验的假设而非已确立的生物学事实。

Abstract: This paper examines the theory of Invariant Structural Learning (ISL), which proposes a non-optimization approach to concept formation. Learning is interpreted as convergence to structural attractors in a hypergraph space, rather than as the minimization of a global loss function. The paper presents the ISL model, including its mathematical formalization, computational verification, and a hypothetical neurobiological interpretation. The mathematical section introduces the formal apparatus of the structural reduction process and proves its finite convergence, the existence and uniqueness of class structural attractors, and the self-organization of attractor maps. The computational section demonstrates the feasibility of the proposed approach on classical image recognition tasks, utilizing the proposed learning mechanism without backpropagation and with extremely small training datasets. Finally, the neurobiological section formulates hypotheses regarding the possible implementation of structural attractors in dendritic trees, neural coding as a projection of internal attractor dynamics, and the development of neural architectures supporting the proposed learning concept. These hypotheses are discussed in the context of modern experimental data in the fields of dendritic computations, synaptic plasticity, and the structural organization of neural circuits. The proposed neurobiological mechanisms are presented as testable hypotheses rather than established biological facts. The results demonstrate the mathematical consistency and computational feasibility of the proposed model, while the neurobiological hypotheses outline potential directions for its experimental verification.

</details>


### [809] [NormViz: A Benchmark and Framework for Grounding Multimodal Reasoning in Global Cultures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06831)
*Akhila Yerukola,Fabrice Y Harel-Canada,Simran Khanuja,Abhinav Sukumar Rao,Ashima Suvarna,Nanyun Peng,Saadia Gabriel,Maarten Sap*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出NormViz-Bench基准和NormViz-Train训练数据集，用于评估和提升多模态AI的"视觉规范理解"能力——即通过当地社会规范推理可观察行为的文化意义。基准包含3,268对对比图像（覆盖16个国家），实验显示最强VLM仅达26.6%的正确率，微调后可相对提升高达125%的配对准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文化理解研究仅关注纯文本或视觉物品种类识别（如食物、服饰），缺乏对"通过当地社会规范推理视觉可观察行为"（即视觉规范理解）能力的评估，这一能力是AI服务全球多元文化人群的关键缺口。

Method: 1) 构建NormViz-Bench：3,268对对比图像（6,536张）覆盖16国，每对仅在文化相关行为上变化（物体、属性、空间关系、动作）；图像标注为符合/违反/无关当地社会规范，配对级评估要求两图均正确分类以防浅层捷径。2) 构建NormViz-Train：64k带解释的图像训练数据，用于微调VLM。

Result: 最强VLM（Gemini 3.0 Flash和Qwen2.5 VL 7B）仅分别达到26.6%和21.6%的配对正确率，在识别违规行为和良性文化视觉行为上最为吃力；在NormViz-Train上微调使Qwen3-VL 4B和8B的配对准确率分别相对提升125%和36%，但绝对值仍低于30%。

Conclusion: NormViz-Bench和NormViz-Train将视觉规范理解确立为多模态AI面临的一个具有挑战性且意义深远的前沿方向；尽管绝对性能仍低，微调路线展示了连接视觉感知与文化意义的教学前景。

Abstract: AI systems are used worldwide, but they struggle to serve the needs of culturally diverse populations. Prior work on cultural understanding evaluates AI systems on text-only settings or on visual artifact recognition (e.g. foods, clothing). The ability to reason about visually observable behaviors through local social norms, which we call visual norm understanding, remains unexamined. We introduce NormViz-Bench, a high quality, human-validated benchmark of 3,268 contrastive image pairs (6,536 images) spanning 16 countries. Each pair varies only in the culturally relevant behavior (e.g., objects, attributes, spatial relations, and actions) that alters how each image is interpreted. Each image is labeled as conforming to, violating, or irrelevant to local social norms, and pair-level evaluation requires both images to be correctly classified, thereby preventing reliance on superficial visual shortcuts. Even the strongest VLMs, Gemini 3.0 Flash and Qwen2.5 VL 7B, succeed on only 26.6% and 21.6% of pairs, struggling most with identifying violating and culturally benign visual behaviors. Towards bridging this, we introduce NormViz-Train, a training dataset of 64k images paired with explanations. Though absolute performance remains low (<30%), finetuning on NormViz-Train improves pair accuracy relatively by up to 125% and 36% Qwen3-VL 4B and 8B respectively, showing a path forward to teach models to connect visual perception to cultural significance. Together, NormViz-Bench and NormViz-Train establish visual norm understanding as a challenging and consequential frontier for multimodal AI.

</details>


### [810] [Learning transferable human physiology from two million hours of sleep with SleepFM-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06849)
*Rahul Thapa,Christopher Sun,William Theodor Lehn-Schioler,Sophia Claire Kivelson,Umaer Hanif,Hyatt Moore,Harrison G. Zhang,Hafsa Ahmed,Marcus Dige,Niels R. Lorenzen,Elisabeth Roxane M. Heremans,Adrien Specht,Ulysse Gimenez,Robin Guillard,Andreas Brink-Kjaer,James Zou,Emmanuel Mignot*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SleepFM-2是一个基于282,511例多导睡眠监测(PSG)记录(含逾200万小时多模态生理数据)训练的基础模型。相比SleepFM，它在疾病预测、睡眠分期、觉醒/肢体运动/呼吸事件检测上均有提升，并成功迁移至可穿戴传感与主观睡眠表型，展示了跨疾病、临床任务、传感器和主观体验的可迁移健康表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 睡眠是反映健康的窗口，涵盖大脑、心脏、肌肉和呼吸系统的协同活动。现有睡眠基础模型(SleepFM)能力有限，需要更大规模的预训练数据和更全面的任务覆盖，以构建能转移至多疾病预测、多临床任务和多传感器的通用睡眠生理表征。

Method: 在235,865例用于预训练、总计282,511例来自26个队列的PSG记录上训练SleepFM-2。将其PSG表征与年龄、性别、BMI结合进行表型预测，替代传统480特征基线，冻结编码器用于睡眠事件评分，并评估其向可穿戴传感(加速度计、PPG、脑电)和主观睡眠体验的迁移能力。

Result: 模型对215个后续EHR表型在两个留出队列(含一个预训练未见过的医疗系统)中达到预设判别力与显著性标准；155个表型中PSG表征提供了超越人口统计学的可复现增量信息。冻结编码器达到专家评分范围，改善六个加速度计队列的睡眠分期，UK Biobank疾病预测接近直接预训练的模型，并捕捉到传统PSG汇总指标无法恢复的主观睡眠方面。

Conclusion: 多模态睡眠生理学可提供跨疾病、临床任务、传感器和主观体验的可迁移人类健康表征，验证了睡眠作为医疗信息整合窗的潜力，为构建通用于健康监测的睡眠基础模型提供了大规模实证支撑。

Abstract: Sleep provides a nightly window into health by capturing coordinated activity across the brain, heart, muscles and respiratory system. We introduce SleepFM-2, a sleep foundation model developed and evaluated on 282,511 polysomnography recordings from 26 cohorts, including 235,865 used for pretraining. These data span more than two million hours of multimodal physiology. Compared with SleepFM, SleepFM-2 improves disease prediction and sleep scoring, supports arousal, limb movement and respiratory event detection, and transfers to wearable sensing and subjective sleep phenotypes. A model combining its PSG representation with age, sex and BMI met a prespecified discrimination and significance criterion for 215 subsequently recorded EHR phenotypes in two held-out cohorts, including one health system unseen during pretraining. For 155 phenotypes, the PSG representation added reproducible information beyond demographics. SleepFM-2 also outperformed a 480-feature baseline derived from the same recordings. Its disease scores revealed a reproducible principal component associated with reduced sigma-band spatial coupling and increased hypnodensity entropy. The frozen encoder performed within the observed range of expert scorers for sleep events and transferred to wakeful EEG, headband and in-ear EEG, wrist PPG and wrist accelerometry. It improved sleep staging across six accelerometry cohorts and achieved disease-prediction performance in UK Biobank similar to models pretrained directly on accelerometry. Finally, SleepFM-2 captured aspects of subjective sleep not recovered by conventional PSG summaries, particularly reports of the recorded night. These results show that multimodal sleep physiology can provide a transferable representation of human health across diseases, clinical tasks, sensors and subjective experience.

</details>


### [811] [A visual large language foundational model for medical image recognition using clinician-oriented social media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06914)
*Lingxuan Hou,Yuhua Xie,Yue Hu,Yan Zhuang,Junqi Li,Chengzhi Xia,Binh Phu Nguyen,Abubakar Siddique,Minh Nguyen,Yao Hou,Yanju Bao,Kexin Liu,Ke Chen,Jianjun Sun,Zeqi Li,Trung Nguyen,Jiangli Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了ThoughtMed-1M，一个包含超过一百万对长格式医学视觉问答（VQA）数据集，通过结合先进大语言模型与临床专家验证的流水线构建。基于此数据集训练的FOLTMed模型在42个医学VQA基准上达到最先进性能（宏准确率85.4%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在医学领域展现出潜力，但其应用受到缺乏能够捕捉临床推理和显式图文对齐的VQA数据集的限制。

Method: 利用脱敏医学图像和面向临床医生的社交媒体上的专家评论，结合先进LLM与临床专家在环验证，构建严格流水线生成ThoughtMed-1M数据集；在此基础上训练FOLTMed基础模型。

Result: FOLTMed在42个医学VQA基准数据集中达到最先进性能，宏准确率85.4%；在事实性和相似性指标上超越最先进模型3-5%。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了一种可扩展的范式，用于推进临床基础多模态LLM研究，并生成了更具临床一致性的响应。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across diverse domains, showing considerable potential in medicine. However, their application in medical settings remains limited by the scarcity of visual question answering (VQA) datasets that capture clinical reasoning and explicit image-text alignment. Here, we leverage de-identified medical images and expert commentaries shared on clinician-oriented social media. By combining an advanced LLM with clinician-in-the-loop verification, we established a rigorous pipeline to construct ThoughtMed-1M, a long-form medical VQA dataset containing over one million VQA pairs and designed to capture structured clinical logic and medical image-text alignment. To demonstrate its utility, we developed a FOundational LLM Trained on ThoughtMed-1M (FOLTMed). FOLTMed achieved state-of-the-art performance across 42 medical VQA benchmark datasets, with a macro accuracy of 85.4%, and generated more clinically coherent responses on the ThoughtMed-1M test set. It outperformed state-of-the-art models by 3--5% across factuality and similarity metrics, highlighting a scalable paradigm for advancing research on clinically grounded multimodal LLMs.

</details>


### [812] [When and Why LLM Causal Priors Help: Closed-Loop Prior Selection for Amortized Causal Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06941)
*Haohao Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个闭环先验选择框架，将LLM蒸馏的因果图注入先验数据拟合计网（PFN）建模为预算约束优化问题，通过廉价训练后评估挑选优胜者再进行完整训练和统计验证。在7.34M参数的Do-PFN上，该框架胜出者取得2.75倍的显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先验数据拟合计网（PFN）的因果效应估计能力主要由合成训练先验决定，而当前先验设计依赖人工手调试错，存在瓶颈。尽管LLM可以生成合理的因果图作为先验素材，但如何注入、注入是否有帮助、增益来源何处等问题缺乏系统化的解决方案。

Method: 提出闭环先验选择框架：将先验注入形式化为一个在候选先验池上的预算约束优化问题。候选先验先进行廉价的后训练，通过以真实域泛化为主导的复合指标评分，胜出者再接受完整训练和配对统计验证。利用LLM蒸馏因果图作为候选先验来源。

Result: 在7.34M参数的Do-PFN上，框架选出胜者获得统计显著的2.75倍性能提升，误差低于未注入的官方基线。相邻监测域泛化显著改善，且没有监控能力退化。机理实验显示增益来自蒸馏图的语义内容而非单纯的结构多样性。

Conclusion: LLM因果先验的使用从人工试错转变为可经验验证的选择问题。该框架结合注入增益的语义依赖性规律，为PFN先验设计提供了系统化、可验证的解决方案。

Abstract: Causal effect estimation asks how an outcome would change under an intervention, and medicine, economics, and public policy all treat it as a foundational task. Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) amortize the task: a model trained on large numbers of programmatically generated synthetic causal tasks reads a new problem's observational data into context and returns an interventional-effect estimate in a single forward pass. The capability of such models is largely determined by the synthetic training prior, which is currently designed by hand, a bottleneck acknowledged by both Do-PFN and CausalPFN. Large language models (LLMs) can now ``draw'' plausible causal graphs for a given domain, suggesting that LLM-distilled graphs could serve as prior material. Whether injecting such graphs helps at all, where any gain comes from, and when injection helps. Practice has so far relied on manual trial and error. We propose a \emph{closed-loop prior selection framework} that casts prior injection as a budget-constrained optimization over a candidate prior pool. Candidates undergo cheap post-training and are scored by a composite metric dominated by real-domain generalization; the winner then receives full training and paired statistical validation. On a 7.34M-parameter Do-PFN, the framework's winner attains a formally significant $2.75\times$ gain on the primary evaluation domain, and its error falls below that of the uninjected official base. Generalization on an adjacent monitoring domain improves significantly, and no monitored capability degrades. Mechanism experiments show that the gain depends on the semantic content of the distilled graph rather than its structural diversity alone does not produce it (directional evidence). With this framework and this regularity in hand, the use of LLM causal priors stops being manual trial and error and becomes an empirically verifiable selection problem.

</details>


### [813] [iBrain: A Unified Foundation Model Reading the Brain from Surface to Spikes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06960)
*Ying Chen,Tiou Wang,Zhifeng Yue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出iBrain，一个统一的基础模型，能够联合学习iEEG与尖峰活动两种异质侵入式神经记录信号。通过信号特定编码器加共享时空Transformer骨干，在7000多小时数据上采用掩码信号重建与通道视图对齐进行预训练，在多项基准上超越单一信号预训练基线，展现了跨记录设置的迁移性与数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经基础模型大多针对单一侵入式记录范式（如iEEG或皮层内尖峰活动）独立开发，缺乏跨异质侵入式信号的联合预训练。由于iEEG与尖峰活动在时空尺度上各有特点，联合学习有望捕捉互补的神经动态信息，但尚未被充分探索。

Method: iBrain采用信号特定编码器以适应iEEG与尖峰活动的不同信号特征，并结合共享的时空Transformer骨干来建模记录通道间及时间维度的依赖关系。预训练在超过7000小时的异质神经记录上进行，使用掩码信号重建与通道视图对齐两个目标，以增强上下文建模能力与跨通道鲁棒性。

Result: iBrain在多个基准上持续优于单一信号预训练基线，达到最先进性能。进一步实验表明，iBrain在不同记录设置间展现出良好的迁移性与数据效率。

Conclusion: 联合预训练于异质侵入式神经记录有助于支撑可扩展的神经建模，并能在不同记录设置与下游任务间提供可迁移的表征，彰显了统一基础模型在神经科学数据处理中的潜力。

Abstract: Invasive neural recordings provide high-fidelity measurements of brain activity, with signals such as intracranial EEG (iEEG) and intracortical spiking activity capturing neural dynamics at different spatial and temporal scales. Yet existing neural foundation models have largely been developed independently for different invasive recording paradigms, leaving joint pretraining across heterogeneous invasive signals underexplored. In this work, we introduce iBrain, a unified foundation model that jointly learns from iEEG and spiking activity. iBrain employs signal-specific encoders to accommodate their distinct signal characteristics and a shared spatiotemporal Transformer backbone to model dependencies across recording channels and time. We pretrain iBrain on over 7,000 hours of heterogeneous neural recordings using masked signal reconstruction and channel-view alignment, promoting contextual modeling of neural dynamics and robustness across different channels. iBrain consistently outperforms single-signal pretraining baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks. Further experiments demonstrate that iBrain exhibits transferability and data efficiency across diverse recording settings. These results highlight the potential of joint pretraining on heterogeneous invasive neural recordings to support scalable neural modeling and transferable representations across recording settings and downstream tasks.

</details>


### [814] [SSP-DMGTimeNet: Physics-Constrained Learning for Spatiotemporal Trajectory Prediction of Vehicle Platoons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06961)
*Yuhang Wang,Kailang Ma,Zirui Li,Mingfeng Fan,Kitae Jang,Changju Lee,Heye Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SSP-DMGTimeNet，一个物理约束的深度学习框架，用于车队时空轨迹预测。该模型通过多尺度时间表征、跨车辆交互特征以及传播延迟感知的因果注意力机制，显式建模扰动沿车队的传播，并通过时域和频域的弦稳定性损失约束训练过程，在保持轨迹预测精度的同时实现物理上稳定的扰动传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跟驰预测方法主要优化轨迹精度，很少考虑预测的扰动是否沿车队真实传播，这可能导致轨迹预测准确但弦不稳定（string-unstable）的结果，即扰动沿车队放大而非衰减，影响实际部署的安全性和可靠性。

Method: 1) 结合多尺度时间表征与跨车辆交互特征捕获复杂时变的车队动力学；2) 提出传播延迟感知的因果注意力机制，显式学习相邻车辆间响应延迟并沿车队累积，建模上游到下游的扰动传播；3) 引入时域和频域的弦稳定性损失，在训练中抑制相邻车辆及任意子车队的扰动放大。

Result: 在HighD数据集上，五车车队的不稳定窗口率为0.65%，最大头尾放大系数为0.898（在真实激励子集上），同时保持具有竞争力的轨迹预测性能。在NGSIM US-101和I-80的零样本评估中，速度MAE分别为1.316 m/s和1.252 m/s，不稳定窗口率分别为3.90%和4.10%。

Conclusion: 加入车队级别的物理约束能够在轨迹预测精度与扰动传播稳定性之间实现有效平衡，验证了物理约束学习框架在车队轨迹预测中的可行性与优越性。

Abstract: Existing car-following prediction methods mainly optimize trajectory accuracy, while rarely considering whether predicted disturbances propagate realistically along a vehicle platoon. This limitation may lead to accurate but string-unstable predictions. We propose SSP-DMGTimeNet, a physics-constrained learning framework for spatiotemporal trajectory prediction of vehicle platoons. The model combines multi-scale temporal representations with cross-vehicle interaction features to capture complex and time-varying platoon dynamics. A propagation-delay-aware causal attention mechanism explicitly models upstream-to-downstream disturbance propagation by learning response delays between adjacent vehicles and accumulating them along the platoon. In addition, time- and frequency-domain string-stability losses relieve disturbance amplification across both adjacent vehicles and arbitrary sub-platoons during training. Experiments on HighD show that SSP-DMGTimeNet achieves an unstable-window rate of 0.65\% for five-vehicle platoons and a maximum head-to-tail amplification of 0.898 on the ground-truth excitation subset, while maintaining competitive trajectory prediction performance. In zero-shot evaluation on NGSIM US-101 and I-80, the model achieves velocity MAEs of 1.316~m/s and 1.252~m/s, with unstable-window rates of 3.90\% and 4.10\%, respectively. These results demonstrate that incorporating platoon-level physical constraints can effectively balance trajectory prediction accuracy and disturbance propagation stability.

</details>


### [815] [RedKnot-MLA: Multi-Head Offline-Online Reuse for DeepSeek-V4 Long-Context Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07008)
*Yang Liu,Zhaokai Luo,Huayi Jin,Ruozhou He,Chenchen Hong,Mingxiao Ma,Biao Zhang,Zhiyong Wang,Boyu Wang,Guanjie Chen,Yifei Liu,Tao Xie,Junhao Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个基于DeepSeek-V4的MLA(多头潜在注意力)头感知复用系统。该系统将不可变文档在离线状态下于规范位置零处理，保留认证的Local-head贡献作为MLA-Off；服务时通过query-side RoPE重定位恢复请求位置，重算Global-head和受保护的Local token行作为MLA-Online，两条路径在共享输出投影前合并，且从不拆分打包的MLA潜在流。FLASH版本使用37个可复用层和56/8 Local/Global分区，Pro-0813使用55层和112/16头。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLA通过一个打包的潜在KV流暴露许多逻辑查询头，这种表示虽然内存高效，但移除了传统逐头复用所假设的物理每头缓存边界。作者旨在解决如何在无物理头边界的情况下实现头感知复用，同时保持内存效率。

Method: 系统采用RedKnot的头感知复用原则的DeepSeek-V4实现：(1)离线处理不可变文档于规范位置零，保留认证的Local-head贡献为MLA-Off；(2)服务时用query-side RoPE重定位恢复文档请求位置；(3)重算小Global-head集和受保护的Local token行作为MLA-Online；(4)两条路径合并后经单一共享输出投影，且打包的MLA潜在流从不拆分。论文详述了因子分解、位置修复、token行闭包、稀疏MoE支持、TP8集成等实现细节。

Result: FLASH版本展示2.02-3.84x的热工件TTFT加速；256K下归档的三数据集研究显示聚合F1提升+3.24个百分点、EM提升+4.16个百分点、分析性主要算子算术节省78.7-79.5%，但有一个数据集F1下降2.81个百分点。另有一项作者报告的256K热工件QPS约2.0x，但因缺少原始并发迹而被标记为初步而非归档证据。

Conclusion: 系统在DeepSeek-V4上成功实现了MLA场景下的头感知复用，在不拆分打包潜在流的前提下获得显著性能提升。作者明确强调了测量边界：区分归档证据与初步结果，指出需结合系统描述的因子分解、位置修复等机制连同测量边界来正确解读这些结果。

Abstract: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) exposes many logical query heads through one packed latent KV stream. This representation is memory efficient, but it removes the physical per-head cache boundary assumed by conventional head-wise reuse. We present our system, a DeepSeek-V4 realization of RedKnot's head-aware reuse principle. Each immutable document is processed offline at canonical position zero; certified Local-head contributions are retained as MLA-Off. At serving time, query-side RoPE relocation restores the document's request position, a small Global-head set and protected Local token rows are recomputed as MLA-Online, and the two paths are merged before a single shared output projection. The packed MLA latent is never split. DeepSeek-V4-Flash uses 37 reusable layers and a 56/8 Local/Global partition, giving a 75.29% analytic logical head-row ceiling; the Pro-0813 profile uses 55 layers and 112/16 heads, giving 78.89%. Frozen Flash operating points show hot-artifact TTFT speedups of 2.02-3.84x. At 256K, the archived three-dataset study reports an aggregate F1 change of +3.24 percentage points, an EM change of +4.16 points, and a 78.7-79.5% analytic major-operator arithmetic saving, while one dataset decreases by 2.81 F1 points. A separate author-reported 256K hot-artifact QPS measurement is approximately 2.0x; because its raw concurrency trace is not included in this bundle, we mark it as preliminary rather than archived evidence. We describe the factorization, position repair, token-row closure, sparse-MoE support, TP8 integration, and the measurement boundaries needed to interpret these results.

</details>


### [816] [Beyond One-Shot Expansion: Contrastive Evidence Exploration for Multi-Hop Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07050)
*JungMin Yun,YoungBin Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个无需训练的、用于多跳问答的检索框架，整合了证据条件探索、逐段落对比细化与覆盖率感知的最终排序，在MuSiQue、HotpotQA和2WikiMultihopQA上取得了检索质量和下游QA性能的一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳问答中的检索高度依赖于逐步发现支持段落，但现有方法依赖单一的检索意图或一次性查询扩展，无法根据新检索到的证据自适应调整，且容易引入噪声或冗余的检索信号。

Method: 提出一个无需训练的多跳检索框架，包含三个关键组件：(1) 证据条件探索——在推理时迭代检索证据并生成针对未解决信息需求的探针；(2) 段落特定对比细化——在离线索引阶段构建段落特定的对比面（相对于语义相近邻居的特征），用于区分相近候选；(3) 覆盖率感知最终排序——选择一组互补的段落以覆盖多样化的证据寻求意图。

Result: 在MuSiQue、HotpotQA和2WikiMultihopQA三个基准数据集上，该框架在检索质量和下游问答性能上均一致优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过对比性内容特征与迭代式证据探索的结合，无需训练即可有效提升多跳检索的适应性和最终问答准确率。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) critically depends on retrieving the evidence necessary for effective reasoning. However, this remains particularly challenging in multi-hop question answering (QA), where supporting passages are often linked through intermediate entities and relations that must be progressively uncovered. Existing retrieval approaches typically rely on a single retrieval intent or one-shot query expansion, limiting their ability to adapt to newly retrieved evidence and potentially introducing noisy or redundant retrieval signals. To address these limitations, we propose a training-free multi-hop retrieval framework that integrates evidence-conditioned exploration, passage-specific contrastive refinement, and coverage-aware final ranking. During offline indexing, the framework constructs passage-specific contrastive facets that characterize each passage relative to its semantically similar neighbors, providing fine-grained signals to distinguish closely related candidates. At inference time, the framework iteratively retrieves evidence, generates probes targeting unresolved information needs, refines candidate relevance using the contrastive facets, and selects a complementary set of passages that collectively cover diverse evidence-seeking intents. Experiments on MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultihopQA demonstrate consistent improvements in retrieval quality and downstream QA performance over baselines.

</details>


### [817] [VST: Verifiable Structured Transport for Auditable Agent-to-Agent Alpha Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07065)
*Yuqi Li,Siyuan Liu,Bingjun Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将LLM多智能体系统中智能体间自由文本通信重构为结构化、类型化、可因果寻址的单播记录协议，使提交的记录流形成可回放、可检查的因果轨迹，并在此之上构建一个带四个类型头部的预测器与事务性"验证-跳跃"控制器。该方法的价值不在于提升准确率，而在于提供可审计性（schema检查、确定性回放、防止信息泄漏）。在CSI 1000样本外测试中，该方法在八个方法中唯一在因子层面保持正的中位数年化收益和Sharpe，但超额收益仍为负，且实验为单次运行、未扣除成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当代LLM多智能体系统中，挖掘代理与评估代理之间的反馈循环依赖自由形式的自然语言消息，这些消息缺乏稳定契约、无法回放，导致A2A阿尔法发现的迭代过程缓慢且不可审计。作者试图通过引入结构化协议来解决这一通信不可复现与不可验证的根本缺陷。

Method: 1) 将通信重构为类型化、因果可寻址、单播记录的结构化A2A协议，形成可提交的因果轨迹；2) 在该轨迹上部署一个四类型头部的单一预测器，提前若干周期预测两个挖掘代理将获得的累积指导；3) 引入事务性"验证-跳跃"控制器，仅在通过四级门控后才提交多周期投机结果，否则回滚至精确的先前状态。

Result: 在CSI 1000样本外测试中，单次运行显示该方法在八种方法中唯一在因子层面保持正的中位数年化收益与Sharpe比率；其开发集选出的前20投资组合在样本外达到0.71的中位数Sharpe。然而，所有方法（包括本方法）的基准超额收益中位数均为负，且作者明确指出这些是单次运行的描述性结果，未扣除成本，也未隔离跳跃机制相对于继承搜索基底的独立效果。

Conclusion: 本工作的核心贡献是结构化（而非准确率）：类型化通信提供了可schema检查、可确定性回放、并可从构造上防止预测泄漏给评估器的状态——即"由构造保证的可审计性"，而非依赖经验压力测试的保证。作者对实验局限性保持透明，并将跳跃机制效果的隔离分析留待未来工作。

Abstract: Agent-to-agent (A2A) alpha discovery is slowed by repeated feedback cycles between mining and evaluation agents, whose hand-offs, in contemporary LLM multi-agent systems, are free-form natural-language messages that carry no stable contract and cannot be replayed. We first restructure this communication as a structured agent-to-agent protocol of \emph{typed, causally addressable, unicast records}, so that the committed stream forms a causal trajectory. On that trajectory a single predictor with four typed heads forecasts the accumulated guidance the two miners would receive several cycles ahead; a transactional verify--leap controller then commits a multi-cycle speculative outcome only when it passes a four-level gate, and otherwise rolls back to the exact prior state. Structure is the enabling contribution, and its value is not accuracy. A controlled ablation shows an equal-information free-text channel reaches the same predictor hit rate. What typing provides is a state that can be schema-checked, replayed deterministically, and prevented by construction from leaking a forecast to an evaluator: auditability by construction, not an empirically stress-tested guarantee. On a CSI~1000 out-of-sample holdout, our single run is the only one among eight methods (seven baselines and ours) to hold a positive median annualized return and Sharpe at the factor level, though the median return \emph{in excess} of the benchmark stays negative for every method including ours; its development-selected top-20 portfolios reach a $0.71$ median holdout Sharpe, selected on a split inside the optimization horizon. We report these single-run results descriptively, gross of costs, and are explicit about their limits throughout; in particular we do not isolate the effect of the leap machinery from the inherited search substrate, which we leave to future work.

</details>


### [818] [A Hierarchical Consistency Framework for Auditing Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07075)
*Ramon Gonzalez,Antonio Diaz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出层次一致性框架（HCF），一种后验的、模型无关的RAG审计方法，从知识库、检索上下文和生成答案三个层次诊断RAG过程中的矛盾证据，并提供可归因、可检视的一致性评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG评估仅关注最终答案是否正确，但答案正确并不代表推理过程无矛盾——检索上下文中可能包含直接矛盾的证据，而仅靠答案审查或检索相关性分数无法发现这些问题。因此需要一个超越答案正确性的、检视证据一致性的评估框架。

Method: HCF包含三个诊断层次：（1）知识库层：将语料冲突表示为带来源链接的原子事实，识别导致矛盾的责任文档；（2）检索上下文层：检视最终检索到的上下文中是否存在相互矛盾的陈述；（3）答案层：为每个答案计算Answer Consistency Score（ACS），并附带支持性与矛盾性上下文语句的解释说明。HCF是后验的、模型无关的审计框架。

Result: 在跨越五个领域、100个查询-语料实例的受控语料上评估。结果显示三个诊断层次可以相互分离：检索相似度均值最高的语料其ACS均值反而最低；结构退化的语料在语料层表现更差但在答案层表现更好。最关键的是，在多个答案与ground truth匹配的案例中，HCF仍识别出了检索上下文中的矛盾证据。

Conclusion: HCF不声称认证事实真伪，而是使支撑和质疑答案的证据可检视、可归因，填补了现有RAG评估中忽视"证据一致性"的空白。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is commonly evaluated by whether the final answer is correct. That test is insufficient: an answer can match its reference while the context that produced it contains a direct contradiction, leaving the contested evidence invisible to answer-only review and retrieval relevance scores. This paper presents the Hierarchical Consistency Framework (HCF), a post-hoc, model-agnostic audit of three distinct levels of a RAG process: the knowledge corpus, the final retrieved context, and the generated answer. HCF represents corpus conflicts as source-linked atomic facts, thereby identifying the documents responsible, and returns each Answer Consistency Score (ACS) with an explanation of supporting and contradictory contextual statements. We evaluate HCF on several controlled corpora spanning five domains and 100 query-corpus instances. A human evaluator compares every generated response with its supplied ground-truth response. The results show that the three diagnostic levels can dissociate: the corpus with the highest mean retrieval similarity has the lowest mean ACS, while a structurally degraded corpus performs worse at corpus level but better at answer level. Most importantly, HCF identifies contradictory retrieved evidence in several cases where the answer still matches the ground truth. HCF does not certify factual truth; it makes the evidence supporting and challenging an answer inspectable and attributable.

</details>


### [819] [Risk Is Not Review Value: Wrong-Answer Exposure Under Bounded Review Budgets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07095)
*SangJin Park,Myungsub Choi,Jineok Kim,Minseung Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将有界审查预算下的LLM回答审查排序建模为风险暴露减少问题，引入WAER和PRRE两个新指标，在TAT-QA/SciFact基准上验证了结合错误概率、干预可修复性、影响和成本的排序策略能有效降低修复后残余暴露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM助手生成大量回答，人类在用户看到前难以全部审查。传统评估只关注回答是否错误、无依据或低置信度，但在固定审查预算下，需要回答"先查哪些"。仅凭风险排序不够，因为高风险回答可能难以修复，而中风险回答可直接从证据修正。因此需要将审查优先级建模为暴露减少问题。

Method: 将审查优先级建模为暴露减少（exposure reduction）问题，审查价值综合四个维度：估计错误程度（wrongness）、干预可及性（intervention affordance）、影响（impact）和成本（cost）。提出两个指标：WAER（错误回答暴露比，衡量未审查错误回答占比）和PRRE（修复后残余暴露比，用不重复使用排序分数的基准修复规则衡量残余暴露）。

Result: 在720项的TAT-QA/SciFact压力测试基准上，审查价值排序在20%预算下使回答级WAER几乎不变（0.605 vs 0.600），但将PRRE从0.881降至0.716，显著降低修复后的暴露错误。

Conclusion: 可信赖的LLM评估不仅应衡量错误检测能力，还应衡量有限审查能力如何减少暴露的错误回答。审查排序需考虑可修复性等维度，而不只是错误风险本身。

Abstract: LLM assistants often produce more answers than humans can review before users see them. Most evaluations ask whether an answer is wrong, unsupported, or low-confidence. Bounded review budgets instead ask which answers should be checked first under a fixed review budget. Risk alone is not enough: a high-risk answer may be hard to repair, while a moderately risky answer may be directly correctable from available evidence. For generated-answer evaluation, we model review prioritization as exposure reduction, where review value combines estimated wrongness, intervention affordance, impact, and cost. We evaluate review queues with Wrong-Answer Exposure Ratio (WAER), the fraction of wrong answers left unreviewed, and post-repair residual exposure (PRRE), the fraction still exposed after deterministic benchmark-supported repairs. PRRE uses repairability rules that do not numerically reuse the affordance scores used for ranking. On a 720-item TAT-QA/SciFact stress benchmark, review-value ranking keeps answer-level WAER nearly unchanged at 20% budget (0.605 vs. 0.600) but lowers PRRE from 0.881 to 0.716. These results show that trustworthy LLM evaluation should measure not only error detection, but also how limited review capacity reduces exposed wrong answers.

</details>


### [820] [Beyond Sparse Rewards: A New Benchmark and Structure-Aware Graph Alignment for Micro-Drama Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07107)
*Yixin Qin,Shi-Zhe Chen,Zhiqi Yu,Siyuan Cheng,Tao Cheng,Jinwen Luo,Zheng Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出M-Drama，首个大规模双语微短剧理解基准（含35K+实例、9,138个片段），并针对现有RL奖励信号稀疏的问题提出SAGA图匹配奖励函数，将叙事建模为异构图，通过语义三元组与结构时序解耦匹配提供稠密奖励，实验表明在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微短剧具有超短时长与超高密度情节的特点，给视频理解带来独特挑战，现有基准无法覆盖；同时强化学习虽能提升VLM处理复杂叙事的能力，但现有奖励指标信号稀疏且表面化，无法捕捉精细的角色身份与时间结构。

Method: 1) 构建M-Drama双语微短剧基准（35K实例、9,138片段）；2) 提出SAGA（Structure-Aware Graph Alignment）图匹配奖励函数，将叙事建模为异构图，通过解耦的语义三元组匹配与结构时序匹配计算稠密且严谨的奖励。

Result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上的大量实验表明，SAGA优于现有基线，在开放式准确率与摘要质量上带来显著提升，同时保持有竞争力的跨域泛化能力。

Conclusion: M-Drama填补了微短剧理解基准的空白，SAGA通过图结构感知的稠密奖励有效提升了VLM在复杂叙事理解上的表现，代码已开源。

Abstract: Micro-dramas, characterized by ultra-short durations and hyper-dense storylines, pose unique challenges for video understanding that conventional benchmarks fail to address. To bridge this gap, we introduce M-Drama, the first large-scale bilingual benchmark for micro-drama comprehension, featuring over 35K instances across 9,138 clips. Furthermore, while reinforcement learning can enhance VLMs on complex narratives, existing reward metrics often suffer from sparse and superficial signals, failing to capture intricate character identities and temporal structures. We propose SAGA (Structure-Aware Graph Alignment), a novel graph-matching reward function that models narratives as heterogeneous graphs. SAGA computes dense, rigorous rewards via decoupled semantic triplet and structural temporal matching. Extensive experiments on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct demonstrate that SAGA outperforms existing baselines, delivering substantial improvements in open-ended accuracy and summary quality, while maintaining competitive out-of-domain generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/qyx1121/MDrama_SAGA.

</details>


### [821] [EEG-Driven Decoding Framework for Passenger Hazard Perception in Highly Automated Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07128)
*Yingkai Yang,Ashton Yu Xuan Tan,Bowen Li,Xiaorong Gao,Sifa Zheng,Jianqiang Wang,Xinyu Gu,Yang Zhao,Yuxin Zhang,Sharon X. Huang,Tania Stathaki,Jun Li,Hong Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于脑电图(EEG)的脑机接口(BCI)系统，通过解码乘客的神经反应来辅助自动驾驶汽车(AV)进行风险预测(RP)和危险识别(DI)。系统包含乘客认知模型(PCM)、风险感知序列标注(RSL)和乘客EEG解码策略(PEDS)，其中3D卷积循环神经网络(3D-CRNN)用于联合EEG解码。实验结果显示3D-CRNN在RP任务中达到95.3%的平衡精度，并在跨会话和跨受试者泛化测试中表现良好，建立了用于AV乘客危险感知的EEG解码框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶汽车(AV)的可靠风险评估仍是核心挑战。尽管自动化技术不断进步，但被动乘客的认知信号作为一种非侵入式的辅助信息源，能够在不需主动人工干预的情况下同时提升客观和感知安全性，目前尚未被充分利用。

Method: 提出三个核心组件：(1)乘客认知模型(PCM)用于建模乘客认知状态；(2)风险感知序列标注(RSL)用于改进单受试者危险识别；(3)乘客EEG解码策略(PEDS)整合基于3D卷积循环神经网络(3D-CRNN)的联合EEG解码模型。实验明确将人类建模为乘客角色以匹配真实AV使用场景。

Result: 3D-CRNN在风险预测中达到95.3%±2.7%的平衡精度；结合RSL后，单受试者危险识别从80.9%±3.9%提升至85.0%±3.2%。事件级分析表明3D-CRNN在不同事件类型中均优于其他模型。泛化实验中，跨会话DI达77.0%±5.3%，跨受试者中已见受试者达77.4%±1.1%，未见受试者维持64.9%±8.5%，展示了良好的泛化性和迁移性。

Conclusion: 该研究建立了面向AV乘客危险感知的EEG解码框架，证明乘客认知信号能够为未来AV决策系统和预期功能安全(SOTIF)提供辅助监督，为提升自动驾驶安全性提供了新思路。

Abstract: Reliable risk assessment remains a central challenge for Autonomous Vehicles (AVs). Despite advances in automation, passenger cognition provides a non-intrusive auxiliary signal that improves both objective and perceived safety without requiring active human intervention. We introduce an Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) that decodes passenger neural responses for both Risk Prediction (RP) and Danger Identification (DI), explicitly modeling humans as passengers to match real-world AV use. To achieve this, we propose the Passenger Cognitive Model (PCM), Risk-aware Sequential Labeling (RSL), and the Passenger EEG Decoding Strategy (PEDS), which integrates a 3D Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (3D-CRNN) model for joint EEG decoding. Experimental results show that 3D-CRNN achieves a Balanced Accuracy (BA) of $95.3\% \pm 2.7\%$ in RP and improves single-subject DI from $80.9\% \pm 3.9\%$ to $85.0\% \pm 3.2\%$ with RSL. Event-wise analyses further show that 3D-CRNN consistently outperforms other models across different event types in RP and DI. In generalization experiments, 3D-CRNN achieves $77.0\% \pm 5.3\%$ BA in cross-session DI and $77.4\% \pm 1.1\%$ BA on seen subjects in cross-subject evaluation, while maintaining a $64.9\% \pm 8.5\%$ BA on unseen subjects, demonstrating promising generalizability and transferability across both intra-subject and inter-subject variability. These findings establish an Electroencephalogram (EEG) decoding framework for AV passenger hazard perception and suggest that passenger cognitive signals can provide auxiliary supervision for future AV decision-making and Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF) support.

</details>


### [822] [Encoded Early, Used Late: Where Transformers Begin to Act on an Inferred Partner's Expertise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07139)
*Mika Okamoto,Gabriele Sarti*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探讨Transformer模型中推理属性（对话伙伴的专业水平）的可解码性与因果影响之间的分离现象。通过ExpertCollab语料库（四档专业水平的模型角色之间的多轮研究规划对话），发现伙伴专业水平在早期层最可解码，在网络中点前降至接近随机水平。反事实修补实验表明，在峰值可解码层注入专业差异几乎不影响固定晚期层读数，而在中点后注入则几乎完全传播，两者相差超过一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作已证明直接从输入中陈述的属性在残差流中可线性解码的位置早于其影响输出的位置。本文想探究这一"可读性-因果性"差距是否也存在于模型必须在对话中逐步推断的属性（对话伙伴的专业水平），从而界定读取或引导伙伴条件化行为必须干预的网络位置。

Method: 构建ExpertCollab语料库（四种专业水平的模型角色进行多轮研究规划对话）。采用线性探针在残差流各层检测伙伴专业水平的可解码性；使用反事实修补在峰值可解码层与中点后分别注入专业差异，观察对固定晚期层读出的影响；并加入内容匹配随机对照和免探针诊断验证结论。

Result: 伙伴专业水平在早期层最可解码，在网络中点前降至接近随机水平。在峰值可解码层注入专业差异几乎不改变晚期层读数，而在中点后注入则几乎完全传播，两者差异超过一个数量级。内容匹配随机对照与免探针诊断均将转换点定位于同一早期层，而静态指定属性的对照在整个网络中保持可解码。

Conclusion: 推断出的关系属性在因果激活之前就已充分表征，这界定并限制了任何读取或操控伙伴条件化行为所必须干预的网络深度位置。该研究为理解Transformer内部表示的时间-因果结构提供了新视角，但仅以单模型和合成语料库作为初步演示。

Abstract: A transformer can make an attribute linearly decodable in its residual stream at a depth where that attribute does not yet influence the output.
